## `tests/test_boot.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Isolated tests: no root and no host boot writes."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('boot', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'tools/install-boot.py')
boot = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(boot)


class ConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_splash_preserves_arguments_and_is_idempotent(self):
        text = '# comment\nGRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet rootflags=subvol=@ cryptdevice=UUID=x:root"\nGRUB_TIMEOUT=5\n'
        updated = boot.splash_defaults(text)
        self.assertIn('quiet rootflags=subvol=@ cryptdevice=UUID=x:root splash', updated)
        self.assertEqual(updated, boot.splash_defaults(updated))
        self.assertTrue(updated.endswith('GRUB_TIMEOUT=5\n'))

    def test_dynamic_or_disabled_cmdline_rejected(self):
        for value in ('"$FLAGS"', '"quiet $(touch /tmp/bad)"', '"plymouth.enable=0"'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                boot.splash_defaults('GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT=' + value)

    def test_hook_order_and_idempotence(self):
        for init, crypt in [('udev', 'encrypt'), ('systemd', 'sd-encrypt')]:
            text = f'HOOKS=(base {init} autodetect kms keyboard keymap {crypt} filesystems fsck)\n'
            updated = boot.plymouth_hooks(text)
            self.assertIn(f'{init} plymouth autodetect', updated)
            self.assertEqual(updated, boot.plymouth_hooks(updated))
            self.assertIn(f'keyboard keymap {crypt} filesystems fsck', updated)

    def test_uki_splash_preserves_quoted_arguments(self):
        original = 'quiet  root=UUID=example param="two words"'
        updated = boot.uki_splash_cmdline(original + '\n')
        self.assertEqual(updated, original + ' splash')
        self.assertEqual(boot.uki_splash_cmdline(updated), updated)
        for value in ('quiet nosplash', 'plymouth.enable=0', 'rd.plymouth=0',
                      'quiet -- initarg', 'quiet\nroot=example', '# comment'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                boot.uki_splash_cmdline(value)

    def test_ambiguous_hooks_rejected(self):
        for text in ('HOOKS=($MYHOOKS)', 'HOOKS=(base)', 'HOOKS=(base udev)\nHOOKS+=(encrypt)',
                     'HOOKS=(base udev plymouth-encrypt)', 'HOOKS=(base udev systemd)'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                boot.plymouth_hooks(text)

    def test_remove_only_stock_uki_splash(self):
        stock = ['-S', 'autodetect', '--splash', '/usr/share/systemd/bootctl/splash-arch.bmp']
        self.assertEqual(boot.without_stock_splash(stock), ['-S', 'autodetect'])
        custom = ['--splash', '/custom/logo.bmp']
        self.assertEqual(boot.without_stock_splash(custom), custom)
        self.assertEqual(len(stock), 4)

    def test_limine_theme_leads_and_is_idempotent(self):
        text = ('timeout: 3\nwallpaper: boot():/old.png\nTERM_PALETTE: 000000\n\n'
                '/Arch Linux\n    protocol: linux\n    cmdline: quiet\n')
        themed = boot.limine_theme(text, 'boot():/limine/penumbra/background.png')
        self.assertTrue(themed.startswith(boot.LIMINE_BEGIN + '\n'))
        self.assertIn('wallpaper: boot():/limine/penumbra/background.png\n', themed)
        # The user's copies stay visible but no longer override the block.
        self.assertIn(boot.LIMINE_OFF + 'wallpaper: boot():/old.png\n', themed)
        self.assertIn(boot.LIMINE_OFF + 'TERM_PALETTE: 000000\n', themed)
        rest = text.replace('wallpaper', boot.LIMINE_OFF + 'wallpaper').replace('TERM_PALETTE', boot.LIMINE_OFF + 'TERM_PALETTE')
        self.assertEqual(themed.split(boot.LIMINE_END + '\n\n', 1)[1], rest)
        self.assertEqual(boot.limine_theme(themed, 'boot():/limine/penumbra/background.png'), themed)
        moved = themed.replace(boot.LIMINE_BEGIN + '\n', '', 1) + boot.LIMINE_BEGIN + '\n'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            boot.limine_theme(moved, 'boot():/x.png')

    def test_limine_splash_only_touches_linux_entries(self):
        text = ('timeout: 5\n/Arch Linux\n    protocol: linux\n    cmdline: root=UUID=x rw quiet\n'
                '/+Tools\n//Memtest\n    protocol: efi\n    path: boot():/memtest.efi\n'
                '/Other kernel\n    PROTOCOL: Linux\n    kernel_cmdline: root=UUID=y splash\r\n')
        updated = boot.limine_splash(text)
        self.assertIn('    cmdline: root=UUID=x rw quiet splash\n', updated)
        self.assertIn('kernel_cmdline: root=UUID=y splash\r\n', updated)
        self.assertEqual(updated.replace(' splash\n', '\n'), text.replace(' splash\n', '\n'))
        self.assertEqual(boot.limine_splash(updated), updated)
        for bad in ('/A\n protocol: linux\n cmdline: ${ARGS}\n', '/A\n protocol: linux\n cmdline: quiet nosplash\n',
                    '/A\n protocol: linux\n path: boot():/vmlinuz\n'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                boot.limine_splash(bad)
        uki = '/Arch\n protocol: efi\n path: boot():/EFI/Linux/arch.efi\n cmdline: quiet\n'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            boot.limine_splash(uki, uki=True)
        self.assertEqual(boot.limine_splash(uki.replace('quiet', 'quiet splash'), uki=True), uki.replace('quiet', 'quiet splash'))

    def test_noninteractive_defaults_no(self):
        with patch.object(boot.os, 'isatty', return_value=False), patch('builtins.input') as read:
            self.assertFalse(boot.ask('Apply?'))
            read.assert_not_called()


class IntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        original_path = Path
        def mapped(value):
            value = str(value)
            if value.startswith(('/etc/', '/boot/', '/usr/', '/sys/')) or value in ('/boot', '/etc'):
                return self.root / value.lstrip('/')
            return original_path(value)
        self.mapping = patch.object(boot, 'Path', side_effect=mapped)
        self.mapping.start()
        self.backups = patch.object(boot, 'BACKUPS', self.root / 'backups')
        self.backups.start()
        self.write('/etc/default/grub', 'GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet"\n')
        self.write('/etc/mkinitcpio.conf', 'HOOKS=(base udev autodetect keyboard filesystems fsck)\n')
        self.write('/etc/mkinitcpio.d/linux.preset', "ALL_kver='/boot/vmlinuz-linux'\nPRESETS=('default')\ndefault_image='/boot/initramfs-linux.img'\n")
        self.write('/boot/vmlinuz-linux', 'kernel')
        self.write('/boot/initramfs-linux.img', 'old image')
        self.write('/boot/grub/grub.cfg', "menuentry 'Arch' {\n linux /vmlinuz-linux root=UUID=example quiet\n initrd /initramfs-linux.img\n}\n")
        self.write('/usr/lib/initcpio/install/plymouth', 'hook')
        self.write('/usr/lib/plymouth/two-step.so', 'plugin')
        self.write('/boot/grub/fonts/unicode.pf2', 'font')
        self.original = self.snapshot()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.mapping.stop()
        self.backups.stop()
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def write(self, name, content):
        path = self.root / name.lstrip('/')
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content)

    def snapshot(self):
        return {str(p.relative_to(self.root)): p.read_bytes() for p in self.root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and 'backups' not in p.parts}

    def fake_run(self, *args):
        if args[0] == 'mkinitcpio':
            Path(args[args.index('-U' if '-U' in args else '-g') + 1]).write_text('new image')
        elif args[0] == 'plymouth-set-default-theme':
            self.write('/etc/plymouth/plymouthd.conf', '[Daemon]\nTheme=penumbra\n')

    def fake_subprocess(self, args, **kwargs):
        if args == ['grub-mkconfig']:
            old = (self.root / 'boot/grub/grub.cfg').read_text()
            kwargs['stdout'].write(old.replace(' quiet', ' quiet splash'))
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(args, 0)

    def test_success_stages_images_and_keeps_backup(self):
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), patch.object(boot, 'run', side_effect=self.fake_run), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'run', side_effect=self.fake_subprocess), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', return_value='usr/bin/plymouth\npenumbra.plymouth'):
            boot.apply_plymouth()
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'boot/initramfs-linux.img').read_text(), 'new image')
        self.assertIn('splash', (self.root / 'boot/grub/grub.cfg').read_text())
        backup = next((self.root / 'backups').iterdir())
        boot.restore(backup)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), self.original)

    def test_build_failure_rolls_back_everything(self):
        def fail(*args):
            self.fake_run(*args)
            if args[0] == 'mkinitcpio':
                raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(1, args)
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), patch.object(boot, 'run', side_effect=fail):
            with self.assertRaises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
                boot.apply_plymouth()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), self.original)

    def grub_path(self, args, **kwargs):
        if args[0] == 'grub-probe':
            return 'ABCD-1234\n'
        return args[1].removeprefix('/boot') + '\n'

    def test_grub_preserves_dynamic_uki_menu_and_is_idempotent(self):
        text = '# Custom UKI discovery\nset timeout=7\nset default=saved\ninsmod bls\nblscfg\n'
        self.write('/boot/grub/grub.cfg', text)
        before = self.snapshot()
        with patch.object(boot, 'run'), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'run') as generate, patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', side_effect=self.grub_path):
            boot.apply_grub()
            first = (self.root / 'boot/grub/grub.cfg').read_text()
            self.assertTrue(first.startswith(text))
            self.assertIn('set theme=($penumbra_root)/grub/themes/penumbra/theme.txt', first)
            boot.apply_grub()
            self.assertEqual((self.root / 'boot/grub/grub.cfg').read_text(), first)
            generate.assert_not_called()
        for backup in sorted((self.root / 'backups').iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime_ns, reverse=True):
            boot.restore(backup)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_grub_success_and_restore(self):
        with patch.object(boot, 'run'), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', side_effect=self.grub_path):
            boot.apply_grub()
        self.assertIn('GRUB_THEME=', (self.root / 'etc/default/grub').read_text())
        boot.restore(next((self.root / 'backups').iterdir()))
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), self.original)

    def test_grub_syntax_failure_restores_original(self):
        def fail(*args):
            if args[0] == 'grub-script-check':
                raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(1, args)
        with patch.object(boot, 'run', side_effect=fail), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', side_effect=self.grub_path):
            with self.assertRaises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
                boot.apply_grub()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), self.original)

    def uki_fixture(self):
        self.write('/etc/kernel/cmdline', 'quiet\n')
        self.write('/etc/mkinitcpio.d/linux.preset', "ALL_kver='/boot/vmlinuz-linux'\nPRESETS=('default')\ndefault_uki='/boot/EFI/Linux/arch-linux.efi'\ndefault_options='--splash /usr/share/systemd/bootctl/splash-arch.bmp'\nfallback_uki='/boot/EFI/Linux/arch-linux-fallback.efi'\n")
        self.write('/usr/share/systemd/bootctl/splash-arch.bmp', 'bitmap')
        self.write('/boot/EFI/Linux/arch-linux.efi', 'old uki')

    def test_uki_preset_accepts_disabled_fallback_and_splash(self):
        self.uki_fixture()
        jobs = boot.preset_jobs(self.root / 'etc/mkinitcpio.d')
        self.assertEqual(len(jobs), 1)
        self.assertEqual(jobs[0][1].name, 'arch-linux.efi')
        self.assertEqual(jobs[0][2], ['--splash', '/usr/share/systemd/bootctl/splash-arch.bmp'])

    def test_uki_preflight_rejects_signature_and_changed_arguments(self):
        self.uki_fixture()
        image = self.root / 'boot/EFI/Linux/arch-linux.efi'
        data = bytearray(512)
        data[:2] = b'MZ'
        data[60:64] = (128).to_bytes(4, 'little')
        data[128:132] = b'PE\0\0'
        data[152:154] = b'\x0b\x02'
        image.write_bytes(data)
        secure = self.root / 'sys/firmware/efi/efivars/SecureBoot-8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c'
        secure.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        secure.write_bytes(b'\x07\0\0\0\0')
        self.write('/etc/kernel/cmdline', 'quiet splash\n')
        self.write('/usr/lib/kernel/uki.conf', '# Stock commented template\n#SecureBootPrivateKey=example\n')
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), patch.object(boot, 'uki_section', return_value=b'quiet splash\0'):
            boot.check_uki(image)
            data[296] = 1
            image.write_bytes(data)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Signed or malformed'):
                boot.check_uki(image)
            data[296] = 0
            image.write_bytes(data)
            self.write('/etc/kernel/cmdline', 'quiet\n')
            with patch.object(boot, 'uki_section', return_value=b'quiet\0'):
                boot.check_uki(image)
            self.write('/etc/kernel/cmdline', 'quiet nosplash\n')
            with patch.object(boot, 'uki_section', return_value=b'quiet nosplash\0'):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'explicitly disabled'):
                    boot.check_uki(image)
            self.write('/etc/kernel/cmdline', 'different splash')
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'must match'):
                boot.check_uki(image)

    def test_uki_success_preserves_grub_and_restores(self):
        self.uki_fixture()
        before = self.snapshot()
        def build(*args):
            if args[0] == 'mkinitcpio':
                self.assertIn('-U', args)
                self.assertNotIn('--splash', args)
                self.assertEqual((self.root / 'etc/kernel/cmdline').read_text(), 'quiet splash\n')
                Path(args[args.index('-U') + 1]).write_text('new uki')
            else:
                self.fake_run(*args)
        def section(image, name):
            return b'quiet splash' if name == '.cmdline' else b'initrd'
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), patch.object(boot, 'check_uki'), patch.object(boot, 'uki_section', side_effect=section), patch.object(boot, 'run', side_effect=build), patch.object(boot, 'generate_grub') as generate, patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', return_value='usr/bin/plymouth\npenumbra.plymouth'):
            boot.apply_plymouth()
            generate.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'boot/EFI/Linux/arch-linux.efi').read_text(), 'new uki')
        self.assertNotIn('--splash', (self.root / 'etc/mkinitcpio.d/linux.preset').read_text())
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'etc/default/grub').read_bytes(), before['etc/default/grub'])
        boot.restore(next((self.root / 'backups').iterdir()))
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_uki_commandline_change_rolls_back(self):
        self.uki_fixture()
        before = self.snapshot()
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), patch.object(boot, 'check_uki'), patch.object(boot, 'uki_section', side_effect=[b'wrong', b'quiet splash']), patch.object(boot, 'run', side_effect=self.fake_run):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'embedded kernel command line'):
                boot.apply_plymouth()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_fallback_grub_requires_loader_evidence_and_confirmation(self):
        self.write('/sys/firmware/efi/efivars/LoaderInfo-4a67b082-0a4c-41cf-b6c7-440b29bb8c4f', '')
        info = self.root / 'sys/firmware/efi/efivars/LoaderInfo-4a67b082-0a4c-41cf-b6c7-440b29bb8c4f'
        info.write_bytes(b'\x07\0\0\0' + 'GRUB 2.16\0'.encode('utf-16-le'))
        result = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0, stdout='BootCurrent: 0008\nBoot0008* Solid State Disk\n')
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', return_value=''), patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'run', return_value=result), patch.object(boot, 'run'), patch.object(boot, 'ask', return_value=True) as ask:
            self.assertTrue(boot.grub_detected())
            ask.assert_called_once()
            ask.return_value = False
            self.assertFalse(boot.grub_detected())
            info.write_bytes(b'\x07\0\0\0' + 'systemd-boot\0'.encode('utf-16-le'))
            ask.return_value = True
            self.assertFalse(boot.grub_detected())

    def limine_fixture(self, entries='/Arch Linux\n    protocol: linux\n    path: boot():/vmlinuz-linux\n    cmdline: root=UUID=x rw quiet\n    module_path: boot():/initramfs-linux.img\n'):
        self.write('/boot/limine/limine.conf', 'timeout: 5\n\n' + entries)
        self.write('/boot/limine/limine-bios.sys', 'stage\0Limine 12.9.4 (x86-64, BIOS)\0')
        (self.root / 'boot/grub/grub.cfg').unlink()
        (self.root / 'etc/default/grub').unlink()
        self.original = self.snapshot()
        return self.root / 'boot/limine/limine.conf'

    def limine_patches(self):
        return (patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', side_effect=lambda c: None if c == 'limine-entry-tool' else '/bin/mock'),
                patch.object(boot, 'boot_volumes', return_value=[self.root / 'boot']),
                patch.object(boot, 'mount_of', return_value=self.root / 'boot'))

    def test_limine_detection_needs_version_single_config_and_confirmation(self):
        config = self.limine_fixture()
        which, volumes, mount = self.limine_patches()
        with which, volumes, mount, patch.object(boot, 'ask', return_value=True) as ask:
            self.assertEqual(boot.limine_detected(), config)
            ask.assert_called_once()
            ask.return_value = False
            self.assertIsNone(boot.limine_detected())
            ask.return_value = True
            self.write('/boot/limine/limine-bios.sys', 'stage\0Limine 11.4.1 (x86-64, BIOS)\0')
            self.assertIsNone(boot.limine_detected())
            self.write('/boot/limine/limine-bios.sys', 'stage\0Limine 12.0.0 (x86-64, BIOS)\0')
            self.write('/boot/limine.conf', 'timeout: 1\n')
            self.assertIsNone(boot.limine_detected())

    def test_limine_theme_success_and_restore(self):
        config = self.limine_fixture()
        which, volumes, mount = self.limine_patches()
        with which, volumes, mount:
            boot.apply_limine(config)
            first = config.read_text()
            self.assertIn('wallpaper: boot():/limine/penumbra/background.png\n', first)
            self.assertTrue((self.root / 'boot/limine/penumbra/background.png').is_file())
            self.assertTrue(first.endswith(self.original['boot/limine/limine.conf'].decode()))
            boot.apply_limine(config)
            self.assertEqual(config.read_text(), first)
        for backup in sorted((self.root / 'backups').iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime_ns, reverse=True):
            boot.restore(backup)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), self.original)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'boot/limine/penumbra').exists())

    def test_limine_plymouth_adds_splash_without_grub(self):
        config = self.limine_fixture()
        which, volumes, mount = self.limine_patches()
        with which, volumes, mount, patch.object(boot, 'run', side_effect=self.fake_run), patch.object(boot, 'generate_grub') as generate, patch.object(boot.subprocess, 'check_output', return_value='usr/bin/plymouth\npenumbra.plymouth'):
            boot.apply_plymouth(config)
            generate.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIn('cmdline: root=UUID=x rw quiet splash\n', config.read_text())
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'boot/initramfs-linux.img').read_text(), 'new image')
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'etc/default/grub').exists())
        boot.restore(next((self.root / 'backups').iterdir()))
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), self.original)

    def test_limine_entry_tool_needs_its_own_cmdline(self):
        config = self.limine_fixture()
        self.write('/etc/default/limine', 'KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]="quiet"\n')
        before = self.snapshot()
        _, volumes, mount = self.limine_patches()
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'), volumes, mount, patch.object(boot, 'run') as run:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'KERNEL_CMDLINE'):
                boot.apply_plymouth(config)
            run.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_combined_uki_and_initramfs_preset_is_rejected(self):
        with (self.root / 'etc/mkinitcpio.d/linux.preset').open('a') as f:
            f.write("default_uki='/efi/EFI/Linux/arch.efi'\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            boot.preset_jobs(self.root / 'etc/mkinitcpio.d')

    def test_dropin_is_rejected_before_changes(self):
        self.write('/etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d/custom.conf', 'HOOKS=(custom)')
        before = self.snapshot()
        with patch.object(boot.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/mock'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                boot.apply_plymouth()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

## `tests/test_install.py`

```python
"""Every distribution folder gives install.sh what it needs, and every template fills in."""
import importlib.machinery
import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DISTROS = sorted(p.parent.name for p in (ROOT / 'distro').glob('*/distro.sh'))
SETTINGS = 'settings=([kb_layout]=us [kb_variant]= [kb_options]= [scale]=auto [numlock]=on [shell]=fish)'


def bash(script, distro, *args):
    """Run `script` with install.sh's functions loaded for `distro`; `args` are "$@". HOME is a
    throwaway folder, so nothing can reach your own configuration."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as home:
        return subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', f'source "$0"; DISTRO=$1; shift; load_distro; {script}',
                               str(ROOT / 'install.sh'), distro, *args],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, 'HOME': home})


def templates(distro):
    """The text files install.sh fills in for `distro`."""
    files = [p for folder in (ROOT / 'config', ROOT / 'bin', ROOT / 'share', ROOT / 'distro' / distro)
             for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
    return [str(p) for p in files if b'@@' in p.read_bytes() and b'\0' not in p.read_bytes()]


class Distributions(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_arch_is_supported(self):
        self.assertIn('arch', DISTROS)

    def test_distro_sh_defines_everything(self):
        for distro in DISTROS:
            with self.subTest(distro=distro):
                result = bash('(( ${#PACKAGES[@]} ))', distro)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)

    def test_updates_module(self):
        for distro in DISTROS:
            path = ROOT / 'distro' / distro / 'share/penumbra/updates.py'
            if not path.exists():
                continue
            with self.subTest(distro=distro):
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('updates', path)
                module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(module)
                for source in module.sources():
                    self.assertTrue(source['name'] and source['command'], source)
                self.assertIsInstance(module.notes(), list)
                self.assertTrue(all(name and command for name, command in module.upgrades()))

    def test_templates_fill_in(self):
        for distro in DISTROS:
            with self.subTest(distro=distro):
                result = bash(f'{SETTINGS}; set_placeholders; for f; do render_template "$f"; done',
                              distro, *templates(distro))
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(result.stderr, '')
                self.assertNotRegex(result.stdout, r'@@[A-Z_]+@@')


def settings_defaults():
    """penumbra-settings' DEFAULTS, loaded from the script."""
    loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('penumbra_settings', str(ROOT / 'bin/penumbra-settings'))
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('penumbra_settings', loader)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.DEFAULTS


class SettingsDefaults(unittest.TestCase):
    """install.sh, penumbra-settings and hyprland.lua each know the settings' defaults."""

    def test_installer_matches_penumbra_settings(self):
        # With nothing detected: no keyboard from localectl, and Lia Files installed.
        result = bash('localectl_field() { :; }; lia_files_installed() { true; }; settings=(); detect_settings; '
                      'for key in "${SETTING_KEYS[@]}"; do printf "%s=%s\\n" "$key" "${settings[$key]}"; done', 'arch')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        installer = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in result.stdout.splitlines())
        defaults = settings_defaults()
        self.assertEqual(list(installer), list(defaults), 'SETTING_KEYS and DEFAULTS list different keys or orders')
        self.assertEqual(installer, defaults)

    def test_hyprland_matches_penumbra_settings(self):
        text = (ROOT / 'config/hypr/hyprland.lua').read_text()
        table = re.search(r'local s = \{(.*?)\}\n', text).group(1)
        lua = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+) = "([^"]*)"', table))
        self.assertTrue(lua)
        defaults = settings_defaults()
        self.assertEqual({key: defaults[key] for key in lua}, lua)


# Stand-ins for the apps in apps/ (and systemctl, for the uninstall): each records how it was
# called. bat answers the question install.sh asks it.
STUB = '''#!/bin/sh
echo "${0##*/} $*" >> "$HOME/calls"
[ "${0##*/} $1" = "bat --config-file" ] && echo "$HOME/.config/bat/config"
exit 0
'''
# Your own settings before the install, then two installs: the second must change nothing.
APP_SETUP = '''
runs=$HOME/.local/state/penumbra/backups; PATH=$1:$PATH
mkdir -p ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/abc.default/chrome ~/.config/mpv ~/.config/vesktop/settings ~/.config/btop ~/.config/cava
printf '[Profile0]\\nName=default\\nIsRelative=1\\nPath=abc.default\\n' > ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/profiles.ini
printf '#nav-bar { padding: 0 }\\n' > ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/abc.default/chrome/userChrome.css
printf '/* My content styles */\\n' > ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/abc.default/chrome/userContent.css
printf '[quiet]\\nvolume=50' > ~/.config/mpv/mpv.conf
printf 'color_theme = "Default"\\nupdate_ms = 1000\\n' > ~/.config/btop/btop.conf
echo '{"enabledThemes": ["mine.css"]}' > ~/.config/vesktop/settings/settings.json
printf '[input]\\nmethod = fifo\\n[color]\\nforeground = cyan\\n' > ~/.config/cava/config
git config --file ~/.gitconfig delta.features side-by-side
BACKUP=$runs/20260101-000000; mkdir -p "$BACKUP"; install_app_colors >/dev/null
find ~ -type f ! -path "$runs/*" ! -name calls ! -name first -exec md5sum {} + | sort > ~/first
BACKUP=$runs/20260102-000000; mkdir -p "$BACKUP"; install_app_colors >/dev/null
find ~ -type f ! -path "$runs/*" ! -name calls ! -name first -exec md5sum {} + | sort | diff ~/first - >&2
'''


class AppColors(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_install(self, checks):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as stubs:
            for app in [p.name for p in (ROOT / 'apps').iterdir()] + ['code', 'codium', 'systemctl', 'gsettings']:
                path = Path(stubs) / app
                path.write_text(STUB)
                path.chmod(0o755)
            # Never reach the real Flatpak or desktop settings from installer tests.
            flatpak = Path(stubs) / 'flatpak'
            flatpak.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
            flatpak.chmod(0o755)
            result = bash(APP_SETUP + checks, 'arch', stubs)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, '')
        return result.stdout

    def test_glass_and_cava_preserve_settings_and_restore(self):
        out = self.run_install('''
            python3 -c 'import json,os; s=json.load(open(os.path.expanduser("~/.config/vesktop/settings/settings.json"))); print(s["transparent"], s["enabledThemes"])'
            cat ~/.config/cava/config
            test -s ~/.config/cava/themes/penumbra
            STAMP=later uninstall_user >/dev/null
            cat ~/.config/cava/config
            cat ~/.config/vesktop/settings/settings.json
        ''')
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), [
            "True ['mine.css', 'penumbra.theme.css']",
            '[input]', 'method = fifo', '[color]', "theme = 'penumbra'", 'foreground = cyan',
            '[input]', 'method = fifo', '[color]', 'foreground = cyan',
            '{"enabledThemes": ["mine.css"]}',
        ])

    def test_firefox_content_and_spicetify_install_and_rollback(self):
        out = self.run_install('''
            cat ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/abc.default/chrome/userContent.css
            test -s ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/abc.default/chrome/penumbra-content.css
            test -s ~/.config/spicetify/Themes/Penumbra/color.ini
            test -s ~/.config/spicetify/Themes/Penumbra/user.css
            STAMP=later uninstall_user >/dev/null
            cat ~/.config/mozilla/firefox/abc.default/chrome/userContent.css

        ''')
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), ['@import "penumbra-content.css";',
                                          '/* My content styles */', '/* My content styles */'])

    def test_cava_keeps_named_theme_and_handles_fresh_config(self):
        out = self.run_install('''
            printf '[color]\\ntheme = "my-theme"\\n' > ~/.config/cava/config
            color_cava
            cat ~/.config/cava/config
            rm ~/.config/cava/config
            color_cava

    def test_vesktop_enables_glass_with_existing_theme_or_fresh_settings(self):

            color_vesktop

            rm ~/.config/vesktop/settings/settings.json
            color_vesktop

            python3 -c 'import json,os; s=json.load(open(os.path.expanduser("~/.config/vesktop/settings/settings.json"))); print(s["transparent"], s["enabledThemes"])'
        ''')

    def test_file_manager_detection_preserves_existing_choice(self):
        out = self.run_install('''
            localectl_field() { :; }
            settings=(); detect_settings; echo "${settings[file_manager]}"
            python3 "$ROOT/bin/penumbra-settings" get | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["file_manager"])'
            settings[file_manager]=custom; detect_settings; echo "${settings[file_manager]}"
            missing=(lia-files)

        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), ['io.github.lia.Files', 'io.github.lia.Files', 'custom',

    def test_saved_dolphin_becomes_lia_files_once_installed(self):
        out = self.run_install('''

    def test_folders_open_in_the_installed_file_manager(self):
        out = self.run_install('''

    def test_flatpak_gets_theme_schemes_and_action(self):
        out = self.run_install('''
```

```python
import os

               if p.is_file()), shutil.which('qmltestrunner6'))

        property bool sharp: false
        property int motion: reducedMotion ? 0 : 1
```

## `tests/test_online.py`

```python
"""Network helpers are exercised with fixtures; tests never contact lyrics/weather services."""
import importlib.machinery
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('online', str(ROOT / 'bin/penumbra-online'))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name, loader)
online = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
loader.exec_module(online)


class Online(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.cache = patch.object(online, 'CACHE', Path(self.temp.name))
        self.cache.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.cache.stop)

    def response(self, value):
        return io.BytesIO(json.dumps(value).encode())

    def test_lyrics_encoded_and_cached(self):
        with patch.object(online, 'urlopen', return_value=self.response({'syncedLyrics': '[00:01.25]a', 'plainLyrics': 'a'})) as request:
            first = online.main(['lyrics', 'A & B', 'Étoile', 'An album', '123'])
            self.assertEqual(first['synced'], '[00:01.25]a')
            self.assertEqual(online.main(['lyrics', 'A & B', 'Étoile', 'An album', '123']), first)
            request.assert_called_once()
            query = parse_qs(urlsplit(request.call_args.args[0].full_url).query)
            self.assertEqual(query['track_name'], ['A & B'])
            self.assertEqual(query['artist_name'], ['Étoile'])
            self.assertEqual(query['duration'], ['123'])
            self.assertEqual(request.call_args.kwargs['timeout'], 8)

    def test_missing_lyrics_and_instrumental(self):
        error = HTTPError('https://lrclib.net', 404, 'Not found', {}, None)
        with patch.object(online, 'urlopen', side_effect=error) as request:
            self.assertEqual(online.main(['lyrics', 'missing', 'artist', '', '0'])['status'], 'missing')
            online.main(['lyrics', 'missing', 'artist', '', '0'])
            request.assert_called_once()
        with patch.object(online, 'urlopen', return_value=self.response({'instrumental': True})):
            self.assertTrue(online.main(['lyrics', 'instrumental', 'artist', '', '0'])['instrumental'])

    def test_rate_limit_applies_across_tracks(self):
        error = HTTPError('https://lrclib.net', 429, 'Slow down', {'Retry-After': '3600'}, None)
        with patch.object(online.time, 'time', return_value=1000), patch.object(online, 'urlopen', side_effect=error) as request:
            online.main(['lyrics', 'one', 'artist', '', '0'])
            online.main(['lyrics', 'two', 'artist', '', '0'])
            request.assert_called_once()
            self.assertGreaterEqual(online.read(online.CACHE / 'lyrics/retry.json')['until'], 4600)

    def test_weather_expiry_and_stale_offline(self):
        value = {'current': {'temperature_2m': 15.2, 'apparent_temperature': 14, 'weather_code': 3, 'wind_speed_10m': 8, 'is_day': 1}}
        args = ['weather', '48.86', '2.33']
        with patch.object(online.time, 'time', return_value=10000), patch.object(online, 'urlopen', return_value=self.response(value)):
            self.assertEqual(online.main(args)['current']['temperature_2m'], 15.2)
        with patch.object(online.time, 'time', return_value=11000), patch.object(online, 'urlopen') as request:
            online.main(args)
            request.assert_not_called()
        with patch.object(online.time, 'time', return_value=12000), patch.object(online, 'urlopen', side_effect=URLError('offline')):
            self.assertTrue(online.main(args)['stale'])
        with patch.object(online.time, 'time', return_value=100000), patch.object(online, 'urlopen', side_effect=URLError('offline')):
            self.assertEqual(online.main(args)['status'], 'offline')

    def test_invalid_coordinates_never_request(self):
        with patch.object(online, 'urlopen') as request:
            for coords in [('91', '0'), ('0', '181'), ('nan', '0')]:
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    online.main(['weather', *coords])
            request.assert_not_called()

    def test_bad_payload_and_corrupt_cache(self):
        with patch.object(online, 'urlopen', return_value=self.response({'current': {'temperature_2m': None}})):
            self.assertEqual(online.main(['weather', '0', '0'])['status'], 'offline')
        p = online.CACHE / 'broken.json'
        for text in ['{', '[]', 'null']:
            p.write_text(text)
            self.assertEqual(online.read(p), {})
        self.assertEqual(online.retry_after('Tue, 03 Nov 2026 12:00:00 GMT', 0), 1793707200)
```

## `tests/test_qml_load.py`

```python
"""Compile shell components offscreen without instantiating desktop services.

Only PanelWindow is substituted: Qt offscreen has no Wayland layer-shell backend.
This catches QML API/type errors, not compositor geometry or live input behaviour.
"""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WINDOW = '''import QtQuick
import Quickshell
FloatingWindow {
    component EdgeFlags: QtObject {
        property bool top: false; property bool bottom: false
        property bool left: false; property bool right: false
    }
    property EdgeFlags anchors: EdgeFlags {}
    component Margins: QtObject {
        property real top: 0; property real bottom: 0
        property real left: 0; property real right: 0
    }
    property Margins margins: Margins {}
    property int exclusionMode: 0
    property int exclusiveZone: 0
}
'''
HARNESS = '''import QtQuick
import Quickshell
ShellRoot {
    Timer {
        interval: 100; running: true
        onTriggered: {
            let failed = false;
            for (const name of COMPONENTS) {
                const component = Qt.createComponent(name);
                if (component.status !== Component.Ready) {
                    console.error(name + ": " + component.errorString());
                    failed = true;
                }
            }
            Qt.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
        }
    }
}
'''


@unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('quickshell'), 'needs Quickshell')
class QmlLoad(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shell_components_compile(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='penumbra-load-') as temp:
            stage = Path(temp)
            shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'config/quickshell/penumbra', stage, dirs_exist_ok=True)
            names = ['Bar', 'LookPage', 'WeatherPage', 'Osd', 'Overview', 'Wallpaper', 'ControlCenter',
                     'MonitorPanel', 'WallpaperPicker', 'ScreenFrame', 'SessionMenu', 'Launcher']
            for path in stage.glob('*.qml'):
                path.write_text(path.read_text().replace('PanelWindow {', 'TestPanelWindow {'))
            (stage / 'TestPanelWindow.qml').write_text(WINDOW)
            (stage / 'shell.qml').write_text(HARNESS.replace('COMPONENTS', json.dumps([n + '.qml' for n in names])))
            (stage / 'runtime').mkdir(mode=0o700)
            env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': temp, 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME': temp, 'XDG_CACHE_HOME': temp,
                   'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR': str(stage / 'runtime'), 'QT_QPA_PLATFORM': 'offscreen',
                   'QT_QUICK_BACKEND': 'software'}
            env.pop('HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE', None)
            env.pop('WAYLAND_DISPLAY', None)
            result = subprocess.run(['quickshell', '-p', temp, '--no-color'], env=env,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
```

## `tests/test_shell.py`

```python
"""The shell's JavaScript logic (tests/shell/*.test.mjs, run with Node), and its OKLCH maths
against palette.py's, so swatches in the shell are the colours penumbra-theme renders."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'share' / 'penumbra'))
import palette  # noqa: E402

NODE = shutil.which('node')


@unittest.skipUnless(NODE, 'needs Node.js')
class ShellLogic(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_suites(self):
        result = subprocess.run([NODE, '--test', str(ROOT / 'tests' / 'shell')],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=ROOT)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)

    def test_oklch_matches_palette_py(self):
        grid = [(L / 10, C / 20, H) for L in range(1, 10) for C in range(0, 8) for H in range(0, 360, 30)]
        script = ("import { load } from './tests/shell/load.mjs';"
                  "const O = load('oklch.js');"
                  "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(process.argv[1]).map(c => O.color(...c))));")
        result = subprocess.run([NODE, '--input-type=module', '-e', script, json.dumps(grid)],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        for color, shell in zip(grid, json.loads(result.stdout)):
            python = palette.oklch_to_hex(*color)
            # Python rounds halves to even, JavaScript up: a channel may differ by one.
            difference = max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(palette.rgb255(shell), palette.rgb255(python)))
            self.assertLessEqual(difference, 1, f'{color}: shell {shell}, palette.py {python}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

## `tests/test_showcase.py`

```python
"""Showcase capture owns only its unique windows, including on a failed capture."""
import importlib.machinery
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('showcase', str(ROOT / 'bin/penumbra-showcase'))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name, loader)
showcase = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
loader.exec_module(showcase)


class Showcase(unittest.TestCase):
    def capture(self, fail=False):
        calls, created = [], []
        def run(argv):
            calls.append(argv)
            if argv == ['hyprctl', '-j', 'monitors']:
                return json.dumps([{'name': 'DP-1', 'focused': True, 'activeWorkspace': {'id': 2}}])
            if argv == ['hyprctl', '-j', 'clients']:
                return json.dumps([{'class': 'personal-editor', 'address': '0xabc'}] +
                                  [{'class': cls, 'address': '0x' + str(i)} for i, cls in enumerate(created)])
            if argv[:2] == ['hyprctl', 'dispatch']:
                match = re.search(r'penumbra-showcase-[a-f0-9]+-[0-3]', argv[2])
                if 'exec_cmd' in argv[2] and match:
                    created.append(match[0])
                return 'ok'
            if argv[0] == 'grim':
                if fail:
                    raise RuntimeError('capture failed')
                Path(argv[-1]).write_bytes(b'PNG')
            return ''
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp, patch.object(showcase, 'run', side_effect=run), \
                patch.object(showcase.shutil, 'which', return_value='/bin/tool'), \
                patch.object(showcase.time, 'sleep'), \
                patch.object(showcase.sys, 'argv', ['penumbra-showcase', '--output', temp, '--delay', '0']):
            if fail:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'capture failed'):
                    showcase.main()
            else:
                self.assertEqual(showcase.main(), 0)
                self.assertEqual(len(list(Path(temp).glob('*/desktop.png'))), 1)
        closes = [argv[2] for argv in calls if argv[:2] == ['hyprctl', 'dispatch'] and 'window.close' in argv[2]]
        self.assertEqual(len(closes), 4)
        self.assertFalse(any('0xabc' in expression for expression in closes))
        self.assertEqual(calls[-1], ['hyprctl', 'dispatch', 'hl.dsp.focus({workspace=2})'])

    def test_capture_and_restore(self):
        self.capture()

    def test_capture_failure_still_restores(self):
        self.capture(fail=True)

    def test_dry_run_does_not_connect(self):
        with patch.object(showcase, 'run') as run, patch.object(showcase.sys, 'argv', ['penumbra-showcase', '--dry-run']):
            self.assertEqual(showcase.main(), 0)
            run.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

## `tests/test_theme.py`

```python
"""The palette engine (share/penumbra/palette.py) and penumbra-theme, which renders it into your files."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TEMPLATES = ROOT / 'palette' / 'templates'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'share' / 'penumbra'))
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import palette  # noqa: E402

PALETTES = palette.load(ROOT / 'palette' / 'palette.toml')


class Engine(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_default_hue_gives_the_default_palette(self):
        for mode in palette.MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
                self.assertEqual(palette.generate(PALETTES[mode], palette.BASE_HUE, 1.0), PALETTES[mode])

    def test_named_palettes_keep_contrast_in_both_modes(self):
        for name in palette.PRESETS:
            for mode in palette.MODES:
                colors = palette.preset_palette(PALETTES, mode, name)
                self.assertEqual(set(colors), set(PALETTES[mode]))
                for a, b, least in palette.GUARDS:
                    self.assertGreaterEqual(palette.contrast(colors[a], colors[b]), least, (name, mode, a, b))
        self.assertEqual(palette.preset_palette(PALETTES, 'dark', 'event-horizon')['base'], '#040307')

    def test_light_templates_render(self):
        for template in sorted(p for p in TEMPLATES.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
            with self.subTest(template=template.relative_to(TEMPLATES)):
                text = palette.render(template.read_text(), PALETTES, 'light', template)
                self.assertNotIn('{{', text)

    def test_contrast_everywhere(self):
        """Both modes' defaults, and every accent at every vividness, keep the guarded contrasts."""
        cases = [(mode, None, None) for mode in palette.MODES]
        cases += [(mode, hue, vividness) for mode in palette.MODES for hue in range(0, 360, 10)
                  for vividness in (0, 0.5, 1, 1.3)]
        for mode, hue, vividness in cases:
            colors = PALETTES[mode] if hue is None else palette.generate(PALETTES[mode], hue, vividness)
            for a, b, least in palette.GUARDS:
                with self.subTest(mode=mode, hue=hue, vividness=vividness, pair=(a, b)):
                    self.assertGreaterEqual(palette.contrast(colors[a], colors[b]), least)

    def test_colour_conversion_round_trips(self):
        for value in PALETTES['dark'].values():
            self.assertEqual(palette.oklch_to_hex(*palette.hex_to_oklch(value)), value)

    def test_harmonized_signals_lean_toward_the_accent(self):
        for mode in palette.MODES:
            for hue in range(0, 360, 30):
                plain = palette.generate(PALETTES[mode], hue, 1.0)
                blended = palette.generate(PALETTES[mode], hue, 1.0, harmonize=True)
                for name in palette.HARMONIZED:
                    with self.subTest(mode=mode, hue=hue, name=name):
                        L, C, H = palette.hex_to_oklch(plain[name])
                        L2, _, H2 = palette.hex_to_oklch(blended[name])
                        self.assertAlmostEqual(L, L2, delta=0.01)
                        if C > 0.02:  # a hue that means something
                            self.assertLessEqual(palette.angle(H, H2), palette.HARMONY + 3)  # 8-bit rounding
                            self.assertLessEqual(palette.angle(H2, hue), palette.angle(H, hue) + 3)
                # Everything else is the plain palette.
                self.assertEqual({k: v for k, v in blended.items() if k not in palette.HARMONIZED},
                                 {k: v for k, v in plain.items() if k not in palette.HARMONIZED})
        # A grey accent pulls nothing.
        grey = palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], 150, 0, harmonize=True)
        self.assertEqual(grey, palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], 150, 0))

    def test_icon_colours(self):
        self.assertEqual(palette.icon_colors(palette.BASE_HUE, 1.0), {c: c for c in palette.ICON_COLORS})
        teal = palette.icon_colors(190, 1.0)
        for old, new in teal.items():
            self.assertAlmostEqual(palette.hex_to_oklch(old)[0], palette.hex_to_oklch(new)[0], delta=0.01)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(teal.values())), 3)


def pixels(*colours):
    """A picture made of COLOURS ({'#rrggbb': how many pixels}), as wallpaper_pixels gives it."""
    return [palette.rgb255(value) for colours in colours for value, n in colours.items() for _ in range(n)]


class WallpaperAccents(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_peaks_strongest_first(self):
        # Mostly dark, some teal, less orange, and a speck of green too faint to count.
        found = palette.wallpaper_accents(pixels({'#0b0b10': 4000, '#2a9d8f': 900, '#e76f51': 400, '#40c040': 5}))
        self.assertEqual(len(found), 2)
        self.assertLess(palette.angle(found[0]['hue'], palette.hex_to_oklch('#2a9d8f')[2]), 3)
        self.assertLess(palette.angle(found[1]['hue'], palette.hex_to_oklch('#e76f51')[2]), 3)
        for accent in found:
            self.assertTrue(0.35 <= accent['vividness'] <= 1.3)

    def test_at_most_four_and_apart(self):
        hues = [palette.oklch_to_hex(0.7, 0.12, hue) for hue in range(0, 360, 30)]
        found = palette.wallpaper_accents(pixels({value: 100 + i for i, value in enumerate(hues)}))
        self.assertEqual(len(found), 4)
        for i, a in enumerate(found):
            for b in found[i + 1:]:
                self.assertGreaterEqual(palette.angle(a['hue'], b['hue']), 30)

    def test_grey_gives_one_neutral_accent(self):
        for picture in (pixels({'#808080': 3000, '#202020': 1000}), pixels({'#000000': 100}), []):
            self.assertEqual(palette.wallpaper_accents(picture),
                             [{'hue': palette.BASE_HUE, 'vividness': palette.NEUTRAL_VIVIDNESS}])
        # A little colour in a grey picture gives the neutral accent its hue.
        found = palette.wallpaper_accents(pixels({'#808080': 3000, '#2a9d8f': 30}))
        self.assertEqual(len(found), 1)
        self.assertLess(palette.angle(found[0]['hue'], palette.hex_to_oklch('#2a9d8f')[2]), 3)

    @unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('ffmpeg'), 'needs ffmpeg')
    def test_built_in_wallpapers(self):
        """Penumbra's wallpapers have hand-picked accents; the first is the picture's own hue."""
        shipped = json.loads((ROOT / 'share/penumbra/wallpaper-colors.json').read_text())
        self.assertEqual(set(shipped), {'wallpaper', 'wallpaper-dawn', 'wallpaper-eclipse'} | {p['wallpaper'] for p in palette.PRESETS.values()})
        for name, accents in shipped.items():
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                picture = palette.wallpaper_pixels(ROOT / 'assets' / f'{name}-clean.png')
                found = palette.wallpaper_accents(picture)
                self.assertEqual(palette.wallpaper_accents(picture), found)
                self.assertLess(palette.angle(found[0]['hue'], accents[0]['hue']), 10)
                self.assertTrue(1 <= len(accents) <= 4)
                for accent in accents:
                    self.assertEqual(set(accent), {'hue', 'vividness'})


# Stand-ins for the programs penumbra-theme tells about a change: each records how it was called.
STUB = '#!/bin/sh\necho "${0##*/} $*" >> "$HOME/calls"\n'
STUBS = ['gsettings', 'hyprctl', 'dbus-send', 'pkill', 'fish', 'nvim', 'bat']


def remove(path):
    """Remove the throwaway home. A fade's Hyprland steps may write there for a moment longer; once
    palette.json is gone they stop."""
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(path)
            return
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.1)
    shutil.rmtree(path)


class Command(unittest.TestCase):
    """penumbra-theme in a throwaway home with Penumbra's files installed as install.sh does."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.home = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        self.addCleanup(remove, self.home)
        share = self.home / '.local/share/penumbra'
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'palette', share / 'palette')
        shutil.copy(ROOT / 'share/penumbra/palette.py', share)
        shutil.copy(ROOT / 'share/penumbra/wallpaper-colors.json', share)
        for name in ('penumbra-theme', 'penumbra-corners'):
            (self.home / '.local/bin').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy(ROOT / 'bin' / name, self.home / '.local/bin')
        # The generated files where install.sh puts them, plus optional app themes.
        for template in TEMPLATES.rglob('*'):
            rel = template.relative_to(TEMPLATES)
            if template.is_file() and rel.parts[0] in ('config', 'share'):
                where = '.config' if rel.parts[0] == 'config' else '.local/share'
                target = self.home / where / Path(*rel.parts[1:])
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy(ROOT / rel, target)
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'apps/bat/config', self.home / '.config', dirs_exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'apps/cava/config', self.home / '.config', dirs_exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'apps/lia-files/config', self.home / '.config', dirs_exist_ok=True)
        for version in ('gtk-3.0', 'gtk-4.0'):
            shutil.copy(ROOT / 'config' / version / 'settings.ini', self.home / '.config' / version)
        # The icon theme, as shipped and as installed, and VS Code's copy of the theme extension.
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'share/icons/Penumbra', share / 'icons/Penumbra')
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'share/icons/Penumbra', self.home / '.local/share/icons/Penumbra')
        self.vscode = self.home / '.vscode/extensions/penumbra.penumbra-theme-1.2.0'
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / 'apps/vscode/vsix/extension', self.vscode)
        stubs = self.home / 'stubs'
        stubs.mkdir()
        for name in STUBS:
            (stubs / name).write_text(STUB)
            (stubs / name).chmod(0o755)
        runtime = self.home / 'run'
        runtime.mkdir()
        (runtime / 'nvim.123.0').touch()
        self.env = {'HOME': str(self.home), 'PATH': f'{stubs}:{os.environ["PATH"]}',
                    'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR': str(runtime), 'HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE': 'test'}

    def theme(self, *args, code=0):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.home / '.local/bin/penumbra-theme'), *args],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, env=self.env)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, code, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        return result.stdout

    def files(self):
        return {p: p.read_bytes() for p in self.home.rglob('*')
                if p.is_file() and 'stubs' not in p.parts and '.local' not in p.parts and p.name != 'calls'}

    def calls(self):
        path = self.home / 'calls'
        return path.read_text() if path.exists() else ''

    def wait_for(self, check):
        """Wait up to 3 s for CHECK() to hold, for what penumbra-theme finishes in the background."""
        for _ in range(60):
            if check():
                return
            time.sleep(0.05)
        self.fail(f'gave up waiting; calls:\n{self.calls()}')

    def palette_json(self):
        return json.loads((self.home / '.local/state/penumbra/palette.json').read_text())

    def test_dark_default_changes_nothing(self):
        before = self.files()
        self.theme('restore')
        self.assertEqual(self.files(), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json(), {'mode': 'dark', 'duration': 0, 'colors': PALETTES['dark']})
        self.assertIn('gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme prefer-dark', self.calls())

    def test_light_mode(self):
        self.theme('set', 'mode=light')
        light = PALETTES['light']
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['mode'], 'light')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], light)
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['duration'], 420)
        config = self.home / '.config'
        self.assertIn(f'background {light["base"]}', (config / 'kitty/penumbra-colors.conf').read_text())
        self.assertIn("mode = 'light'", (config / 'nvim/lua/penumbra/palette.lua').read_text())
        self.assertIn('mode = "light"', (config / 'hypr/colors.lua').read_text())
        self.assertIn(light['base'], (config / 'bat/themes/Penumbra.tmTheme').read_text())
        self.assertIn(f"gradient_color_1 = '{light['accentDeep']}'", (config / 'cava/themes/penumbra').read_text())
        self.assertIn(f"gradient_color_4 = '{light['pink']}'", (config / 'cava/themes/penumbra').read_text())
        for version in ('gtk-3.0', 'gtk-4.0'):
            text = (config / version / 'settings.ini').read_text()
            self.assertIn('gtk-theme-name=Breeze\n', text)
            self.assertIn('gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=false\n', text)
        # The shell keeps its compiled-in default; it reads palette.json.
        self.assertEqual((config / 'quickshell/penumbra/palette.js').read_bytes(),
                         (ROOT / 'config/quickshell/penumbra/palette.js').read_bytes())
        calls = self.calls()
        self.assertIn(f'pkill -USR2 -u {os.getuid()} -x cava', calls)
        for call in ('gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme prefer-light',
                     'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme Breeze',
                     'hyprctl eval hl.config(', 'dbus-send --session --type=signal /KGlobalSettings',
                     'pkill -USR1', 'fish -c set -U penumbra_theme',
                     f'nvim --server {self.home}/run/nvim.123.0 --remote-expr'):
            self.assertIn(call, calls)
        # bat's cache is rebuilt in the background.
        self.wait_for(lambda: 'bat cache --build' in self.calls())

    def test_custom_accent(self):
        self.theme('set', 'colors=custom', 'hue=190', 'vividness=0.8')
        colors = palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], 190, 0.8)
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], colors)
        self.assertIn(f'cursor {colors["accent"]}', (self.home / '.config/kitty/penumbra-colors.conf').read_text())
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get')),
                         {'mode': 'dark', 'colors': 'custom', 'hue': 190.0, 'vividness': 0.8, 'pick': 0,
                          'harmonize': False, 'auto': 'dark', 'preset': '',
                          'presets': [dict(id=k, **v) for k, v in palette.PRESETS.items()],
                          'candidates': json.loads((ROOT / 'share/penumbra/wallpaper-colors.json').read_text())['wallpaper']})

    def test_harmonize(self):
        self.theme('set', 'colors=custom', 'hue=190', 'harmonize=true')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], 190, 1.0, harmonize=True))
        self.assertIs(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['harmonize'], True)
        # Penumbra's own colours are never blended.
        self.theme('set', 'colors=default')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], PALETTES['dark'])

    def test_auto_mode(self):
        """mode=auto shows what auto= says; the shell sets that at sunrise and sunset."""
        self.theme('set', 'mode=auto', 'auto=light')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['mode'], 'light')
        self.assertIn("mode = 'light'", (self.home / '.config/nvim/lua/penumbra/palette.lua').read_text())
        self.theme('set', 'auto=dark', '--duration', '2000')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json(), {'mode': 'dark', 'duration': 2000, 'colors': PALETTES['dark']})
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['mode'], 'auto')
        # auto= alone doesn't change a fixed mode.
        self.theme('set', 'mode=light')
        self.theme('set', 'auto=dark')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['mode'], 'light')

    def test_hyprland_borders_step(self):
        """Hyprland's borders step from the colours on screen to the new ones, after penumbra-theme returns."""
        self.theme('restore')
        before = self.calls().count('hyprctl eval hl.config({general')
        self.theme('set', 'colors=custom', 'hue=190')
        accent = palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], 190, 1.0)['accent'][1:]
        self.wait_for(lambda: f'rgba({accent}ee)' in self.calls())
        steps = self.calls().count('hyprctl eval hl.config({general') - before
        self.assertTrue(2 <= steps <= 8, steps)
        # Without a fade, one step.
        before = self.calls().count('hyprctl eval hl.config({general')
        self.theme('set', 'colors=default', '--duration', '0')
        self.assertEqual(self.calls().count('hyprctl eval hl.config({general') - before, 1)

    def test_preset_restore_preview_and_manual_override(self):
        helper = self.home / '.local/bin/penumbra-wallpaper'
        helper.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%s" "$1" > "' + str(self.home / 'scene') + '"\n')
        helper.chmod(0o755)
        self.theme('set', 'preset=solar-corona')
        self.assertEqual((self.home / 'scene').read_text(), 'wallpaper-solar-corona')
        expected = palette.preset_palette(PALETTES, 'dark', 'solar-corona')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], expected)
        self.theme('preview', 'preset=starlight')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['preset'], 'solar-corona')
        self.theme('restore')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], expected)
        self.theme('set', 'hue=210')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['preset'], '')
        self.assertNotEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], expected)

    def test_icons_follow_the_accent(self):
        live = self.home / '.local/share/icons/Penumbra'
        shipped = sorted(ROOT.joinpath('share/icons/Penumbra').rglob('*.svg'))
        self.theme('set', 'colors=custom', 'hue=190')
        teal = palette.icon_colors(190, 1.0)
        icons = ''.join(path.read_text() for path in live.rglob('*.svg'))
        for old, new in teal.items():
            self.assertNotIn(old, icons)
            self.assertIn(new, icons)
        self.assertIn('dbus-send --session --type=signal /KIconLoader', self.calls())
        # The shipped copy stays, and Penumbra's colours bring every icon back.
        self.theme('set', 'colors=default')
        for icon in shipped:
            rel = icon.relative_to(ROOT / 'share/icons/Penumbra')
            self.assertEqual((live / rel).read_bytes(), icon.read_bytes())
            self.assertEqual((self.home / '.local/share/penumbra/icons/Penumbra' / rel).read_bytes(), icon.read_bytes())

    def test_vscode_themes_follow(self):
        self.theme('set', 'colors=custom', 'hue=190')
        dark = palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], 190, 1.0)
        light = palette.generate(PALETTES['light'], 190, 1.0)
        themes = self.vscode / 'themes'
        self.assertIn(dark['accent'], (themes / 'penumbra-color-theme.json').read_text())
        self.assertIn(light['accent'], (themes / 'penumbra-light-color-theme.json').read_text())
        # Open windows reload a theme only when it asks to be watched.
        manifest = json.loads((self.vscode / 'package.json').read_text())
        self.assertTrue(all(theme['_watch'] for theme in manifest['contributes']['themes']))

    def wallpaper(self, name):
        state = self.home / '.local/state/penumbra'
        state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (state / 'wallpaper').write_text(name + '\n')

    def test_wallpaper_colours(self):
        shipped = json.loads((ROOT / 'share/penumbra/wallpaper-colors.json').read_text())['wallpaper-dawn']
        self.wallpaper('wallpaper-dawn')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['candidates'], shipped)
        self.theme('set', 'colors=wallpaper', 'pick=1')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], shipped[1]['hue'], shipped[1]['vividness']))
        # A pick past the last accent takes the last.
        self.theme('set', 'pick=3')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], shipped[-1]['hue'], shipped[-1]['vividness']))
        # A wallpaper that can't be read gives the default colours.
        self.wallpaper('/nowhere/gone.png')
        self.theme('restore')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['colors'], PALETTES['dark'])

    @unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('ffmpeg'), 'needs ffmpeg')
    def test_new_wallpaper(self):
        """penumbra-wallpaper's hook: the theme takes the new wallpaper's strongest accent as it grows in."""
        image = self.home / 'Pictures' / 'sea.png'
        image.parent.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-f', 'lavfi', '-i', 'color=c=0x2a9d8f:s=64x40', '-frames:v', '1',
                        str(image)], check=True)
        self.theme('set', 'colors=wallpaper', 'pick=1')
        self.wallpaper(str(image))
        found = json.loads(self.theme('wallpaper', str(image)))
        self.assertEqual(len(found), 1)
        self.assertLess(palette.angle(found[0]['hue'], palette.hex_to_oklch('#2a9d8f')[2]), 3)
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json(), {'mode': 'dark', 'duration': 1400,
                                               'colors': palette.generate(PALETTES['dark'], found[0]['hue'], found[0]['vividness'])})
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['pick'], 0)
        self.assertIn(f'cursor {self.palette_json()["colors"]["accent"]}',
                      (self.home / '.config/kitty/penumbra-colors.conf').read_text())
        # Found once, then read from the cache.
        cached = list((self.home / '.cache/penumbra/theme').glob('*.json'))
        self.assertEqual(len(cached), 1)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(cached[0].read_text())['accents'], found)
        # A wallpaper that isn't the current one is only looked at.
        before = self.palette_json()
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('wallpaper', 'wallpaper-eclipse')),
                         json.loads((ROOT / 'share/penumbra/wallpaper-colors.json').read_text())['wallpaper-eclipse'])
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json(), before)

    def test_preview_only_touches_the_shell(self):
        before = self.files()
        self.theme('preview', 'mode=light', 'colors=custom', 'hue=30')
        self.assertEqual(self.files(), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['mode'], 'light')
        self.assertEqual(self.palette_json()['duration'], 160)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.theme('get'))['mode'], 'dark')
        self.assertEqual(self.calls(), '')

    def test_bad_values_change_nothing(self):
        for args in (['mode=dim'], ['auto=auto'], ['harmonize=maybe'], ['hue=400'], ['vividness=2'], ['colors=sunset'], ['pick=4'], ['pick=1.5'],
                     ['colors=custom', 'shade=red'], ['nonsense']):
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                self.theme('set', *args, code=2 if '=' in args[0] else 1)
        self.assertFalse((self.home / '.local/state/penumbra/theme.json').exists())

    def test_lia_files_follows_palette_and_flatpak(self):

    def test_lia_files_corners_restore_and_round_trip(self):
```

```python
import importlib.util

    def test_accent_ink_and_interrupted_fades(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            folder = Path(temp)
            preview.stage(folder)
            (folder / 'runtime').mkdir(mode=0o700)
            (folder / 'shell.qml').write_text('''import QtQuick
import Quickshell
ShellRoot {
    function check(ok, message) {
        if (!ok) { console.error(message); Qt.exit(1); }
    }
    Timer { interval: 40; running: true; onTriggered: {
        Settings.reducedMotion = false;
        Theme.show(Theme.makePalette("light", {onAccent: "#ffffff"}), 120);
    } }
    Timer { interval: 250; running: true; onTriggered: {
        check(Qt.colorEqual(Theme.accentInk, "#ffffff"), "Light selection ink is not white");
        Theme.show(Theme.makePalette("dark", {onAccent: "#100d18"}), 400);
    } }
    Timer { interval: 350; running: true; onTriggered: {
        const visibleInk = Theme.accentInk;
        Theme.show(Theme.makePalette("light", {onAccent: "#ffffff"}), 400);
        check(Qt.colorEqual(Theme.accentInk, visibleInk), "Interrupted fade jumped");
        Settings.reducedMotion = true;
        check(Theme.t === 1, "Reduced motion did not settle active fade");
        check(Qt.colorEqual(Theme.accentInk, "#ffffff"), "Reduced motion lost target ink");
        Theme.show(Theme.makePalette("dark", {onAccent: "#100d18"}), 0);
        check(Qt.colorEqual(Theme.accentInk, "#100d18"), "Dark selection ink is incorrect");
        Qt.quit();
    } }
}
''')
            env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': temp, 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME': temp, 'XDG_CACHE_HOME': temp,
                   'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR': str(folder / 'runtime'), 'QT_QPA_PLATFORM': 'offscreen',
                   'QT_QUICK_BACKEND': 'software'}
            env.pop('WAYLAND_DISPLAY', None)
            env.pop('HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE', None)
```

```python
"""Quickshell runtime checks with fake services and a temporary HOME, never the live desktop."""
import importlib.util
import os

import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('preview', ROOT / 'tools/preview-widgets.py')
preview = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(preview)


@unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which('quickshell'), 'needs Quickshell')
class Widgets(unittest.TestCase):

                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)

                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)

            self.assertGreater(Path(temp + '/aesthetics.png').stat().st_size, 10000)

    def test_notes_save_survives_sidebar_lifetime(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            folder = Path(temp)
            (folder / '.local/state/penumbra').mkdir(parents=True)
            (folder / 'runtime').mkdir(mode=0o700)
            shutil.copy2(preview.SHELL / 'Notes.qml', folder)
            (folder / 'shell.qml').write_text('import QtQuick\nimport Quickshell\nShellRoot {\n    property bool notesReady: Notes.ready\n    Timer { interval: 100; running: true; onTriggered: { if (!Notes.ready) { Qt.exit(1); return; } Notes.edit("first draft"); } }\n    Timer { interval: 200; running: true; onTriggered: Notes.edit("kept after closing the sidebar") }\n    Timer { interval: 1200; running: true; onTriggered: Qt.exit(Notes.dirty || Notes.error ? 1 : 0) }\n}\n')
            env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': temp, 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME': temp, 'XDG_CACHE_HOME': temp,
                   'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR': str(folder / 'runtime'), 'QT_QPA_PLATFORM': 'offscreen', 'QT_QUICK_BACKEND': 'software'}
            env.pop('WAYLAND_DISPLAY', None)
            env.pop('HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE', None)
```
