```python
                    raise RuntimeError('Timed out opening ' + command[0])
            time.sleep(args.delay)
            run(['grim', '-o', monitor['name'], str(out / 'desktop.png')])
            if args.video:
                print(f'Recording {args.video}s at 60 fps. Demonstrate panels, Overview and Launcher now.', flush=True)
                with (out / 'recording.log').open('w') as log:
                    recorder = subprocess.Popen(['wf-recorder', '-o', monitor['name'], '-r', '60', '-f', str(out / 'hero.mp4')],
                                                stdout=log, stderr=log)
                    time.sleep(args.video)
                    recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
                    if recorder.wait(timeout=15):
                        raise RuntimeError('wf-recorder failed; see recording.log')
                    recorder = None
                run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-i', str(out / 'hero.mp4'), '-vf', 'fps=30,scale=960:-2',
                     '-loop', '0', '-c:v', 'libwebp_anim', str(out / 'hero.webp')], timeout=120)
            print(out)
    finally:
        if recorder and recorder.poll() is None:
            recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                recorder.wait(timeout=15)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                recorder.terminate()
        try:
            for client in json.loads(run(['hyprctl', '-j', 'clients'])):
                if client.get('class') in classes:
                    dispatch('hl.dsp.window.close({window=' + quote('address:' + client['address']) + '})')
            dispatch('hl.dsp.focus({workspace=' + quote(old_target_workspace) + '})')
            dispatch('hl.dsp.focus({workspace=' + quote(old_workspace) + '})')
        except (RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError, ValueError) as error:
            print('Could not restore showcase workspace: ' + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        sys.exit('penumbra-showcase: ' + str(error))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        sys.exit(130)
```

## `bin/penumbra-terminal`

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run a command in the terminal chosen in Settings → Default apps (terminal= in settings.conf).
# Usage: penumbra-terminal [--class NAME] [--title TITLE] [--hold] [-- COMMAND…]
# Terminals spell these options differently; the ones below are known, others get the command
# through xdg-terminal-exec when it is installed, or kitty.
set -euo pipefail

class="" title="" hold=0
while (($#)); do
    case $1 in
        --class) class=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --title) title=$2; shift 2 ;;
        --hold) hold=1; shift ;;
        --) shift; break ;;
        *) break ;;
    esac
done

# The setting names a desktop file; its Exec= line gives the program.
id=$(sed -n 's/^terminal=//p' "$HOME/.config/penumbra/settings.conf" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
program=""
IFS=: read -ra dirs <<<"${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}:${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}"
for dir in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    file="$dir/applications/${id:-kitty}.desktop"
    if [[ -n $id && -r $file ]]; then
        program=$(sed -n 's/^Exec=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' "$file" | head -n 1)
        break
    fi
done
[[ -n $program ]] && command -v "$program" >/dev/null || program=kitty

kitty_args() {
    [[ -n $class ]] && args+=(--class "$class")
    [[ -n $title ]] && args+=(--title "$title")
    ((hold)) && args+=(--hold)
    args+=(--)
}

args=()
case ${program##*/} in
    kitty) kitty_args ;;
    foot)
        [[ -n $class ]] && args+=(--app-id "$class")
        [[ -n $title ]] && args+=(--title "$title")
        ((hold)) && args+=(--hold) ;;
    alacritty)
        [[ -n $class ]] && args+=(--class "$class")
        [[ -n $title ]] && args+=(--title "$title")
        ((hold)) && args+=(--hold)
        (($#)) && args+=(-e) ;;
    ghostty)
        [[ -n $class ]] && args+=("--class=$class")
        [[ -n $title ]] && args+=("--title=$title")
        ((hold)) && args+=(--wait-after-command)
        (($#)) && args+=(-e) ;;
    wezterm)
        args+=(start)
        [[ -n $class ]] && args+=(--class "$class")
        (($#)) && args+=(--) ;;
    konsole)
        ((hold)) && args+=(--hold)
        (($#)) && args+=(-e) ;;
    *)
        # Unknown terminal: no options, and the command only through xdg-terminal-exec.
        if (($#)) && command -v xdg-terminal-exec >/dev/null; then
            exec xdg-terminal-exec "$@"
        fi
        if (($#)); then
            program=kitty
            kitty_args
        fi ;;
esac
exec "$program" "${args[@]}" "$@"
```

## `bin/penumbra-theme`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Choose Penumbra's theme: dark or light, and the accent colour, for the shell and the apps at once.

The choice is kept in ~/.local/state/penumbra/theme.json. The palette it makes goes to palette.json
next to it, which the shell watches and fades to, and into every colour file Penumbra installed,
rendered again from the templates install.sh keeps in ~/.local/share/penumbra/palette/. Apps that
can reload their colours are told to; the others show them on their next start. Hyprland's
borders step through the fade with the shell, the folder icons take the accent, and VS Code's
Penumbra themes are rewritten in place, which open windows follow.

  penumbra-theme set preset=solar-corona   apply a named palette and matching scene
  penumbra-theme get                     the choice, as JSON
  penumbra-theme set KEY=VALUE...        check, save and apply; nothing changes if one is wrong
  penumbra-theme preview KEY=VALUE...    show a choice in the shell only, without saving it
  penumbra-theme restore                 apply the saved choice again (install.sh, after copying)
  penumbra-theme wallpaper [NAME|FILE]   the wallpaper changed (default: to the current one): print
                                         its accents, and with colors=wallpaper take the strongest

  mode=dark|light|auto  colors=default|custom|wallpaper  hue=0-360 (custom)  vividness=0-1.3
  (custom; 0 is grey)  pick=0-3 (wallpaper: which of its accents, the strongest first)
  harmonize=true|false (custom and wallpaper: signal colours lean toward the accent)
  auto=dark|light  what mode=auto shows now; the shell sets it at sunrise and sunset
  --duration MS    how long the shell fades (default: 420 for set, 160 for preview, 0 for restore,
                   1400 for wallpaper, as long as the wallpaper's transition)

`get` adds the current wallpaper's accents to the choice, as "candidates". They are found in the
picture once (a GIF's or video's most typical frame) and kept in ~/.cache/penumbra/theme/;
Penumbra's own wallpapers have theirs in ~/.local/share/penumbra/wallpaper-colors.json.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HOME = Path.home()
CONFIG = Path(os.environ.get('XDG_CONFIG_HOME') or HOME / '.config')
DATA = HOME / '.local' / 'share'
STATE = HOME / '.local' / 'state' / 'penumbra'
CHOICE = STATE / 'theme.json'
PALETTE_JSON = STATE / 'palette.json'
SHARE = DATA / 'penumbra'
TEMPLATES = SHARE / 'palette' / 'templates'
WALLPAPER = STATE / 'wallpaper'  # penumbra-wallpaper's choice: one of Penumbra's, or a path
CACHE = HOME / '.cache' / 'penumbra' / 'theme'
# The icon theme as Penumbra ships it (install.sh keeps a copy), and the one apps use.
ICONS = SHARE / 'icons' / 'Penumbra'
ICONS_LIVE = DATA / 'icons' / 'Penumbra'
# Where VS Code (Code - OSS, VSCodium) installed Penumbra's theme extension.
VSCODE = [HOME / '.vscode' / 'extensions', HOME / '.vscode-oss' / 'extensions']

sys.path.insert(0, str(SHARE))
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
try:
    import palette  # ~/.local/share/penumbra/palette.py, shared with tools/build-palette.py
except ImportError:
    sys.exit('penumbra-theme: ~/.local/share/penumbra/palette.py is missing; run ./install.sh --user-only.')

BUILT_IN = ('wallpaper', 'wallpaper-dawn', 'wallpaper-eclipse', *(p['wallpaper'] for p in palette.PRESETS.values()))

DEFAULTS = {'mode': 'dark', 'colors': 'default', 'hue': palette.BASE_HUE, 'vividness': 1.0, 'pick': 0,
            'harmonize': False, 'auto': 'dark', 'preset': ''}
DURATIONS = {'set': 420, 'preview': 160, 'restore': 0, 'wallpaper': 1400}
# Templates the engine leaves alone: the shell reads palette.json instead (a new palette.js would
# restart it), and the login screen's files belong to root.
SKIPPED = ('config/quickshell/', 'system/')
# How many colours Hyprland's borders step through during a fade (it can't fade them itself).
BORDER_STEPS = 8
BOOLEANS = {'true': True, 'false': False, '1': True, '0': False}


def problem(key, value):
    """Why VALUE won't do for KEY, or None."""
    if key == 'preset':
        if not isinstance(value, str) or (value != '' and value not in palette.PRESETS):
            return 'Unknown preset: ' + str(value)
    elif key == 'mode':
        if value not in palette.MODES + ('auto',):
            return "Mode should be 'dark', 'light' or 'auto'."
    elif key == 'auto':
        if value not in palette.MODES:
            return "Auto should be 'dark' or 'light'."
    elif key == 'harmonize':
        if str(value).lower() not in BOOLEANS:
            return "Harmonize should be 'true' or 'false'."
    elif key == 'colors':
        if value not in ('default', 'custom', 'wallpaper'):
            return "Colours should be 'default', 'custom' or 'wallpaper'."
    elif key == 'pick':
        if str(value) not in ('0', '1', '2', '3'):
            return 'Pick should be 0 to 3.'

    elif key in ('hue', 'vividness'):
        try:
            number = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return f'{key.capitalize()} should be a number.'
        if key == 'hue' and not 0 <= number <= 360:
            return 'Hue should be 0 to 360.'
        if key == 'vividness' and not 0 <= number <= 1.3:
            return 'Vividness should be 0 to 1.3.'
    else:
        return f"Unknown theme setting '{key}'."
    return None


def typed(key, value):
    if key == 'pick':
        return int(value)
    if key == 'harmonize':
        return BOOLEANS[str(value).lower()]
    return float(value) % 360 if key == 'hue' else float(value) if key == 'vividness' else value


def load():
    """The saved choice; a missing or unreadable file, or a bad value in it, means the default."""
    choice = dict(DEFAULTS)
    try:
        saved = json.loads(CHOICE.read_text())
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        saved = {}
    if isinstance(saved, dict):
        for key, value in saved.items():
            if key in DEFAULTS and not problem(key, value):
                choice[key] = typed(key, value)
    return choice


def shown_mode(choice):
    """dark or light: the mode, or what mode=auto shows at this time of day."""
    return choice['auto'] if choice['mode'] == 'auto' else choice['mode']


def current_wallpaper():
    try:
        return WALLPAPER.read_text().strip() or 'wallpaper'
    except OSError:
        return 'wallpaper'


def wallpaper_accents(name):
    """The accents of wallpaper NAME (one of Penumbra's, or a path), the strongest first, as
    [{'hue', 'vividness'}]; none when it can't be read."""
    if name in BUILT_IN:
        try:
            return json.loads((SHARE / 'wallpaper-colors.json').read_text()).get(name, [])
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return []
    path = Path(name)
    try:
        mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
    except OSError:
        return []
    # Found once per file, like penumbra-wallpaper's first frames, and again when it changes.
    cached = CACHE / (hashlib.md5(name.encode()).hexdigest() + '.json')
    try:
        saved = json.loads(cached.read_text())
        if saved['mtime'] == mtime:
            return saved['accents']
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        pass
    try:
        accents = palette.wallpaper_accents(palette.wallpaper_pixels(path))
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return []
    write(cached, json.dumps({'path': name, 'mtime': mtime, 'accents': accents}) + '\n')
    return accents


def accent(choice, wallpaper=None):
    """The (colors, hue, vividness) palette.resolve makes the choice's palette from: a wallpaper's
    accent is a custom one, and a wallpaper without any gives the default."""
    if choice['colors'] != 'wallpaper':
        return choice['colors'], choice['hue'], choice['vividness']
    accents = wallpaper_accents(wallpaper or current_wallpaper())
    if not accents:
        return 'default', palette.BASE_HUE, 1.0
    picked = accents[min(choice['pick'], len(accents) - 1)]
    return 'custom', picked['hue'], picked['vividness']


def write(path, text):
    """Write TEXT to PATH through a temporary file, only when it changes; True if it did. File
    watchers see one change, and a symbolic link stays one (its target is written)."""
    try:
        if path.read_text() == text:
            return False
    except OSError:
        pass
    path = path.resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name(f'.{path.name}.penumbra-tmp')
    temporary.write_text(text)
    temporary.replace(path)
    return True


def firefox_profiles():
    """Every Firefox profile folder, as install.sh's color_firefox finds them."""
    for root in (HOME / '.mozilla' / 'firefox', CONFIG / 'mozilla' / 'firefox'):
        try:
            lines = (root / 'profiles.ini').read_text().splitlines()
        except OSError:
            continue
        for line in lines:
            if line.startswith('Path='):
                yield root / line[5:]


def vscode_extensions():
    """Each installed copy of Penumbra's VS Code extension. Its themes set VS Code's _watch, so open
    windows show a rewritten theme at once; install.sh installs the extension only."""
    for root in VSCODE:
        yield from sorted(root.glob('penumbra.penumbra-theme-*'))


def targets(rel):
    """Where the template at REL (relative to the templates folder) is installed. Only files that are
    already there count: install.sh decides what is installed, for example an app's colours only
    when the app is."""
    if rel.startswith(SKIPPED):
        return []
    parts = rel.split('/')
    if parts[0] == 'config':
        found = [CONFIG.joinpath(*parts[1:])]
    elif parts[0] == 'share':
        found = [DATA.joinpath(*parts[1:])]
    elif parts[0] == 'apps' and parts[1] == 'firefox':
        found = [profile / 'chrome' / parts[-1] for profile in firefox_profiles()]
    elif parts[0] == 'apps' and parts[1] == 'vscode':
        found = [extension / 'themes' / parts[-1] for extension in vscode_extensions()]
    elif parts[0] == 'apps' and len(parts) > 3 and parts[2] in ('config', 'share'):
        found = [(CONFIG if parts[2] == 'config' else DATA).joinpath(*parts[3:])]
        # yazi's flavor previews code with bat's theme (install.sh's color_yazi).
        if rel == 'apps/bat/config/bat/themes/Penumbra.tmTheme':
            found.append(CONFIG / 'yazi' / 'flavors' / 'penumbra.yazi' / 'tmtheme.xml')
    else:
        found = []
    # Flatpak uses its sandbox XDG paths even when host files are readable.
    sandbox = HOME / '.var/app/io.github.lia.Files'
    if rel == 'apps/lia-files/config/lia-files/penumbra.css':
        found.append(sandbox / 'config/lia-files/penumbra.css')
    elif rel.startswith('share/gtksourceview-5/styles/'):
        found.append(sandbox / 'data/gtksourceview-5/styles' / parts[-1])
    return [path for path in found if path.is_file()]


def render_files(palettes, mode):
    """Render every installed colour file with PALETTES[MODE]; the set of templates whose files changed."""
    changed = set()
    for template in sorted(p for p in TEMPLATES.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
        rel = template.relative_to(TEMPLATES).as_posix()
        paths = targets(rel)
        if not paths:
            continue
        text = palette.render(template.read_text(), palettes, mode, rel)
        for path in paths:
            if write(path, text):
                changed.add(rel)
    return changed


def apply_mode(mode):
    """The settings that follow the mode besides colours: the GTK theme and its dark preference,
    which GTK, libadwaita, Qt and the portal (for web pages) read."""
    dark = mode == 'dark'
    for version in ('gtk-3.0', 'gtk-4.0'):
        path = CONFIG / version / 'settings.ini'
        try:
            text = path.read_text()
        except OSError:
            continue
        text = re.sub(r'(?m)^gtk-theme-name=.*$', 'gtk-theme-name=' + ('Breeze-Dark' if dark else 'Breeze'), text)
        text = re.sub(r'(?m)^gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=.*$',
                      'gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=' + ('true' if dark else 'false'), text)
        write(path, text)
    if shutil.which('gsettings'):
        interface = ['gsettings', 'set', 'org.gnome.desktop.interface']
        # Older GNOME schemas have no prefer-light; default means light there.
        if subprocess.run(interface + ['color-scheme', 'prefer-dark' if dark else 'prefer-light'],
                          capture_output=True).returncode and not dark:
            subprocess.run(interface + ['color-scheme', 'default'], capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(interface + ['gtk-theme', 'Breeze-Dark' if dark else 'Breeze'], capture_output=True)


def hyprland_lua(colors, mode):
    """The Lua that gives a running Hyprland the borders, shadow and blur hyprland.lua makes from colors.lua."""
    c = {key: value[1:] for key, value in colors.items()}
    if mode == 'light':
        shadow, inactive, brightness = f'rgba({c["shade"]}30)', 'rgba(00000022)', '1'
    else:
        shadow, inactive, brightness = f'rgba({c["onAccent"]}88)', 'rgba(00000055)', '0.9'
    return ('hl.config({general = {col = {active_border = {colors = {"rgba(%see)", "rgba(%sbb)"}, angle = 45}, '
            'inactive_border = "rgba(%sff)"}}, decoration = {shadow = {color = "%s", color_inactive = "%s"}, '
            'glow = {color = "rgba(%s40)"}, blur = {brightness = %s}}})'
            % (c['accent'], c['accentDeep'], c['black'], shadow, inactive, c['accentDeep'], brightness))


def fade_hyprland(old, colors, mode, duration):
    """Give a running Hyprland the new borders, shadow and blur. From OLD colours (the palette on
    screen), they step there over DURATION ms alongside the shell's fade, from a child process so
    the files are written meanwhile; a newer palette stops it."""
    steps = min(BORDER_STEPS, duration // 50) if old and old.keys() == colors.keys() and old != colors else 0
    if steps < 2:
        quiet(['hyprctl', 'eval', hyprland_lua(colors, mode)])
        return
    if os.fork():
        return
    try:
        # Nothing to say; the caller (the shell, a test) needn't wait for its output to end.
        null = os.open(os.devnull, os.O_RDWR)
        for fd in (0, 1, 2):
            os.dup2(null, fd)
        start = time.monotonic()
        for step in range(1, steps + 1):
            time.sleep(max(0.0, start + duration / 1000 * step / steps - time.monotonic()))
            try:
                if json.loads(PALETTE_JSON.read_text())['colors'] != colors:
                    break
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                break
            t = step / steps
            eased = 2 * t * t if t < 0.5 else 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 2 / 2  # the shell's InOutQuad
            shown = colors if step == steps else {k: palette.mix(old[k], v, eased) for k, v in colors.items()}
            quiet(['hyprctl', 'eval', hyprland_lua(shown, mode)])
    finally:
        os._exit(0)


def recolor_icons(accent):
    """The folder icons in the accent: Penumbra's icon theme from its pristine copy, each of its
    violets turned as the palette is (ACCENT is resolve's (colors, hue, vividness)). Only the icons
    install.sh installed are written; True if one changed."""
    kind, hue, vividness = accent
    colors = {} if kind == 'default' else palette.icon_colors(hue, vividness)
    pattern = re.compile('|'.join(colors), re.IGNORECASE) if colors else None
    changed = False
    for source in sorted(ICONS.rglob('*.svg')):
        target = ICONS_LIVE / source.relative_to(ICONS)
        if not target.is_file():
            continue
        text = source.read_text()
        if pattern:
            text = pattern.sub(lambda match: colors[match.group().lower()], text)
        changed |= write(target, text)
    return changed


def quiet(command, timeout=5):
    try:
        subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=timeout)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        pass


def reload_apps(colors, mode, changed, icons):
    """Tell the running apps whose files CHANGED (template paths) to read their colours again, and
    the ones that cache icons when ICONS changed."""
    def has(command):
        return shutil.which(command) is not None

    if changed & {'config/kdeglobals', 'share/color-schemes/Penumbra.colors'} and has('dbus-send'):
        quiet(['dbus-send', '--session', '--type=signal', '/KGlobalSettings',
               'org.kde.KGlobalSettings.notifyChange', 'int32:0', 'int32:0'])
    if 'config/kitty/penumbra-colors.conf' in changed and has('pkill'):
        quiet(['pkill', '-USR1', '-u', str(os.getuid()), '-x', 'kitty'])
    if 'apps/cava/config/cava/themes/penumbra' in changed and has('pkill'):
        quiet(['pkill', '-USR2', '-u', str(os.getuid()), '-x', 'cava'])
    # Every running fish sources its colours again when this universal variable changes.
    if 'config/fish/conf.d/penumbra-colors.fish' in changed and has('fish'):
        quiet(['fish', '-c', f'set -U penumbra_theme {time.time_ns()}'])
    if 'config/nvim/lua/penumbra/palette.lua' in changed and has('nvim'):
        runtime = Path(os.environ.get('XDG_RUNTIME_DIR') or f'/run/user/{os.getuid()}')
        for server in runtime.glob('nvim.*'):
            # Only the editors that show Penumbra's colour scheme.
            quiet(['nvim', '--server', str(server), '--remote-expr',
                   'execute(get(g:, "colors_name", "") ==# "penumbra" ? "colorscheme penumbra" : "")'], timeout=2)
    # The rounded or sharp corners are edited into some colour files after they are installed.
    if changed & {'config/fastfetch/config.jsonc', 'config/satty/config.toml'}:
        corners = HOME / '.local' / 'bin' / 'penumbra-corners'
        if os.access(corners, os.X_OK):
            quiet([str(corners), 'restore'])
    if icons:
        if (ICONS_LIVE / 'icon-theme.cache').exists() and has('gtk-update-icon-cache'):
            quiet(['gtk-update-icon-cache', '--quiet', '--force', str(ICONS_LIVE)], timeout=20)
        # KDE apps drop their icon cache.
        if has('dbus-send'):
            quiet(['dbus-send', '--session', '--type=signal', '/KIconLoader',
                   'org.kde.KIconLoader.iconChanged', 'int32:0'])
    # bat's theme cache, which delta reads too; slow, so it finishes in the background.
    if 'apps/bat/config/bat/themes/Penumbra.tmTheme' in changed and has('bat'):
        subprocess.Popen(['bat', 'cache', '--build'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                         start_new_session=True)


def show(colors, mode, duration):
    """Hand the palette to the shell, which fades to it over DURATION ms."""
    write(PALETTE_JSON, json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'duration': duration, 'colors': colors}, indent=1) + '\n')


def apply(choice, duration, everything=True, wallpaper=None):
    try:
        palettes = palette.load(SHARE / 'palette' / 'palette.toml')
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        sys.exit(f'penumbra-theme: {error}; run ./install.sh --user-only.')
    mode = shown_mode(choice)
    picked = accent(choice, wallpaper)
    colors = (palette.preset_palette(palettes, mode, choice['preset']) if choice.get('preset')
              else palette.resolve(palettes, mode, *picked, choice['harmonize']))
    try:
        old = json.loads(PALETTE_JSON.read_text())['colors']
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        old = None
    # The shell first, so it starts fading while the files are written, and Hyprland with it.
    show(colors, mode, duration)
    if not everything:
        return
    if os.environ.get('HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE') and shutil.which('hyprctl'):
        fade_hyprland(old, colors, mode, duration)
    # The files' other mode comes from the same choice, for the ones that hold both ({{light.name}}).
    other = 'light' if mode == 'dark' else 'dark'
    palettes = {mode: colors, other: (palette.preset_palette(palettes, other, choice['preset'])
                if choice.get('preset') else palette.resolve(palettes, other, *picked, choice['harmonize']))}
    changed = render_files(palettes, mode)
    icons = recolor_icons(picked)
    apply_mode(mode)
    reload_apps(colors, mode, changed, icons)


def parse(args):
    """KEY=VALUE pairs (checked, typed) and the --duration option."""
    updates, duration = {}, None
    args = list(args)
    while args:
        arg = args.pop(0)
        if arg == '--duration' or arg.startswith('--duration='):
            value = arg.partition('=')[2] or (args.pop(0) if args else '')
            if not value.isdigit():
                sys.exit('penumbra-theme: --duration needs milliseconds, such as 400.')
            duration = int(value)
            continue
        key, sep, value = arg.partition('=')
        if not sep:
            sys.exit(f'penumbra-theme: expected KEY=VALUE, got {arg!r}')
        updates[key] = value.strip()
    errors = [p for p in (problem(k, v) for k, v in updates.items()) if p]
    if errors:
        print('\n'.join(errors), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    return {k: typed(k, v) for k, v in updates.items()}, duration


def main():
    command, args = (sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ('', [])
    if command == 'get':
        print(json.dumps({**load(), 'candidates': wallpaper_accents(current_wallpaper()),
                          'presets': [dict(id=k, **v) for k, v in palette.PRESETS.items()]}))
    elif command == 'wallpaper':
        name = args.pop(0) if args and not args[0].startswith('--') else current_wallpaper()
        if name not in BUILT_IN:
            name = str(Path(name).absolute())
        updates, duration = parse(args)
        if updates:
            sys.exit('penumbra-theme: wallpaper takes no settings; use set.')
        accents = wallpaper_accents(name)
        print(json.dumps(accents))
        # Only for the wallpaper on screen: not one just looked at, nor one replaced while its
        # colours were being found.
        if name != current_wallpaper():
            return
        choice = load()
        # A new wallpaper starts from its strongest accent.
        if choice['pick']:
            choice['pick'] = 0
            write(CHOICE, json.dumps(choice) + '\n')
        if choice['colors'] == 'wallpaper':
            apply(choice, DURATIONS['wallpaper'] if duration is None else duration, wallpaper=name)
    elif command in ('set', 'preview', 'restore'):
        updates, duration = parse(args)
        if command == 'restore' and updates:
            sys.exit('penumbra-theme: restore takes no settings; use set.')
        if 'preset' in updates and updates['preset']:
            p = palette.PRESETS[updates['preset']]
            updates = {**{k: p[k] for k in ('mode', 'hue', 'vividness')},
                       'colors': 'custom', 'harmonize': True, **updates}
        elif set(updates) & {'colors', 'hue', 'vividness', 'harmonize'}:
            updates.setdefault('preset', '')
        choice = {**load(), **updates}
        if command == 'set':
            write(CHOICE, json.dumps(choice) + '\n')
        apply(choice, DURATIONS[command] if duration is None else duration, everything=command != 'preview')
        if command == 'set' and updates.get('preset'):
            helper = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name('penumbra-wallpaper')
            result = (subprocess.run([str(helper), palette.PRESETS[updates['preset']]['wallpaper']], check=False)
                      if helper.is_file() else None)
            if result is None or result.returncode:
                print('Palette applied; matching wallpaper could not be selected.', file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__.strip())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

## `bin/penumbra-updates`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Update checks for the Penumbra bar and an interactive update session in the terminal."""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

# The distribution's package sources, installed from distro/<name>/share/penumbra/updates.py.
DISTRO = Path.home() / ".local/share/penumbra/updates.py"


def distro():
    """The distribution's updates module, or None when there is none."""
    if not DISTRO.is_file():
        return None
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("penumbra_distro_updates", DISTRO)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def check(command, empty=(), empty_if_silent=()):
    """The pending updates a command lists, one per line, or None when the check failed."""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=180, env={**os.environ, "LC_ALL": "C"})
        if result.returncode in empty:
            return []
        if (result.returncode in empty_if_silent
                and not result.stdout.strip() and not result.stderr.strip()):
            return []
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip() or "check failed")
        return sorted({line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()})
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(f"{command[0]}: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None


def status():
    packages = distro()
    sources = packages.sources() if packages else []
    if shutil.which("flatpak"):
        sources.extend({"name": f"Flatpak ({scope})",
                        "command": ["flatpak", "remote-ls", f"--{scope}", "--updates",
                                    "--all", "--arch=*", "--columns=ref"]}
                       for scope in ("user", "system"))
    # The checks wait on the network, so they run side by side.
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, len(sources))) as pool:
        results = pool.map(lambda source: check(source["command"], source.get("empty", ()),
                                                source.get("empty_if_silent", ())), sources)
        found = list(zip((source["name"] for source in sources), results))
    total = sum(len(lines) for _, lines in found if lines is not None)
    details = [f"{name}: {len(lines) if lines is not None else 'check unavailable'}"
               for name, lines in found]
    details.extend(packages.notes() if packages else ["System packages: run ./install.sh to enable"])
    # The distribution's news since the last upgrade, and whether a restart is due, where it has them.
    news, restart = [], []
    if packages and hasattr(packages, "news"):
        try:
            news = packages.news(Path(os.environ.get("XDG_CACHE_HOME") or Path.home() / ".cache") / "penumbra/news.xml")
        except Exception as error:  # the network, or a feed that changed shape
            print(f"news: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
    if packages and hasattr(packages, "restart_reasons"):
        restart = packages.restart_reasons()
    if restart:
        details.insert(0, "Restart to finish: " + "; ".join(restart).lower())
    if any(item["new"] for item in news):
        details.insert(0, "News since your last upgrade: read it before updating")
    details.append("Click for the list · checked every 15 minutes")
    # For the shell: the count, the lines of the bar's tooltip, and each source's updates, one line
    # each as the distribution's check prints it (pacman: "name old -> new") or a Flatpak ref.
    print(json.dumps({"count": total,
                      "details": details,
                      "news": news,
                      "restart": restart,
                      "sources": [{"name": name, "packages": lines}
                                  for name, lines in found if lines]}))


def lock(name):
    directory = Path(os.environ.get("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR",
                     os.environ.get("XDG_CACHE_HOME", str(Path.home() / ".cache")))) / "penumbra"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle = (directory / name).open("w")
    try:
        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except BlockingIOError:
        handle.close()
        return None
    return handle


def update():
    handle = lock("update.lock")
    if handle is None:
        return 0
    failed = False
    try:
        packages = distro()
        commands = packages.upgrades() if packages else []
        if shutil.which("flatpak"):
            commands.extend((f"Flatpak ({scope})", ["flatpak", "update", f"--{scope}"])
                            for scope in ("user", "system"))
        for name, command in commands:
            print(f"\n── {name} ──\n", flush=True)
            if subprocess.run(command).returncode:
                failed = True
                break
    except (OSError, KeyboardInterrupt) as error:
        print(f"\nUpdate interrupted: {error}", flush=True)
        failed = True
    finally:
        # Refresh the bar's update count, including after a partial upgrade.
        subprocess.run([str(Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("penumbra-ipc")), "updates", "refresh"],
                       capture_output=True, check=False)
        handle.close()
    if failed:
        try:
            input("\nUpdates did not finish. Press Enter to close…")
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            pass
    return int(failed)


def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "status"
    if mode == "status":
        status()
    elif mode == "open":
        handle = lock("terminal.lock")
        if handle is not None:
            try:
                # penumbra-terminal opens the terminal from Settings → Default apps.
                terminal = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("penumbra-terminal")
                return subprocess.call([str(terminal), "--class", "penumbra-updates",
                                        "--title", "Penumbra · Updates", "--",
                                        str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "run"])
            finally:
                handle.close()
    elif mode == "run":
        return update()
    else:
        sys.exit("Usage: penumbra-updates [status|open|run]")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

## `bin/penumbra-wallpaper`

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Switch wallpapers with an awww transition: Penumbra's own scenes by name, or any image, GIF or
# video by path. `next` cycles through Penumbra's, then those in ~/Pictures/Wallpapers. GIFs and
# videos show as their first frame in awww and the shell plays them over it, as it animates dawn
# and eclipse. The lock screen follows the choice, and so do the theme's colours when they are
# taken from the wallpaper.
set -euo pipefail
dir="$HOME/.local/share/penumbra"
state="$HOME/.local/state/penumbra/wallpaper"
folder="$HOME/Pictures/Wallpapers"
# First frames and PNG copies, named after the md5 of the file's path (the shell finds them the same way).
cache="$HOME/.cache/penumbra/wallpapers"
names=(wallpaper wallpaper-dawn wallpaper-eclipse wallpaper-solar-corona wallpaper-aurora-borealis wallpaper-event-horizon wallpaper-nebula-rose wallpaper-starlight)
stills='png|jpg|jpeg|webp|bmp'
moving='gif|mp4|webm|mkv|mov|m4v'

usage() {
 echo "Usage: penumbra-wallpaper [next|restore|posters|wallpaper|wallpaper-dawn|wallpaper-eclipse|wallpaper-solar-corona|wallpaper-aurora-borealis|wallpaper-event-horizon|wallpaper-nebula-rose|wallpaper-starlight|FILE]" >&2
 exit 2
}
kind() {
 local ext=${1##*.}
 ext=${ext,,}
 if [[ $ext =~ ^($stills)$ ]]; then echo still
 elif [[ $ext =~ ^($moving)$ ]]; then echo moving
 else echo none; fi
}
valid() {
 case $1 in
  wallpaper|wallpaper-dawn|wallpaper-eclipse|wallpaper-solar-corona|wallpaper-aurora-borealis|wallpaper-event-horizon|wallpaper-nebula-rose|wallpaper-starlight) [[ -e $dir/$1.png ]];;
  /*) [[ -f $1 && $(kind "$1") != none ]];;
  *) false;;
 esac
}
# Penumbra's wallpapers, then yours.
choices() {
 printf '%s\n' "${names[@]}"
 [[ -d $folder ]] || return 0
 find "$folder" -maxdepth 1 -type f -regextype posix-extended -iregex ".*\.($stills|$moving)" ! -iname "*-fg.png" | LC_ALL=C sort
}
# still FILE: a PNG of the file's first frame, which awww and the lock screen can show.
still() {
 local out
 if [[ $(kind "$1") = still && ${1,,} = *.png ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$1"
  return
 fi
 out="$cache/$(printf '%s' "$1" | md5sum | cut -c1-32).png"
 if [[ ! -s $out || $1 -nt $out ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$cache"
  ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i "$1" -frames:v 1 -update 1 "$out" || { rm -f "$out"; return 1; }
 fi
 printf '%s\n' "$out"
}

current=$(cat "$state" 2>/dev/null || echo wallpaper)
valid "$current" || current=wallpaper
previous=$current
transition=(--transition-type grow --transition-duration 1.4 --transition-fps 120)
case "${1:-next}" in
 next)
  mapfile -t list < <(choices)
  for i in "${!list[@]}"; do [[ ${list[i]} = "$current" ]] && break; done
  current=${list[(i + 1) % ${#list[@]}]};;
 restore) transition=(--transition-type none);;
 # First frames of the GIFs and videos in your folder, for the wallpaper picker.
 posters)
  while IFS= read -r file; do
   [[ $(kind "$file") = moving ]] && { still "$file" >/dev/null || true; }
  done < <(choices)
  exit 0;;
 wallpaper|wallpaper-dawn|wallpaper-eclipse|wallpaper-solar-corona|wallpaper-aurora-borealis|wallpaper-event-horizon|wallpaper-nebula-rose|wallpaper-starlight) current=$1;;
 *)
  # Absolute, but through any symlinked folder, so the picker recognises it.
  file=$(realpath -es -- "$1" 2>/dev/null) || usage
  valid "$file" || { echo "penumbra-wallpaper: $1 is not an image, GIF or video" >&2; exit 2; }
  current=$file;;
esac
# Grow each scene out of its planet, or the eclipse; your own from the middle.
if [[ ${1:-next} != restore ]]; then
 case $current in
  wallpaper-dawn|wallpaper-solar-corona|wallpaper-starlight) transition+=(--transition-pos 0.32,0.37);;
  wallpaper-eclipse|wallpaper-aurora-borealis|wallpaper-event-horizon) transition+=(--transition-pos 0.65,0.63);;
  wallpaper|wallpaper-nebula-rose) transition+=(--transition-pos 0.68,0.51);;
  *) transition+=(--transition-pos 0.5,0.5);;
 esac
fi
case $current in
 /*)
  lock=$(still "$current")
  [[ $(kind "$current") = moving ]] && image=$lock || image=$current;;
 *)
  image=$dir/$current.png
  lock=$dir/$current-clean.png;;
esac
mkdir -p "${state%/*}"
printf '%s\n' "$current" > "$state"
ln -sfn "$lock" "$dir/lock.png"
# penumbra-theme finds the new wallpaper's colours and, if the theme takes them from it, fades the
# shell to them while the wallpaper grows in.
if [[ ${1:-next} != restore && $current != "$previous" ]]; then
 "$HOME/.local/bin/penumbra-theme" wallpaper "$current" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi
# The shell animates dawn, eclipse, GIFs and videos over awww's still image, once the transition has finished.
[[ ${1:-next} = restore ]] && delay=0 || delay=1400
"${0%/*}/penumbra-ipc" wallpaper set "$current" "$delay" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
for _ in {1..50}; do awww query >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.1; done
exec awww img "$image" --resize crop "${transition[@]}"
```

```fish
# penumbra_theme: every running fish reads the file again.

    source $__fish_config_dir/conf.d/penumbra-colors.fish

# Set an exported variable unless you set your own: one this file set before is replaced.
function __penumbra_default -a name value
    set -l mine __penumbra_$name
    if not set -q $name; or test "$$name" = "$$mine"
        set -gx $name $value
        set -g $mine $value

end
```

## `config/fish/functions/fish_greeting.fish`

```fish
function fish_greeting
    if command -q fastfetch
        if test "$TERM" = xterm-kitty; and test "$COLUMNS" -ge 95
            fastfetch
        else
            fastfetch --logo none
        end
    else
        set_color $penumbra_violet
        printf '\n  ◈  P E N U M B R A\n'
        set_color normal
    end
end
```

## `config/hypr/hyprland.lua`

```lua
-- PENUMBRA / Hyprland 0.56 Lua configuration
-- Keyboard, Num Lock, scale and the terminal come from ~/.config/penumbra/settings.conf, which
-- ./install.sh and the shell's Settings write; screens from ~/.config/penumbra/monitors.lua, which
-- Settings → Displays writes. Put your own settings in ~/.config/hypr/user.lua, which is read last
-- and survives ./install.sh.
local home = os.getenv("HOME")
-- Colours come from palette/palette.toml (tools/build-palette.py), and penumbra-theme rewrites them
-- with the theme you choose. In light mode the shadow is fainter and the blur doesn't darken;
-- penumbra-theme gives a running Hyprland the same (hyprland_lua there).
local c = dofile(home .. "/.config/hypr/colors.lua")
local light = c.mode == "light"
-- settings.conf as a table, read afresh each time (bindings below call it when pressed).
local function settings()
 local s = {kb_layout = "us", kb_variant = "", kb_options = "", scale = "auto", numlock = "on", terminal = "kitty", file_manager = "io.github.lia.Files"}
 local file = io.open(home .. "/.config/penumbra/settings.conf")
 if file then
  for line in file:lines() do
   local key, value = line:match("^([a-z_]+)=(.*)$")
   if key then s[key] = value end
  end
  file:close()
 end
 return s
end
local s = settings()
-- Every screen without a rule of its own in monitors.lua.
hl.monitor({ output = "", mode = "preferred", position = "auto", scale = s.scale })
local monitors = io.open(home .. "/.config/penumbra/monitors.lua")
if monitors then monitors:close(); dofile(home .. "/.config/penumbra/monitors.lua") end
hl.env("XCURSOR_THEME", "Penumbra-Cursors")
hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", "28")
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", "28")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME", "qt6ct")
-- GTK apps ask the file chooser portal for Open and Save dialogs: Lia Files once it is installed.
hl.env("GTK_USE_PORTAL", "1")
-- Rounded or sharp corners, as penumbra-corners records them.
local corners = io.open(home .. "/.local/state/penumbra/corners")
local sharp = corners ~= nil and corners:read("l") == "sharp"
if corners then corners:close() end
-- Settings → Reduced motion (shell.json) turns Hyprland's animations off too.
local shell = io.open(home .. "/.config/penumbra/shell.json")
local still = shell ~= nil and shell:read("a"):find('"reducedMotion"%s*:%s*true') ~= nil
if shell then shell:close() end
hl.config({
 xwayland = {
    force_zero_scaling = true
 },
 -- Software cursors in virtual machines, where hardware cursors often draw wrongly; automatic elsewhere.
 cursor = { no_hardware_cursors = @@SOFTWARE_CURSOR@@, enable_hyprcursor = false },
 general = { gaps_in = 6, gaps_out = 14, border_size = 2, resize_on_border = true, layout = "dwindle",
  col = { active_border = {colors = {"rgba(" .. c.accent .. "ee)", "rgba(" .. c.accentDeep .. "bb)"}, angle = 45}, inactive_border = "rgba(" .. c.black .. "ff)" } },
 -- Global blur also covers the alpha backgrounds in GTK, Vesktop and terminal apps.
 decoration = { rounding = sharp and 0 or 16, rounding_power = 2, active_opacity = 1, inactive_opacity = 0.97,
  shadow = {enabled = true, range = 28, render_power = 3, color = light and "rgba(" .. c.shade .. "30)" or "rgba(" .. c.onAccent .. "88)",
   color_inactive = light and "rgba(00000022)" or "rgba(00000055)"},
  glow = {enabled = true, range = 18, render_power = 3, color = "rgba(" .. c.accentDeep .. "40)", color_inactive = "rgba(00000000)"},
  blur = {enabled = true, size = 10, passes = 4, vibrancy = 0.28, vibrancy_darkness = 0.15, noise = 0.025, contrast = 1.1, brightness = light and 1 or 0.9, popups = true} },
 animations = {enabled = not still},
 dwindle = {preserve_split = true},
 input = {kb_layout = s.kb_layout, kb_variant = s.kb_variant, kb_options = s.kb_options, numlock_by_default = s.numlock == "on",
  follow_mouse = 1, sensitivity = 0, touchpad = {natural_scroll = true}},
 -- A fresh lock screen (hyprlock from a TTY) can take over if the shell's ever dies while locked.
 misc = {disable_hyprland_logo = true, disable_splash_rendering = true, force_default_wallpaper = 0, allow_session_lock_restore = true},
})
hl.curve("penumbra", {type = "bezier", points = {{0.16, 1}, {0.3, 1}}})
hl.curve("overshoot", {type = "bezier", points = {{0.05, 0.9}, {0.1, 1.04}}})
hl.curve("soft", {type = "bezier", points = {{0.4, 0}, {0.2, 1}}})
hl.curve("linear", {type = "bezier", points = {{0, 0}, {1, 1}}})
for _, a in ipairs({
 {"windows", 4.5, "penumbra", "slide"}, {"windowsIn", 4, "overshoot", "popin 88%"},
 {"windowsOut", 3, "soft", "popin 96%"}, {"border", 5, "penumbra", nil},
 {"borderangle", 60, "linear", "loop"},
 {"fade", 3, "soft", nil}, {"workspaces", 4.5, "overshoot", "slidefade 18%"},
 {"layers", 3.5, "penumbra", "fade"}
}) do hl.animation({leaf=a[1], enabled=true, speed=a[2], bezier=a[3], style=a[4]}) end
local function exec(key, cmd) hl.bind(key, hl.dsp.exec_cmd(cmd)) end
-- The terminal chosen in Settings → Default apps (its desktop file, e.g. kitty or foot).
local function terminal() hl.exec_cmd("gtk-launch " .. settings().terminal .. " || kitty") end
hl.bind("SUPER + Return", terminal)
hl.bind("SUPER + Q", terminal)
-- The file manager chosen in Settings → Default apps.
hl.bind("SUPER + E", function() hl.exec_cmd("gtk-launch " .. settings().file_manager .. " || lia-files || dolphin") end)
exec("SUPER + R", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-launcher")
exec("SUPER + space", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-launcher")
-- Your default web browser (Settings → Default apps, or xdg-settings set default-web-browser NAME.desktop).
exec("SUPER + B", "gtk-launch \"$(xdg-settings get default-web-browser)\"")
exec("SUPER + M", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-power")
exec("SUPER + L", "loginctl lock-session")
exec("SUPER + N", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call notifications clear")
exec("SUPER + A", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call panel control")
exec("SUPER + comma", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call panel settings")
exec("SUPER + SHIFT + V", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-clipboard")
exec("SUPER + semicolon", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call launcher emoji")
-- Jump to an open window by typing part of its title or app.
exec("ALT + Tab", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call launcher windows")
exec("SUPER + SHIFT + C", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-picker")
exec("SUPER + W", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-wallpaper next")
exec("SUPER + SHIFT + W", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call panel wallpapers")
exec("SUPER + SHIFT + R", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-session restart")
-- Every workspace at a glance: Super and the key left of 1 (` on QWERTY, ² on AZERTY), or four
-- fingers up on a touchpad.
exec("SUPER + code:49", "quickshell -c penumbra ipc call panel overview")
hl.gesture({fingers=4, direction="up", action=function() hl.exec_cmd("quickshell -c penumbra ipc call panel overview") end})
-- Caps Lock shows a popup saying whether it is on; the key still reaches the window.
hl.bind("Caps_Lock", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("quickshell -c penumbra ipc call osd capsLock"), {release=true, non_consuming=true, ignore_mods=true})
exec("Print", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-shot")
exec("SHIFT + Print", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-shot annotate")
-- Record the screen; press again (or click the red capsule) to stop.
exec("CTRL + Print", "~/.local/bin/penumbra-record")
hl.bind("SUPER + C", hl.dsp.window.close())
hl.bind("SUPER + V", hl.dsp.window.float({action="toggle"}))
hl.bind("SUPER + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen())
hl.bind("SUPER + J", hl.dsp.layout("togglesplit"))
-- Pin a floating window (picture-in-picture, a note) so it follows you to every workspace.
hl.bind("SUPER + P", hl.dsp.window.pin())
-- Group windows into tabs; Super+Tab and Super+Shift+Tab step through the group.
hl.bind("SUPER + G", hl.dsp.group.toggle())
hl.bind("SUPER + Tab", hl.dsp.group.next())
hl.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + Tab", hl.dsp.group.prev())
-- A scratchpad workspace that slides over the current one: Super+Shift+S sends a window there.
hl.bind("SUPER + S", hl.dsp.workspace.toggle_special("scratch"))
hl.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + S", hl.dsp.window.move({workspace="special:scratch"}))
-- Arrows focus; with Shift they move the window, with Ctrl they resize it (repeating while held).
local step = {left={-40, 0}, right={40, 0}, up={0, -40}, down={0, 40}}
for _, d in ipairs({"left", "right", "up", "down"}) do
 hl.bind("SUPER + "..d, hl.dsp.focus({direction=d}))
 hl.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + "..d, hl.dsp.window.move({direction=d}))
 hl.bind("SUPER + CTRL + "..d, hl.dsp.window.resize({x=step[d][1], y=step[d][2], relative=true}), {repeating=true})
end
-- Physical keycodes keep the number-row workspace shortcuts working on any layout (AZERTY included).
-- Super+Alt sends the window without following it.
for i=1,10 do
 hl.bind("SUPER + code:"..(i+9), hl.dsp.focus({workspace=i}))
 hl.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + code:"..(i+9), hl.dsp.window.move({workspace=i}))
 hl.bind("SUPER + ALT + code:"..(i+9), hl.dsp.window.move({workspace=i, follow=false}))
end
-- Three-finger swipes switch workspaces on a touchpad.
hl.gesture({fingers=3, direction="horizontal", action="workspace"})
hl.bind("SUPER + mouse:272", hl.dsp.window.drag(), {mouse=true})
hl.bind("SUPER + mouse:273", hl.dsp.window.resize(), {mouse=true})
hl.bind("SUPER + mouse_down", hl.dsp.focus({workspace="e+1"}))
hl.bind("SUPER + mouse_up", hl.dsp.focus({workspace="e-1"}))
-- Volume and brightness repeat while held; toggles (mute, play/pause) fire once per press.
for key,cmd in pairs({
 XF86AudioRaiseVolume="~/.local/bin/penumbra-osd volume up",
 XF86AudioLowerVolume="~/.local/bin/penumbra-osd volume down",
 XF86MonBrightnessUp="~/.local/bin/penumbra-osd brightness up", XF86MonBrightnessDown="~/.local/bin/penumbra-osd brightness down"
}) do hl.bind(key, hl.dsp.exec_cmd(cmd), {locked=true, repeating=true}) end
for key,cmd in pairs({
 XF86AudioMute="~/.local/bin/penumbra-osd volume mute",
 XF86AudioMicMute="~/.local/bin/penumbra-osd microphone mute",
 XF86AudioPlay="playerctl play-pause", XF86AudioPause="playerctl pause",
 XF86AudioNext="playerctl next", XF86AudioPrev="playerctl previous"
}) do hl.bind(key, hl.dsp.exec_cmd(cmd), {locked=true}) end
hl.window_rule({name="settings", match={class="^(org.pulseaudio.pavucontrol|pavucontrol|blueman-manager|nm-connection-editor|qt6ct)$"}, float=true, size="820 540", center=true})
hl.window_rule({name="annotate", match={class="^(com.gabm.satty)$"}, float=true, center=true})
-- Browser video popped out: floating, on every workspace, keeping its shape.
hl.window_rule({name="pip", match={title="^(Picture-in-Picture|Picture in picture)$"}, float=true, pin=true, keep_aspect_ratio=true, size="480 270"})
-- Open and save dialogs float over their app instead of splitting the screen.
hl.window_rule({name="dialogs", match={title="^(Open File|Open Files|Open Folder|Select Folder|Save File|Save As|Save Image|File Upload|Choose Files?)(.*)$"}, float=true, size="900 600", center=true})
-- Fullscreen windows (videos, games) keep the screen from dimming and locking.
hl.window_rule({name="fullscreen-awake", match={class=".*"}, idle_inhibit="fullscreen"})
-- Frosted glass behind every Penumbra shell surface and the launcher.
hl.layer_rule({name="glass", match={namespace="^(penumbra-.*|rofi)$"}, blur=true, ignore_alpha=0.3})
-- The screenshot overlay must be gone at once, before grim reads the screen.
hl.layer_rule({name="shot", match={namespace="^penumbra-shot$"}, no_anim=true})
hl.window_rule({name="suppress-maximize", match={class=".*"}, suppress_event="maximize"})
hl.on("hyprland.start", function() hl.exec_cmd("~/.local/bin/penumbra-session") end)
-- Your own settings, if any, override everything above.
local user = io.open(home .. "/.config/hypr/user.lua")
if user then user:close(); dofile(home .. "/.config/hypr/user.lua") end
```

```ini
}
```

## `config/nvim/colors/penumbra.lua`

```lua
-- Original Penumbra palette, shared with the desktop (lua/penumbra/palette.lua is generated from
-- palette/palette.toml).
vim.cmd('highlight clear')
if vim.g.syntax_on then vim.cmd('syntax reset') end
-- penumbra-theme rewrites the palette for the theme you choose and runs :colorscheme penumbra again.
package.loaded['penumbra.palette'] = nil
local c = require('penumbra.palette')
-- Let the terminal's glass show through; set vim.g.penumbra_transparent = false for a solid editor.
local background = vim.g.penumbra_transparent == false and c.bg or 'NONE'
vim.o.background = c.mode or 'dark'
vim.g.colors_name = 'penumbra'
local groups = {
  Normal = { fg = c.fg, bg = background }, NormalNC = { fg = c.fg, bg = background },
  NormalFloat = { fg = c.fg, bg = c.panel }, FloatBorder = { fg = c.accent, bg = c.panel },
  FloatTitle = { fg = c.accent, bg = c.panel, bold = true },
  CursorLine = { bg = c.raised }, CursorLineNr = { fg = c.accent, bold = true },
  LineNr = { fg = c.muted }, SignColumn = { bg = background }, EndOfBuffer = { fg = c.border },
  WinSeparator = { fg = c.border }, Visual = { bg = c.selection },
  Search = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.gold }, IncSearch = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.accent }, CurSearch = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.accent },
  Pmenu = { fg = c.fg, bg = c.panel }, PmenuSel = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.accent },
  PmenuSbar = { bg = c.raised }, PmenuThumb = { bg = c.muted },
  StatusLine = { fg = c.fg, bg = c.panel }, StatusLineNC = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel },
  TabLine = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel }, TabLineSel = { fg = c.accent, bg = c.raised, bold = true },
  TabLineFill = { bg = c.panel }, Directory = { fg = c.accent },
  Title = { fg = c.accent, bold = true }, Comment = { fg = c.dim, italic = true },
  Constant = { fg = c.gold }, String = { fg = c.green }, Character = { fg = c.green },
  Number = { fg = c.gold }, Boolean = { fg = c.gold }, Float = { fg = c.gold },
  Identifier = { fg = c.fg }, Function = { fg = c.blue }, Statement = { fg = c.accent },
  Keyword = { fg = c.accent }, Operator = { fg = c.pink }, PreProc = { fg = c.pink },
  Type = { fg = c.gold }, Special = { fg = c.pink }, Delimiter = { fg = c.muted },
  Underlined = { fg = c.blue, underline = true }, Todo = { fg = c.gold, bold = true },
  Error = { fg = c.rose }, ErrorMsg = { fg = c.rose }, WarningMsg = { fg = c.gold },
  MatchParen = { fg = c.accent, bg = c.border, bold = true }, NonText = { fg = c.border },
  Folded = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel }, FoldColumn = { fg = c.muted },
  DiffAdd = { bg = c.diffAdd }, DiffDelete = { bg = c.diffDelete },
  DiffChange = { bg = c.diffChange }, DiffText = { bg = c.diffText },
  GitSignsAdd = { fg = c.green }, GitSignsChange = { fg = c.accent }, GitSignsDelete = { fg = c.rose },
  DiagnosticError = { fg = c.rose }, DiagnosticWarn = { fg = c.gold },
  DiagnosticInfo = { fg = c.blue }, DiagnosticHint = { fg = c.accent },
  NvimTreeNormal = { fg = c.fg, bg = c.panel }, NvimTreeNormalNC = { fg = c.fg, bg = c.panel },
  NvimTreeEndOfBuffer = { fg = c.panel, bg = c.panel },
  NvimTreeRootFolder = { fg = c.accent, bold = true }, NvimTreeFolderName = { fg = c.accent },
  NvimTreeOpenedFolderName = { fg = c.pink, bold = true }, NvimTreeFolderIcon = { fg = c.accent },
  TelescopeBorder = { fg = c.border }, TelescopeSelection = { bg = c.raised },
  TelescopeMatching = { fg = c.accent, bold = true },
  WhichKey = { fg = c.accent }, WhichKeyGroup = { fg = c.blue }, WhichKeyDesc = { fg = c.fg },

  -- Treesitter captures (`:Inspect` shows them under the cursor). Unlisted ones fall back to
  -- Neovim's links to the classic groups above.
  ['@variable'] = { fg = c.fg }, ['@variable.builtin'] = { fg = c.pink, italic = true },
  ['@variable.parameter'] = { fg = c.soft }, ['@variable.member'] = { fg = c.soft },
  ['@property'] = { fg = c.soft }, ['@constant'] = { fg = c.gold }, ['@constant.builtin'] = { fg = c.gold, italic = true },
  ['@module'] = { fg = c.cyan }, ['@label'] = { fg = c.cyan },
  ['@string'] = { fg = c.green }, ['@string.escape'] = { fg = c.pink }, ['@string.regexp'] = { fg = c.pink },
  ['@string.special.url'] = { fg = c.blue, underline = true },
  ['@character'] = { fg = c.green }, ['@number'] = { fg = c.gold }, ['@boolean'] = { fg = c.gold },
  ['@type'] = { fg = c.gold }, ['@type.builtin'] = { fg = c.gold, italic = true },
  ['@attribute'] = { fg = c.cyan }, ['@function'] = { fg = c.blue }, ['@function.builtin'] = { fg = c.blue, italic = true },
  ['@function.method'] = { fg = c.blue }, ['@constructor'] = { fg = c.gold },
  ['@keyword'] = { fg = c.accent }, ['@keyword.function'] = { fg = c.accent, italic = true },
  ['@keyword.return'] = { fg = c.accent, bold = true }, ['@keyword.import'] = { fg = c.pink },
  ['@operator'] = { fg = c.pink }, ['@punctuation'] = { fg = c.muted }, ['@punctuation.bracket'] = { fg = c.muted },
  ['@punctuation.delimiter'] = { fg = c.muted }, ['@punctuation.special'] = { fg = c.pink },
  ['@comment'] = { fg = c.dim, italic = true }, ['@comment.todo'] = { fg = c.gold, bold = true },
  ['@comment.error'] = { fg = c.rose, bold = true }, ['@comment.warning'] = { fg = c.gold, bold = true },
  ['@tag'] = { fg = c.accent }, ['@tag.attribute'] = { fg = c.cyan }, ['@tag.delimiter'] = { fg = c.muted },
  ['@markup.heading'] = { fg = c.accent, bold = true }, ['@markup.strong'] = { bold = true },
  ['@markup.italic'] = { italic = true }, ['@markup.link'] = { fg = c.blue }, ['@markup.link.url'] = { fg = c.blue, underline = true },
  ['@markup.raw'] = { fg = c.green }, ['@markup.list'] = { fg = c.pink }, ['@markup.quote'] = { fg = c.muted, italic = true },
  ['@diff.plus'] = { fg = c.green }, ['@diff.minus'] = { fg = c.rose }, ['@diff.delta'] = { fg = c.accent },
  -- Language servers' semantic tokens use the same colours.
  ['@lsp.type.namespace'] = { link = '@module' }, ['@lsp.type.parameter'] = { link = '@variable.parameter' },
  ['@lsp.type.property'] = { link = '@property' }, ['@lsp.type.enumMember'] = { link = '@constant' },
  ['@lsp.type.macro'] = { link = '@constant' }, ['@lsp.mod.deprecated'] = { strikethrough = true },
}
for name, value in pairs(groups) do vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, name, value) end
for _, severity in ipairs({ 'Error', 'Warn', 'Info', 'Hint' }) do
  vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, 'DiagnosticUnderline' .. severity, { sp = groups['Diagnostic' .. severity].fg, undercurl = true })
end
for i, color in ipairs(c.terminal) do vim.g['terminal_color_' .. (i - 1)] = color end
```

```lua
vim.g.mapleader = ' '

local o = vim.opt
o.termguicolors = true

o.mouse = 'a'
o.clipboard = 'unnamedplus'
o.expandtab = true
o.shiftwidth = 2
o.tabstop = 2

o.ignorecase = true
o.smartcase = true
o.signcolumn = 'yes'
o.cursorline = true
o.wrap = false
o.scrolloff = 6
o.splitright = true
o.splitbelow = true
o.undofile = true
o.updatetime = 250
o.timeoutlen = 400
o.completeopt = { 'menu', 'menuone', 'noselect' }
o.laststatus = 3
vim.cmd.colorscheme('penumbra')
local path = vim.fn.stdpath('data') .. '/lazy/lazy.nvim'
if not vim.uv.fs_stat(path) then
  local result = vim.fn.system({ 'git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', '--branch=stable',
    'https://github.com/folke/lazy.nvim.git', path })
  if vim.v.shell_error ~= 0 then
    vim.notify('Plugin download failed. Check your connection and restart Neovim.\n' .. result, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
    return
  end
end
vim.opt.rtp:prepend(path)
require('lazy').setup('penumbra.plugins', {
  change_detection = { notify = false },
  checker = { enabled = false },
  local_spec = false,
  ui = { border = 'rounded' },
})
require('penumbra.keys')
vim.diagnostic.config({ virtual_text = false, float = { border = 'rounded' }, severity_sort = true })
local reading_stdin = false
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('StdinReadPre', { callback = function() reading_stdin = true end })
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('VimEnter', {
  callback = function()
    if #vim.api.nvim_list_uis() == 0 or reading_stdin or vim.fn.argc() > 1 then return end
    local arg = vim.fn.argv(0)
    if vim.fn.argc() == 0 then
      require('penumbra.dashboard').open()
    elseif vim.fn.isdirectory(arg) == 1 then
      vim.cmd.cd(vim.fn.fnameescape(arg))
      require('nvim-tree.api').tree.open()
    end
  end,
})
-- Your own settings: ~/.config/nvim/lua/user.lua runs last and survives ./install.sh.
local user = vim.fn.stdpath('config') .. '/lua/user.lua'
if vim.uv.fs_stat(user) then dofile(user) end
```

## `config/nvim/lua/penumbra/dashboard.lua`

```lua
-- A native start buffer: no new plugin, downloads or background work.
local M = {}
function M.open()
  if vim.bo.modified or vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(0) ~= '' or vim.bo.buftype ~= '' then return end
  if vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(0) ~= 1 or vim.api.nvim_get_current_line() ~= '' then return end
  local buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
  vim.api.nvim_set_current_buf(buf)
  vim.bo[buf].buftype = 'nofile'
  vim.bo[buf].bufhidden = 'wipe'
  vim.bo[buf].swapfile = false
  vim.bo[buf].filetype = 'penumbra'
  vim.bo[buf].modifiable = false
  local win = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
  local saved = { number = vim.wo.number, relativenumber = vim.wo.relativenumber,
    cursorline = vim.wo.cursorline, signcolumn = vim.wo.signcolumn }
  vim.wo.number, vim.wo.relativenumber, vim.wo.cursorline, vim.wo.signcolumn = false, false, false, 'no'
  local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace('penumbra-dashboard')
  local function draw()
    if not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(buf) or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(win) then return end
    local width = vim.api.nvim_win_get_width(win)
    local lines = { '', '◯  ──────  ◌', '', 'P E N U M B R A', 'A quiet place to make things.', '',
      '[f]  Find file', '[r]  Recent files', '[n]  New file', '[c]  Configuration', '[q]  Quit', '',
      vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.getcwd(), ':~') }
    for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
      lines[i] = string.rep(' ', math.max(0, math.floor((width - vim.fn.strdisplaywidth(line)) / 2))) .. line
    end
    vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
    vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, 0, -1, false, lines)
    vim.bo[buf].modifiable = false
    vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(buf, ns, 0, -1)
    for _, row in ipairs({ 1, 3 }) do
      vim.api.nvim_buf_set_extmark(buf, ns, row, 0, { end_row = row + 1, hl_group = 'Title' })
    end
    for _, row in ipairs({ 4, 12 }) do
      vim.api.nvim_buf_set_extmark(buf, ns, row, 0, { end_row = row + 1, hl_group = 'Comment' })
    end
  end
  local actions = {
    f = function() require('telescope.builtin').find_files() end,
    r = function() require('telescope.builtin').oldfiles() end,
    n = function() vim.cmd.enew(); vim.cmd.startinsert() end,
    c = function() vim.cmd.edit(vim.fn.fnameescape(vim.fn.stdpath('config') .. '/init.lua')) end,
    q = function() vim.cmd.quit() end,
  }
  for key, action in pairs(actions) do vim.keymap.set('n', key, action, { buffer = buf, silent = true }) end
  local resize = vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('VimResized', { callback = draw })
  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('BufWinLeave', { buffer = buf, once = true, callback = function()
    if vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(win) then
      for name, value in pairs(saved) do vim.wo[win][name] = value end
    end
  end })
  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('BufWipeout', { buffer = buf, once = true, callback = function()
    pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_autocmd, resize)
  end })
  draw()
end
return M
```

```lua
    options = { diagnostics = 'nvim_lsp', separator_style = 'thin',
      offsets = { { filetype = 'NvimTree', text = 'PENUMBRA · Files', text_align = 'center' } } },
  } },
  { 'nvim-lualine/lualine.nvim', opts = function()
    local c = require('penumbra.palette')
    return { options = { theme = {
      normal = { a = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.accent, gui = 'bold' }, b = { fg = c.fg, bg = c.raised }, c = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel } },
      insert = { a = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.green } },
      visual = { a = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.pink } },
      replace = { a = { fg = c.bg, bg = c.rose } },
      inactive = { a = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel }, b = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel }, c = { fg = c.muted, bg = c.panel } },
    }, globalstatus = true, section_separators = { left = '', right = '' },
      component_separators = { left = '│', right = '│' }, disabled_filetypes = { statusline = { 'penumbra' } } } }
  end },
  -- Treesitter parsers, so code is coloured by its structure. Building them needs tree-sitter-cli
  -- and a C compiler (both installed by ./install.sh); `:TSInstall LANGUAGE` adds more.
  { 'nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitter', branch = 'main', lazy = false, build = ':TSUpdate', config = function()
    if vim.fn.executable('tree-sitter') == 1 then
      require('nvim-treesitter').install({ 'bash', 'c', 'css', 'go', 'html', 'javascript', 'json', 'lua',
        'markdown', 'markdown_inline', 'python', 'qmljs', 'rust', 'toml', 'typescript', 'yaml' })
    end
    vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('FileType', { callback = function(ev)
      -- Treesitter colours and indents wherever a parser is installed; Vim's syntax files elsewhere.
      if pcall(vim.treesitter.start, ev.buf) then
        vim.bo[ev.buf].indentexpr = "v:lua.require'nvim-treesitter'.indentexpr()"
      end
    end })
  end },
  { 'lewis6991/gitsigns.nvim', opts = {} },
  { 'windwp/nvim-autopairs', opts = {} },
  { 'mason-org/mason.nvim', opts = { ui = { border = 'rounded' } } },
  { 'neovim/nvim-lspconfig', dependencies = { 'mason-org/mason.nvim' }, config = function()
    -- Enable only installed servers; Mason adds its executables to PATH.
    local servers = {
      lua_ls = 'lua-language-server', pyright = 'pyright-langserver',
      ts_ls = 'typescript-language-server', bashls = 'bash-language-server',
      clangd = 'clangd', rust_analyzer = 'rust-analyzer', gopls = 'gopls',
    }
    vim.lsp.config('lua_ls', { settings = { Lua = { diagnostics = { globals = { 'vim' } } } } })
    for server, executable in pairs(servers) do
      if vim.fn.executable(executable) == 1 then vim.lsp.enable(server) end
    end
    vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('LspAttach', { callback = function(ev)
      local client = vim.lsp.get_client_by_id(ev.data.client_id)
      if client and client:supports_method('textDocument/completion') then
        vim.lsp.completion.enable(true, client.id, ev.buf, { autotrigger = true })
      end
    end })
  end },
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Desktop entries can name a themed icon, an absolute file, or an image URL.
// Keep the logo's aspect ratio and a single, centered fallback across all app surfaces.
IconImage {
    id: root
    property string icon: ""
    property string fallbackGlyph: "󰣆"
    implicitSize: 32
    source: !icon ? "" : icon.startsWith("/") ? "file://" + encodeURI(icon).replace(/#/g, "%23").replace(/\?/g, "%3F")
        : icon.includes("://") ? icon : Quickshell.iconPath(icon, true)
    asynchronous: true
    Glyph {
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        visible: root.status !== Image.Ready
        text: root.fallbackGlyph
        size: Math.min(root.width, root.height) * 0.8
        color: Theme.textSoft
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/AppsPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Default apps: the web browser is the XDG default every app asks for (xdg-settings); the file
// manager and terminal are settings.conf's, for Super+E and Super+Enter, and the file manager also
// becomes the XDG default for folders.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12

    property string browser: ""
    property string expanded: ""
    onVisibleChanged: {
        expanded = "";
        if (visible)
            current.running = true;
    }
    Component.onCompleted: current.running = true

    // Desktop entry ids, with or without ".desktop".
    function bare(id) {
        return (id ?? "").trim().replace(/\.desktop$/, "");
    }
    function apps(category) {
        return DesktopEntries.applications.values.filter(e => !e.noDisplay && e.categories.includes(category))
            .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    }
    function entry(id) {
        return DesktopEntries.applications.values.find(e => bare(e.id) === bare(id)) ?? null;
    }

    Process {
        id: current
        command: ["xdg-settings", "get", "default-web-browser"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.browser = root.bare(text)
        }
    }
    Process {
        id: change
        onExited: current.running = true
    }
    function choose(kind, id) {
        expanded = "";
        if (kind === "terminal") {
            Config.set({ terminal: bare(id) });
            return;
        }
        if (kind === "files") {
            Config.set({ file_manager: bare(id) });
            change.command = ["xdg-mime", "default", bare(id) + ".desktop", "inode/directory"];
        } else {
            browser = bare(id);
            change.command = ["xdg-settings", "set", "default-web-browser", bare(id) + ".desktop"];
        }
        change.running = true;
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Default apps"
        status: "What links, folders and Super+Enter open"
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "settings"
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 4
        Repeater {
            model: [
                { kind: "browser", glyph: "󰖟", title: "Web browser", category: "WebBrowser", id: root.browser, keys: "Super+B and links" },
                { kind: "files", glyph: "󰉋", title: "File manager", category: "FileManager", id: Config.values.file_manager ?? "io.github.lia.Files", keys: "Super+E and folders" },
                { kind: "terminal", glyph: "󰆍", title: "Terminal", category: "TerminalEmulator", id: Config.values.terminal ?? "kitty", keys: "Super+Enter" }
            ]
            delegate: ListRow {
                id: row
                required property var modelData
                readonly property var app: root.entry(modelData.id)
                readonly property var others: root.apps(modelData.category)
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                glyph: modelData.glyph
                title: modelData.title
                subtitle: `${app?.name ?? (modelData.id || "None")} · ${modelData.keys}`
                trailing: others.length > 1 ? (expanded ? "󰅃" : "󰅀") : ""
                expanded: root.expanded === modelData.kind
                onClicked: if (others.length > 1) root.expanded = expanded ? "" : modelData.kind

                Repeater {
                    model: row.others
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property bool chosen: root.bare(modelData.id) === root.bare(row.modelData.id)
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        implicitHeight: 34
                        radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                        color: chosen ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.16) : choice.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                        RowLayout {
                            anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 8; rightMargin: 10 }
                            spacing: 10
                            IconImage {
                                implicitSize: 18
                                source: modelData.icon ? Quickshell.iconPath(modelData.icon, true) : ""
                                asynchronous: true
                            }
                            Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: modelData.name; font.weight: chosen ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal }
                            Glyph { visible: chosen; text: "󰄬"; size: 13; color: Theme.accentBright }
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: choice
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: root.choose(row.modelData.kind, modelData.id)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Avatar.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Your ~/.face when there is one, else your initial on a violet disc. The control center and
// the lock screen show the same one.
ClippingRectangle {
    id: root

    property int size: 42
    property bool ring: false

    implicitWidth: size
    implicitHeight: size
    radius: Theme.corner(size / 2)
    border.width: ring ? 2 : 0
    border.color: Theme.accent

    Rectangle {
        anchors.fill: parent
        gradient: Gradient {
            GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accent }
            GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.accentDeep }
        }
    }
    Label {
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        visible: face.status !== Image.Ready
        text: Quickshell.env("USER").charAt(0).toUpperCase()
        font.family: Theme.display
        font.pixelSize: Math.round(root.size * 0.4)
        font.weight: Font.Bold
        color: Theme.accentInk
    }
    Image {
        id: face
        anchors.fill: parent
        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
        sourceSize: Qt.size(root.size * 2, root.size * 2)
        asynchronous: true
    }
    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.face"
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: face.source = "file://" + path
    }
}
```
