## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Bar.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Effects
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Services.SystemTray
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Floating capsules: launcher, clock, workspaces and media left; focused window centered; status right.
PanelWindow {
    id: bar
    required property var modelData
    screen: modelData

    anchors { top: true; left: true; right: true }
    readonly property bool island: Settings.barStyle === "island"
    margins { top: island ? 0 : 10; left: Settings.barStyle === "framed" ? 3 : Theme.edge; right: Settings.barStyle === "framed" ? 3 : Theme.edge }
    implicitHeight: Theme.barHeight + (island ? 10 : 0)
    exclusiveZone: Theme.barHeight + 4
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-bar"

    // Explicit layout coordinates keep the origin live as capsules resize or appear.
    readonly property var panelOrigins: ({
        calendar: margins.left + content.x + leftSide.x + clockCapsule.x + clockCapsule.width / 2,
        control: margins.left + content.x + rightSide.x + controls.x + controls.width / 2,
        monitor: margins.left + content.x + rightSide.x + monitor.x + monitor.width / 2,
        updates: margins.left + content.x + rightSide.x + updatesCapsule.x + updatesCapsule.width / 2,
        wallpapers: margins.left + content.x + rightSide.x + controls.x + controls.width / 2
    })
    onPanelOriginsChanged: if (screen) Ui.setPanelOrigins(screen.name, panelOrigins)
    Component.onCompleted: if (screen) Ui.setPanelOrigins(screen.name, panelOrigins)

    IdleInhibitor {
        window: bar
        // Stay awake, or an app chosen in Settings → Idle and sleep is open.
        enabled: Ui.stayAwake
    }

    Item {
    id: content
    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
    y: bar.island ? 6 : 0
    width: bar.island ? Math.min(bar.width, leftSide.implicitWidth + rightSide.implicitWidth + 3 * Theme.gap) : bar.width
    height: Theme.barHeight
    Rectangle { anchors.fill: parent; visible: Settings.barStyle === "framed"; color: Theme.surface }
    IslandSurface {
        visible: bar.island
        x: -Theme.gap; y: -6
        width: parent.width + 2 * Theme.gap
        height: parent.height + 10
    }
    HoverHandler {
        onPointChanged: bar.updateTip(point.position)
        onHoveredChanged: if (!hovered) bar.updateTip(null)
    }

    // ── Left ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    RowLayout {
        id: leftSide
        anchors { left: parent.left; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
        spacing: Theme.gap

        Capsule {
            id: launcherCapsule
            padding: 14
            tip: "Applications · right-click for the clipboard"
            active: Ui.launcherOpen
            onClicked: m => Ui.toggleLauncher(m.button === Qt.RightButton ? "clipboard" : "apps")
            Glyph { text: Theme.distroGlyph; size: 20; color: Ui.launcherOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright }
        }

        Capsule {
            id: clockCapsule
            padding: 18
            active: Ui.calendarOpen
            tip: Qt.formatDateTime(Clock.date, "dddd d MMMM yyyy")
            onClicked: Ui.toggle("calendar")
            Label {
                text: Qt.formatDateTime(Clock.date, "HH:mm")
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                font.weight: Font.Bold
                color: Ui.calendarOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text
            }
        }

        // Weather uses the same opt-in cached request as Calendar.
        Capsule {
            id: weatherCapsule
            shown: Settings.weatherEnabled && Settings.weatherInBar && !!Weather.current && !Weather.stale
            padding: 10
            tip: Weather.description
            onClicked: Ui.toggle("calendar")
            Glyph { text: Weather.current?.weather_code === 0 ? "󰖙" : "󰖐"; color: Theme.accentBright }
            Label { text: Math.round(Weather.current?.temperature_2m ?? 0) + "°" }
        }

        WorkspaceStrip {
            id: workspaceStrip
            workspaces: Hyprland.workspaces.values
                .filter(w => w.id > 0 && w.monitor?.name === bar.screen.name && (w.toplevels.values.length > 0 || w.focused || w.active))
                .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
            showIcons: Settings.workspaceStyle === "icons" && bar.width - rightSide.width > 850
        }

        MediaCapsule {
            // Reserve the status area first; long titles elide and small screens keep just art + spectrum.
            titleWidth: Math.max(0, Math.min(140, bar.width - rightSide.width
                - workspaceStrip.implicitWidth - clockCapsule.implicitWidth - launcherCapsule.implicitWidth
                - weatherCapsule.implicitWidth * weatherCapsule.reveal - 6 * Theme.gap - 108))
        }
    }

    // ── Center ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The focused window holds the exact center.
    RowLayout {
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        Capsule {
            id: title
            // The Wayland toplevel protocol knows the focused window from startup; nothing is
            // activated on an empty workspace. Show it on the bar of the screen it is on.
            readonly property var client: ToplevelManager.activeToplevel
            readonly property var entry: client ? DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(client.appId) : null
            // Most windows end their title with the app's name ("… — Mozilla Firefox"); the icon says that.
            readonly property string text: {
                const t = client?.title ?? "";
                const m = t.match(/^(.+)\s[—–-]\s(.+)$/);
                const names = [entry?.name, client?.appId].filter(n => n).map(n => n.toLowerCase());
                return m && names.some(n => m[2].toLowerCase().includes(n)) ? m[1] : t;
            }
            readonly property real availableWidth: 2 * Math.min(content.width / 2 - leftSide.x - leftSide.width,
                rightSide.x - content.width / 2) - 2 * Theme.gap
            shown: !bar.island && availableWidth >= 80 && !!client && client.activated && text !== "" && client.screens.some(s => s.name === bar.screen.name)
            interactive: false
            padding: 15
            spacing: 8
            tip: shown ? client.title : ""
            IconImage {
                visible: source !== ""
                implicitSize: 15
                source: title.entry?.icon ? Quickshell.iconPath(title.entry.icon, true) : ""
                asynchronous: true
            }
            Label {
                text: title.text
                // As wide as the room between the side capsules allows, up to a point.
                Layout.maximumWidth: Math.max(0, Math.min(300, title.availableWidth - 60))
                color: Theme.textSoft
            }
        }
    }

    // ── Right ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    RowLayout {
        id: rightSide
        anchors { right: parent.right; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
        spacing: Theme.gap

        // A capture's timer counting down; click to cancel.
        Capsule {
            shown: Recorder.countdown > 0
            padding: 14
            tip: "Click to cancel"
            onClicked: Recorder.cancel()
            Glyph { text: "󰔛"; color: Theme.amber }
            Label { text: Recorder.countdown; font.weight: Font.Bold; color: Theme.amber }
        }

        // A screen recording and how long it has run; click to stop, right-click to pause.
        Capsule {
            shown: Recorder.recording
            padding: 14
            tip: Recorder.paused ? "Paused · right-click to go on · click to stop" : "Recording · click to stop (or Ctrl+Print) · right-click to pause"
            color: hovered ? Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.3) : Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.16)
            border.color: Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.5)
            onClicked: m => m.button === Qt.RightButton ? Recorder.togglePause() : Recorder.stop()
            Glyph { visible: Recorder.paused; text: "󰏤"; size: 12; color: Theme.rose }
            Rectangle {
                visible: !Recorder.paused
                implicitWidth: 9
                implicitHeight: 9
                radius: Theme.corner(4.5)
                color: Theme.rose
                SequentialAnimation on opacity {
                    running: Recorder.recording && !Recorder.paused && !Theme.reducedMotion
                    loops: Animation.Infinite
                    NumberAnimation { to: 0.3; duration: 700; easing.type: Easing.InOutSine }
                    NumberAnimation { to: 1; duration: 700; easing.type: Easing.InOutSine }
                }
            }
            Label { text: Recorder.elapsedText; font.weight: Font.Bold; color: Theme.rose }
        }

        // Casting to a TV; click for the Cast page.
        Capsule {
            id: castCapsule
            shown: Cast.casting
            padding: 14
            active: Ui.controlOpen && Ui.controlPage === "cast"
            tip: Cast.connecting ? `Connecting to ${Cast.tvName}…` : `Casting to ${Cast.tvName} · click to manage`
            onClicked: Ui.openControl("cast")
            Glyph { text: "󰄙"; color: castCapsule.active ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright }
            Label { text: Cast.tvName; font.weight: Font.Bold; color: castCapsule.active ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright }
        }

        Capsule {
            shown: Devices.layouts.length > 1
            padding: 14
            tip: `${Devices.layoutName} · click to switch`
            onClicked: Devices.nextLayout()
            Glyph { text: "󰌌"; color: Theme.textSoft }
            Label { text: Devices.layoutCode; font.weight: Font.Bold; color: Theme.textSoft }
        }

        // Pending updates; also there when a restart is due, with its own glyph.
        Capsule {
            shown: Sys.updates > 0 || Sys.restartReasons.length > 0
            padding: 12
            active: Ui.updatesOpen
            tip: Sys.updatesDetail
            id: updatesCapsule
            onClicked: Ui.toggle("updates")
            Glyph { visible: Sys.updates > 0; text: "󰚰"; color: Ui.updatesOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright }
            Label { visible: Sys.updates > 0; text: Sys.updates; color: Ui.updatesOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright }
            Glyph { visible: Sys.restartReasons.length > 0; text: "󰜉"; color: Ui.updatesOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.amber }
        }

        Capsule {
            id: monitor
            padding: 12
            spacing: 12
            active: Ui.monitorOpen
            tip: `CPU ${Usage.cpu}% · Memory ${Usage.memoryDetail}`
            onClicked: m => m.button === Qt.RightButton ? Ui.spawn(Ui.terminal(["btop"], ["--class", "penumbra-monitor"])) : Ui.toggle("monitor")
            readonly property color tint: Ui.monitorOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.subtle
            Repeater {
                model: ["CPU", "RAM"]
                delegate: RowLayout {
                    required property string modelData
                    spacing: 5
                    Label {
                        text: modelData
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 0.6
                        color: Ui.monitorOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.dim
                    }
                    Label { text: (modelData === "CPU" ? Usage.cpu : Usage.memory) + "%"; color: monitor.tint }
                }
            }
        }

        Capsule {
            // nm-applet and blueman keep running for password and pairing prompts,
            // but the control center replaces their tray icons.
            readonly property var items: SystemTray.items.values.filter(i => !["nm-applet", "blueman"].includes(i.id))
            id: tray
            shown: items.length > 0
            interactive: false
            padding: 12
            spacing: 10
            Repeater {
                model: tray.items
                delegate: Item {
                    id: trayItem
                    required property var modelData
                    implicitWidth: 18
                    implicitHeight: 18
                    IconImage {
                        id: trayIcon
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: trayItem.modelData.icon
                        visible: false
                    }
                    // Tinted to match the bar; full color on hover.
                    MultiEffect {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: trayIcon
                        saturation: trayMouse.containsMouse ? 0 : -1
                        colorization: trayMouse.containsMouse ? 0 : 0.35
                        colorizationColor: Theme.accent
                        brightness: trayMouse.containsMouse ? 0 : 0.1
                        Behavior on saturation { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                        Behavior on colorization { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: trayMouse
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.RightButton | Qt.MiddleButton
                        onClicked: m => {
                            const item = trayItem.modelData;
                            if (m.button === Qt.MiddleButton)
                                item.secondaryActivate();
                            else if (m.button === Qt.RightButton || item.onlyMenu) {
                                if (item.hasMenu) {
                                    const p = trayItem.mapToItem(bar.contentItem, 0, trayItem.height + 14);
                                    item.display(bar, p.x, p.y);
                                }
                            } else
                                item.activate();
                        }
                        onWheel: w => trayItem.modelData.scroll(w.angleDelta.y, false)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Network, Bluetooth, audio, battery and notifications open the control center.
        Capsule {
            id: controls
            padding: 14
            spacing: 13
            active: Ui.controlOpen
            tip: `${Devices.networkName} · Bluetooth ${Devices.bluetoothName}` + (Devices.hasBattery ? `\n${Devices.batteryDetail}` : "")
                + (Devices.peripheralBatteries.length ? "\n" + Devices.peripheralBatteries.join(" · ") : "")
            onClicked: m => m.button === Qt.RightButton ? Ui.run("pavucontrol") : Ui.toggle("control")
            onScrolled: step => Devices.adjust("volume", step > 0 ? "up" : "down")
            readonly property color tint: Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft

            Glyph { text: Devices.networkGlyph; color: Devices.networkName === "Offline" && !Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.dim : controls.tint }
            Glyph { text: Devices.bluetoothGlyph; color: !Devices.bluetoothOn && !Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.dim : controls.tint }
            RowLayout {
                spacing: 5
                Glyph { text: Devices.volumeGlyph; color: Devices.muted && !Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.dim : controls.tint }
                Label {
                    visible: !Devices.muted
                    text: Devices.volume + "%"
                    color: controls.tint
                }
            }
            RowLayout {
                visible: Devices.hasBattery
                spacing: 5
                Glyph { text: Devices.batteryGlyph; color: Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Devices.batteryColor }
                Label { text: Devices.batteryPercent + "%"; color: Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Devices.batteryColor }
            }
            Item {
                implicitWidth: bell.implicitWidth
                implicitHeight: bell.implicitHeight
                Glyph {
                    id: bell
                    text: Notifs.dnd ? "󰂛" : Notifs.count ? "󰂚" : "󰂜"
                    color: Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Notifs.dnd ? Theme.dim : Theme.textSoft
                }
                Rectangle {
                    visible: Notifs.count > 0 && !Notifs.dnd
                    width: 6; height: 6; radius: Theme.corner(3)
                    color: Ui.controlOpen ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright
                    anchors { right: bell.right; top: bell.top; rightMargin: -2; topMargin: 1 }
                }
            }
        }

        Capsule {
            padding: 14
            tip: "Session & power"
            onClicked: Ui.openSession()
            Glyph { text: "󰐥"; size: 16; color: Theme.accentBright }
        }
    }

    }

    // ── Tooltip ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    property Item tipTarget: null
    function updateTip(pos) {
        const target = pos ? capsuleAt(pos) : null;
        if (target !== tipTarget) {
            tipTarget = target;
            tipWindow.visible = false;
            tipDelay.restart();
        }
    }
    // Innermost item under the pointer that declares a tooltip.
    function capsuleAt(pos) {
        let found = null, item = content, p = pos;
        for (let child = item.childAt(p.x, p.y); child; child = item.childAt(p.x, p.y)) {
            p = item.mapToItem(child, p.x, p.y);
            if (child.tip !== undefined)
                found = child;
            item = child;
        }
        return found;
    }
    Timer {
        id: tipDelay
        interval: 550
        onTriggered: tipWindow.visible = !!bar.tipTarget && bar.tipTarget.tip !== ""
    }
    PopupWindow {
        id: tipWindow
        anchor.item: bar.tipTarget ?? bar.contentItem
        anchor.edges: Edges.Bottom
        anchor.gravity: Edges.Bottom
        anchor.margins.top: 8
        implicitWidth: tipText.implicitWidth + 24
        implicitHeight: tipText.implicitHeight + 16
        color: "transparent"
        Rectangle {
            anchors.fill: parent
            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
            color: Theme.glassStrong
            border.color: Theme.lineStrong
            Label {
                id: tipText
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                text: bar.tipTarget?.tip ?? ""
                color: Theme.text
                elide: Text.ElideNone
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/BluetoothPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell.Bluetooth

// Bluetooth devices: discover, pair, connect, disconnect and forget.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    property bool active: false
    readonly property var adapter: Devices.adapter
    readonly property bool powered: adapter?.enabled ?? false
    readonly property var all: Bluetooth.devices.values
    readonly property var paired: all.filter(d => d.paired || d.bonded)
        .sort((a, b) => (b.connected - a.connected) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
    // Unnamed devices only advertise their address; leave them out.
    readonly property var available: all.filter(d => !d.paired && !d.bonded && d.deviceName && !/^([0-9A-F]{2}[:-]){5}[0-9A-F]{2}$/i.test(d.name))
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
    property string expanded: ""
    property string pairingAddress: ""

    spacing: 12

    // Discover only while the page is on screen.
    function updateDiscovery() {
        if (adapter && adapter.enabled && adapter.discovering !== active)
            adapter.discovering = active;
    }
    onActiveChanged: { updateDiscovery(); if (!active) expanded = ""; }
    onPoweredChanged: updateDiscovery()
    // The control center builds the page when it is shown and drops it when it is left.
    Component.onCompleted: updateDiscovery()
    Component.onDestruction: if (adapter?.discovering) adapter.discovering = false

    function glyphFor(device) {
        const icon = device.icon ?? "";
        if (icon.includes("headset") || icon.includes("headphone"))
            return "󰋋";
        if (icon.includes("audio") || icon.includes("speaker"))
            return "󰓃";
        if (icon.includes("mouse"))
            return "󰍽";
        if (icon.includes("keyboard"))
            return "󰌌";
        if (icon.includes("gaming") || icon.includes("joystick"))
            return "󰊴";
        if (icon.includes("phone"))
            return "󰏲";
        if (icon.includes("computer"))
            return "󰌢";
        return "󰂯";
    }
    function statusFor(device) {
        if (device.state === BluetoothDeviceState.Connecting)
            return "Connecting…";
        if (device.state === BluetoothDeviceState.Disconnecting)
            return "Disconnecting…";
        if (device.connected)
            return device.batteryAvailable ? `Connected · ${Math.round(device.battery > 1 ? device.battery : device.battery * 100)}% battery` : "Connected";
        return "Not connected";
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Bluetooth"
        status: !root.adapter ? "No adapter" : !root.powered ? "Off" : root.adapter.discovering ? "On · searching for devices" : "On"
        showSwitch: !!root.adapter
        checked: root.powered
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
        onToggled: root.adapter.enabled = !root.adapter.enabled
    }

    component SectionTitle: Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
    }

    Flickable {
        id: scroller
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(contentHeight, 400)
        visible: root.powered
        contentHeight: sections.implicitHeight
        clip: true
        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
        ScrollBar.vertical: ScrollBar { policy: scroller.contentHeight > scroller.height ? ScrollBar.AsNeeded : ScrollBar.AlwaysOff }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: sections
            width: scroller.width
            spacing: 4

            SectionTitle { visible: root.paired.length > 0; text: "My devices" }
            Repeater {
                model: root.paired
                delegate: ListRow {
                    id: row
                    required property var modelData
                    readonly property var dev: modelData
                    readonly property bool changing: dev.state === BluetoothDeviceState.Connecting || dev.state === BluetoothDeviceState.Disconnecting
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    glyph: root.glyphFor(dev)
                    title: dev.name
                    subtitle: root.statusFor(dev)
                    highlighted: dev.connected
                    busy: changing
                    expanded: root.expanded === dev.address
                    onClicked: {
                        const open = root.expanded === dev.address;
                        root.expanded = open ? "" : dev.address;
                        // One click connects; the row stays open for Disconnect and Forget.
                        if (!open && !dev.connected && !changing)
                            dev.connect();
                    }
                    Flow {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 6
                        PillButton {
                            text: row.dev.connected ? "Disconnect" : "Connect"
                            primary: !row.dev.connected
                            available: !row.changing
                            onClicked: row.dev.connected ? row.dev.disconnect() : row.dev.connect()
                        }
                        PillButton {
                            text: "Forget"
                            danger: true
                            onClicked: { root.expanded = ""; row.dev.forget(); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            SectionTitle {
                Layout.topMargin: root.paired.length ? 10 : 2
                text: root.available.length ? "Available devices" : "Searching for devices…"
            }
            Repeater {
                model: root.available
                delegate: ListRow {
                    id: candidate
                    required property var modelData
                    readonly property var dev: modelData
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    glyph: root.glyphFor(dev)
                    title: dev.name
                    subtitle: dev.pairing ? "Pairing…" : "Click to pair"
                    busy: dev.pairing
                    onClicked: {
                        if (dev.pairing)
                            return;
                        root.pairingAddress = dev.address;
                        dev.pair();
                    }
                    // Trust and connect as soon as pairing completes.
                    Connections {
                        target: candidate.dev
                        function onPairedChanged() {
                            if (candidate.dev.paired && root.pairingAddress === candidate.dev.address) {
                                root.pairingAddress = "";
                                candidate.dev.trusted = true;
                                candidate.dev.connect();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 6
        Layout.bottomMargin: 6
        visible: !root.powered
        spacing: 4
        Glyph { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "󰂲"; size: 28; color: Theme.dim }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: !root.adapter ? "This computer has no Bluetooth adapter" : "Bluetooth is off"
            color: Theme.muted
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
        visible: !!root.adapter
        text: "Advanced Bluetooth settings"
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: advancedArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.muted
        MouseArea {
            id: advancedArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            anchors.margins: -4
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: { Ui.close(); Ui.run("blueman-manager"); }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/CalendarPanel.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell.Io

// Month view under the clock, with week numbers if you like (click "Wk") and the events of your
// calendars (penumbra-calendar reads their .ics files): a dot under each day that has some, and
// the chosen day's list below.
Panel {
    id: root
    originKey: "calendar"
    anchors { top: true; left: true }
    margins.left: edgeMargin - shadowRoom
    preferredSheetWidth: 360
    open: Ui.calendarOpen
    onDismissed: Ui.dismiss()

    property date today: new Date()
    property int month: today.getMonth()
    property int year: today.getFullYear()
    property date selected: today
    onOpenChanged: if (open) { today = new Date(); selected = today; month = today.getMonth(); year = today.getFullYear(); loadEvents(); }
    function shift(delta) {
        const d = new Date(year, month + delta, 1);
        month = d.getMonth();
        year = d.getFullYear();
        loadEvents();
    }

    // The events of the six weeks on show: { "YYYY-MM-DD": [{ time, title }] }.
    property var events: ({})
    function iso(d) {
        return Qt.formatDate(d, "yyyy-MM-dd");
    }
    function loadEvents() {
        const first = new Date(year, month, 1 - 7), last = new Date(year, month + 1, 7);
        eventList.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-calendar", iso(first), iso(last)];
        eventList.running = true;
    }
    Process {
        id: eventList
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const byDay = {};
                try {
                    for (const e of JSON.parse(text))
                        (byDay[e.date] = byDay[e.date] ?? []).push(e);
                } catch (error) {}
                root.events = byDay;
            }
        }
    }
    readonly property var dayEvents: events[iso(selected)] ?? []

    Flickable {
        x: 18
        y: 18
        width: root.sheetWidth - 36
        height: Math.min(calendarContent.implicitHeight, root.implicitHeight - 2 * root.shadowRoom - 36)
        contentHeight: calendarContent.implicitHeight
        contentWidth: width
        flickableDirection: Flickable.VerticalFlick
        clip: true
        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
        ColumnLayout {
            id: calendarContent
            width: parent.width
            spacing: 10

            Overline {
                text: Qt.formatDate(root.today, "dddd")
                color: Theme.accent
            }
            Label {
                text: Qt.formatDate(root.today, "d MMMM yyyy")
                font.family: Theme.display
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textHeading
                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
            }

            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.topMargin: 4
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: Qt.formatDate(new Date(root.year, root.month, 1), "MMMM yyyy")
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                    color: Theme.textSoft
                }
                // Week numbers on or off.
                Rectangle {
                    implicitWidth: 32
                    implicitHeight: 28
                    radius: Theme.corner(14)
                    color: Settings.calendarWeekNumbers ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.2) : weekArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                    Label { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Wk"; font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny; font.weight: Font.DemiBold; color: Settings.calendarWeekNumbers ? Theme.accent : Theme.dim }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: weekArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: Settings.calendarWeekNumbers = !Settings.calendarWeekNumbers
                    }
                }
                Repeater {
                    model: [{ glyph: "󰅁", delta: -1 }, { glyph: "󰅂", delta: 1 }]
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var modelData
                        implicitWidth: 28
                        implicitHeight: 28
                        radius: Theme.corner(14)
                        color: navArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                        Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: modelData.glyph; color: Theme.textSoft }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: navArea
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: root.shift(modelData.delta)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            DayOfWeekRow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: Settings.calendarWeekNumbers ? weeks.width + 4 : 0
                locale: grid.locale
                delegate: Label {
                    required property string shortName
                    text: shortName.slice(0, 2)
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                    color: Theme.dim
                }
            }

            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 4
                WeekNumberColumn {
                    id: weeks
                    visible: Settings.calendarWeekNumbers
                    Layout.preferredHeight: grid.Layout.preferredHeight
                    implicitWidth: 22
                    month: root.month
                    year: root.year
                    locale: grid.locale
                    spacing: 2
                    delegate: Label {
                        required property int weekNumber
                        text: weekNumber
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                        color: Theme.dim
                    }
                }
                MonthGrid {
                    id: grid
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.preferredHeight: 6 * 34 + 5 * 2
                    month: root.month
                    year: root.year
                    locale: Qt.locale()
                    spacing: 2
                    onClicked: d => root.selected = d
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var model
                        readonly property bool isToday: model.today
                        readonly property bool isSelected: root.iso(model.date) === root.iso(root.selected) && !isToday
                        readonly property bool busy: (root.events[root.iso(model.date)] ?? []).length > 0
                        implicitWidth: 34
                        implicitHeight: 34
                        radius: Theme.corner(17)
                        color: isToday ? Theme.accent : isSelected ? Theme.raised : "transparent"
                        border.color: isSelected ? Theme.lineStrong : "transparent"
                        Label {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: model.day
                            font.weight: parent.isToday ? Font.Bold : Font.Normal
                            color: parent.isToday ? Theme.accentInk : model.month === root.month ? Theme.text : Theme.dim
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 4 }
                            visible: parent.busy
                            width: 4
                            height: 4
                            radius: 2
                            color: parent.isToday ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            WeatherCard { Layout.fillWidth: true }

            // The chosen day's events.
            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.topMargin: 2
                visible: root.dayEvents.length > 0
                spacing: 4
                Overline {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.iso(root.selected) === root.iso(root.today) ? "Today" : Qt.formatDate(root.selected, "dddd d MMMM")
                }
                Repeater {
                    model: root.dayEvents
                    delegate: RowLayout {
                        required property var modelData
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 10
                        Label {
                            Layout.preferredWidth: 46
                            text: modelData.time || "All day"
                            font.family: Theme.mono
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                            color: Theme.accent
                        }
                        Label {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            text: modelData.title
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Capsule.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// A floating glass pill; children are laid out in a row.
Rectangle {
    id: root
    scale: Theme.reducedMotion ? 1 : (interactive ? (mouse.pressed ? 0.96 : hovered ? 1.02 : 1) : 1)
    Behavior on scale { enabled: !Theme.reducedMotion; SpringAnimation { spring: 5; damping: 0.7 } }

    default property alias content: row.data
    property alias spacing: row.spacing
    property int padding: 13
    property string tip: ""
    property bool interactive: true
    property bool active: false
    readonly property bool hovered: mouse.containsMouse
    // Set instead of `visible`: the capsule fades and narrows away, and its neighbours glide.
    property bool shown: true
    property real reveal: shown ? 1 : 0
    Behavior on reveal { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
    visible: reveal > 0
    opacity: reveal
    Layout.preferredWidth: Math.round(implicitWidth * reveal)
    clip: reveal < 1

    signal clicked(var mouse)
    // One step per wheel notch: +1 up, -1 down. Touchpads send many small deltas, which add up
    // to a notch (120) before anything happens.
    signal scrolled(int step)
    property int wheelRest: 0

    implicitHeight: Theme.barHeight
    implicitWidth: row.implicitWidth + padding * 2
    radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
    color: active ? Theme.accent : (interactive && hovered ? Theme.hover : Settings.barStyle === "floating" ? Theme.glass : "transparent")
    border.width: 1
    border.color: active ? Theme.accentBright : Settings.barStyle === "floating" ? Theme.line : "transparent"
    Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
    Behavior on implicitWidth { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }

    // Declared before the row so it sits underneath: children with their own
    // mouse handling (tray icons) receive their clicks, plain contents fall through.
    MouseArea {
        id: mouse
        anchors.fill: parent
        hoverEnabled: true
        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.RightButton | Qt.MiddleButton
        cursorShape: root.interactive ? Qt.PointingHandCursor : Qt.ArrowCursor
        onClicked: m => root.clicked(m)
        onWheel: w => {
            root.wheelRest += w.angleDelta.y;
            while (Math.abs(root.wheelRest) >= 120) {
                const step = root.wheelRest > 0 ? 1 : -1;
                root.wheelRest -= step * 120;
                root.scrolled(step);
            }
        }
        onExited: root.wheelRest = 0
    }

    // An active capsule takes the focused window's border: accent shading towards accentDeep.
    Rectangle {
        anchors.fill: parent
        radius: root.radius
        opacity: root.active ? 1 : 0
        visible: opacity > 0
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
        gradient: Gradient {
            orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
            GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accentBright }
            GradientStop { position: 1; color: Qt.tint(Theme.accent, Theme.alpha(Theme.accentDeep, 0.4)) }
        }
    }
    // The lit top edge the panels have, so the bar reads as the same glass.
    GlassEdge {
        radius: root.radius
        strength: root.active ? 0.55 : Settings.barStyle === "floating" ? 0.2 : 0
    }

    RowLayout {
        id: row
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        spacing: 6
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Cast.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Casting the screen to a TV. penumbra-cast finds the TVs (Chromecast, Google TV and DLNA) and does
// the cast, keeping it in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/penumbra/cast so it outlives the shell; the control
// center's Cast page and the bar show it from there.
Singleton {
    id: root

    property var tvs: [] // [{ id, name, kind (chromecast or dlna), model }]
    property bool scanning: false
    property bool scanned: false

    property bool casting: false
    property bool connecting: false
    property string tvId: ""
    property string tvName: ""
    property bool sound: false // whether the TV plays what the computer plays too

    function scan() {
        if (!scanner.running) {
            scanning = true;
            scanner.running = true;
        }
    }
    function start(tv, output) {
        const command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-cast", "start", tv.id, "--name", tv.name];
        if (output)
            command.push("--output", output);
        if (Settings.castSound)
            command.push("--sound");
        if (Settings.castPort > 0)
            command.push("--port", String(Settings.castPort));
        // Shown at once; penumbra-cast confirms it in a moment.
        tvId = tv.id;
        tvName = tv.name;
        sound = Settings.castSound;
        connecting = true;
        casting = true;
        Ui.spawn(command);
    }
    function stop() {
        Quickshell.execDetached([Ui.bin + "penumbra-cast", "stop"]);
    }
    function refresh() {
        state.reload();
    }

    Process {
        id: scanner
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-cast", "scan"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                try {
                    root.tvs = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch (e) {
                    root.tvs = [];
                }
            }
        }
        onExited: {
            root.scanning = false;
            root.scanned = true;
        }
    }

    FileView {
        id: state
        path: (Quickshell.env("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR") || "/tmp") + "/penumbra/cast"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onLoaded: {
            try {
                const cast = JSON.parse(text());
                root.tvId = cast.id ?? "";
                root.tvName = cast.name ?? "";
                root.sound = cast.sound ?? root.sound;
                root.connecting = cast.phase === "connecting";
                root.casting = true;
            } catch (e) {
                root.casting = false;
            }
        }
        onLoadFailed: {
            root.casting = false;
            root.connecting = false;
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/CastPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell

// Cast the screen to a TV on the same network: pick one and it shows this screen in a moment.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    property bool active: false
    // The screen to cast: the one the panel opened on, unless another is picked.
    property string output: ""
    readonly property string chosenOutput: output || (Ui.screen?.name ?? "")

    spacing: 12

    // Look for TVs while the page is on screen, again every so often.
    onActiveChanged: if (active) { output = ""; Cast.scan(); }
    Component.onCompleted: if (active) Cast.scan()
    Timer {
        interval: 20000
        repeat: true
        running: root.active
        onTriggered: Cast.scan()
    }

    function glyphFor(tv) {
        return tv.kind === "chromecast" ? "󰄘" : "󰔂";
    }
    function detailFor(tv) {
        const kind = tv.kind === "chromecast" ? "Chromecast" : "DLNA";
        return tv.model ? `${tv.model} · ${kind}` : kind;
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Cast screen"
        status: Cast.connecting ? `Connecting to ${Cast.tvName}…`
            : Cast.casting ? `Casting to ${Cast.tvName}`
            : Cast.scanning ? "Searching for TVs…"
            : Cast.tvs.length === 1 ? "1 TV on this network"
            : Cast.tvs.length ? `${Cast.tvs.length} TVs on this network` : "No TVs found"
        showSwitch: Cast.casting
        checked: Cast.casting
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
        onToggled: Cast.stop()
    }

    // The cast in progress.
    ListRow {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Cast.casting
        glyph: "󰄙"
        title: Cast.tvName
        subtitle: Cast.connecting ? "Connecting…" : Cast.sound ? "Showing this screen, with sound" : "Showing this screen"
        highlighted: true
        busy: Cast.connecting
        expanded: true
        PillButton {
            text: "Stop casting"
            danger: true
            onClicked: Cast.stop()
        }
    }

    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
        Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "TVs" }
        Glyph {
            id: refreshGlyph
            text: "󰑐"
            size: 14
            color: Cast.scanning ? Theme.accent : refreshArea.containsMouse ? Theme.text : Theme.muted
            RotationAnimation on rotation {
                running: Cast.scanning && !Theme.reducedMotion
                from: 0
                to: 360
                duration: 1200
                loops: Animation.Infinite
                onStopped: refreshGlyph.rotation = 0
            }
            MouseArea {
                id: refreshArea
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: -6
                hoverEnabled: true
                enabled: !Cast.scanning
                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                onClicked: Cast.scan()
            }
        }
    }

    Flickable {
        id: scroller
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(contentHeight, 300)
        visible: Cast.tvs.length > 0
        contentHeight: list.implicitHeight
        clip: true
        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
        ScrollBar.vertical: ScrollBar { policy: scroller.contentHeight > scroller.height ? ScrollBar.AsNeeded : ScrollBar.AlwaysOff }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: list
            width: scroller.width
            spacing: 4
            Repeater {
                model: Cast.tvs
                delegate: ListRow {
                    required property var modelData
                    readonly property bool current: Cast.casting && Cast.tvId === modelData.id
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    glyph: root.glyphFor(modelData)
                    title: modelData.name
                    subtitle: current ? (Cast.connecting ? "Connecting…" : "Casting") : root.detailFor(modelData)
                    highlighted: current
                    busy: current && Cast.connecting
                    trailing: current ? "" : "󰄘"
                    onClicked: if (!current) Cast.start(modelData, root.chosenOutput)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Nothing found yet.
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 4
        Layout.bottomMargin: 4
        visible: Cast.tvs.length === 0
        spacing: 4
        Glyph { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: Cast.scanning || !Cast.scanned ? "󰄘" : "󰔂"; size: 28; color: Theme.dim }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: Cast.scanning || !Cast.scanned ? "Searching for TVs…" : "No TVs found"
            color: Theme.muted
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            visible: Cast.scanned && !Cast.scanning
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
            text: "Turn the TV on and connect it to the same network as this computer."
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.dim
        }
    }

    // Which screen, when there are several.
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Quickshell.screens.length > 1
        spacing: 6
        Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Screen" }
        Segmented {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            current: root.chosenOutput
            options: Quickshell.screens.map(s => ({ value: s.name, title: s.name, glyph: "󰍹" }))
            onChosen: value => root.output = value
        }
    }

    SwitchRow {
        glyph: Settings.castSound ? "󰓃" : "󰓄"
        title: "Sound on the TV"
        subtitle: Cast.casting ? "Applies to the next cast" : "What this computer plays"
        checked: Settings.castSound
        onToggled: Settings.castSound = !Settings.castSound
    }

    // A fixed port for the stream, so a firewall can let the TV in; empty is any free port.
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 10
        spacing: 11
        Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: "󰒍"; size: 17 }
        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 0
            Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "Port" }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: Settings.castPort > 0 ? `Allow TCP ${Settings.castPort} in your firewall` : "Any free one; set one to allow it in a firewall"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.muted
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            }
        }
        Field {
            Layout.preferredWidth: 90
            text: Settings.castPort > 0 ? String(Settings.castPort) : ""
            placeholderText: "Any"
            inputMethodHints: Qt.ImhDigitsOnly
            invalid: text !== "" && !(/^\d+$/.test(text) && Number(text) >= 1024 && Number(text) <= 65535)
            onEditingFinished: if (!invalid) Settings.castPort = text === "" ? 0 : Number(text)
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
        text: "The TV shows the screen a few seconds late: fine for films and slides, not for games."
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.dim
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Clock.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell

// Wall-clock time to the minute. Stands in for Quickshell's SystemClock, which during the hour
// repeated when DST ends schedules its next tick in the past and spins a 1ms timer, flooding the
// log. Checking every second also catches up straight away after suspend or a clock change.
Singleton {
    id: root

    property date date: new Date()

    Timer {
        interval: 1000
        running: true
        repeat: true
        onTriggered: {
            const now = new Date();
            if (Math.floor(now.getTime() / 60000) !== Math.floor(root.date.getTime() / 60000))
                root.date = now;
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls

// A slider on a track of colours: the hue's rainbow, the vividness's grey to vivid. colorAt(value)
// paints the track (sampled every twelfth of the way) and fills the handle.
Slider {
    id: root

    property var colorAt: value => Theme.accent
    // The colour a fraction of the way along the track.
    function at(fraction) { return colorAt(from + (to - from) * fraction); }

    // The custom background and handle give no implicit height, which would leave a 0 px hit area.
    implicitHeight: 32
    snapMode: Slider.SnapAlways

    background: Rectangle {
        x: root.leftPadding
        y: root.topPadding + root.availableHeight / 2 - height / 2
        width: root.availableWidth
        height: 12
        radius: Theme.corner(6)
        border.color: Theme.line
        gradient: Gradient {
            orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
            GradientStop { position: 0; color: root.at(0) }
            GradientStop { position: 1 / 12; color: root.at(1 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 2 / 12; color: root.at(2 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 3 / 12; color: root.at(3 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 4 / 12; color: root.at(4 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 5 / 12; color: root.at(5 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 6 / 12; color: root.at(6 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 7 / 12; color: root.at(7 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 8 / 12; color: root.at(8 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 9 / 12; color: root.at(9 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 10 / 12; color: root.at(10 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 11 / 12; color: root.at(11 / 12) }
            GradientStop { position: 1; color: root.at(1) }
        }
    }

    handle: Rectangle {
        x: root.leftPadding + root.visualPosition * (root.availableWidth - width)
        y: root.topPadding + root.availableHeight / 2 - height / 2
        width: root.pressed ? 22 : 20
        height: width
        radius: Theme.corner(width / 2)
        color: Theme.white
        border.color: Theme.lineStrong
        Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
        Rectangle {
            anchors { fill: parent; margins: 4 }
            radius: Theme.corner(width / 2)
            color: root.colorAt(root.value)
        }
    }
}
```
