## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Config.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// The settings install.sh asks for, kept in ~/.config/penumbra/settings.conf: keyboard, scale,
// terminal and idle timings. penumbra-settings checks, saves and applies each change, so the
// installer and the Settings pages always agree. Shell-only preferences are in Settings instead.
Singleton {
    id: root

    property var values: ({})
    property string error: ""
    readonly property bool busy: setter.running

    // Change some: { idle_lock: "15" }. `error` says why when one is refused.
    function set(changes) {
        pending = Object.assign({}, pending, changes);
        if (!setter.running)
            flush();
    }
    property var pending: ({})
    function flush() {
        const changes = pending;
        pending = {};
        const keys = Object.keys(changes);
        if (!keys.length)
            return;
        error = "";
        // Shown at once; the file, read back, has the last word.
        values = Object.assign({}, values, changes);
        setter.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-settings", "set"].concat(keys.map(key => `${key}=${changes[key]}`));
        setter.running = true;
    }
    Process {
        id: setter
        stderr: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: if (text.trim()) root.error = text.trim()
        }
        onExited: {
            getter.running = true;
            root.flush();
        }
    }

    // Every setting with its default filled in, whenever the file changes.
    Process {
        id: getter
        running: true
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-settings", "get"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                try {
                    root.values = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        }
    }
    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.config/penumbra/settings.conf"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: getter.running = true
    }

    // Keyboard layouts and their variants from the XKB rules, the first time a page asks.
    property var layouts: [] // [[code, name]]
    property var variants: ({}) // layout → [[code, name]]
    function loadLayouts() {
        if (!layouts.length && !layoutList.running)
            layoutList.running = true;
    }
    Process {
        id: layoutList
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-settings", "layouts"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                try {
                    const all = JSON.parse(text);
                    root.layouts = all.layouts;
                    root.variants = all.variants;
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        }
    }
    function layoutName(code) {
        return layouts.find(l => l[0] === code)?.[1] ?? code;
    }

    // Minutes, or "never", as the idle rows show them: "9 min 30 s".
    function duration(value) {
        if (value === "never" || value === undefined)
            return "Never";
        const s = Math.round(Number(value) * 60), h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor(s % 3600 / 60), r = s % 60;
        return [h ? `${h} h` : "", m ? `${m} min` : "", r ? `${r} s` : ""].filter(t => t).join(" ");
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/ControlCenter.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Effects
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Networking
import Quickshell.Services.UPower
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Quick settings, sliders, media and notification history, under the status capsule.
Panel {
    id: root
    originKey: "control"
    anchors { top: true; right: true }
    margins.right: edgeMargin - shadowRoom
    preferredSheetWidth: 440
    open: Ui.controlOpen
    onDismissed: Ui.dismiss()

    readonly property var player: Media.player
    property var expandedApps: []

    property string uptime: ""
    onOpenChanged: if (open) { uptimeFile.reload(); Sys.refreshBrightness(); }
    FileView {
        id: uptimeFile
        path: "/proc/uptime"
        onLoaded: {
            const s = Number(text().split(" ")[0]), h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor(s % 3600 / 60);
            root.uptime = h ? `up ${h} h ${m} min` : `up ${m} min`;
        }
    }

    // One page at a time: the main view, or Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, night light, casting, settings
    // and the settings' own pages. A page taller than the room under the bar scrolls.
    Flickable {
        id: scroller
        x: Theme.padding
        y: Theme.padding
        width: root.sheetWidth - 2 * Theme.padding
        // The sheet's padding and shadow room above and below.
        height: Math.min(pages.implicitHeight, root.height - 2 * root.shadowRoom - 2 * Theme.padding)
        contentWidth: width
        contentHeight: pages.implicitHeight
        clip: true
        interactive: contentHeight > height
        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
        // Each page, and each opening, starts at the top.
        Connections {
            target: root
            function onOpenChanged() { scroller.contentY = 0; }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: pages
            width: scroller.width
            spacing: 0

            Connections {
                target: Ui
                function onControlPageChanged() { scroller.contentY = 0; pageIn.restart(); }
            }
            ParallelAnimation {
                id: pageIn
                NumberAnimation { target: pages; property: "opacity"; from: 0; to: 1; duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
                NumberAnimation { target: pages; property: "x"; from: Ui.controlPage === "main" ? -24 : 24; to: 0; duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo }
            }

            // Pages are built when first shown and dropped when left: most of the time the control
            // center is closed, and what must outlive a page lives in the singletons.
            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "wifi"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { WifiPage { active: root.open } }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "bluetooth"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { BluetoothPage { active: root.open } }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "mixer"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { MixerPage { active: root.open } }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "night"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { NightLightPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "weather"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { WeatherPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "cast"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { CastPage { active: root.open } }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "settings"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { SettingsPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "look"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { LookPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "displays"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { DisplaysPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "keyboard"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { KeyboardPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "idle"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { IdlePage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "notifications"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { NotificationsPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "apps"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { AppsPage {} }
            }

            Loader {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                active: Ui.controlPage === "notes"
                visible: active
                sourceComponent: Component { NotesPage {} }
            }

            ColumnLayout {
                id: mainPage
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: Ui.controlPage === "main"
                spacing: 14

                // Header: who, how long, and session shortcuts.
                RowLayout {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 0 }
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: 12
                    Avatar { size: 42 }
                    ColumnLayout {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 1
                        Label { text: Quickshell.env("USER"); font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge; font.weight: Font.DemiBold }
                        Label { text: root.uptime; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.muted }
                    }
                    Repeater {
                        model: [
                            { glyph: "󰒓", tip: "Settings", run: () => Ui.controlPage = "settings" },
                            { glyph: "󰸉", tip: "Wallpaper", run: () => Ui.toggle("wallpapers") },
                            { glyph: "󰌾", tip: "Lock", run: () => { Ui.close(); Ui.run("loginctl lock-session"); } },
                            { glyph: "󰐥", tip: "Session", run: () => Ui.openSession() }
                        ]
                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            required property var modelData
                            implicitWidth: 36
                            implicitHeight: 36
                            radius: Theme.corner(18)
                            color: headerArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
                            border.color: Theme.line
                            Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: modelData.glyph; size: 15; color: Theme.accentBright }
                            MouseArea {
                                id: headerArea
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                hoverEnabled: true
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: modelData.run()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                GridLayout {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 1 }
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    columns: 2
                    rowSpacing: 8
                    columnSpacing: 8
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        glyph: Devices.networkGlyph
                        title: Devices.wifiDevice ? "Wi-Fi" : "Network"
                        subtitle: Devices.networkName
                        on: Devices.wifiDevice ? Networking.wifiEnabled : Devices.wired
                        hasMore: true
                        onToggled: Devices.wifiDevice ? Networking.wifiEnabled = !Networking.wifiEnabled : Ui.controlPage = "wifi"
                        onMore: Ui.controlPage = "wifi"
                    }
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        glyph: Devices.bluetoothGlyph
                        title: "Bluetooth"
                        subtitle: Devices.bluetoothName
                        on: Devices.bluetoothOn
                        available: !!Devices.adapter
                        hasMore: true
                        onToggled: Devices.adapter.enabled = !Devices.adapter.enabled
                        onMore: Ui.controlPage = "bluetooth"
                    }
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        glyph: Notifs.dnd ? "󰂛" : "󰂚"
                        title: "Do not disturb"
                        subtitle: Notifs.dndStatus
                        on: Notifs.dnd
                        hasMore: true
                        onToggled: Notifs.toggleDnd()
                        onMore: Ui.controlPage = "notifications"
                    }
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        glyph: Ui.caffeine ? "󰅶" : "󰛊"
                        title: "Stay awake"
                        subtitle: Ui.caffeine ? "Idle lock paused" : "Off"
                        on: Ui.caffeine
                        onToggled: Ui.caffeine = !Ui.caffeine
                    }
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        glyph: "󱩌"
                        title: "Night light"
                        subtitle: NightLight.status
                        on: NightLight.on
                        available: NightLight.available
                        hasMore: true
                        onToggled: NightLight.toggle()
                        onMore: Ui.controlPage = "night"
                    }
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        glyph: "󰹑"
                        title: "Screenshot"
                        subtitle: "Picture or video"
                        onToggled: Ui.openShot()
                    }
                    // The odd one out spans the row.
                    Tile {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.columnSpan: 2
                        glyph: Cast.casting ? "󰄙" : "󰄘"
                        title: "Cast screen"
                        subtitle: Cast.connecting ? `Connecting to ${Cast.tvName}…` : Cast.casting ? `Casting to ${Cast.tvName}` : "Show this screen on a TV"
                        on: Cast.casting
                        hasMore: true
                        onToggled: Cast.casting ? Cast.stop() : Ui.controlPage = "cast"
                        onMore: Ui.controlPage = "cast"
                    }
                }

                // Power profile, through power-profiles-daemon.
                ColumnLayout {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 2 }
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: Ui.hasPowerProfiles
                    spacing: 6
                    Segmented {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        current: PowerProfiles.profile
                        options: [
                            { value: PowerProfile.PowerSaver, glyph: "󰌪", title: "Power saver" },
                            { value: PowerProfile.Balanced, glyph: "󰗑", title: "Balanced" },
                            { value: PowerProfile.Performance, glyph: "󰓅", title: "Performance", available: PowerProfiles.hasPerformanceProfile }
                        ]
                        onChosen: value => PowerProfiles.profile = value
                    }
                    // Performance can be held back by the hardware; say why.
                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.leftMargin: 4
                        visible: PowerProfiles.profile === PowerProfile.Performance && PowerProfiles.degradationReason !== PerformanceDegradationReason.None
                        text: PowerProfiles.degradationReason === PerformanceDegradationReason.LapDetected
                            ? "Performance is limited while the laptop is on your lap"
                            : "Performance is limited while the computer is hot"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                        color: Theme.amber
                    }
                }

                ColumnLayout {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 3 }
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: 4
                    RowLayout {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 2
                        SliderRow {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            glyph: Devices.volumeGlyph
                            value: Devices.volume
                            muted: Devices.muted
                            onMoved: v => Devices.setVolume(v)
                            onGlyphClicked: if (Devices.sink) Devices.sink.muted = !Devices.sink.muted
                        }
                        // Devices and per-app volume.
                        Rectangle {
                            implicitWidth: 26
                            implicitHeight: 36
                            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                            color: mixerArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                            Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰅂"; color: Theme.muted }
                            MouseArea {
                                id: mixerArea
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                hoverEnabled: true
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: Ui.controlPage = "mixer"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    SliderRow {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.rightMargin: 28
                        visible: !!Devices.source
                        glyph: Devices.micMuted ? "󰍭" : "󰍬"
                        value: Devices.source ? Math.round(Devices.source.volume * 100) : 0
                        muted: Devices.micMuted
                        onMoved: v => { Devices.source.muted = false; Devices.source.volume = v / 100; }
                        onGlyphClicked: Devices.source.muted = !Devices.source.muted
                    }
                    SliderRow {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.rightMargin: 28
                        visible: Sys.brightness >= 0
                        glyph: "󰃟"
                        value: Sys.brightness
                        onMoved: v => Sys.setBrightness(v)
                    }
                }

                // Media: blurred cover art behind the track, controls and a seek bar.
                ClippingRectangle {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 4 }
                    id: media
                    property bool lyricsOpen: false
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: !!root.player
                    implicitHeight: mediaColumn.implicitHeight + 20
                    radius: Theme.radius
                    color: Theme.raised
                    border.color: Theme.line

                    Image {
                        id: artwork
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: root.player?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
                        sourceSize.width: 200
                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                        asynchronous: true
                        visible: false
                    }
                    MultiEffect {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: artwork
                        visible: artwork.status === Image.Ready
                        blurEnabled: true
                        blur: 1
                        blurMax: 48
                        saturation: 0.2
                        opacity: 0.45
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        gradient: Gradient {
                            orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
                            GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.alpha(Theme.surface, 0.55) }
                            GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.alpha(Theme.surface, 0.15) }
                        }
                    }

                    // MPRIS doesn't announce position changes; ask while it's on screen.
                    Timer {
                        interval: media.lyricsOpen ? 250 : 1000
                        repeat: true
                        running: root.open && !!root.player?.isPlaying
                        onTriggered: root.player.positionChanged()
                    }
                    ColumnLayout {
                        id: mediaColumn
                        anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 10 }
                        spacing: 8
                        RowLayout {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            spacing: 12
                            ClippingRectangle {
                                implicitWidth: 56
                                implicitHeight: 56
                                radius: Theme.corner(12)
                                color: Theme.hover
                                Image {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    source: root.player?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
                                    sourceSize: Qt.size(112, 112)
                                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                    asynchronous: true
                                }
                                Glyph {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    visible: !root.player?.trackArtUrl
                                    text: "󰎆"
                                    size: 22
                                    color: Theme.accentBright
                                }
                            }
                            ColumnLayout {
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                spacing: 2
                                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: root.player?.trackTitle || Media.appName(root.player); font.weight: Font.DemiBold }
                                RowLayout {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    spacing: 6
                                    // A live stream has nothing to seek through; say so instead.
                                    Rectangle {
                                        visible: Media.isLive(root.player)
                                        implicitWidth: liveLabel.implicitWidth + 12
                                        implicitHeight: 16
                                        radius: Theme.corner(8)
                                        color: Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.18)
                                        border.color: Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.5)
                                        Label {
                                            id: liveLabel
                                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                                            text: "LIVE"
                                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                                            font.weight: Font.Bold
                                            font.letterSpacing: 0.8
                                            color: Theme.rose
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: root.player?.trackArtist || Media.appName(root.player); font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.textSoft }
                                }
                            }
                            Repeater {
                                model: [
                                    { glyph: "󰒮", run: () => root.player.previous(), ok: root.player?.canGoPrevious },
                                    { glyph: root.player?.isPlaying ? "󰏤" : "󰐊", run: () => root.player.togglePlaying(), ok: root.player?.canTogglePlaying, main: true },
                                    { glyph: "󰒭", run: () => root.player.next(), ok: root.player?.canGoNext }
                                ]
                                delegate: Rectangle {
                                    required property var modelData
                                    implicitWidth: modelData.main ? 38 : 30
                                    implicitHeight: implicitWidth
                                    radius: Theme.corner(implicitWidth / 2)
                                    opacity: modelData.ok ? 1 : 0.4
                                    color: modelData.main ? Theme.accent : mediaArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                                    Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: modelData.glyph; size: 16; color: modelData.main ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        id: mediaArea
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        hoverEnabled: true
                                        enabled: !!modelData.ok
                                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                        onClicked: modelData.run()
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        RowLayout {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            visible: Media.hasLength(root.player)
                            spacing: 10
                            Label {
                                text: Media.time(seekArea.pressed ? seekArea.target * (root.player?.length ?? 0) : root.player?.position ?? 0)
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                                color: Theme.textSoft
                            }
                            Item {
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                implicitHeight: 14
                                // While dragging, the bar follows the pointer; the player seeks once, on release.
                                readonly property real progress: seekArea.pressed ? seekArea.target
                                    : root.player?.length > 0 ? Math.min(1, root.player.position / root.player.length) : 0
                                Rectangle {
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    width: parent.width
                                    height: seekArea.containsMouse ? 6 : 4
                                    radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
                                    color: Theme.overlayStrong
                                    Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: parent.width * parent.parent.progress
                                        height: parent.height
                                        radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
                                        color: Theme.accent
                                    }
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    id: seekArea
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    hoverEnabled: true
                                    enabled: root.player?.canSeek ?? false
                                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                    property real target: 0
                                    onPressed: m => target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.x / width))
                                    onPositionChanged: m => { if (pressed) target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.x / width)); }
                                    onReleased: if (root.player) root.player.position = target * root.player.length
                                }
                            }
                            Label {
                                text: Media.time(root.player?.length ?? 0)
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                                color: Theme.textSoft
                            }
                        }
                        RowLayout {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            PillButton {
                                text: media.lyricsOpen ? "Hide lyrics" : "󰨸 Lyrics"
                                primary: media.lyricsOpen
                                onClicked: media.lyricsOpen = !media.lyricsOpen
                            }
                            Item { Layout.fillWidth: true }
                        }
                        LyricsView {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            visible: media.lyricsOpen
                            active: media.lyricsOpen && root.open && mainPage.visible
                            player: root.player
                        }
                        // A mirrored Cava waveform over the blurred album cover.
                        Row {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            Layout.preferredHeight: 24
                            visible: media.lyricsOpen && Ui.hasVisualizer
                            spacing: 3
                            Repeater {
                                model: 32
                                delegate: Rectangle {
                                    required property int index
                                    width: (parent.width - 31 * 3) / 32
                                    height: 2 + 22 * (Media.bars[Math.floor(index / 4)] ?? 0)
                                    y: (24 - height) / 2
                                    radius: Theme.corner(width / 2)
                                    color: Theme.alpha(Theme.accentBright, 0.65)
                                    Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.reducedMotion ? 0 : 80 } }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Notifications
                RowLayout {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 5 }
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.topMargin: 2
                    Overline {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: Notifs.count ? `Notifications · ${Notifs.count}` : "Notifications"
                    }
                    Label {
                        visible: Notifs.count > 0
                        text: "Clear all"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                        color: clearArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.accent
                        MouseArea {
                            id: clearArea
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: -6
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: Notifs.clear()
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Grouped by app; each group shows its newest notification until expanded.
                ListView {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.preferredHeight: Notifs.count ? Math.min(contentHeight, 360) : 0
                    visible: Notifs.count > 0
                    clip: true
                    spacing: 12
                    // Keyed by app name: the group objects are rebuilt on every notification,
                    // but the names stay, so existing delegates are kept and `displaced` runs.
                    model: ScriptModel { values: Notifs.groups.map(g => g.app) }
                    boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                    delegate: ColumnLayout {
                        id: group
                        required property int index
                        StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 6 + group.index }
                        required property string modelData
                        readonly property string app: modelData
                        readonly property var items: Notifs.groups.find(g => g.app === app)?.items ?? []
                        readonly property bool expanded: root.expandedApps.includes(app)
                        width: ListView.view.width
                        spacing: 6

                        RowLayout {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            Layout.leftMargin: 4
                            Layout.rightMargin: 4
                            Label {
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                // While the pointer is on the rule button, what it does instead of the count.
                                text: group.app + (ruleArea.containsMouse
                                    ? " · " + ({ "": "click: no popups", "silent": "no popups · click: mute",
                                                 "mute": "muted · click: always keep", "keep": "always kept · click: normal" })[Notifs.rule(group.app)]
                                    : group.items.length > 1 ? ` · ${group.items.length}` : "")
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                                color: Theme.textSoft
                            }
                            Label {
                                visible: group.items.length > 1
                                text: group.expanded ? "Show less" : "Show all"
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                color: expandArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.accent
                                MouseArea {
                                    id: expandArea
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    anchors.margins: -6
                                    hoverEnabled: true
                                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                    onClicked: root.expandedApps = group.expanded
                                        ? root.expandedApps.filter(a => a !== group.app)
                                        : [...root.expandedApps, group.app]
                                }
                            }
                            // The app's rule: normal, no popups, muted, or kept; each click moves to the next.
                            Glyph {
                                Layout.leftMargin: 8
                                readonly property string rule: Notifs.rule(group.app)
                                readonly property var next: ({ "": "silent", "silent": "mute", "mute": "keep", "keep": "" })
                                text: ({ "": "󰂚", "silent": "󰂠", "mute": "󰂛", "keep": "󰐃" })[rule] ?? "󰂚"
                                size: 13
                                color: ruleArea.containsMouse ? Theme.text : rule ? Theme.accent : Theme.dim
                                MouseArea {
                                    id: ruleArea
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    anchors.margins: -6
                                    hoverEnabled: true
                                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                    onClicked: Settings.setRule(group.app, parent.next[parent.rule] ?? "")
                                }
                            }
                            Glyph {
                                Layout.leftMargin: 8
                                text: "󰎟"
                                size: 13
                                color: clearGroup.containsMouse ? Theme.text : Theme.dim
                                MouseArea {
                                    id: clearGroup
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    anchors.margins: -6
                                    hoverEnabled: true
                                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                    onClicked: Notifs.clearApp(group.app)
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Repeater {
                            model: ScriptModel { values: group.expanded ? group.items : group.items.slice(0, 1) }
                            delegate: NotificationCard {
                                required property var modelData
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                notification: modelData
                                compact: true
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    displaced: Transition { NumberAnimation { property: "y"; duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                }

                ColumnLayout {
                    StaggerReveal { shown: root.open && mainPage.visible; order: 6 }
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.bottomMargin: 6
                    visible: Notifs.count === 0
                    spacing: 4
                    Glyph { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "󰂜"; size: 26; color: Theme.dim }
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter; text: "All caught up"; color: Theme.muted }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/DawnScene.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes
import "dawn/layers.js" as Dawn

// Dawn: stars twinkle, the glow breathes, light creeps along the planet's rim, a moonlet rides
// the ring and a shooting star crosses now and then.
WallpaperScene {
    id: root
    folder: "dawn"
    layers: Dawn.layers
    width: Dawn.width
    height: Dawn.height

    // Ring geometry from assets/wallpaper-dawn.svg.
    readonly property point planet: Qt.point(820, 1010)
    readonly property real ringX: 760
    readonly property real ringY: 172
    readonly property real ringTilt: 16 * Math.PI / 180

    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: root.clean ? "sky-clean" : "sky"; z: 0 }
    // Rendered brighter than the still image, so it can swell and ebb around it.
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "glow"
        z: 1
        opacity: (1 + 0.3 * root.wave(11)) / info.boost
    }
    Stars {
        scene: root
        stars: Dawn.stars
        z: 2
    }
    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "back"; z: 3 }
    DesktopDepth {
        z: 4
        active: root.desktop && !root.clean
        running: root.running
        center: root.planet
        orbitRadius: 465
        clockY: 362
    }
    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "planet"; z: 5 }
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "rim"
        z: 6
        opacity: 0.85 + 0.15 * root.wave(7, 1)
        pivot: root.planet
        angle: 3 * root.wave(23)
    }
    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "front"; z: 7 }

    // A moonlet on the ring: behind the planet on the far side, brightest where the ring is lit.
    Item {
        readonly property real angle: 2 * Math.PI * root.t / 80 + 2.2
        readonly property real along: root.ringX * Math.cos(angle)
        readonly property real across: root.ringY * Math.sin(angle)
        x: root.planet.x + along * Math.cos(root.ringTilt) - across * Math.sin(root.ringTilt)
        y: root.planet.y + along * Math.sin(root.ringTilt) + across * Math.cos(root.ringTilt)
        z: across > 0 ? 8 : 4
        scale: 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(angle)
        opacity: Math.max(0.2, 1 - Math.abs(Math.cos(angle)))

        Shape {
            x: -24
            y: -24
            width: 48
            height: 48
            preferredRendererType: Shape.CurveRenderer
            ShapePath {
                strokeColor: "transparent"
                fillGradient: RadialGradient {
                    centerX: 24; centerY: 24; focalX: 24; focalY: 24
                    centerRadius: 24
                    GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.alpha(root.sceneTint, 0.55) }
                    GradientStop { position: 1; color: "transparent" }
                }
                PathAngleArc { centerX: 24; centerY: 24; radiusX: 24; radiusY: 24; sweepAngle: 360 }
            }
        }
        Rectangle {
            x: -2.5
            y: -2.5
            width: 5
            height: 5
            radius: 2.5
            color: root.sceneTint
        }
    }

    // Shooting stars cross the open sky to the right.
    Meteor {
        z: 9
        running: root.running
        area: Qt.rect(1700, 80, 700, 300)
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick

// SVG-space widgets: foreground scene layers occlude the lower edge of the clock and aura.
// Reuses the bar's Cava stream; no extra audio process or frame timer.
Item {
    id: root
    required property bool active
    required property bool running
    required property point center
    required property real orbitRadius
    required property real clockY
    // Eclipse feeds the same audio samples into its existing horizon aurora instead.
    property bool radialAura: true
    readonly property bool live: active && running && Settings.desktopAura
        && !Theme.reducedMotion && Ui.hasVisualizer && !!Media.playing
    visible: active
    // Disconnect the audio binding while resting or covered.
    readonly property var samples: live ? Media.bars : []

    Column {
        z: 1
        x: root.center.x - width / 2
        y: root.clockY
        width: 800
        visible: root.active && Settings.desktopClock
        spacing: -8
        Text {
            width: parent.width
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: Qt.formatDateTime(Clock.date, "dddd, d MMMM").toUpperCase()
            font.family: Theme.sans
            font.pixelSize: 23
            font.letterSpacing: 5
            font.weight: Font.Medium
            color: Theme.accentBright
            style: Text.Outline
            styleColor: Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.35)
        }
        Text {
            width: parent.width
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: Qt.formatDateTime(Clock.date, "HH:mm")
            font.family: Theme.display
            font.pixelSize: 240
            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
            font.letterSpacing: -12
            color: Theme.white
            opacity: 0.86
            style: Text.Outline
            styleColor: Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.35)
        }
    }

    Item {
        x: root.center.x
        y: root.center.y
        visible: root.live && root.radialAura
        Repeater {
            model: root.active && root.radialAura && Settings.desktopAura ? 64 : 0
            delegate: Item {
                required property int index
                // Mirror eight frequency bands into a continuous circular spectrum.
                readonly property real band: (index % 32) / 31 * 7
                readonly property real sample: {
                    const a = root.samples[Math.floor(band)] ?? 0;
                    const b = root.samples[Math.min(7, Math.ceil(band))] ?? 0;
                    return a + (b - a) * (band % 1);
                }
                rotation: index * 360 / 64
                Rectangle {
                    x: -2.5
                    y: -root.orbitRadius - height
                    width: 5
                    height: 4 + 70 * parent.sample
                    radius: Theme.corner(2.5)
                    color: index % 16 < 8 ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.pink
                    opacity: 0.25 + 0.5 * parent.sample
                    Behavior on height {
                        enabled: root.live
                        NumberAnimation { duration: 90; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Devices.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Bluetooth
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Networking
import Quickshell.Services.Pipewire
import Quickshell.Services.UPower

// Live device state, with the glyphs the bar and control center show for it.
Singleton {
    id: root

    PwObjectTracker {
        objects: [Pipewire.defaultAudioSink, Pipewire.defaultAudioSource]
    }
    readonly property var sink: Pipewire.defaultAudioSink?.audio ?? null
    readonly property var source: Pipewire.defaultAudioSource?.audio ?? null
    readonly property int volume: sink ? Math.round(sink.volume * 100) : 0
    readonly property bool muted: sink?.muted ?? true
    readonly property string volumeGlyph: muted ? "󰝟" : volume > 60 ? "󰕾" : volume > 25 ? "󰖀" : "󰕿"
    readonly property bool micMuted: source?.muted ?? true
    function setVolume(percent) {
        if (!sink)
            return;
        sink.muted = false;
        sink.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent)) / 100;
    }

    // Volume and microphone keys: 5% steps between 0 and 100% ("up", "down"), "mute" toggles,
    // "current" only shows the popup. Held keys repeat faster than PipeWire reports back, so each
    // step starts from the last one asked for while it is recent.
    property var targets: ({})
    function adjust(control, action) {
        const node = control === "microphone" ? source : sink;
        if (!node)
            return false;
        const recent = targets[control] && Date.now() - targets[control].at < 600;
        let volume = recent ? targets[control].volume : node.volume;
        let muted = node.muted;
        if (action === "mute") {
            muted = !muted;
            node.muted = muted;
        } else if (action === "up" || action === "down") {
            volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.round(volume * 20 + (action === "up" ? 1 : -1)) / 20));
            node.volume = volume;
        }
        targets = Object.assign({}, targets, { [control]: { volume, at: Date.now() } });
        Ui.showOsd(control, Math.round(volume * 100), muted);
        return true;
    }

    readonly property var wifiDevice: Networking.devices.values.find(d => d.type === DeviceType.Wifi) ?? null
    readonly property var wiredDevice: Networking.devices.values.find(d => d.type === DeviceType.Wired) ?? null
    readonly property var wifiNetwork: wifiDevice?.networks.values.find(n => n.connected) ?? null
    readonly property bool wired: wiredDevice?.connected ?? false
    readonly property string networkName: wifiNetwork ? wifiNetwork.name : wired ? "Wired" : "Offline"
    // Signal strength as 0–1, whichever scale the backend reports.
    function strength(network) {
        return network.signalStrength > 1 ? network.signalStrength / 100 : network.signalStrength;
    }
    function signalGlyph(network) {
        const s = strength(network);
        return s > 0.75 ? "󰤨" : s > 0.5 ? "󰤥" : s > 0.25 ? "󰤢" : "󰤟";
    }
    readonly property string networkGlyph: {
        if (wifiNetwork)
            return signalGlyph(wifiNetwork);
        return wired ? "󰈀" : Networking.wifiEnabled ? "󰤯" : "󰤭";
    }

    readonly property var adapter: Bluetooth.defaultAdapter
    readonly property bool bluetoothOn: adapter?.enabled ?? false
    readonly property var bluetoothConnected: Bluetooth.devices.values.filter(d => d.connected)
    readonly property string bluetoothGlyph: !adapter ? "󰂲" : !bluetoothOn ? "󰂲" : bluetoothConnected.length ? "󰂱" : "󰂯"
    readonly property string bluetoothName: !adapter ? "No adapter" : !bluetoothOn ? "Off" : bluetoothConnected.length ? bluetoothConnected[0].name : "On"

    // Batteries of headsets, mice, keyboards and controllers: UPower's (which also hears Logitech
    // receivers), then Bluetooth's for the rest. ["Name 80%"].
    readonly property var peripheralBatteries: {
        const percent = p => Math.round(p > 1 ? p : p * 100);
        const found = UPower.devices.values
            .filter(d => d.ready && d.isPresent && !d.isLaptopBattery && d.type !== UPowerDeviceType.LinePower && d.type !== UPowerDeviceType.Battery && d.percentage > 0)
            .map(d => ({ name: d.model || d.nativePath, percent: percent(d.percentage) }));
        for (const d of bluetoothConnected)
            if (d.batteryAvailable && !found.some(f => f.name === d.name))
                found.push({ name: d.name, percent: percent(d.battery) });
        return found.map(f => `${f.name} ${f.percent}%`);
    }
    readonly property var battery: UPower.displayDevice
    // Not until UPower has answered: before that the percentage reads 0 and would warn.
    readonly property bool hasBattery: (battery?.ready ?? false) && battery.isPresent && battery.type === UPowerDeviceType.Battery
    readonly property int batteryPercent: !hasBattery ? 0 : Math.round(battery.percentage > 1 ? battery.percentage : battery.percentage * 100)
    readonly property bool charging: hasBattery && (battery.state === UPowerDeviceState.Charging || battery.state === UPowerDeviceState.FullyCharged || battery.state === UPowerDeviceState.PendingCharge)
    readonly property string batteryGlyph: charging ? "󰂄" : ["󰁺", "󰁼", "󰁾", "󰂀", "󰁹"][Math.min(4, Math.floor(batteryPercent / 20))]
    readonly property color batteryColor: charging ? Theme.green : batteryPercent <= 10 ? Theme.rose : batteryPercent <= 25 ? Theme.amber : Theme.textSoft
    readonly property string batteryDetail: {
        if (!hasBattery)
            return "";
        const seconds = charging ? battery.timeToFull : battery.timeToEmpty;
        if (!seconds)
            return charging ? "Charging" : "On battery";
        const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600), m = Math.round(seconds % 3600 / 60);
        return `${h ? h + " h " : ""}${m} min ${charging ? "until full" : "left"}`;
    }
    // Warn once at 10% and again, as a critical notification that stays, at 5%, while
    // discharging; plugging the charger in resets both.
    // Checked later, once every binding has caught up: when hasBattery turns true,
    // batteryPercent and charging still hold their old 0 and false.
    property int batteryWarned: 100
    onBatteryPercentChanged: Qt.callLater(warnBattery)
    onChargingChanged: Qt.callLater(warnBattery)
    onHasBatteryChanged: Qt.callLater(warnBattery)
    function warnBattery() {
        if (!hasBattery || charging) {
            batteryWarned = 100;
            return;
        }
        const level = batteryPercent <= 5 ? 5 : batteryPercent <= 10 ? 10 : 100;
        if (level >= batteryWarned)
            return;
        batteryWarned = level;
        const critical = level === 5;
        Quickshell.execDetached(["notify-send", "--app-name=Battery", "--icon=" + (critical ? "battery-empty" : "battery-caution"),
            "--urgency=" + (critical ? "critical" : "normal"), critical ? "Battery critically low" : "Battery low",
            `${batteryPercent}% · ${batteryDetail}. Plug in the charger${critical ? " now" : " soon"}.`]);
    }

    // Keyboard layouts of the main keyboard, e.g. ["us", "fr"], and the one in use.
    property var layouts: []
    property int layoutIndex: 0
    property string layoutName: ""
    readonly property string layoutCode: (layouts[layoutIndex] ?? "").toUpperCase()
    function nextLayout() {
        Quickshell.execDetached(["hyprctl", "switchxkblayout", "all", "next"]);
    }
    // Whether the next reading follows a layout switch, which shows in the popup.
    property bool layoutSwitched: false
    Process {
        id: keyboards
        running: true
        command: ["hyprctl", "devices", "-j"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const before = root.layoutName;
                try {
                    const all = JSON.parse(text).keyboards;
                    const main = all.find(k => k.main) ?? all[all.length - 1];
                    root.layouts = main.layout.split(",").map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l);
                    root.layoutIndex = main.active_layout_index ?? 0;
                    root.layoutName = main.active_keymap ?? "";
                } catch (e) {
                    root.layouts = [];
                }
                if (root.layoutSwitched && before !== "" && root.layoutName !== before)
                    Ui.showOsd("layout", 0, false, root.layoutName);
                root.layoutSwitched = false;
            }
        }
    }
    Connections {
        target: Hyprland
        function onRawEvent(event) {
            if (event.name === "activelayout" || event.name === "configreloaded") {
                if (event.name === "activelayout")
                    root.layoutSwitched = true;
                keyboards.running = true;
            }
        }
    }

    // Caps Lock: Hyprland runs `ipc call osd capsLock` when the key is released (hyprland.lua),
    // and says whether it is now on. Laptops often have no light for it.
    property bool capsLock: false
    Process {
        id: capsCheck
        command: ["hyprctl", "devices", "-j"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                try {
                    const all = JSON.parse(text).keyboards;
                    root.capsLock = all.some(k => k.capsLock);
                } catch (e) {
                    return;
                }
                Ui.showOsd("capslock", 0, !root.capsLock, root.capsLock ? "Caps Lock on" : "Caps Lock off");
            }
        }
    }
    function showCapsLock() {
        capsCheck.running = true;
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Displays.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Io

// Screens for Settings → Displays: what Hyprland has, a draft you change, and applying it. A draft
// is tried at once through `hyprctl eval`; unless you keep it within 15 seconds it is undone, in
// case the screen went dark. Only a kept draft is written to ~/.config/penumbra/monitors.lua
// (which hyprland.lua reads before user.lua), so a shell that dies during the trial leaves the
// file as it was and the next reload or login brings the old layout back.
Singleton {
    id: root

    // [{ key, name, label, modes: ["1920x1080@144.00"], mode, x, y, scale, transform, enabled }]
    property var screens: []
    property var draft: []
    readonly property bool changed: JSON.stringify(screens) !== JSON.stringify(draft)
    property int countdown: 0 // seconds left to keep an applied change

    function refresh() {
        if (!list.running)
            list.running = true;
    }
    Process {
        id: list
        command: ["hyprctl", "monitors", "all", "-j"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                let all;
                try {
                    all = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch (e) {
                    return;
                }
                const descriptions = all.map(m => m.description);
                root.screens = all.map(m => {
                    // The model's description stays when the cable moves to another port; two of
                    // the same model (or none) fall back to the port.
                    const unique = m.description && descriptions.filter(d => d === m.description).length === 1;
                    const modes = [...new Set((m.availableModes ?? []).map(t => t.replace(/Hz$/, "")))];
                    // A screen that is off may report no mode of its own.
                    let mode = `${m.width}x${m.height}@${Number(m.refreshRate).toFixed(2)}`;
                    if (m.width > 0 && !modes.includes(mode))
                        modes.unshift(mode);
                    else if (m.width <= 0)
                        mode = modes[0] ?? "preferred";
                    return {
                        key: unique ? "desc:" + m.description : m.name,
                        name: m.name,
                        label: [m.make, m.model].filter(t => t && t !== "Unknown").join(" ") || m.name,
                        modes, mode,
                        x: m.x, y: m.y,
                        scale: m.scale > 0 ? Math.round(m.scale * 1000) / 1000 : 1,
                        transform: m.transform % 4,
                        enabled: !m.disabled
                    };
                });
                if (root.countdown === 0)
                    root.draft = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.screens));
            }
        }
    }
    // Screens plugged in or out while nothing is being changed.
    Connections {
        target: Hyprland
        function onRawEvent(event) {
            if (["monitoradded", "monitorremoved", "monitoraddedv2", "monitorremovedv2"].includes(event.name) && !root.changed)
                root.refresh();
        }
    }

    function update(index, changes) {
        const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft));
        Object.assign(next[index], changes);
        draft = next;
    }
    function reset() {
        draft = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(screens));
    }

    // A mode's pixels, then the size the screen takes in the layout: rotated, divided by its scale.
    function pixels(mode) {
        const m = /^(\d+)x(\d+)/.exec(mode);
        return m ? { width: Number(m[1]), height: Number(m[2]) } : { width: 1920, height: 1080 };
    }
    function logical(s) {
        const p = pixels(s.mode), turned = s.transform % 2 === 1;
        return { width: Math.round((turned ? p.height : p.width) / s.scale), height: Math.round((turned ? p.width : p.height) / s.scale) };
    }
    // Scales Hyprland takes for a mode: whole logical pixels, in 120ths (Wayland's fractional
    // scale), and round enough to read: 1, 1.2, 1.25, 1.33, 1.5…
    function scales(s) {
        const p = pixels(s.mode), found = [];
        for (let k = 120; k <= 360; k++) {
            const whole = Number.isInteger(p.width * 120 / k) && Number.isInteger(p.height * 120 / k);
            if (whole && (k % 6 === 0 || k % 40 === 0))
                found.push(Math.round(k / 120 * 1000) / 1000);
        }
        if (!found.some(v => Math.abs(v - s.scale) < 0.001))
            found.push(s.scale);
        return found.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    }

    // Drop screen `index` near (x, y), in layout pixels: against the nearest edge of another
    // screen, lined up with its side when close, never overlapping. Then the arrangement moves so
    // its top-left corner is 0, 0.
    function place(index, x, y) {
        const me = logical(draft[index]);
        const others = draft.map((s, i) => ({ i, s, size: logical(s) })).filter(o => o.i !== index && o.s.enabled);
        let best = null;
        const overlaps = (cx, cy) => others.some(o => cx < o.s.x + o.size.width && cx + me.width > o.s.x && cy < o.s.y + o.size.height && cy + me.height > o.s.y);
        const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
        const align = (v, starts) => starts.reduce((b, t) => Math.abs(t - v) < Math.abs(b - v) && Math.abs(t - v) < 60 ? t : b, v);
        for (const o of others) {
            const ys = [o.s.y, o.s.y + o.size.height - me.height], xs = [o.s.x, o.s.x + o.size.width - me.width];
            const candidates = [
                { x: o.s.x - me.width, y: align(clamp(y, o.s.y - me.height, o.s.y + o.size.height), ys) },
                { x: o.s.x + o.size.width, y: align(clamp(y, o.s.y - me.height, o.s.y + o.size.height), ys) },
                { x: align(clamp(x, o.s.x - me.width, o.s.x + o.size.width), xs), y: o.s.y - me.height },
                { x: align(clamp(x, o.s.x - me.width, o.s.x + o.size.width), xs), y: o.s.y + o.size.height }
            ];
            for (const c of candidates) {
                const d = Math.hypot(c.x - x, c.y - y);
                if (!overlaps(c.x, c.y) && (!best || d < best.d))
                    best = { x: Math.round(c.x), y: Math.round(c.y), d };
            }
        }
        const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft));
        if (best)
            Object.assign(next[index], { x: best.x, y: best.y });
        const shown = next.filter(s => s.enabled);
        const left = Math.min(...shown.map(s => s.x)), top = Math.min(...shown.map(s => s.y));
        for (const s of next) {
            s.x -= left;
            s.y -= top;
        }
        draft = next;
    }

    // The draft as Lua: one hl.monitor rule per screen.
    function lua(screens) {
        const quote = t => '"' + t.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '"';
        return screens.map(s => s.enabled
            ? `hl.monitor({ output = ${quote(s.key)}, mode = ${quote(s.mode)}, position = "${s.x}x${s.y}", scale = ${s.scale}, transform = ${s.transform} })`
            : `hl.monitor({ output = ${quote(s.key)}, disabled = true })`).join("\n");
    }
    readonly property string header: "-- Your screens, written by the Penumbra shell's Settings → Displays. hyprland.lua reads this\n"
        + "-- file before user.lua; change it there, or here by hand.\n"

    function apply() {
        if (!changed)
            return;
        evaluate(lua(draft));
        countdown = 15;
        timer.restart();
    }
    function keep() {
        timer.stop();
        countdown = 0;
        file.setText(header + lua(draft) + "\n");
        refresh();
    }
    function revert() {
        timer.stop();
        countdown = 0;
        // The file was never touched; only the screens need putting back.
        evaluate(lua(screens));
        draft = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(screens));
        refresh();
    }
    function evaluate(text) {
        Quickshell.execDetached(["hyprctl", "eval", text]);
    }
    Timer {
        id: timer
        interval: 1000
        repeat: true
        onTriggered: {
            root.countdown -= 1;
            if (root.countdown <= 0)
                root.revert();
        }
    }
    FileView {
        id: file
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.config/penumbra/monitors.lua"
        printErrors: false
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/DisplaysPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// Settings → Displays: drag the screens into place, then pick each one's resolution, refresh
// rate, scale and rotation. Displays holds the draft and applies it.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12

    property int selected: 0
    readonly property var current: Displays.draft[Math.min(selected, Displays.draft.length - 1)] ?? null
    readonly property int enabledCount: Displays.draft.filter(s => s.enabled).length
    onVisibleChanged: if (visible && Displays.countdown === 0 && !Displays.changed) Displays.refresh()
    Component.onCompleted: if (Displays.countdown === 0 && !Displays.changed) Displays.refresh()

    // Change the selected screen, then put it back against its neighbours: a new size may overlap.
    function change(changes) {
        Displays.update(selected, changes);
        Displays.place(selected, current.x, current.y);
    }
    readonly property var resolutions: current ? [...new Set(current.modes.map(m => m.split("@")[0]))]
        .sort((a, b) => Displays.pixels(b).width * Displays.pixels(b).height - Displays.pixels(a).width * Displays.pixels(a).height) : []
    readonly property string resolution: current?.mode.split("@")[0] ?? ""
    readonly property var rates: current ? current.modes.filter(m => m.split("@")[0] === resolution)
        .sort((a, b) => Number(b.split("@")[1]) - Number(a.split("@")[1])) : []
    readonly property var scales: current ? Displays.scales(current) : []
    readonly property var rotations: ["Normal", "90°", "Upside down", "270°"]

    // A titled row with its control on the right.
    component SettingRow: RowLayout {
        id: setting
        property string glyph
        property string title
        default property alias control: holder.data
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 10
        Layout.preferredHeight: 36
        spacing: 11
        Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: setting.glyph; size: 17 }
        Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: setting.title }
        Item {
            id: holder
            implicitWidth: childrenRect.width
            implicitHeight: childrenRect.height
        }
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Displays"
        status: Displays.draft.length > 1 ? `${root.enabledCount} of ${Displays.draft.length} screens on · drag to arrange` : (root.current?.label ?? "")
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "settings"
    }

    // ── Arrangement ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Rectangle {
        id: canvas
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        implicitHeight: 168
        radius: Theme.radius
        color: Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.45)
        border.color: Theme.line

        readonly property var shown: Displays.draft.map(s => ({ s, size: Displays.logical(s) })).filter(o => o.s.enabled)
        readonly property real minX: shown.length ? Math.min(...shown.map(o => o.s.x)) : 0
        readonly property real minY: shown.length ? Math.min(...shown.map(o => o.s.y)) : 0
        readonly property real spanX: shown.length ? Math.max(...shown.map(o => o.s.x + o.size.width)) - minX : 1
        readonly property real spanY: shown.length ? Math.max(...shown.map(o => o.s.y + o.size.height)) - minY : 1
        readonly property real fit: Math.min((width - 40) / spanX, (height - 40) / spanY)
        readonly property real originX: (width - spanX * fit) / 2
        readonly property real originY: (height - spanY * fit) / 2

        Repeater {
            model: Displays.draft
            delegate: Rectangle {
                id: box
                required property var modelData
                required property int index
                readonly property var size: Displays.logical(modelData)
                readonly property bool chosen: index === root.selected
                property real dx: 0
                property real dy: 0
                visible: modelData.enabled
                x: canvas.originX + (modelData.x - canvas.minX) * canvas.fit + dx
                y: canvas.originY + (modelData.y - canvas.minY) * canvas.fit + dy
                width: size.width * canvas.fit
                height: size.height * canvas.fit
                z: area.pressed ? 2 : chosen ? 1 : 0
                radius: Theme.corner(8)
                color: chosen ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.28) : Theme.raised
                border.width: chosen ? 2 : 1
                border.color: chosen ? Theme.accent : Theme.lineStrong
                Behavior on x { enabled: !area.pressed; NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                Behavior on y { enabled: !area.pressed; NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }

                ColumnLayout {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: parent.width - 8
                    spacing: 0
                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        text: String(box.index + 1)
                        font.family: Theme.display
                        font.pixelSize: Math.max(Theme.textBody, Math.min(Theme.textHeading, box.height / 3))
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        color: box.chosen ? Theme.text : Theme.textSoft
                    }
                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        visible: box.height > 54
                        text: box.modelData.name
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                        color: Theme.muted
                    }
                }
                MouseArea {
                    id: area
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    hoverEnabled: true
                    cursorShape: canvas.shown.length > 1 ? (pressed ? Qt.ClosedHandCursor : Qt.OpenHandCursor) : Qt.PointingHandCursor
                    property point start
                    onPressed: m => {
                        root.selected = box.index;
                        start = mapToItem(canvas, m.x, m.y);
                    }
                    onPositionChanged: m => {
                        if (!pressed || canvas.shown.length < 2)
                            return;
                        const p = mapToItem(canvas, m.x, m.y);
                        box.dx = p.x - start.x;
                        box.dy = p.y - start.y;
                    }
                    onReleased: {
                        if (box.dx !== 0 || box.dy !== 0)
                            Displays.place(box.index, box.modelData.x + box.dx / canvas.fit, box.modelData.y + box.dy / canvas.fit);
                        box.dx = 0;
                        box.dy = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ── The selected screen ─────────────────────────────────────────
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        visible: !!root.current
        spacing: 8
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: `${root.selected + 1} · ${root.current?.label ?? ""}`
            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
        }
        Label { text: root.current?.name ?? ""; font.family: Theme.mono; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.muted }
    }

    SwitchRow {
        visible: Displays.draft.length > 1
        glyph: "󰍹"
        title: "Use this screen"
        subtitle: root.current?.enabled && root.enabledCount === 1 ? "The last screen on stays on" : ""
        checked: root.current?.enabled ?? false
        onToggled: {
            if (root.current.enabled && root.enabledCount === 1)
                return;
            root.change({ enabled: !root.current.enabled });
        }
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: root.current?.enabled ?? false
        spacing: 4
        SettingRow {
            glyph: "󰨤"
            title: "Resolution"
            Stepper {
                readonly property int at: root.resolutions.indexOf(root.resolution)
                text: root.resolution.replace("x", " × ")
                textWidth: 100
                // Larger to the right.
                canDecrease: at < root.resolutions.length - 1
                canIncrease: at > 0
                function pick(resolution) {
                    // The same refresh rate when the new resolution has it, else its fastest.
                    const rate = root.current.mode.split("@")[1];
                    const modes = root.current.modes.filter(m => m.split("@")[0] === resolution);
                    root.change({ mode: modes.find(m => m.split("@")[1] === rate) ?? modes.sort((a, b) => Number(b.split("@")[1]) - Number(a.split("@")[1]))[0] });
                }
                onDecreased: pick(root.resolutions[at + 1])
                onIncreased: pick(root.resolutions[at - 1])
            }
        }
        SettingRow {
            glyph: "󰓅"
            title: "Refresh rate"
            Stepper {
                readonly property int at: root.rates.indexOf(root.current?.mode ?? "")
                text: `${Math.round(Number((root.current?.mode ?? "@0").split("@")[1]) * 100) / 100} Hz`
                textWidth: 100
                canDecrease: at < root.rates.length - 1
                canIncrease: at > 0
                onDecreased: root.change({ mode: root.rates[at + 1] })
                onIncreased: root.change({ mode: root.rates[at - 1] })
            }
        }
        SettingRow {
            glyph: "󰑒"
            title: "Scale"
            Stepper {
                readonly property int at: root.scales.findIndex(s => Math.abs(s - (root.current?.scale ?? 1)) < 0.001)
                text: Math.round((root.current?.scale ?? 1) * 100) + "%"
                textWidth: 100
                canDecrease: at > 0
                canIncrease: at < root.scales.length - 1
                onDecreased: root.change({ scale: root.scales[at - 1] })
                onIncreased: root.change({ scale: root.scales[at + 1] })
            }
        }
        SettingRow {
            glyph: "󰑵"
            title: "Rotation"
            Stepper {
                text: root.rotations[root.current?.transform ?? 0]
                textWidth: 100
                onDecreased: root.change({ transform: (root.current.transform + 3) % 4 })
                onIncreased: root.change({ transform: (root.current.transform + 1) % 4 })
            }
        }
    }

    // ── Apply, then keep or undo ────────────────────────────────────
    Rectangle {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Displays.countdown > 0
        implicitHeight: keepRow.implicitHeight + 20
        radius: Theme.radius
        color: Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.14)
        border.color: Theme.alpha(Theme.accentBright, 0.45)
        RowLayout {
            id: keepRow
            anchors { fill: parent; margins: 10; leftMargin: 14 }
            spacing: 8
            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 0
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "Keep these settings?"; font.weight: Font.DemiBold }
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: `Undoing them in ${Displays.countdown} s`; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.textSoft }
            }
            PillButton { text: "Undo"; onClicked: Displays.revert() }
            PillButton { text: "Keep"; primary: true; onClicked: Displays.keep() }
        }
    }
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Displays.changed && Displays.countdown === 0
        spacing: 8
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 4
            text: "Not applied yet"
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.muted
        }
        PillButton { text: "Reset"; onClicked: Displays.reset() }
        PillButton { text: "Apply"; primary: true; onClicked: Displays.apply() }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Dock.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets

// One dock per output. A four-pixel edge reveals it; only its visible bounds take input.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    required property var modelData
    property bool locked: false
    screen: modelData
    anchors { bottom: true }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Top
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-dock"
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: WlrKeyboardFocus.None
    readonly property var monitor: Hyprland.monitorFor(screen)
    readonly property var workspace: monitor?.activeWorkspace ?? null
    visible: Settings.dockMode !== "off" && !locked && !(workspace?.hasFullscreen ?? false)
        && !Ui.overviewOpen && !Ui.launcherOpen && !Ui.sessionOpen && !Ui.shotOpen
    property bool held: false
    readonly property bool shown: held || (Settings.dockMode === "empty" && (workspace?.toplevels.values.length ?? 0) === 0)
    readonly property var windows: Hyprland.workspaces.values
        .filter(w => w.monitor?.name === monitor?.name)
        .reduce((all, w) => all.concat(w.toplevels.values), []).filter(w => !w.lastIpcObject?.hidden)
    readonly property var apps: {
        const groups = [];
        for (const id of Settings.dockPins) {
            const entry = DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(id);
            if (entry && !groups.some(g => g.key === entry.id))
                groups.push({ key: entry.id, entry, windows: [], pin: id });
        }
        for (const win of windows) {
            const id = win.wayland?.appId || win.lastIpcObject?.class || "";
            const entry = id ? DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(id) : null;
            const key = entry?.id || id || win.address;
            let group = groups.find(g => g.key === key);
            if (!group) {
                group = { key, entry, windows: [], pin: "" };
                groups.push(group);
            }
            group.windows.push(win);
        }
        return groups;
    }
    readonly property bool previewing: surface.previewing
    implicitWidth: Math.min(screen?.width ?? 800, Math.max(300, apps.length * 56 + 76))
    implicitHeight: 246
    mask: Region { item: inputBounds }
    Item {
        id: inputBounds
        z: 10
        anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter }
        width: root.previewing ? root.width : surface.trayWidth
        height: root.previewing ? 246 : root.shown ? 78 : 4
        HoverHandler {
            onHoveredChanged: {
                if (hovered) { hide.stop(); root.held = true; }
                else hide.restart();
            }
        }
    }
    Timer { id: hide; interval: 450; onTriggered: { root.held = false; surface.hoveredKey = ""; } }
    onVisibleChanged: if (!visible) { held = false; surface.hoveredKey = ""; }
    DockSurface {
        id: surface
        anchors.fill: parent
        apps: root.apps
        shown: root.shown
        onTogglePin: app => Settings.dockPins = app.pin ? Settings.dockPins.filter(id => id !== app.pin) : Settings.dockPins.concat([app.entry.id])
        onLaunchApp: entry => root.launch(entry)
        onActivateWindow: window => root.focusWindow(window)
        onOpenLauncher: Ui.toggleLauncher("apps")
    }
    function focusWindow(win) {
        const address = win.lastIpcObject?.address ?? "0x" + win.address;
        if (/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(address)) Hyprland.dispatch(`hl.dsp.focus({window = "address:${address}"})`);
    }
    function launch(entry) {
        if (!entry) return;
        const command = entry.command.filter(arg => !/^%[a-zA-Z]$/.test(arg));
        Ui.spawn({ command: entry.runInTerminal ? Ui.terminal(command) : command, workingDirectory: entry.workingDirectory || Quickshell.env("HOME") });
    }
}
```
