## `config/quickshell/penumbra/DockSurface.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Visual dock shared by the live layer-shell window and the offscreen preview harness.
Item {
    id: root
    property var apps: []
    property bool shown: false
    property string hoveredKey: ""
    readonly property var hoveredApp: apps.find(a => a.key === hoveredKey) ?? null
    readonly property bool previewing: shown && (hoveredApp?.windows.length ?? 0) > 0
    readonly property real trayWidth: tray.width
    signal togglePin(var app)
    signal launchApp(var entry)
    signal activateWindow(var window)
    signal openLauncher()
    Rectangle {
        id: tray
        anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 10; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter }
        width: Math.min(root.width - 20, root.apps.length * 56 + 64)
        height: 64
        radius: Theme.radiusLarge
        color: Theme.panel
        border.color: Theme.line
        opacity: root.shown ? 1 : 0
        transform: Translate { y: root.shown ? 0 : 80; Behavior on y { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } } }
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
        GlassEdge { radius: parent.radius }
        Flickable {
            anchors { fill: parent; margins: 6 }
            contentWidth: row.width
            contentHeight: height
            flickableDirection: Flickable.HorizontalFlick
            clip: true
            Row {
                id: row
                spacing: 4
                Repeater {
                    model: root.apps
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        id: app
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property bool focused: modelData.windows.some(w => w.activated)
                        width: 52
                        height: 52
                        radius: Theme.corner(14)
                        color: pointer.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                        scale: Theme.reducedMotion ? 1 : pointer.pressed ? 0.94 : pointer.containsMouse ? 1.04 : 1
                        Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                        AppIcon {
                            id: appIcon
                            anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; top: parent.top; topMargin: 5 }
                            implicitSize: 32
                            icon: app.modelData.entry?.icon ?? ""
                            asynchronous: true
                        }
                        Row {
                            anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 4 }
                            spacing: 3
                            Repeater {
                                model: Math.min(3, app.modelData.windows.length)
                                delegate: Rectangle { width: app.focused ? 10 : 4; height: 3; radius: Theme.corner(2); color: app.focused ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.muted }
                            }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            visible: !!app.modelData.pin
                            x: 3; y: 3; width: 3; height: 3; radius: 2; color: Theme.accent
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: pointer
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.MiddleButton | Qt.RightButton
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onEntered: root.hoveredKey = app.modelData.key
                            onClicked: event => {
                                const a = app.modelData;
                                if (event.button === Qt.RightButton && a.entry) {
                                    root.togglePin(a);
                                } else if (event.button === Qt.MiddleButton || !a.windows.length) {
                                    root.launchApp(a.entry);
                                } else {
                                    const index = a.windows.findIndex(w => w.activated);
                                    root.activateWindow(a.windows[(index + 1) % a.windows.length]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    width: 48; height: 52; radius: Theme.corner(14)
                    color: launcher.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                    Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰀻"; size: 26; color: Theme.accentBright }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: launcher
                        anchors.fill: parent; hoverEnabled: true; cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onEntered: root.hoveredKey = ""
                        onClicked: root.openLauncher()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Rectangle {
        id: preview
        visible: root.previewing
        anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 10 }
        height: 156
        radius: Theme.radius
        color: Theme.panel
        border.color: Theme.line
        GlassEdge { radius: parent.radius }
        Flickable {
            anchors { fill: parent; margins: 8 }
            contentWidth: previews.width
            contentHeight: height
            clip: true
            flickableDirection: Flickable.HorizontalFlick
            Row {
                id: previews
                spacing: 8
                Repeater {
                    model: root.previewing ? root.hoveredApp.windows : []
                    delegate: Column {
                        id: thumb
                        required property var modelData
                        width: 200
                        spacing: 5
                        ClippingRectangle {
                            width: 200; height: 110; radius: Theme.corner(8); color: Theme.raised
                            ScreencopyView {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                captureSource: root.visible && root.previewing ? thumb.modelData.wayland : null
                                live: root.visible && root.previewing
                                constraintSize: Qt.size(width, height)
                            }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor; onClicked: root.activateWindow(thumb.modelData) }
                        }
                        Label { width: parent.width; text: thumb.modelData.title; textFormat: Text.PlainText; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/EclipseScene.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes
import "eclipse/layers.js" as Eclipse

// Eclipse: the nebula drifts, stars twinkle and glint, the corona's streamers sway and shimmer,
// the diamond-ring flare breathes, two backlit moons circle the eclipse, an aurora ripples along
// the near world's horizon, a satellite blinks across the sky and the odd shooting star falls.
WallpaperScene {
    id: root
    folder: "eclipse"
    layers: Eclipse.layers
    width: Eclipse.width
    height: Eclipse.height

    // Geometry from assets/wallpaper-eclipse.svg.
    readonly property point eclipse: Qt.point(1660, 600)
    readonly property real orbitTilt: -18 * Math.PI / 180
    readonly property point world: Qt.point(380, 2950)
    readonly property real worldRadius: 1680

    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: root.clean ? "sky-clean" : "sky"; z: 0 }
    // Zoomed a touch so its cropped edges never come into view as it turns.
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "nebula"
        z: 1
        opacity: (1 + 0.25 * root.wave(17)) / info.boost
        zoom: 1.05 + 0.02 * root.wave(60)
        angle: 0.8 * root.wave(80)
    }
    Stars {
        scene: root
        stars: Eclipse.stars
        color: root.sceneTint
        z: 2
    }
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "halo"
        z: 3
        pivot: root.eclipse
        opacity: (1 + 0.2 * root.wave(9)) / info.boost
        zoom: 1.02 + 0.02 * root.wave(9)
    }
    // Two sets of streamers swaying against each other read as a living corona.
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "corona"
        z: 4
        pivot: root.eclipse
        angle: 2.5 * root.wave(47)
        opacity: 0.85 + 0.15 * root.wave(6.3)
    }
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "wisps"
        z: 5
        pivot: root.eclipse
        angle: -3.5 * root.wave(37, 1)
        zoom: 1 + 0.04 * root.wave(11)
        opacity: 0.7 + 0.3 * root.wave(5.1, 2)
    }
    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "orbits"; z: 6 }
    DesktopDepth {
        id: desktopDepth
        radialAura: false
        z: 7
        active: root.desktop && !root.clean
        running: root.running
        center: root.eclipse
        orbitRadius: 295
        clockY: 190
    }
    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "body"; z: 8 }
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "limb"
        z: 9
        opacity: 0.85 + 0.15 * root.wave(4.3)
    }
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "bead"
        z: 10
        opacity: 0.8 + 0.2 * root.wave(5.7)
        zoom: 0.85 + 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * root.wave(5.7))
    }
    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "near"; z: 11 }

    // Moons on the dotted orbits, lit from behind: a rim on the side facing the eclipse that
    // closes into a ring as they cross it. On the far side they pass behind the eclipsing body.
    component Moon: Item {
        id: moon
        required property real orbitX
        required property real orbitY
        required property real period
        required property real phase
        required property real radius
        readonly property real angle: 2 * Math.PI * root.t / period + phase
        readonly property real along: orbitX * Math.cos(angle)
        readonly property real across: orbitY * Math.sin(angle)
        readonly property real toward: Math.atan2(root.eclipse.y - y, root.eclipse.x - x) * 180 / Math.PI
        readonly property real sweep: 110 + 250 * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot(root.eclipse.x - x, root.eclipse.y - y) / 520)
        x: root.eclipse.x + along * Math.cos(root.orbitTilt) - across * Math.sin(root.orbitTilt)
        y: root.eclipse.y + along * Math.sin(root.orbitTilt) + across * Math.cos(root.orbitTilt)
        z: across > 0 ? 12 : 7

        Shape {
            preferredRendererType: Shape.CurveRenderer
            ShapePath {
                fillColor: "#0b0911"
                strokeColor: "#2a1d3a"
                strokeWidth: 1
                PathAngleArc { radiusX: moon.radius; radiusY: moon.radius; sweepAngle: 360 }
            }
            ShapePath {
                fillColor: "transparent"
                strokeColor: root.sceneTint
                strokeWidth: 1.6
                capStyle: ShapePath.RoundCap
                PathAngleArc {
                    radiusX: moon.radius
                    radiusY: moon.radius
                    startAngle: moon.toward - moon.sweep / 2
                    sweepAngle: moon.sweep
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Moon { orbitX: 360; orbitY: 92; period: 55; phase: 0.6; radius: 13 }
    Moon { orbitX: 560; orbitY: 148; period: 95; phase: 3.4; radius: 8 }

    // A satellite crosses in a minute, then the sky stays empty for a while.
    Item {
        readonly property real progress: root.t % 140 / 60
        visible: progress < 1
        z: 13
        x: -40 + 2680 * progress
        y: 230 - 170 * progress
        Rectangle {
            x: -1.3
            y: -1.3
            width: 2.6
            height: 2.6
            radius: 1.3
            color: root.sceneTint
            opacity: 0.6
        }
        Rectangle {
            x: -2.5
            y: -2.5
            width: 5
            height: 5
            radius: 2.5
            color: "#ef8fa4"
            visible: root.t % 1.6 < 0.1
        }
    }

    Meteor {
        z: 14
        running: root.running
        area: Qt.rect(700, 60, 800, 250)
        heading: 150
    }

    SceneLayer { scene: root; name: "world"; z: 15 }
    SceneLayer {
        scene: root
        name: "air"
        z: 16
        opacity: 0.8 + 0.2 * root.wave(8)
    }

    // Aurora along the near world's horizon (eclipse/aurora.frag).
    ShaderEffect {
        z: 17
        y: 640
        width: 1600
        height: 960
        // Audio takes over the curtains completely; only the ambient mode uses the clock.
        property color sceneTint: root.sceneTint
        property real time: desktopDepth.live ? 0 : root.t
        property real audioActive: desktopDepth.live ? 1 : 0
        // DesktopDepth disconnects Cava while paused, locked, disabled or in reduced motion.
        property real bass: ((desktopDepth.samples[0] ?? 0) + (desktopDepth.samples[1] ?? 0)
            + (desktopDepth.samples[2] ?? 0)) / 3
        property real mids: ((desktopDepth.samples[3] ?? 0) + (desktopDepth.samples[4] ?? 0)
            + (desktopDepth.samples[5] ?? 0)) / 3
        property real treble: ((desktopDepth.samples[6] ?? 0) + (desktopDepth.samples[7] ?? 0)) / 2
        Behavior on bass {
            enabled: desktopDepth.live
            NumberAnimation { duration: 60; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
        }
        Behavior on mids {
            enabled: desktopDepth.live
            NumberAnimation { duration: 80; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
        }
        Behavior on treble {
            enabled: desktopDepth.live
            NumberAnimation { duration: 60; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
        }
        property size size: Qt.size(width, height)
        property point center: Qt.point(root.world.x - x, root.world.y - y)
        property real radius: root.worldRadius
        // From the left edge of the scene to where the horizon leaves its bottom edge.
        property real arcFrom: -0.21
        property real arcTo: 0.545
        fragmentShader: "eclipse/aurora.frag.qsb"
    }
}
```

```qml
// A bezel with a clear capsule row and concave inner corners below it.

    id: root
    readonly property real edge: 3

    readonly property real radius: Theme.corner(22)
    preferredRendererType: Shape.CurveRenderer
    ShapePath {
        strokeColor: "transparent"
        fillColor: Theme.surface
        fillRule: ShapePath.OddEvenFill
        startX: 0; startY: 0
        PathLine { x: root.width; y: 0 }
        PathLine { x: root.width; y: root.height }
        PathLine { x: 0; y: root.height }
        PathLine { x: 0; y: 0 }
        // Leave the capsule row clear even when this surface maps above the bar.
        PathMove { x: root.edge; y: root.edge }
        PathLine { x: root.width - root.edge; y: root.edge }
        PathLine { x: root.width - root.edge; y: root.topEdge - 4 }
        PathLine { x: root.edge; y: root.topEdge - 4 }
        PathLine { x: root.edge; y: root.edge }
        PathMove { x: root.edge + root.radius; y: root.topEdge }
        PathLine { x: root.width - root.edge - root.radius; y: root.topEdge }
        PathArc { x: root.width - root.edge; y: root.topEdge + root.radius; radiusX: root.radius; radiusY: root.radius }
        PathLine { x: root.width - root.edge; y: root.height - root.edge - root.radius }
```

```qml
import QtQuick

// A diagonal specular hairline and faint accent reflection over the surface's own border.
// One shader pass (shaders/glass-edge.frag): every bar capsule has one, so no layer or mask.
ShaderEffect {
    id: root

    property real radius: 0
    property real strength: 0.22

    anchors.fill: parent
    visible: strength > 0 && width > 0 && height > 0

    property size size: Qt.size(width, height)
    readonly property real edge: Math.min(1, strength * Theme.highlightGain)
    // Passed opaque, with the alpha apart, since the shader gets colours premultiplied.
    readonly property color tint: Qt.rgba(Theme.highlight.r, Theme.highlight.g, Theme.highlight.b, 1)
    readonly property color reflection: Qt.rgba(Theme.accent.r, Theme.accent.g, Theme.accent.b, 1)
    fragmentShader: "shaders/glass-edge.frag.qsb"
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Glyph.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick

// A Nerd Font icon.
Text {
    id: root
    property real size: 14
    color: Theme.textSoft
    font.family: Theme.mono
    font.pixelSize: size
    verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
    Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

    // The non-Mono Nerd Font draws most icons wider than their one-cell advance, hanging off to
    // the right, so centring the advance leaves the icon off-centre. Pad the short side so the
    // ink, not the advance, sits in the middle.
    TextMetrics {
        id: ink
        font: root.font
        text: root.text
    }
    readonly property real inkOffset: ink.tightBoundingRect.x + ink.tightBoundingRect.width / 2 - ink.advanceWidth / 2
    leftPadding: Math.max(0, -2 * inkOffset)
    rightPadding: Math.max(0, 2 * inkOffset)
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Graph.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes

// A history graph, newest sample at the right edge: a line over a fill that fades downwards.
// While live, each new sample glides in over one sampling interval instead of jumping.
Item {
    id: root

    property var values: []
    // The value at the top edge; 0 scales to the largest value shown, but never below floor.
    property real maximum: 100
    property real floor: 1
    property color color: Theme.accent
    property real fillOpacity: 0.3
    property bool live: true

    readonly property real ceiling: maximum > 0 ? maximum : Math.max(floor, 1.15 * Math.max(0, ...values))
    // One point more than fits: the oldest sits just off the left edge, so the glide never
    // shows a gap there.
    readonly property real step: width / (Usage.historyLength - 2)
    // Inset by half the line, so a line along the top or bottom is drawn whole.
    readonly property var points: values.map((v, i) => Qt.point(width - (values.length - 1 - i) * step, 1 + (height - 2) * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(v, ceiling)) / ceiling)))

    clip: true
    onValuesChanged: if (live) glide.restart()

    Shape {
        id: shape
        width: root.width
        height: root.height
        visible: root.points.length > 1
        preferredRendererType: Shape.CurveRenderer

        NumberAnimation on x {
            id: glide
            running: false
            from: root.step
            to: 0
            duration: Usage.interval
        }

        ShapePath {
            strokeColor: "transparent"
            fillGradient: LinearGradient {
                y1: 0
                y2: root.height
                GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.alpha(root.color, root.fillOpacity) }
                GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.alpha(root.color, 0) }
            }
            PathPolyline {
                path: root.points.length ? [Qt.point(root.points[0].x, root.height)].concat(root.points, [Qt.point(root.width, root.height)]) : []
            }
        }
        ShapePath {
            strokeColor: root.color
            strokeWidth: 1.5
            fillColor: "transparent"
            joinStyle: ShapePath.RoundJoin
            capStyle: ShapePath.RoundCap
            PathPolyline { path: root.points }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/IdlePage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland

// When an idle computer dims, locks, turns its screens off and (on battery) suspends:
// settings.conf's idle timings, which penumbra-settings writes into hypridle.conf.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12

    // The steps each row moves through, in minutes; a value typed into settings.conf joins them.
    readonly property var steps: [0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180]
    function choices(value) {
        const list = steps.slice();
        if (value !== "never" && value !== undefined && !list.includes(Number(value)))
            list.push(Number(value));
        return list.sort((a, b) => a - b).map(String).concat(["never"]);
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Idle and sleep"
        status: Ui.caffeine ? "Paused by Stay awake" : Ui.awakeApps.length ? "Paused while an app below is open" : "After this long without input"
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "settings"
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 2
        Repeater {
            model: [
                { key: "idle_dim", glyph: "󰃞", title: "Dim the screen", subtitle: "Any input brightens it again" },
                { key: "idle_lock", glyph: "󰌾", title: "Lock", subtitle: "Also before every suspend" },
                { key: "idle_screen_off", glyph: "󰍹", title: "Turn the screens off", subtitle: "" },
                { key: "idle_suspend", glyph: "󰒲", title: "Suspend", subtitle: "Only on battery" }
            ]
            delegate: Rectangle {
                id: row
                required property var modelData
                readonly property string value: Config.values[modelData.key] ?? "never"
                readonly property var list: root.choices(value)
                readonly property int index: list.indexOf(value === "never" ? "never" : String(Number(value)))
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                implicitHeight: 52
                radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                color: hover.hovered ? Theme.raised : "transparent"
                Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                HoverHandler { id: hover }
                RowLayout {
                    anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 10; rightMargin: 4 }
                    spacing: 11
                    Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: row.modelData.glyph; size: 17 }
                    ColumnLayout {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 0
                        Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: row.modelData.title }
                        Label {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            visible: text !== ""
                            text: row.modelData.subtitle
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                            color: Theme.muted
                        }
                    }
                    Stepper {
                        text: Config.duration(row.value)
                        textWidth: 92
                        canDecrease: row.index > 0
                        canIncrease: row.index < row.list.length - 1
                        onDecreased: Config.set({ [row.modelData.key]: row.list[Math.max(0, row.index - 1)] })
                        onIncreased: Config.set({ [row.modelData.key]: row.list[Math.min(row.list.length - 1, row.index + 1)] })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Apps that keep the screen awake while they are open: video calls, presentations.
    Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Stay awake while open" }
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 2
        Repeater {
            model: Settings.idleInhibitApps
            delegate: ListRow {
                required property string modelData
                readonly property var entry: DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(modelData)
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                glyph: "󰅶"
                title: entry?.name ?? modelData
                subtitle: Ui.awakeApps.includes(modelData) ? "Open now · keeping the screen awake" : modelData
                trailing: "󰅖"
                onClicked: Settings.idleInhibitApps = Settings.idleInhibitApps.filter(a => a !== modelData)
            }
        }
        // Open apps that could be added.
        readonly property var candidates: [...new Set(ToplevelManager.toplevels.values.map(t => t.appId).filter(a => a && !Settings.idleInhibitApps.includes(a)))].sort()
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 4
            Layout.topMargin: 4
            text: parent.candidates.length ? "Add an open app:" : "Open an app to add it here."
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.muted
        }
        Flow {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 4
            spacing: 6
            Repeater {
                model: parent.parent.candidates
                delegate: PillButton {
                    required property string modelData
                    text: DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(modelData)?.name ?? modelData
                    onClicked: Settings.idleInhibitApps = [...Settings.idleInhibitApps, modelData]
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        text: "Stay awake in the control center pauses all of these, and so does a fullscreen window."
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.dim
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        visible: Config.error !== ""
        text: Config.error
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.rose
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/KeyboardPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// Keyboard layouts, their variants and XKB options, and Num Lock: settings.conf's, applied to
// Hyprland at once by penumbra-settings.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12
    onVisibleChanged: if (visible) Config.loadLayouts()
    Component.onCompleted: Config.loadLayouts()

    // The comma-separated entry being typed in a field: its index and text.
    function token(field) {
        const before = field.text.slice(0, field.cursorPosition);
        return { index: before.split(",").length - 1, text: before.slice(before.lastIndexOf(",") + 1).trim().toLowerCase() };
    }
    function replaceToken(field, index, value) {
        const parts = field.text.split(",").map(p => p.trim());
        parts[index] = value;
        field.text = parts.join(",");
        field.cursorPosition = field.text.length;
    }

    // Up to five matches for what is being typed; a click puts one in.
    component Suggestions: ColumnLayout {
        id: suggestions
        property var field
        property var choices: [] // [[code, name]]
        readonly property var current: field.activeFocus ? root.token(field) : null
        readonly property var matches: !current || current.text === "" ? []
            : choices.filter(c => c[0].startsWith(current.text) || c[1].toLowerCase().includes(current.text))
                .sort((a, b) => (b[0] === current.text) - (a[0] === current.text) || (b[0].startsWith(current.text)) - (a[0].startsWith(current.text)))
                .slice(0, 5)
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: matches.length > 0
        spacing: 0
        Repeater {
            model: suggestions.matches
            delegate: Rectangle {
                required property var modelData
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                implicitHeight: 28
                radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                color: pick.containsMouse ? Theme.raised : "transparent"
                RowLayout {
                    anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 12; rightMargin: 12 }
                    spacing: 10
                    Label { Layout.preferredWidth: 90; text: modelData[0]; font.family: Theme.mono; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.accentBright }
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: modelData[1]; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.textSoft }
                }
                MouseArea {
                    id: pick
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    hoverEnabled: true
                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                    onClicked: {
                        root.replaceToken(suggestions.field, suggestions.current.index, modelData[0]);
                        suggestions.field.forceActiveFocus();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // A labelled text field, saved on Enter or when it loses focus.
    component SettingField: ColumnLayout {
        id: setting
        property string key
        property string title
        property alias field: input
        property alias placeholder: input.placeholderText
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 6
        Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: setting.title }
        Field {
            id: input
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: Config.values[setting.key] ?? ""
            font.family: Theme.mono
            function save() {
                const value = text.split(",").map(p => p.trim()).join(",");
                if (value !== (Config.values[setting.key] ?? ""))
                    Config.set({ [setting.key]: value });
            }
            onAccepted: save()
            onEditingFinished: save()
            // Follow the saved value whenever this field isn't being edited.
            Connections {
                target: Config
                function onValuesChanged() {
                    if (!input.activeFocus)
                        input.text = Config.values[setting.key] ?? "";
                }
            }
        }
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Keyboard"
        status: Config.busy ? "Applying…" : "Changes apply as you press Enter"
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "settings"
    }

    SettingField {
        id: layouts
        key: "kb_layout"
        title: "Layouts"
        placeholder: "us, or several: us,fr"
    }
    Suggestions {
        field: layouts.field
        choices: Config.layouts
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        visible: (Config.values.kb_layout ?? "").includes(",")
        text: (Config.values.kb_layout ?? "").split(",").map(l => Config.layoutName(l)).join(" · ") + " · the bar's layout capsule switches between them"
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.muted
    }

    SettingField {
        id: variants
        key: "kb_variant"
        title: "Variants"
        placeholder: "None; one per layout, e.g. intl or ,dvorak"
    }
    Suggestions {
        field: variants.field
        // Variants of the layout in the same place in the list.
        choices: Config.variants[(Config.values.kb_layout ?? "").split(",")[root.token(variants.field).index] ?? ""] ?? []
    }

    SettingField {
        key: "kb_options"
        title: "Options"
        placeholder: "e.g. caps:escape,grp:alt_shift_toggle"
    }

    SwitchRow {
        glyph: "󰎠"
        title: "Num Lock at login"
        subtitle: "Applies from your next login"
        checked: Config.values.numlock === "on"
        onToggled: Config.set({ numlock: Config.values.numlock === "on" ? "off" : "on" })
    }

    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        visible: Config.error !== ""
        text: Config.error
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.rose
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Launcher.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets
import "search.js" as Search
import "symbols.js" as Symbols

// Applications, open windows, clipboard history, emoji and symbols, over a dimmed screen. Type to
// search; `>` runs a command, `?` searches the web, `/` finds files; a sum (or `=`), "10 km in mi"
// or "100 usd in eur" is worked out and copied. Tab moves to the next mode.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    screen: Ui.screen
    anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    visible: Ui.launcherOpen || card.opacity > 0
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-launcher"
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: Ui.launcherOpen ? WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive : WlrKeyboardFocus.None

    readonly property var modes: [
        { mode: "apps", label: "Apps", glyph: "󰀻" },
        { mode: "windows", label: "Windows", glyph: "󰖯" },
        { mode: "clipboard", label: "Clipboard", glyph: "󰅍" },
        { mode: "emoji", label: "Emoji", glyph: "󰇵" },
        { mode: "symbols", label: "Symbols", glyph: "󰒠" }
    ]
    readonly property bool clipboard: Ui.launcherMode === "clipboard"
    readonly property bool windows: Ui.launcherMode === "windows"
    // Emoji and symbols are a grid of characters.
    readonly property bool characters: Ui.launcherMode === "emoji" || Ui.launcherMode === "symbols"
    readonly property var apps: DesktopEntries.applications.values.filter(e => !e.noDisplay)
    // Emoji and symbols are read the first time either opens, not at startup.
    property bool charactersUsed: false
    onCharactersChanged: if (characters) charactersUsed = true
    onSymbolsChanged: if (Ui.launcherOpen) refresh()
    readonly property var symbols: charactersUsed ? Symbols.groups.reduce((all, g) => all.concat(g[1].map(s => ({ char: s[0], name: s[1], group: g[0] }))), []) : []
    property var emoji: []
    property var results: []
    readonly property var selectedResult: results[view.currentIndex] ?? null
    readonly property bool showPreview: width >= 1080 && !characters
        && ["app", "action", "window", "clip", "pin"].includes(selectedResult?.kind)
    property var readyThumbs: ({})
    property var clips: []
    property var usage: ({}) // desktop entry id → { score, at } (frecency, see search.js)
    property var picks: ({}) // emoji or symbol → times picked
    property var pointer: null // where the mouse last was, in window coordinates

    Connections {
        target: Ui
        function onLauncherOpenChanged() {
            if (Ui.launcherOpen) {
                root.pointer = null;
                root.reset();
            }
        }
        function onLauncherModeChanged() { if (Ui.launcherOpen) root.reset(); }
    }
    onAppsChanged: refresh()

    function reset() {
        search.text = "";
        search.forceActiveFocus();
        if (clipboard)
            loadClips();
        refresh();
    }
    function loadClips() {
        if (Settings.clipboardDays > 0) {
            prune.running = true; // lists the clips once it has expired the old ones
        } else {
            clipList.running = true;
        }
    }

    // Hover follows the mouse only when it moves: opening under a still cursor, the card growing or
    // results shifting beneath it leave the selection alone. Positions are the pointer's own window
    // coordinates, never mapped back through the scaling card, so a still cursor reads the same each
    // time. The first sighting only records where it is.
    function pointerAt(x, y) {
        if (pointer === null)
            pointer = Qt.point(x, y);
        if (Math.hypot(x - pointer.x, y - pointer.y) < 2)
            return;
        pointer = Qt.point(x, y);
        const list = characters ? grid : view;
        const p = list.mapFromItem(null, x, y);
        if (!list.contains(p))
            return;
        const i = list.indexAt(p.x + list.contentX, p.y + list.contentY);
        if (i >= 0)
            list.currentIndex = i;
    }

    // ── Results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function refresh() {
        const text = search.text, q = text.trim().toLowerCase();
        let list = [];
        if (characters) {
            const terms = q.split(/\s+/).filter(t => t);
            const pool = Ui.launcherMode === "emoji" ? emoji : symbols;
            const scored = pool.map((c, i) => ({ c, i, score: Search.charScore(c, terms, picks[c.char]) })).filter(s => s.score > 0);
            scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.i - b.i);
            list = scored.map(s => ({ kind: "char", char: s.c }));
        } else if (clipboard) {
            // Pinned texts first; Clear history leaves them.
            list = Settings.clipboardPins.filter(t => !q || t.toLowerCase().includes(q)).map(t => ({ kind: "pin", text: t }))
                .concat(clips.filter(c => !q || c.text.toLowerCase().includes(q)).map(c => ({ kind: "clip", clip: c })));
        } else if (windows) {
            const open = ToplevelManager.toplevels.values.filter(t => !q || (t.title + " " + t.appId).toLowerCase().includes(q));
            list = open.map(t => ({ kind: "window", toplevel: t, entry: DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(t.appId) }));
        } else if (text.startsWith(">")) {
            if (text.slice(1).trim())
                list = [{ kind: "run", command: text.slice(1).trim() }];
        } else if (text.startsWith("?")) {
            if (text.slice(1).trim())
                list = [{ kind: "web", query: text.slice(1).trim() }];
        } else if (text.startsWith("/")) {
            list = files; // findFiles fills them in as you type
        } else {
            const sum = Search.calculate(text);
            if (sum !== null)
                list.push({ kind: "calc", value: sum });
            const units = Search.convert(text);
            if (units)
                list.push({ kind: "convert", value: units.value, unit: units.unit });
            const money = Search.currency(text);
            if (money) {
                const answer = exchange(money);
                if (answer)
                    list.push(answer);
            }
            const now = Date.now();
            const scored = apps.map(e => ({ entry: e, score: Search.score(e, q, Search.frecency(usage[e.id], now)) })).filter(s => s.score > 0);
            // Desktop actions ("New Private Window") join in when the query names them.
            for (const e of apps)
                for (const a of e.actions ?? []) {
                    const score = Search.actionScore(e.name, a.name, q);
                    if (score)
                        scored.push({ entry: e, action: a, score: score + Search.boost(Search.frecency(usage[e.id], now)) });
                }
            scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.entry.name.localeCompare(b.entry.name));
            list = list.concat(scored.slice(0, 60).map(s => s.action ? { kind: "action", entry: s.entry, action: s.action } : { kind: "app", entry: s.entry }));
            // Nothing runs unless asked for with `>`: a typo like "reboot" must not reboot.
        }
        results = list;
        view.currentIndex = 0;
        view.positionViewAtBeginning();
        grid.currentIndex = 0;
        grid.positionViewAtBeginning();
    }

    // ── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    function activate(index, alternate) {
        const item = results[index];
        if (!item)
            return;
        Ui.launcherOpen = false;
        if (item.kind === "app") {
            launch(item.entry);
        } else if (item.kind === "run") {
            Ui.spawn(alternate ? Ui.terminal(["bash", "-c", item.command], ["--hold"]) : ["bash", "-c", item.command]);
        } else if (item.kind === "action") {
            const command = item.action.command.filter(arg => !/^%[a-zA-Z]$/.test(arg));
            Ui.spawn({ command, workingDirectory: item.entry.workingDirectory || Quickshell.env("HOME") });
            usage = Object.assign({}, usage, { [item.entry.id]: Search.launched(usage[item.entry.id], Date.now()) });
            usageFile.setText(JSON.stringify(usage));
        } else if (item.kind === "window") {
            item.toplevel.activate();
        } else if (item.kind === "web") {
            Ui.spawn(["xdg-open", "https://duckduckgo.com/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(item.query)]);
        } else if (item.kind === "file") {
            // Shift+Enter opens the folder it is in.
            Ui.spawn(["xdg-open", alternate ? item.path.replace(/\/[^/]*$/, "") || "/" : item.path]);
        } else if (item.kind === "calc" || item.kind === "convert" || item.kind === "currency" && !item.pending) {
            Ui.spawn(["wl-copy", String(item.value)]);
        } else if (item.kind === "pin") {
            Ui.spawn(["wl-copy", "--", item.text]);
        } else if (item.kind === "clip") {
            Ui.spawn(["bash", "-c", 'printf "%s" "$1" | cliphist decode | wl-copy', "_", item.clip.line]);
        } else if (item.kind === "char") {
            // Typed into the focused window once the launcher lets go of the keyboard, else copied.
            Ui.spawn(["bash", "-c",
                'if [ "$2" = type ] && command -v wtype >/dev/null; then sleep 0.15; printf "%s" "$1" | wtype -; else printf "%s" "$1" | wl-copy; fi',
                "_", item.char.char, alternate || !Ui.hasTyping ? "copy" : "type"]);
            picks = Object.assign({}, picks, { [item.char.char]: (picks[item.char.char] ?? 0) + 1 });
            picksFile.setText(JSON.stringify(picks));
        }
    }
    function launch(entry) {
        // Field codes (%u, %F…) stand for files and URLs; there are none to pass.
        const command = entry.command.filter(arg => !/^%[a-zA-Z]$/.test(arg));
        Ui.spawn({
            command: entry.runInTerminal ? Ui.terminal(command) : command,
            workingDirectory: entry.workingDirectory || Quickshell.env("HOME")
        });
        usage = Object.assign({}, usage, { [entry.id]: Search.launched(usage[entry.id], Date.now()) });
        usageFile.setText(JSON.stringify(usage));
    }
    function forget(index) {
        const item = results[index];
        if (item?.kind === "pin") {
            Settings.clipboardPins = Settings.clipboardPins.filter(t => t !== item.text);
        } else if (item?.kind === "clip") {
            Quickshell.execDetached(["bash", "-c", 'printf "%s" "$1" | cliphist delete', "_", item.clip.line]);
            clips = clips.filter(c => c !== item.clip);
        } else {
            return;
        }
        const keep = view.currentIndex;
        refresh();
        view.currentIndex = Math.min(keep, results.length - 1);
    }

    // Alt+P pins a text clip (the whole text: cliphist's list only has a preview) or unpins a pin.
    function togglePin(index) {
        const item = results[index];
        if (item?.kind === "pin") {
            forget(index);
        } else if (item?.kind === "clip" && !item.clip.image) {
            pinner.command = ["bash", "-c", 'printf "%s" "$1" | cliphist decode', "_", item.clip.line];
            pinner.running = true;
        }
    }
    Process {
        id: pinner
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                if (text && !Settings.clipboardPins.includes(text))
                    Settings.clipboardPins = [text, ...Settings.clipboardPins];
                root.refresh();
            }
        }
    }

    // Files for `/name`: fd when it is installed (it skips hidden and ignored files), else find,
    // in the home folder; asked again a moment after typing stops.
    property var files: []
    Timer {
        id: findFiles
        interval: 150
        onTriggered: {
            const name = search.text.slice(1).trim();
            fileSearch.running = false;
            if (!name) {
                root.files = [];
                root.refresh();
                return;
            }
            fileSearch.command = ["bash", "-c",
                'cd "$HOME" && if command -v fd >/dev/null; then fd -i --absolute-path --max-results 40 -- "$1"; '
                + 'else find "$HOME" -mindepth 1 -name ".*" -prune -o -iname "*$1*" -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 40; fi', "_", name];
            fileSearch.running = true;
        }
    }
    Process {
        id: fileSearch
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                root.files = text.split("\n").filter(l => l).map(path => ({ kind: "file", path: path.replace(/\/$/, "") }));
                if (search.text.startsWith("/"))
                    root.refresh();
            }
        }
    }

    // Exchange rates from the European Central Bank (frankfurter.dev), asked for only when a
    // query names two currencies and kept for 12 hours.
    property var rates: ({}) // base → { rates, date, at }
    function exchange(money) {
        const known = rates[money.from];
        if (!known || Date.now() - known.at > 12 * 3600000) {
            if (!rateFetch.running) {
                rateFetch.base = money.from;
                rateFetch.command = ["curl", "-sfL", "--max-time", "5", "https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/latest?base=" + money.from];
                rateFetch.running = true;
            }
            return known ? null : { kind: "currency", pending: true, value: "", text: `${money.amount} ${money.from} in ${money.to}` };
        }
        const rate = known.rates[money.to];
        if (!rate)
            return null;
        const value = Number((money.amount * rate).toFixed(rate * money.amount >= 100 ? 2 : 4));
        return { kind: "currency", value, text: `${value} ${money.to}`, date: known.date, from: money };
    }
    Process {
        id: rateFetch
        property string base: ""
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(text);
                    if (data.rates)
                        root.rates = Object.assign({}, root.rates, { [rateFetch.base]: { rates: data.rates, date: data.date, at: Date.now() } });
                } catch (e) {
                    root.rates = Object.assign({}, root.rates, { [rateFetch.base]: { rates: {}, date: "", at: Date.now() } });
                }
                if (Ui.launcherOpen)
                    root.refresh();
            }
        }
    }

    // Clipboard history older than Settings → Clipboard history goes, every hour and before the
    // clipboard opens.
    Process {
        id: prune
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-clipboard", "prune", String(Settings.clipboardDays)]
        onExited: if (Ui.launcherOpen && root.clipboard) clipList.running = true
    }
    Timer {
        interval: 3600000
        running: Settings.clipboardDays > 0
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: if (!prune.running) prune.running = true
    }

    function gridKey(key) {
        const page = grid.columns * 4;
        if (key === Qt.Key_Left)
            grid.moveCurrentIndexLeft();
        else if (key === Qt.Key_Right)
            grid.moveCurrentIndexRight();
        else if (key === Qt.Key_Up)
            grid.moveCurrentIndexUp();
        else if (key === Qt.Key_Down)
            grid.moveCurrentIndexDown();
        else if (key === Qt.Key_PageDown)
            grid.currentIndex = Math.min(results.length - 1, grid.currentIndex + page);
        else if (key === Qt.Key_PageUp)
            grid.currentIndex = Math.max(0, grid.currentIndex - page);
        else
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    FileView {
        id: usageFile
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/launcher.json"
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: {
            try {
                root.usage = JSON.parse(text());
            } catch (e) {
                root.usage = {};
            }
        }
    }

    FileView {
        id: picksFile
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/characters.json"
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: {
            try {
                root.picks = JSON.parse(text());
            } catch (e) {
                root.picks = {};
            }
        }
    }

    // Unicode's emoji list (the unicode-emoji package), one per line:
    // "1F600 ; fully-qualified # 😀 E1.0 grinning face", under "# group: …" headings.
    // Skin-tone variants are left out.
    FileView {
        path: root.charactersUsed ? "/usr/share/unicode/emoji/emoji-test.txt" : ""
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: {
            let group = "";
            const list = [];
            for (const line of text().split("\n")) {
                if (line.startsWith("# group: ")) {
                    group = line.slice(9);
                    continue;
                }
                const m = line.match(/; fully-qualified\s+# (\S+) E[\d.]+ (.+)$/);
                if (m && !m[2].includes("skin tone"))
                    list.push({ char: m[1], name: m[2], group });
            }
            root.emoji = list;
            if (Ui.launcherOpen)
                root.refresh();
        }
    }

    // cliphist lists "id<TAB>preview", newest first; images preview as
    // "[[ binary data 52 KiB png 800x600 ]]".
    Process {
        id: clipList
        command: ["cliphist", "list"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                root.clips = text.split("\n").filter(line => line.includes("\t")).map(line => {
                    const tab = line.indexOf("\t"), preview = line.slice(tab + 1);
                    const image = preview.match(/^\[\[ binary data (.+) (\w+) (\d+)x(\d+) \]\]$/);
                    return {
                        line,
                        id: line.slice(0, tab),
                        text: image ? `${image[2].toUpperCase()} image · ${image[3]}×${image[4]} · ${image[1]}` : preview.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(),
                        image: image ? image[2] : ""
                    };
                });
                root.refresh();
            }
        }
    }
    readonly property string thumbs: (Quickshell.env("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR") || "/tmp") + "/penumbra/clipboard"

    // ── Surface ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Faint enough that the glass rule leaves it unblurred; only the card is frosted.
    Rectangle {
        anchors.fill: parent
        color: Theme.alpha(Theme.scrim, 0.26)
        opacity: card.opacity
        MouseArea {
            anchors.fill: parent
            onClicked: Ui.launcherOpen = false
        }
    }

    Shadow { target: card }
    Rectangle {
        id: card
        width: root.showPreview ? 960 : Math.min(640, root.width - 32)
        x: (parent.width - width) / 2
        y: Math.min(100, Math.round(parent.height * 0.12))
        implicitHeight: Math.max(root.showPreview ? 370 : 0, column.implicitHeight + 24)
        height: implicitHeight
        radius: Theme.radiusLarge
        color: Theme.panel
        border.color: Theme.lineStrong
        clip: true
        opacity: Ui.launcherOpen ? 1 : 0
        scale: Ui.launcherOpen ? 1 : 0.96
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
        Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo } }
        Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }

        LauncherPreview {
            anchors { top: parent.top; right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom; margins: 12 }
            width: 304
            visible: root.showPreview
            active: visible && Ui.launcherOpen
            result: root.selectedResult
            clipImage: root.selectedResult?.kind === "clip" ? root.readyThumbs[root.selectedResult.clip.id] ?? "" : ""
        }

        // Swallow clicks so they don't reach the backdrop.
        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }
        // Handlers hear hover even when a row's MouseArea takes it.
        HoverHandler {
            onPointChanged: if (hovered) root.pointerAt(point.scenePosition.x, point.scenePosition.y)
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: column
            x: 12
            y: 12
            width: root.showPreview ? 616 : parent.width - 24
            spacing: 8

            // Search field and mode switch.
            RowLayout {
                StaggerReveal { shown: Ui.launcherOpen; order: 0 }
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                Layout.preferredHeight: 48
                spacing: 12
                Glyph {
                    text: Ui.launcherMode !== "apps" ? root.modes.find(m => m.mode === Ui.launcherMode).glyph
                        : search.text.startsWith(">") ? "󰆍" : search.text.startsWith("?") ? "󰖟" : search.text.startsWith("/") ? "󰈞" : "󰍉"
                    size: 20
                    color: Theme.accentBright
                }
                TextInput {
                    id: search
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    color: Theme.text
                    selectionColor: Theme.accentDeep
                    selectedTextColor: Theme.text
                    font.family: Theme.sans
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTitle
                    clip: true
                    focus: true
                    onTextChanged: {
                        root.refresh();
                        if (text.startsWith("/") && Ui.launcherMode === "apps")
                            findFiles.restart();
                    }
                    Label {
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        visible: !search.text
                        text: ({ windows: "Search open windows…", clipboard: "Search clipboard history…", emoji: "Search emoji…", symbols: "Search symbols…" })[Ui.launcherMode]
                            ?? "Search apps, > run, ? web, / files, = calculate…"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTitle
                        color: Theme.dim
                    }
                    Keys.onPressed: event => {
                        const ctrl = event.modifiers & Qt.ControlModifier;
                        if (event.key === Qt.Key_Escape) {
                            Ui.launcherOpen = false;
                        } else if (root.characters && root.gridKey(event.key)) {
                            // Arrows and pages move around the grid.
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Down || (ctrl && event.key === Qt.Key_N)) {
                            view.incrementCurrentIndex();
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Up || (ctrl && event.key === Qt.Key_P)) {
                            view.decrementCurrentIndex();
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_PageDown) {
                            view.currentIndex = Math.min(root.results.length - 1, view.currentIndex + 6);
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_PageUp) {
                            view.currentIndex = Math.max(0, view.currentIndex - 6);
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Tab || event.key === Qt.Key_Backtab) {
                            const at = root.modes.findIndex(m => m.mode === Ui.launcherMode), step = event.key === Qt.Key_Tab ? 1 : -1;
                            Ui.launcherMode = root.modes[(at + step + root.modes.length) % root.modes.length].mode;
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Return || event.key === Qt.Key_Enter) {
                            root.activate(root.characters ? grid.currentIndex : view.currentIndex, event.modifiers & Qt.ShiftModifier);
                        } else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Delete && (event.modifiers & Qt.ShiftModifier)) {
                            root.forget(view.currentIndex);
                        } else if (root.clipboard && event.key === Qt.Key_P && (event.modifiers & Qt.AltModifier)) {
                            root.togglePin(view.currentIndex);
                        } else {
                            return;
                        }
                        event.accepted = true;
                    }
                }
                // Only the current mode shows its name; the others are icons.
                Repeater {
                    model: root.modes
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property bool current: Ui.launcherMode === modelData.mode
                        implicitWidth: current ? modeRow.implicitWidth + 22 : 30
                        implicitHeight: 30
                        radius: Theme.corner(15)
                        color: current ? Theme.accent : modeArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
                        border.color: current ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.line
                        Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                        RowLayout {
                            id: modeRow
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            spacing: 6
                            Glyph { text: modelData.glyph; size: 13; color: current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft }
                            Label { visible: current; text: modelData.label; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; font.weight: Font.DemiBold; color: current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text }
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: modeArea
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: { Ui.launcherMode = modelData.mode; search.forceActiveFocus(); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Rectangle {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                implicitHeight: 1
                color: Theme.line
            }

            ListView {
                id: view
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(contentHeight, 7 * 64, Math.max(64, root.height - card.y - 210 * Theme.textScale))
                visible: root.results.length > 0 && !root.characters
                clip: true
                spacing: 2
                model: root.characters ? [] : root.results
                boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                highlightMoveDuration: Theme.fast
                highlight: Rectangle {
                    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                    color: Theme.line
                    border.color: Theme.lineStrong
                }
                delegate: Item {
                    id: row
                    StaggerReveal { shown: Ui.launcherOpen; order: 1 + row.index }
                    required property var modelData
                    required property int index
                    readonly property bool current: ListView.isCurrentItem
                    readonly property bool isImage: modelData.kind === "clip" && modelData.clip.image !== ""
                    width: ListView.view.width
                    implicitHeight: isImage ? 84 : Math.max(60, Theme.textMedium + Theme.textSmall + 26)

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: root.activate(row.index, false)
                    }

                    RowLayout {
                        anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 12; rightMargin: 14 }
                        spacing: 14

                        // App icon, or a glyph for commands, sums and text clips.
                        Item {
                            visible: !row.isImage
                            implicitWidth: 32
                            implicitHeight: 32
                            readonly property bool hasIcon: ["app", "action", "window"].includes(row.modelData.kind)
                            AppIcon {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                visible: parent.hasIcon
                                icon: parent.hasIcon ? row.modelData.action?.icon || row.modelData.entry?.icon || row.modelData.toplevel?.appId || "" : ""
                                asynchronous: true
                            }
                            // Picked colors (#rrggbb) show as a swatch.
                            Rectangle {
                                readonly property bool swatch: row.modelData.kind === "clip" && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(row.modelData.clip.text)
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                visible: !parent.hasIcon
                                radius: Theme.corner(10)
                                color: swatch ? row.modelData.clip.text : Theme.raised
                                border.color: swatch ? Theme.lineStrong : "transparent"
                                Glyph {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    visible: !parent.swatch
                                    text: ({ run: "󰆍", calc: "󰃬", clip: "󰅍", pin: "󰐃", web: "󰖟", file: "󰈔", convert: "󰁔", currency: "󰄉" })[row.modelData.kind] ?? ""
                                    size: 16
                                    color: Theme.accentBright
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Image clips show a thumbnail, decoded once into the runtime directory.
                        ClippingRectangle {
                            visible: row.isImage
                            implicitWidth: 112
                            implicitHeight: 68
                            radius: Theme.corner(10)
                            color: Theme.raised
                            Image {
                                id: thumb
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                asynchronous: true
                                sourceSize: Qt.size(224, 136)
                            }
                            Process {
                                running: row.isImage
                                command: ["bash", "-c", 'f=$1; [ -s "$f" ] || { mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; printf "%s" "$2" | cliphist decode > "$f"; }',
                                    "_", `${root.thumbs}/${row.modelData.clip?.id}.${row.modelData.clip?.image}`, row.modelData.clip?.line ?? ""]
                                onExited: exitCode => {
                                    if (exitCode !== 0) return;
                                    const source = Ui.fileUrl(`${root.thumbs}/${row.modelData.clip.id}.${row.modelData.clip.image}`);
                                    thumb.source = source;
                                    root.readyThumbs = Object.assign({}, root.readyThumbs, { [row.modelData.clip.id]: source });
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        ColumnLayout {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            spacing: 1
                            Label {
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                text: {
                                    const m = row.modelData;
                                    if (m.kind === "app")
                                        return m.entry.name;
                                    if (m.kind === "run")
                                        return m.command;
                                    if (m.kind === "calc")
                                        return "= " + m.value;
                                    if (m.kind === "convert")
                                        return `= ${m.value} ${m.unit}`;
                                    if (m.kind === "currency")
                                        return m.pending ? m.text : "≈ " + m.text;
                                    if (m.kind === "action")
                                        return m.action.name;
                                    if (m.kind === "window")
                                        return m.toplevel.title || m.toplevel.appId;
                                    if (m.kind === "web")
                                        return m.query;
                                    if (m.kind === "file")
                                        return m.path.replace(/^.*\//, "");
                                    if (m.kind === "pin")
                                        return m.text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
                                    return m.clip.text;
                                }
                                readonly property bool answer: ["calc", "convert", "currency"].includes(row.modelData.kind)
                                font.pixelSize: answer ? Theme.textTitle - 1 : Theme.textMedium
                                font.family: row.modelData.kind === "run" || answer ? Theme.mono : Theme.sans
                                font.weight: row.current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                                color: answer ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.text
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                            }
                            Label {
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                visible: text !== ""
                                text: {
                                    const m = row.modelData;
                                    if (m.kind === "app")
                                        return m.entry.genericName || m.entry.comment;
                                    if (m.kind === "run")
                                        return "Run command · Shift+Enter in a terminal";
                                    if (m.kind === "calc" || m.kind === "convert")
                                        return "Enter copies the result";
                                    if (m.kind === "currency")
                                        return m.pending ? "Asking the European Central Bank for today's rate…" : `${m.from.amount} ${m.from.from} · ECB rate of ${m.date} · Enter copies`;
                                    if (m.kind === "action")
                                        return m.entry.name;
                                    if (m.kind === "window")
                                        return (m.entry?.name || m.toplevel.appId) + (m.toplevel.activated ? " · focused" : "");
                                    if (m.kind === "web")
                                        return "Search the web · DuckDuckGo in your browser";
                                    if (m.kind === "file")
                                        return m.path.replace(Quickshell.env("HOME"), "~").replace(/\/[^/]*$/, "") + " · Shift+Enter opens the folder";
                                    if (m.kind === "pin")
                                        return "Pinned · Alt+P unpins";
                                    return "";
                                }
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                color: Theme.muted
                            }
                        }

                        Glyph {
                            visible: row.current
                            text: "󰌑"
                            size: 14
                            color: Theme.accent
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            GridView {
                id: grid
                readonly property int columns: 10
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(Math.min(Math.ceil(count / columns), 5) * cellHeight, Math.max(cellHeight, root.height - card.y - 210 * Theme.textScale))
                visible: root.results.length > 0 && root.characters
                clip: true
                cellWidth: Math.floor(width / columns)
                cellHeight: 56
                model: root.characters ? root.results : []
                boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                highlightMoveDuration: Theme.fast
                highlight: Rectangle {
                    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                    color: Theme.line
                    border.color: Theme.lineStrong
                }
                delegate: Item {
                    id: cell
                    StaggerReveal { shown: Ui.launcherOpen; order: 1 + Math.floor(cell.index / grid.columns) }
                    required property var modelData
                    required property int index
                    width: grid.cellWidth
                    height: grid.cellHeight
                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: cell.modelData.char?.char ?? ""
                        font.family: Ui.launcherMode === "emoji" ? "Noto Color Emoji" : Theme.sans
                        font.pixelSize: Ui.launcherMode === "emoji" ? 28 : 24
                        color: Theme.text
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: mouse => root.activate(cell.index, mouse.modifiers & Qt.ShiftModifier)
                    }
                }
            }

            // The chosen character's name.
            RowLayout {
                readonly property var current: root.characters ? root.results[grid.currentIndex]?.char : null
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                visible: !!current
                spacing: 10
                Label {
                    text: parent.current?.name ?? ""
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                    Layout.maximumWidth: 420
                }
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: parent.current?.group ?? ""
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                    color: Theme.muted
                }
            }

            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.topMargin: 14
                Layout.bottomMargin: 10
                visible: root.results.length === 0
                spacing: 4
                Glyph {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.clipboard || root.characters ? root.modes.find(m => m.mode === Ui.launcherMode).glyph : "󰍉"
                    size: 26
                    color: Theme.dim
                }
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    text: {
                        if (root.clipboard)
                            return search.text ? "Nothing copied matches" : "Nothing copied yet";
                        if (Ui.launcherMode === "emoji" && root.emoji.length === 0)
                            return "Install the unicode-emoji package for the emoji list";
                        if (root.characters)
                            return "Nothing matches";
                        if (root.windows)
                            return search.text ? "No open window matches" : "No windows are open";
                        if (search.text.startsWith("/"))
                            return search.text.slice(1).trim() ? (fileSearch.running || findFiles.running ? "Looking…" : "No file in your home folder matches") : "Type part of a file or folder name";
                        if (search.text.trim() && !search.text.startsWith(">") && !search.text.startsWith("?"))
                            return "No application matches · start with > to run it as a command";
                        return "Type to search";
                    }
                    color: Theme.muted
                }
            }

            // Hints, and clearing the clipboard.
            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                Layout.rightMargin: 4
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: {
                        if (root.clipboard)
                            return "↑↓ choose · Enter copy · Alt+P pin · Shift+Del forget · Tab emoji · Esc close";
                        if (root.windows)
                            return "↑↓ choose · Enter go to the window · Tab clipboard · Esc close";
                        if (root.characters)
                            return (Ui.hasTyping ? "Arrows choose · Enter type · Shift+Enter copy" : "Arrows choose · Enter copy")
                                + (Ui.launcherMode === "emoji" ? " · Tab symbols" : " · Tab apps") + " · Esc close";
                        return "↑↓ choose · Enter open · Tab windows · Esc close";
                    }
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                    color: Theme.dim
                }
                PillButton {
                    visible: root.clipboard && root.clips.length > 0
                    text: "Clear history"
                    danger: true
                    onClicked: {
                        Ui.launcherOpen = false;
                        Ui.run(Ui.bin + "penumbra-clipboard clear");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    GlassEdge {
        anchors.fill: card
        radius: card.radius
        opacity: card.opacity
        scale: card.scale
    }
}
```

```qml
// Selected-result details. Live capture stops as soon as the launcher closes.
Rectangle {
    id: root
    property var result: null
    property bool active: false
    property url clipImage: ""
    readonly property var entry: result?.entry ?? null
    readonly property string kind: result?.kind ?? ""
    radius: Theme.radius
    color: Theme.raised

    ColumnLayout {
        anchors { fill: parent; margins: Theme.padding }

            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.preferredHeight: 140
            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
            color: Theme.surface
            Loader {
                anchors.fill: parent
                active: root.active && root.kind === "window"
                sourceComponent: ScreencopyView {
                    captureSource: root.result?.toplevel ?? null
                    live: root.active
                    constraintSize: Qt.size(width, height)
                }
            }
            Image {
                anchors.fill: parent

                source: visible ? root.clipImage : ""

                text: "󰅍"; size: 40; color: Theme.accentBright
            }
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: root.kind === "window" ? root.result?.toplevel?.title ?? ""
                : root.entry?.name ?? (root.kind === "pin" ? "Pinned note" : "Clipboard")
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            maximumLineCount: 3
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textTitle
            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.fillHeight: true
            text: root.entry?.comment || root.entry?.genericName || root.result?.text || root.result?.clip?.text || ""
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignTop
            color: Theme.textSoft
            maximumLineCount: 8
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: root.kind === "window" ? "Enter to focus" : ["clip", "pin"].includes(root.kind) ? "Enter to copy" : "Enter to launch"
            color: Theme.muted
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        }
    }
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// A device or network row; `expanded` reveals the extra content below it.
Rectangle {
    id: root

    property string glyph
    property string title
    property string subtitle
    property string trailing: "" // glyph on the right, e.g. a lock
    property bool highlighted: false
    property bool busy: false
    property bool expanded: false
    property bool danger: false
    default property alias extra: extraColumn.data
    signal clicked()

    implicitHeight: column.implicitHeight + 16
    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
    color: highlighted ? Theme.line : area.containsMouse || expanded ? Theme.raised : "transparent"
    border.color: highlighted ? Theme.lineStrong : expanded ? Theme.line : "transparent"
    Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
    Behavior on implicitHeight { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
    clip: true

    MouseArea {
        id: area
        anchors.fill: parent
        hoverEnabled: true
        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
        onClicked: root.clicked()
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        id: column
        anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 8; leftMargin: 10; rightMargin: 10 }
        spacing: 8

        RowLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 11
            Glyph {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 22
                text: root.glyph
                size: 17
                color: root.highlighted ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.textSoft
            }
            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 0
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: root.title; font.weight: root.highlighted ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal }
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: text !== ""
                    text: root.subtitle
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                    color: root.danger ? Theme.rose : root.highlighted ? Theme.accent : Theme.muted
                }
            }
            Glyph {
                visible: root.busy
                text: "󰔟"
                size: 14
                color: Theme.accent
                RotationAnimation on rotation { running: root.busy && !Theme.reducedMotion; from: 0; to: 360; duration: 1200; loops: Animation.Infinite }
            }
            Glyph {
                visible: root.trailing !== "" && !root.busy
                text: root.trailing
                size: 13
                color: Theme.dim
            }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: extraColumn
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 33
            visible: root.expanded
            spacing: 8
        }
    }
}
```
