## `config/quickshell/penumbra/LockContent.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Widgets

// One monitor of the lock screen: the wordmark-free wallpaper (dawn and eclipse keep moving),
// the time, and the password field. Every monitor shows the same password dots.
Rectangle {
    id: surface
    required property var lock
    property real pixelRatio: 1
    color: Theme.base

    readonly property var player: Media.player

    // ── Wallpaper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Image {
        anchors.fill: parent
        // Not before the surface has a size, so it decodes at the screen's size, not the file's.
        source: width > 0 ? Ui.fileUrl(Ui.wallpaperStill) : ""
        sourceSize: Qt.size(Math.ceil(width * surface.pixelRatio), Math.ceil(height * surface.pixelRatio))
        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
        asynchronous: true
    }
    // Cover the screen like `awww img --resize crop`.
    Loader {
        id: scene
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        // Not before the surface has a size: the scene decodes its layers for it.
        active: surface.width > 0 && !!Ui.wallpaperScenes[Ui.wallpaper]?.scene
        scale: item ? Math.max(surface.width / item.width, surface.height / item.height) : 1
        sourceComponent: Ui.wallpaperScenes[Ui.wallpaper]?.scene === "eclipse" ? eclipse : dawn
        Component {
            id: dawn
            DawnScene {
                folder: Ui.wallpaperScenes[Ui.wallpaper]?.folder ?? "dawn"
                sceneTint: Ui.wallpaperScenes[Ui.wallpaper]?.tint ?? "#c4a6ff"
                clean: true
                running: !Theme.reducedMotion
                pixelScale: width > 0 && height > 0 ? Math.max(surface.width / width, surface.height / height) * surface.pixelRatio : 1
            }
        }
        Component {
            id: eclipse
            EclipseScene {
                folder: Ui.wallpaperScenes[Ui.wallpaper]?.folder ?? "eclipse"
                sceneTint: Ui.wallpaperScenes[Ui.wallpaper]?.tint ?? "#c4a6ff"
                clean: true
                running: !Theme.reducedMotion
                pixelScale: width > 0 && height > 0 ? Math.max(surface.width / width, surface.height / height) * surface.pixelRatio : 1
            }
        }
    }
    // Darker toward the bottom, where the password field sits.
    Rectangle {
        anchors.fill: parent
        gradient: Gradient {
            GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.25) }
            GradientStop { position: 0.55; color: Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.35) }
            GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.78) }
        }
    }

    MouseArea {
        anchors.fill: parent
        onClicked: input.forceActiveFocus()
    }

    // ── Content ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Item {
        id: content
        anchors.fill: parent
        opacity: 0
        Component.onCompleted: { opacity = 1; input.forceActiveFocus(); }
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.slow * 2; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }

        // Battery and network, top right.
        RowLayout {
            anchors { top: parent.top; right: parent.right; margins: 28 }
            spacing: 16
            Glyph { text: Devices.networkGlyph; size: 16; color: Theme.textSoft }
            RowLayout {
                visible: Devices.hasBattery
                spacing: 6
                Glyph { text: Devices.batteryGlyph; size: 16; color: Devices.batteryColor }
                Label { text: Devices.batteryPercent + "%"; color: Devices.batteryColor }
            }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            y: Math.round(parent.height * 0.2)
            spacing: 0
            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: Qt.formatDateTime(Clock.date, "HH:mm")
                font.family: Theme.display
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textDisplay
                font.weight: Font.Light
                font.letterSpacing: -1
                color: Theme.text
            }
            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: Qt.formatDateTime(Clock.date, "dddd d MMMM")
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                font.letterSpacing: 3
                font.capitalization: Font.AllUppercase
                color: Theme.accent
            }
            // How many notifications came in while locked, never what they say.
            RowLayout {
                readonly property int count: Notifs.history.filter(n => (Notifs.received[n.id] ?? 0) > surface.lock.lockedAt).length
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                Layout.topMargin: 14
                visible: Settings.lockNotificationCount && count > 0
                spacing: 8
                Glyph { text: "󰂚"; size: 15; color: Theme.textSoft }
                Label {
                    text: `${parent.count} new notification${parent.count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                    color: Theme.textSoft
                }
            }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: login
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            y: Math.round(parent.height * 0.58)
            spacing: 14

            Avatar {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                size: 76
                ring: true
            }
            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: Quickshell.env("USER")
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
            }

            // The typed password shows as dots; the real field is invisible behind them.
            Rectangle {
                id: field
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                Layout.topMargin: 4
                implicitWidth: 320
                implicitHeight: 52
                radius: Theme.corner(26)
                color: Theme.glassStrong
                border.width: input.activeFocus ? 2 : 1
                border.color: surface.lock.message && !surface.lock.busy ? Theme.rose : input.activeFocus ? Theme.accent : Theme.lineStrong
                Behavior on border.color { ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

                TextInput {
                    id: input
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    opacity: 0
                    echoMode: TextInput.Password
                    enabled: !surface.lock.busy
                    onTextChanged: if (surface.lock.password !== text) surface.lock.password = text
                    Keys.onReturnPressed: surface.lock.submit()
                    Keys.onEnterPressed: surface.lock.submit()
                    Keys.onEscapePressed: text = ""
                    Keys.onPressed: event => {
                        surface.lock.checkCaps();
                        event.accepted = false;
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: surface.lock
                    function onPasswordChanged() {
                        if (input.text !== surface.lock.password)
                            input.text = surface.lock.password;
                    }
                    function onRejected() { shake.restart(); }
                }

                Label {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    visible: surface.lock.password === "" && !surface.lock.busy
                    text: "Enter password"
                    color: Theme.dim
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                }
                Row {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    spacing: 8
                    Repeater {
                        model: Math.min(surface.lock.password.length, 22)
                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            width: 9
                            height: 9
                            radius: Theme.corner(4.5)
                            color: Theme.accentBright
                            scale: 0
                            Component.onCompleted: scale = 1
                            Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast; easing.type: Easing.OutBack } }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Glyph {
                    anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 18; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                    text: surface.lock.busy ? "󰔟" : "󰌆"
                    size: 15
                    color: surface.lock.busy ? Theme.accent : Theme.dim
                    RotationAnimation on rotation { running: surface.lock.busy && !Theme.reducedMotion; from: 0; to: 360; duration: 1200; loops: Animation.Infinite }
                }

                SequentialAnimation {
                    id: shake
                    NumberAnimation { target: field; property: "Layout.leftMargin"; to: 18; duration: 50 * Theme.motion }
                    NumberAnimation { target: field; property: "Layout.leftMargin"; to: -14; duration: 70 * Theme.motion }
                    NumberAnimation { target: field; property: "Layout.leftMargin"; to: 10; duration: 60 * Theme.motion }
                    NumberAnimation { target: field; property: "Layout.leftMargin"; to: 0; duration: 60 * Theme.motion }
                }
            }

            // The fingerprint reader, pulsing while it waits; click it to try again after it paused.
            RowLayout {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                visible: surface.lock.fingerprint
                spacing: 8
                Glyph {
                    property real pulse: 1
                    text: "󰈷"
                    size: 20
                    color: surface.lock.fingerWaiting ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.dim
                    opacity: surface.lock.fingerWaiting ? pulse : 1
                    SequentialAnimation on pulse {
                        running: surface.lock.fingerWaiting && !Theme.reducedMotion
                        loops: Animation.Infinite
                        NumberAnimation { to: 0.35; duration: 900; easing.type: Easing.InOutSine }
                        NumberAnimation { to: 1; duration: 900; easing.type: Easing.InOutSine }
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: -8
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: {
                            surface.lock.fingerTries = 0;
                            surface.lock.startFinger();
                            input.forceActiveFocus();
                        }
                    }
                }
                Label {
                    text: surface.lock.fingerMessage || "Touch the fingerprint reader, or type your password"
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                    color: Theme.textSoft
                }
            }

            // With several keyboard layouts, the one the password is typed in; click to switch.
            Rectangle {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                visible: Devices.layouts.length > 1
                implicitWidth: layoutRow.implicitWidth + 24
                implicitHeight: 28
                radius: Theme.corner(14)
                color: layoutArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.glass
                border.color: Theme.line
                RowLayout {
                    id: layoutRow
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    spacing: 6
                    Glyph { text: "󰌌"; size: 13; color: Theme.textSoft }
                    Label { text: Devices.layoutCode; font.weight: Font.Bold; color: Theme.textSoft }
                }
                MouseArea {
                    id: layoutArea
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    hoverEnabled: true
                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                    onClicked: { Devices.nextLayout(); input.forceActiveFocus(); }
                }
            }

            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                Layout.preferredHeight: 16
                text: surface.lock.message || (surface.lock.capsLock ? "Caps Lock is on" : "")
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                color: surface.lock.message ? Theme.rose : Theme.amber
            }
        }

        // What's playing, with its controls.
        Rectangle {
            anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 40 }
            visible: !!surface.player
            implicitWidth: 360
            implicitHeight: 64
            radius: Theme.corner(32)
            color: Theme.glassStrong
            border.color: Theme.line
            RowLayout {
                anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 8; rightMargin: 12 }
                spacing: 12
                ClippingRectangle {
                    implicitWidth: 48
                    implicitHeight: 48
                    radius: Theme.corner(24)
                    color: Theme.raised
                    Image {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: surface.player?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
                        sourceSize: Qt.size(96, 96)
                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                        asynchronous: true
                    }
                    Glyph {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        visible: !surface.player?.trackArtUrl
                        text: "󰎆"
                        size: 19
                        color: Theme.accentBright
                    }
                }
                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: 1
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: surface.player?.trackTitle || Media.appName(surface.player); font.weight: Font.DemiBold }
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: surface.player?.trackArtist || Media.appName(surface.player); font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.muted }
                }
                Repeater {
                    model: [
                        { glyph: "󰒮", run: () => surface.player.previous() },
                        { glyph: surface.player?.isPlaying ? "󰏤" : "󰐊", run: () => surface.player.togglePlaying(), main: true },
                        { glyph: "󰒭", run: () => surface.player.next() }
                    ]
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var modelData
                        implicitWidth: modelData.main ? 36 : 28
                        implicitHeight: implicitWidth
                        radius: Theme.corner(implicitWidth / 2)
                        color: modelData.main ? Theme.accent : lockMedia.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                        Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: modelData.glyph; size: 15; color: modelData.main ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: lockMedia
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: { modelData.run(); input.forceActiveFocus(); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/LockScreen.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Services.Pam
import Quickshell.Wayland

// The lock screen, on every monitor. hypridle locks through `ipc call lock lock` (which
// `loginctl lock-session` triggers); hyprlock takes over when the shell is not running. With a
// finger enrolled in fprintd, a touch of the reader unlocks it too, while the password still works.
Scope {
    id: root

    property string password: ""
    property bool busy: false
    property string message: ""
    property bool capsLock: false
    // Kept here rather than bound to sessionLock.locked: Quickshell 0.3.2 never signals the
    // unlock, so a binding stays true and the wallpapers stay paused after the first lock.
    property bool locked: false
    // When the screen was locked (Date.now()), for the lock screen's count of new notifications.
    property double lockedAt: 0
    signal rejected()

    // Fingerprint: whether a finger is enrolled (fprintd-list, checked at each lock), the reader
    // is waiting, and what it last said.
    property bool fingerprint: false
    readonly property bool fingerWaiting: fingerPam.active
    property string fingerMessage: ""
    property int fingerTries: 0

    // Whether the screen is locked afterwards.
    function lock() {
        if (sessionLock.locked)
            return true;
        Ui.closeOverlays();
        capsLeds.running = true;
        password = "";
        message = "";
        fingerTries = 0;
        fingerMessage = "";
        fingers.running = true;
        checkCaps();
        lockState.setText("locked\n");
        lockedAt = Date.now();
        sessionLock.locked = true;
        // False if the compositor refused the lock.
        locked = sessionLock.locked;
        return locked;
    }
    function submit() {
        if (busy || password === "")
            return;
        busy = true;
        message = "";
        pam.start();
    }
    function unlock() {
        if (pam.active)
            pam.abort();
        if (fingerPam.active)
            fingerPam.abort();
        sessionLock.locked = false;
        locked = false;
        lockState.setText("");
    }
    // Wait for a finger; a click on the fingerprint glyph tries again after giving up.
    function startFinger() {
        if (fingerprint && sessionLock.locked && !fingerPam.active && fingerTries < 5)
            fingerPam.start();
    }
    // Re-reads the Caps Lock LEDs; cheap enough for every keypress.
    function checkCaps() {
        for (const led of leds.instances)
            led.reload();
    }

    // The default "login" PAM stack, the same one hyprlock includes.
    PamContext {
        id: pam
        onPamMessage: {
            if (responseRequired)
                respond(root.password);
            else if (message)
                root.message = message;
        }
        onCompleted: result => {
            root.busy = false;
            root.password = "";
            if (result === PamResult.Success) {
                root.unlock();
                return;
            }
            if (result === PamResult.MaxTries)
                root.message = "Too many attempts; wait a moment";
            else if (!root.message)
                root.message = "Wrong password";
            root.rejected();
        }
        onError: error => {
            root.busy = false;
            root.password = "";
            root.message = "Could not check the password (" + PamError.toString(error) + ")";
            root.rejected();
        }
    }

    // The fingerprint check, through the shell's own PAM stack (pam/fingerprint): one scan each
    // time, so a miss can say so and the next scan starts afresh. Five misses or timeouts stop it.
    PamContext {
        id: fingerPam
        configDirectory: Quickshell.shellDir + "/pam"
        config: "fingerprint"
        onPamMessage: {
            if (responseRequired)
                respond("");
            else if (message)
                root.fingerMessage = /finger|swipe|reader/i.test(message) && !messageIsError ? "Touch the fingerprint reader, or type your password" : message;
        }
        onCompleted: result => {
            if (result === PamResult.Success) {
                root.unlock();
                return;
            }
            root.fingerTries += 1;
            root.fingerMessage = root.fingerTries >= 5 ? "Fingerprint paused · click it to try again" : "Fingerprint not recognised";
            if (root.fingerTries < 5)
                fingerRetry.restart();
        }
        onError: error => {
            // No reader, or fprintd missing: the password alone.
            root.fingerprint = false;
            root.fingerMessage = "";
        }
    }
    Timer {
        id: fingerRetry
        interval: 900
        onTriggered: root.startFinger()
    }
    Process {
        id: fingers
        command: ["bash", "-c", "command -v fprintd-list >/dev/null && fprintd-list \"$USER\" 2>/dev/null"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                root.fingerprint = /#\d+:/.test(text);
                root.startFinger();
            }
        }
    }

    // Whether the screen is locked, kept outside the shell: if the shell dies while locked,
    // systemd starts it again (penumbra-shell.service) and it locks straight away. The runtime
    // directory is emptied at logout, so a stale "locked" never outlives the session.
    FileView {
        id: lockState
        path: (Quickshell.env("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR") || "/tmp") + "/penumbra-locked"
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: if (text().trim() === "locked") root.lock()
    }

    // Caps Lock lights an LED on every keyboard that has one. The LEDs are listed when locking
    // (a keyboard may have been plugged in since), then read directly.
    property var capsPaths: []
    Process {
        id: capsLeds
        running: true
        command: ["bash", "-c", "printf '%s\\n' /sys/class/leds/*::capslock/brightness"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.capsPaths = text.split("\n").filter(p => p.startsWith("/") && !p.includes("*"))
        }
    }
    Variants {
        id: leds
        model: root.capsPaths
        delegate: FileView {
            required property string modelData
            path: modelData
            printErrors: false
            onLoaded: root.capsLock = leds.instances.some(led => led.loaded && parseInt(led.text()) > 0)
        }
    }

    WlSessionLock {
        id: sessionLock
        WlSessionLockSurface {
            id: surface
            color: Theme.base
            LockContent {
                anchors.fill: parent
                lock: root
                pixelRatio: surface.screen?.devicePixelRatio ?? 1
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Look.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import "oklch.js" as Oklch
import "sun.js" as Sun

// The theme choice penumbra-theme keeps in ~/.local/state/penumbra/theme.json: dark, light or auto
// (light from sunrise to sunset), and the accent (Penumbra's, your own, or one of the wallpaper's).
// A change shows here at once;
// penumbra-theme saves and applies it (palette.json, which Theme fades to, then every app's
// colours), and the file, read back, has the last word.
Singleton {
    id: root

    property var choice: ({ mode: "dark", colors: "default", hue: 297, vividness: 1, pick: 0, harmonize: false, auto: "dark" })
    // "dark" or "light": the mode, or what auto mode shows now.
    readonly property string mode: choice.mode === "auto" ? (choice.auto === "light" ? "light" : "dark") : choice.mode
    // The accents penumbra-theme found in the current wallpaper, the strongest first: [{ hue, vividness }].
    property var candidates: []
    property var presets: []
    // The one colors=wallpaper uses, or null when the wallpaper has none (the default accent then).
    readonly property var wallpaperAccent: candidates.length ? candidates[Math.min(choice.pick ?? 0, candidates.length - 1)] : null
    property string error: ""
    readonly property bool busy: setter.running

    // "Dark · Default colours · Rounded", for the Settings row.
    readonly property string summary: [({ light: "Light", auto: "Auto" })[choice.mode] ?? "Dark",
        presets.find(p => p.id === choice.preset)?.title ?? ({ custom: "Custom colours", wallpaper: "Wallpaper colours" })[choice.colors] ?? "Default colours",
        Theme.sharp ? "Sharp" : "Rounded"].join(" · ")

    // Change some: { mode: "light" }, faded in over `duration` ms (penumbra-theme's own when
    // left out). `error` says why when one is refused.
    function set(changes, duration) {
        pending = Object.assign({}, pending, changes);
        pendingDuration = duration ?? -1;
        choice = Object.assign({}, choice, changes);
        if (!setter.running)
            flush();
    }
    property var pending: ({})
    property int pendingDuration: -1
    function flush() {
        const changes = pending;
        pending = {};
        const keys = Object.keys(changes);
        if (!keys.length)
            return;
        error = "";
        setter.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-theme", "set"].concat(keys.map(key => `${key}=${changes[key]}`),
            pendingDuration >= 0 ? ["--duration", String(pendingDuration)] : []);
        setter.running = true;
    }
    Process {
        id: setter
        stderr: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: if (text.trim()) root.error = text.trim()
        }
        onExited: {
            root.flush();
            if (!setter.running)
                root.refresh();
        }
    }

    // Show a choice in the shell only, without saving it or touching the apps (while a slider is
    // dragged); the latest one wins. Saving the choice on release replaces the preview.
    function preview(changes) {
        if (Object.keys(changes).some(k => ["colors", "hue", "vividness", "harmonize"].includes(k)))
            changes = Object.assign({}, changes, { preset: "" });
        previewing = Object.assign({}, choice, changes);
        if (!previewer.running)
            showPreview();
    }
    property var previewing: null
    function showPreview() {
        if (previewing === null)
            return;
        const shown = previewing;
        previewing = null;
        previewer.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-theme", "preview"].concat(Object.keys(shown).map(key => `${key}=${shown[key]}`));
        previewer.running = true;
    }
    Process {
        id: previewer
        onExited: root.showPreview()
    }

    // The saved choice with its defaults filled in, and the wallpaper's accents, whenever the file
    // or the wallpaper changes.
    function refresh() {
        if (getter.running)
            stale = true;
        else
            getter.running = true;
    }
    property bool stale: false
    property bool loaded: false
    Process {
        id: getter
        running: true
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-theme", "get"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                let got;
                try {
                    got = JSON.parse(text);
                } catch (e) {
                    return;
                }
                root.candidates = got.candidates ?? [];
                delete got.candidates;
                root.presets = got.presets ?? [];
                delete got.presets;
                // A change still on its way would be undone for a moment.
                if (!setter.running && !Object.keys(root.pending).length)
                    root.choice = Object.assign({}, root.choice, got);
                root.loaded = true;
            }
        }
        onExited: {
            if (root.stale) {
                root.stale = false;
                getter.running = true;
            }
        }
    }
    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/theme.json"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: root.refresh()
    }
    Connections {
        target: Ui
        function onWallpaperChanged() { root.refresh(); }
    }

    // ── Auto mode ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Light from sunrise to sunset where night light places you (the place typed there, or your
    // time zone's city); 07:00 to 19:00 while that is unknown. At each change the shell tells
    // penumbra-theme (auto=light or dark), which keeps it for the next login and fades slowly.
    readonly property var place: NightLight.place
    readonly property var day: {
        const sun = place ? Sun.times(Clock.date, place.latitude, place.longitude) : null;
        if (!sun)
            return { from: 7 * 60, to: 19 * 60 };
        return sun.polar ? { polar: sun.polar } : { from: sun.rise, to: sun.set };
    }
    readonly property string daylight: {
        if (day.polar)
            return day.polar === "day" ? "light" : "dark";
        return Sun.between(Clock.date.getHours() * 60 + Clock.date.getMinutes(), day.from, day.to) ? "light" : "dark";
    }
    // "Light until 19:42 · sunrise and sunset in Paris", for the Look page.
    readonly property string autoStatus: {
        const where = place ? `sunrise and sunset in ${place.name}` : "07:00 to 19:00 until night light knows where you are";
        if (day.polar)
            return `${daylight === "light" ? "Light" : "Dark"} all day · ${where}`;
        return `${daylight === "light" ? "Light" : "Dark"} until ${Sun.clock(daylight === "light" ? day.to : day.from)} · ${where}`;
    }
    function followDaylight() {
        if (ready && choice.mode === "auto" && choice.auto !== daylight)
            set({ auto: daylight }, 2000);
    }
    onDaylightChanged: followDaylight()
    onChoiceChanged: followDaylight()
    // The saved choice, and the place (night light's settings and its list of cities), load just
    // after the shell starts; until then the time of day isn't known.
    property bool ready: false
    Timer {
        interval: 1500
        running: root.loaded
        onTriggered: {
            root.ready = true;
            root.followDaylight();
        }
    }

    // The default accent family's OKLCH in each mode (palette.toml's accentDeep, accent, accentBright);
    // a custom accent turns their hues and scales their chroma, as penumbra-theme does.
    readonly property var accents: ({
        dark: [[0.491, 0.241, 292.6], [0.747, 0.134, 296.9], [0.783, 0.129, 299.3]],
        light: [[0.420, 0.200, 292.8], [0.520, 0.170, 296.8], [0.450, 0.170, 299.3]]
    })
    // [deep, accent, bright] for a choice, close to what penumbra-theme will make of it. The
    // wallpaper's colours take their hue and vividness from wallpaperAccent.
    function swatches(mode, colors, hue, vividness) {
        if (colors === "wallpaper")
            return wallpaperAccent ? swatches(mode, "custom", wallpaperAccent.hue, wallpaperAccent.vividness) : swatches(mode, "default");
        const turn = colors === "custom" ? hue - 297 : 0;
        const scale = colors === "custom" ? vividness : 1;
        return accents[mode === "light" ? "light" : "dark"].map(([L, C, H]) => Oklch.color(L, Math.max(C * scale, 0.02), (H + turn + 360) % 360));
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/LookPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import "oklch.js" as Oklch

// Look: dark, light or auto, the accent colours (Penumbra's, your own or the wallpaper's) and the corner
// style, for the shell and the apps at once.
// Look and penumbra-theme apply a change; the shell fades to it.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12

    component Section: Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
    }

    // A choice drawn as a card: its picture above, its name below, the current one outlined.
    component Choice: Rectangle {
        id: choice
        property bool current
        property string title
        default property alias picture: holder.data
        signal picked()

        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.preferredWidth: 1 // equal shares
        implicitHeight: 118
        radius: Theme.radius
        color: current ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.12) : choiceArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
        border.width: current ? 2 : 1
        border.color: current ? Theme.accent : Theme.line
        Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

        Item {
            id: holder
            anchors { top: parent.top; topMargin: 16; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter }
            width: 116
            height: 62
        }
        RowLayout {
            anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 12; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter }
            spacing: 6
            Rectangle {
                visible: choice.current
                implicitWidth: 6
                implicitHeight: 6
                radius: Theme.corner(3)
                color: Theme.accent
            }
            Label {
                text: choice.title
                font.weight: choice.current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                color: choice.current ? Theme.text : Theme.textSoft
            }
        }
        MouseArea {
            id: choiceArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: if (!choice.current) choice.picked()
        }
    }

    // A line standing in for text in the previews.
    component Line: Rectangle {
        implicitHeight: 4
        radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Look"
        status: Look.error || "Mode, colours and corners"
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "settings"
    }

    // A little desktop in the colours on screen: a bar, a window and a panel. They fade with the
    // shell, so it shows each change as it happens.
    Rectangle {
        id: desktop
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        implicitHeight: 150
        radius: Theme.radius
        color: Theme.base
        border.color: Theme.line
        clip: true

        // A faint wash of the accent, where a wallpaper would be.
        Rectangle {
            anchors.fill: parent
            radius: parent.radius
            gradient: Gradient {
                orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
                GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.alpha(Theme.accentDeep, Theme.light ? 0.16 : 0.32) }
                GradientStop { position: 1; color: "transparent" }
            }
        }

        // The bar: workspaces, the clock, the status capsule.
        Rectangle {
            id: bar
            x: 10
            y: 10
            width: parent.width - 20
            height: 18
            radius: Theme.corner(9)
            color: Theme.glassStrong
            border.color: Theme.line
            Row {
                anchors { left: parent.left; leftMargin: 7; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                spacing: 4
                Line { width: 14; height: 6; color: Theme.accent }
                Line { width: 6; height: 6; color: Theme.dim }
                Line { width: 6; height: 6; color: Theme.dim }
            }
            Line { anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 28; color: Theme.textSoft }
            Row {
                anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 7; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                spacing: 4
                Line { width: 6; height: 6; color: Theme.muted }
                Line { width: 6; height: 6; color: Theme.muted }
                Line { width: 18; height: 6; color: Theme.textSoft }
            }
        }

        // A window: a title, some text, a primary and a plain button.
        Rectangle {
            x: 10
            y: bar.y + bar.height + 8
            width: parent.width - panel.width - 28
            height: parent.height - y - 10
            radius: Theme.corner(10)
            color: Theme.surface
            border.color: Theme.lineStrong
            Column {
                anchors { left: parent.left; top: parent.top; margins: 11 }
                spacing: 6
                Line { width: 64; height: 6; color: Theme.text }
                Line { width: 120; color: Theme.textSoft }
                Line { width: 96; color: Theme.muted }
                Line { width: 108; color: Theme.dim }
            }
            Row {
                anchors { left: parent.left; bottom: parent.bottom; margins: 11 }
                spacing: 6
                Rectangle {
                    width: 46
                    height: 16
                    radius: Theme.corner(8)
                    color: Theme.accent
                    Line { anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 24; color: Theme.accentInk }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    width: 40
                    height: 16
                    radius: Theme.corner(8)
                    color: Theme.raised
                    border.color: Theme.line
                    Line { anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 20; color: Theme.textSoft }
                }
            }
        }

        // A panel: two tiles (one on), a slider.
        Rectangle {
            id: panel
            anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 10 }
            y: bar.y + bar.height + 8
            width: 128
            height: parent.height - y - 10
            radius: Theme.corner(12)
            color: Theme.glassStrong
            border.color: Theme.line
            Row {
                anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 9 }
                spacing: 6
                Repeater {
                    model: [true, false]
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property bool modelData
                        width: (parent.width - 6) / 2
                        height: 34
                        radius: Theme.corner(8)
                        color: modelData ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.22) : Theme.raised
                        border.color: modelData ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accentBright, 0.55) : Theme.line
                        Line { x: 7; y: 8; width: 8; height: 8; color: modelData ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.muted }
                        Line { x: 7; y: 22; width: 30; color: modelData ? Theme.text : Theme.textSoft }
                    }
                }
            }
            Line {
                id: track
                anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom; margins: 12; bottomMargin: 16 }
                color: Theme.overlayStrong
                Line { width: parent.width * 0.6; color: Theme.accent }
                Rectangle {
                    x: parent.width * 0.6 - width / 2
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    width: 10
                    height: 10
                    radius: Theme.corner(5)
                    color: Theme.white
                    border.color: Theme.accent
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Section { text: "Curated palettes" }
    GridLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        columns: 2
        columnSpacing: 8
        rowSpacing: 8
        Repeater {
            model: Look.presets
            delegate: Choice {
                required property var modelData
                title: modelData.title
                current: Look.choice.preset === modelData.id
                onPicked: Look.set({ preset: modelData.id })
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    color: modelData.base
                    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                    Image {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: Ui.fileUrl(Ui.wallpapers + modelData.wallpaper + "-clean.png")
                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        anchors { right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom; margins: 6 }
                        width: 50; height: 28
                        radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                        color: modelData.surface
                        border.color: modelData.accent
                        Label { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Aa"; color: modelData.accent; font.pixelSize: 16 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        text: "A complete palette and matching wallpaper scene. Custom colours below clear the preset."
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        color: Theme.dim
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
    }

    Section { text: "Desktop composition" }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        text: "Signature: floating capsules, numbered workspaces and a clear desktop. Palette and text size stay yours."
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        color: Theme.textSoft
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
    }
    PillButton { text: "Apply signature layout"; onClicked: Settings.signatureComposition() }

    Section { text: "Bar style" }
    Segmented {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        current: Settings.barStyle
        options: [{ value: "floating", title: "Capsules" }, { value: "island", title: "Island" }, { value: "framed", title: "Framed" }]
        onChosen: value => Settings.barStyle = value
    }
    Section { text: "Workspaces" }
    Segmented {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        current: Settings.workspaceStyle
        options: [{ value: "pills", title: "Numbers" }, { value: "icons", title: "Numbers + icons" }, { value: "dots", title: "Dots" }]
        onChosen: value => Settings.workspaceStyle = value
    }
    Section { text: "Volume and brightness" }
    Segmented {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        current: Settings.osdPosition
        options: [{ value: "bottom", title: "Bottom" }, { value: "top", title: "Top island" }]
        onChosen: value => Settings.osdPosition = value
    }
    Section { text: "Glass frost" }
    SliderRow {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        glyph: "󰂓"
        from: -0.15; to: 0.28; stepSize: 0.01
        value: Settings.glassFrost
        label: Math.round((value + 0.15) / 0.43 * 100) + "%"
        onMoved: value => Settings.glassFrost = value
    }

    Section { text: "Mode" }
    Segmented {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        current: Look.choice.mode
        options: [
            { value: "dark", title: "Dark", glyph: "󰖔" },
            { value: "light", title: "Light", glyph: "󰖙" },
            { value: "auto", title: "Auto", glyph: "󰔎" }
        ]
        // Auto starts from the time of day, so the screen changes now if it should.
        onChosen: value => Look.set(value === "auto" ? { mode: value, auto: Look.daylight } : { mode: value })
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Look.choice.mode === "auto"
        text: Look.autoStatus
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.dim
    }

    Section { text: "Colours" }
    // Each card shows its accent family in the current mode.
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 8
        Repeater {
            model: [
                { name: "default", title: "Default" },
                { name: "custom", title: "Custom" },
                { name: "wallpaper", title: "Wallpaper" }
            ]
            delegate: Choice {
                id: colours
                required property var modelData
                readonly property var swatches: Look.swatches(Look.mode, modelData.name, custom.hue, custom.vividness)
                current: Look.choice.colors === modelData.name
                title: modelData.title
                onPicked: Look.set({ colors: modelData.name })
                Row {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    spacing: -10
                    Repeater {
                        model: colours.swatches
                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            required property color modelData
                            width: 34
                            height: 34
                            radius: Theme.corner(17)
                            color: modelData
                            border.width: 2
                            border.color: Theme.surface
                            Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.slow } }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // The custom accent: presets, the hue and vividness, an exact colour. A slider shows its colour in
    // the shell while it moves; the choice is saved and given to the apps once it rests.
    ColumnLayout {
        id: custom
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Look.choice.colors === "custom"
        spacing: 10

        // As the controls have them: while a slider moves, ahead of Look.choice.
        readonly property real hue: hueSlider.value
        readonly property real vividness: vividSlider.value
        // The accent a hue and vividness give in the current mode.
        function accentAt(hue, vividness) { return Look.swatches(Look.mode, "custom", hue, vividness)[1]; }
        readonly property color accent: accentAt(hue, vividness)

        readonly property var presets: [
            { hue: 297, vividness: 1 },    // violet
            { hue: 272, vividness: 1 },    // indigo
            { hue: 250, vividness: 1 },    // blue
            { hue: 192, vividness: 0.9 },  // teal
            { hue: 148, vividness: 0.85 }, // green
            { hue: 75, vividness: 1 },     // amber
            { hue: 12, vividness: 1 },     // rose
            { hue: null, vividness: 0 }    // mono, at the current hue
        ]
        function isCurrent(preset) {
            const turn = Math.abs(((hue - preset.hue) % 360 + 540) % 360 - 180);
            return Math.abs(vividness - preset.vividness) < 0.005 && (preset.hue === null || turn < 0.5);
        }

        // A slider moved: show it now, apply it once both sliders rest (released, or no key pressed for a moment).
        function moved() {
            Look.preview({ hue: Math.round(hue), vividness: vividness.toFixed(2) });
            settle.restart();
        }
        Timer {
            id: settle
            interval: 400
            onTriggered: {
                if (hueSlider.pressed || vividSlider.pressed)
                    return; // the release starts it again
                const changes = { hue: Math.round(custom.hue), vividness: Number(custom.vividness.toFixed(2)) };
                if (changes.hue !== Math.round(Look.choice.hue) || changes.vividness !== Number(Look.choice.vividness.toFixed(2)))
                    Look.set(changes);
            }
        }

        // An exact colour's hue and vividness; the lightness stays the mode's, so text still reads on it.
        function useHex(text) {
            const lch = Oklch.fromHex(text);
            if (!lch)
                return false;
            const chroma = Look.accents[Look.mode === "light" ? "light" : "dark"][1][1];
            Look.set({
                // A grey has no hue of its own; it keeps the current one.
                hue: lch[1] < 0.01 ? Math.round(Look.choice.hue) : Math.round(lch[2]) % 360,
                vividness: Number(Math.min(1.3, lch[1] / chroma).toFixed(2))
            });
            return true;
        }

        // Round chips spread from edge to edge.
        Item {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            implicitHeight: 34
            Row {
                spacing: (parent.width - custom.presets.length * 34) / (custom.presets.length - 1)
                Repeater {
                    model: custom.presets
                    delegate: Swatch {
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property real hue: modelData.hue ?? Math.round(custom.hue)
                        width: 34
                        height: 34
                        color: custom.accentAt(hue, modelData.vividness)
                        selected: custom.isCurrent(modelData)
                        onPicked: Look.set({ hue: hue, vividness: modelData.vividness })
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Each slider with its name before it and its value after; then the exact colour.
        GridLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            columns: 3
            columnSpacing: 10
            rowSpacing: 4

            Label {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 64
                text: "Hue"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.textSoft
            }
            ColorSlider {
                id: hueSlider
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                from: 0
                to: 360
                stepSize: 1
                value: Look.choice.hue
                // The rainbow stays readable even when the accent is nearly grey.
                colorAt: hue => custom.accentAt(hue, Math.max(custom.vividness, 0.5))
                onMoved: custom.moved()
                onPressedChanged: if (!pressed) settle.restart()
            }
            Label {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 38
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                text: Math.round(custom.hue) + "°"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.muted
            }

            Label {
                text: "Vividness"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.textSoft
            }
            ColorSlider {
                id: vividSlider
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                from: 0
                to: 1.3
                stepSize: 0.01
                value: Look.choice.vividness
                colorAt: vividness => custom.accentAt(custom.hue, vividness)
                onMoved: custom.moved()
                onPressedChanged: if (!pressed) settle.restart()
            }
            Label {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 38
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                text: Math.round(custom.vividness * 100) + " %"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.muted
            }

            Label {
                text: "Colour"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.textSoft
            }
            Field {
                id: hexField
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.columnSpan: 2
                placeholderText: "#rrggbb"
                font.family: Theme.mono
                invalid: text !== "" && !Oklch.fromHex(text)
                // Shows the accent unless you are typing one; Enter or leaving the box uses it.
                function reset() { text = custom.accent.toString(); }
                Component.onCompleted: reset()
                onAccepted: {
                    if (invalid)
                        return;
                    apply();
                    reset();
                    focus = false;
                }
                onActiveFocusChanged: if (!activeFocus && !apply()) reset()
                // Uses the colour typed, if it is one and new; true if it did.
                function apply() { return text.toLowerCase() !== custom.accent.toString() && custom.useHex(text); }
                Connections {
                    target: custom
                    function onAccentChanged() { if (!hexField.activeFocus) hexField.reset(); }
                }
            }
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: "A colour you type gives its hue and vividness; the lightness stays the mode's, so text keeps reading on it"
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.dim
        }
    }

    // The wallpaper's accents, the strongest first. penumbra-wallpaper hands a new wallpaper to
    // penumbra-theme, which finds its own and fades the shell to the strongest as it grows in.
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Look.choice.colors === "wallpaper"
        spacing: 10

        Row {
            visible: Look.candidates.length > 0
            spacing: 8
            Repeater {
                model: Look.candidates
                delegate: Swatch {
                    required property var modelData
                    required property int index
                    width: 34
                    height: 34
                    color: Look.swatches(Look.mode, "custom", modelData.hue, modelData.vividness)[1]
                    selected: index === Math.min(Look.choice.pick ?? 0, Look.candidates.length - 1)
                    onPicked: Look.set({ pick: index })
                }
            }
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: Look.candidates.length
                ? "Found in " + Ui.wallpaperTitle(Ui.wallpaper) + (Look.candidates.length > 1 ? ", the strongest first" : "")
                    + "; a new wallpaper brings its own colours as it grows in"
                : "No colours could be read from this wallpaper, so the default ones show"
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.dim
        }
    }

    // Custom and wallpaper accents can pull the signal colours (red, green, amber…) a little toward
    // themselves, so they sit together; they keep their meaning.
    SwitchRow {
        visible: Look.choice.colors !== "default"
        glyph: "󰢵"
        title: "Blend signal colours"
        subtitle: "Red, green, amber and blue lean a little toward the accent"
        checked: Look.choice.harmonize === true
        onToggled: Look.set({ harmonize: !(Look.choice.harmonize === true) })
    }

    Section { text: "Desktop depth" }
    SwitchRow {
        title: "Depth clock"
        subtitle: "Time behind Dawn, Eclipse or a custom foreground mask"
        glyph: "󰥔"
        checked: Settings.desktopClock
        onToggled: Settings.desktopClock = !Settings.desktopClock
    }
    SwitchRow {
        title: "Audio aura"
        subtitle: "Dawn’s ring and Eclipse’s horizon aurora react to music"
        glyph: "󰝚"
        checked: Settings.desktopAura
        onToggled: Settings.desktopAura = !Settings.desktopAura
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        text: "Choose Dawn or Eclipse in Wallpaper. The aura rests when wallpaper motion is paused."
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.dim
    }
    Section { text: "Calendar weather" }
    SwitchRow {
        title: "Show weather"
        subtitle: "Open-Meteo · " + (Weather.place?.name ?? "Choose a weather location")
        glyph: "󰖐"
        checked: Settings.weatherEnabled
        onToggled: Settings.weatherEnabled = !Settings.weatherEnabled
    }
    SwitchRow {
        visible: Settings.weatherEnabled
        title: "Weather beside the clock"
        subtitle: "Temperature and sky conditions in the bar"
        glyph: "󰖐"
        checked: Settings.weatherInBar
        onToggled: Settings.weatherInBar = !Settings.weatherInBar
    }
    PillButton { text: "Choose location"; onClicked: Ui.controlPage = "weather" }
    Section { text: "Floating dock" }
    Segmented {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        current: Settings.dockMode
        options: [{ value: "off", title: "Off" }, { value: "auto", title: "Auto-hide" }, { value: "empty", title: "Empty workspace" }]
        onChosen: value => Settings.dockMode = value
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        text: "Hover the bottom edge to reveal. Right-click an app to pin or unpin; middle-click to open another window."
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        color: Theme.dim
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
    }
    Section { text: "Screen frame" }
    SwitchRow {
        title: "Join the bar to a screen frame"
        subtitle: "A thin bezel with curved inner corners around each display"
        glyph: "󰍹"
        checked: Settings.screenFrame
        onToggled: Settings.screenFrame = !Settings.screenFrame
    }

    Section { text: "Corners" }
    // Each card draws a little bar and window in its own style.
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 8
        Repeater {
            model: [
                { name: "rounded", title: "Rounded", round: true },
                { name: "sharp", title: "Sharp", round: false }
            ]
            delegate: Choice {
                id: corners
                required property var modelData
                readonly property color ink: current ? Theme.accent : Theme.lineStrong
                function r(px) { return modelData.round ? px : 0; }
                current: Theme.corners === modelData.name
                title: modelData.title
                onPicked: Ui.run(Ui.bin + "penumbra-corners " + modelData.name)
                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 10
                    radius: corners.r(5)
                    color: Theme.glass
                    border.color: corners.ink
                    Rectangle { x: 4; y: 3; width: 14; height: 4; radius: corners.r(2); color: corners.ink }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    y: 16
                    width: parent.width
                    height: parent.height - y
                    radius: corners.r(9)
                    color: Theme.surface
                    border.color: corners.ink
                    Rectangle { x: 9; y: 10; width: 44; height: 5; radius: corners.r(2.5); color: corners.ink }
                    Rectangle { x: 9; y: 21; width: 70; height: 4; radius: corners.r(2); color: Theme.line }
                    Rectangle { x: 9; y: 30; width: 56; height: 4; radius: corners.r(2); color: Theme.line }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        text: "The shell, windows, launcher and lock screen follow at once; open apps pick up some changes when they restart"
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.dim
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/LyricsView.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell.Io
import "lyrics.js" as Lrc

ColumnLayout {
    id: root
    property var player: null
    property bool active: false
    property var result: ({})
    readonly property string signature: JSON.stringify([player?.trackTitle ?? "", player?.trackArtist ?? "", player?.trackAlbum ?? "", Math.round(player?.length ?? 0)])
    readonly property var lines: Lrc.parse(result.synced ?? "")
    readonly property int current: Lrc.current(lines, player?.position ?? 0)
    property string loaded: ""
    spacing: 5
    onSignatureChanged: { result = {}; loaded = ""; settle.restart(); }
    onActiveChanged: if (active) settle.restart()
    function fetch() {
        if (!active || !player || request.running || loaded === signature) return;
        if (!player.trackTitle || !player.trackArtist || Media.isLive(player)) {
            result = { status: "missing" }; return;
        }
        request.signature = signature;
        request.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-online", "lyrics"].concat(JSON.parse(signature).map(String));
        result = { status: "loading" };
        request.running = true;
    }
    Timer { id: settle; interval: 400; onTriggered: root.fetch() }
    Process {
        id: request
        property string signature
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                if (request.signature !== root.signature) return;
                try { root.result = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { root.result = { status: "offline" }; }
                root.loaded = request.signature;
            }
        }
        onExited: {
            if (request.signature !== root.signature) settle.restart();
            else if (root.result.status === "loading") root.result = { status: "offline" };
        }
    }
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "Lyrics · LRCLIB"; color: Theme.textSoft; font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny }
        PillButton {
            visible: root.result.status === "offline"
            text: "Retry"
            onClicked: { root.loaded = ""; settle.restart(); }
        }
    }
    Item {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        implicitHeight: 90
        visible: root.lines.length > 0
        clip: true
        Column {
            width: parent.width
            y: 30 - Math.max(-1, root.current) * 30
            Behavior on y { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
            Repeater {
                model: root.lines
                delegate: Label {
                    required property var modelData
                    required property int index
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 30
                    text: modelData.text || "♪"
                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    font.weight: index === root.current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                    color: index === root.current ? Theme.white : Theme.textSoft
                    opacity: index === root.current ? 1 : 0.5
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Flickable {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        implicitHeight: 100
        visible: !root.lines.length && !!root.result.plain
        contentHeight: plain.implicitHeight
        contentWidth: width
        flickableDirection: Flickable.VerticalFlick
        clip: true
        Label {
            id: plain
            width: parent.width
            text: "Unsynced lyrics\n\n" + (root.result.plain ?? "")
            textFormat: Text.PlainText
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            color: Theme.textSoft
        }
    }
    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: !root.lines.length && !root.result.plain
        text: root.result.status === "loading" ? "Finding lyrics…" : root.result.status === "offline" ? "Lyrics unavailable offline" : root.result.instrumental ? "Instrumental" : "No lyrics for this track"
        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
        color: Theme.textSoft
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Media.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Services.Mpris

// What's playing, and a small spectrum of it from cava while it plays.
Singleton {
    id: root

    // The player that is playing, else the last one that played, while it lasts.
    readonly property var playing: Mpris.players.values.find(p => p.isPlaying) ?? null
    property var recent: null
    onPlayingChanged: if (playing) recent = playing
    readonly property var player: playing ?? (Mpris.players.values.includes(recent) ? recent : null)
    readonly property int count: 8
    property var bars: new Array(count).fill(0)

    // The app's own name ("Firefox"), not its MPRIS identity ("Mozilla firefox").
    function appName(p) {
        if (!p)
            return "";
        return DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(p.desktopEntry || p.identity)?.name || p.identity;
    }
    // Live streams have no real length: Firefox reports an endless one (about 292,000 years).
    function isLive(p) {
        return !!p && p.lengthSupported && p.length > 100 * 3600;
    }
    function hasLength(p) {
        return !!p && p.lengthSupported && p.length > 0 && !isLive(p);
    }
    // 4:05, or 1:02:03 past an hour.
    function time(seconds) {
        const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds)), h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor(s % 3600 / 60);
        const ss = String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0");
        return h ? `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}:${ss}` : `${m}:${ss}`;
    }

    readonly property string config: [
        "[general]", `bars = ${count}`, "framerate = 30", "sleep_timer = 2",
        "[input]", "method = pipewire",
        "[output]", "method = raw", "raw_target = /dev/stdout", "data_format = ascii",
        "ascii_max_range = 100", "bar_delimiter = 59", "frame_delimiter = 10",
        "[smoothing]", "noise_reduction = 60", ""
    ].join("\n")

    // cava prints one frame per line: "12;40;7;…;".
    Process {
        running: Ui.hasVisualizer && !!root.playing
        command: ["bash", "-c", 'f="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/penumbra/cava.conf"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; printf "%s" "$1" > "$f"; exec cava -p "$f"', "_", root.config]
        stdout: SplitParser {
            onRead: data => root.bars = data.split(";").filter(v => v !== "").map(v => Math.min(1, parseInt(v) / 100))
        }
        onRunningChanged: if (!running) root.bars = new Array(root.count).fill(0)
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/MediaCapsule.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets

Capsule {
    id: root
    property real titleWidth: 140
    shown: !!Media.player
    padding: 12
    spacing: 10
    tip: ""
    // The player can disappear during the exit animation.
    onClicked: m => {
        if (m.button === Qt.MiddleButton) Media.player?.togglePlaying();
        else { pinned = !popup.visible || !pinned; popup.visible = pinned; }
    }
    onScrolled: step => step > 0 ? Media.player?.previous() : Media.player?.next()

    property bool pinned: false
    property color artTint: Theme.accentBright
    onHoveredChanged: hovered ? openDelay.restart() : closeDelay.restart()
    onShownChanged: if (!shown) { pinned = false; popup.visible = false; }
    property Timer openDelay: Timer {
        interval: 280
        onTriggered: if (root.hovered && Media.player) popup.visible = true
    }
    property Timer closeDelay: Timer {
        interval: 350
        onTriggered: if (!root.hovered && !popup.hovered && !root.pinned) popup.visible = false
    }
    property MediaPopover popup: MediaPopover {
        anchor.item: root
        onHoveredChanged: if (!hovered) root.closeDelay.restart()
        onDismissed: { root.pinned = false; visible = false; }
    }
    // Quantize a tiny cover sample; use its most common saturated colour for the spectrum.
    // This runs once per cover, never once per audio frame.
    property Canvas sampler: Canvas {
        parent: root
        width: 16; height: 16; opacity: 0
        property string art: Media.player?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
        property string previous: ""
        onArtChanged: {
            root.artTint = Theme.accentBright;
            if (previous) unloadImage(previous);
            previous = art;
            if (art) loadImage(art);
        }
        onImageLoaded: requestPaint()
        onAvailableChanged: if (available) requestPaint()
        onPaint: {
            if (!art || !isImageLoaded(art)) return;
            const ctx = getContext("2d");
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 16, 16); ctx.drawImage(art, 0, 0, 16, 16);
            const pixels = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 16, 16).data;
            const buckets = {}; let best = null;
            for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) {
                const r = pixels[i], g = pixels[i+1], b = pixels[i+2];
                if (pixels[i+3] < 128 || Math.max(r,g,b) < 65 || Math.max(r,g,b)-Math.min(r,g,b) < 25) continue;
                const key = [r >> 5, g >> 5, b >> 5].join(",");
                const v = buckets[key] ?? (buckets[key] = {n: 0, r: 0, g: 0, b: 0});
                v.n++; v.r += r; v.g += g; v.b += b;
                if (!best || v.n > best.n) best = v;
            }
            if (best) root.artTint = Qt.rgba(best.r / best.n / 255, best.g / best.n / 255, best.b / best.n / 255, 1);
        }
    }

    ClippingRectangle {
        implicitWidth: 24
        implicitHeight: 24
        radius: Theme.corner(6)
        color: Theme.raised
        Image {
            id: cover
            anchors.fill: parent
            source: Media.player?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
            sourceSize: Qt.size(48, 48)
            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
            asynchronous: true
        }
        Glyph {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            visible: cover.status !== Image.Ready
            text: "󰎆"
            size: 15
            color: Theme.accentBright
        }
    }
    Label {
        visible: root.titleWidth >= 40
        Layout.maximumWidth: root.titleWidth
        text: Media.player?.trackTitle || Media.appName(Media.player)
        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
        color: Theme.textSoft
    }
    Row {
        visible: Ui.hasVisualizer
        spacing: 2
        Layout.preferredHeight: 18
        Repeater {
            model: Media.count
            delegate: Rectangle {
                required property int index
                anchors.verticalCenter: parent?.verticalCenter
                width: 3
                height: 5 + (Media.bars[index] ?? 0) * 13
                radius: Theme.corner(1.5)
                color: root.artTint
                Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: 60 * Theme.motion } }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/MediaPopover.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets

PopupWindow {
    id: root
    property var player: Media.player
    property bool hovered: hover.hovered
    signal dismissed()
    implicitWidth: 340
    implicitHeight: body.implicitHeight + 32
    color: "transparent"
    anchor.edges: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.gravity: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.margins.top: 4

    Rectangle {
        anchors.fill: parent
        radius: Theme.radiusLarge
        color: Theme.glassStrong
        border.color: Theme.line
        opacity: root.visible ? 1 : 0
        scale: root.visible ? 1 : 0.94
        transformOrigin: Item.Top
        Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutBack } }
        GlassEdge { radius: parent.radius }
        HoverHandler { id: hover }
        ColumnLayout {
            id: body
            anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 16 }
            spacing: 10
            RowLayout {
                spacing: 12
                ClippingRectangle {
                    implicitWidth: 64; implicitHeight: 64
                    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                    color: Theme.raised
                    Image {
                        id: art
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        source: root.player?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
                        sourceSize: Qt.size(128, 128)
                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                        asynchronous: true
                    }
                    Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; visible: art.status !== Image.Ready; text: "󰎆"; size: 26 }
                }
                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: root.player?.trackTitle || "Nothing playing"; font.weight: Font.Bold }
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: root.player?.trackArtist ?? ""; color: Theme.muted }
                }
                PillButton { text: "×"; onClicked: root.dismissed() }
            }
            RowLayout {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                PillButton { text: "󰒮"; available: root.player?.canGoPrevious ?? false; onClicked: root.player?.previous() }
                PillButton { text: root.player?.isPlaying ? "󰏤" : "󰐊"; primary: true; available: root.player?.canTogglePlaying ?? false; onClicked: root.player?.togglePlaying() }
                PillButton { text: "󰒭"; available: root.player?.canGoNext ?? false; onClicked: root.player?.next() }
                PillButton { text: "Lyrics"; primary: lyrics.active; onClicked: lyrics.active = !lyrics.active }
            }
            SliderRow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: Media.hasLength(root.player)
                enabled: root.player?.canSeek ?? false
                glyph: "󰎆"
                to: Math.max(1, root.player?.length ?? 1)
                value: root.player?.position ?? 0
                label: Media.time(value)
                labelWidth: 45
                onMoved: value => { if (root.player?.canSeek) root.player.position = value; }
            }
            LyricsView {
                id: lyrics
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: active
                player: root.player
                onVisibleChanged: if (!root.visible) active = false
            }
        }
    }
    onVisibleChanged: if (!visible) lyrics.active = false
    Timer {
        interval: 250; repeat: true
        running: root.visible && !!root.player?.isPlaying
        onTriggered: root.player?.positionChanged()
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Meteor.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick

// Now and then a shooting star starts somewhere in `area` (scene coordinates) and falls along `heading`.
Item {
    id: root
    property bool running: true
    property rect area
    property real heading: 155
    property real distance: 560

    Rectangle {
        id: streak
        property real startX: 0
        property real startY: 0
        property real progress: 0
        width: 260
        height: 2
        radius: 1
        visible: falling.running
        transformOrigin: Item.Right
        rotation: root.heading
        x: startX + root.distance * progress * Math.cos(root.heading * Math.PI / 180) - width
        y: startY + root.distance * progress * Math.sin(root.heading * Math.PI / 180) - height / 2
        opacity: Math.sin(Math.PI * progress)
        gradient: Gradient {
            orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
            GradientStop { position: 0; color: "transparent" }
            GradientStop { position: 1; color: "#f7e6ff" }
        }
        NumberAnimation on progress {
            id: falling
            running: false
            from: 0
            to: 1
            duration: 1100
            easing.type: Easing.InQuad
        }
    }

    Timer {
        interval: 20000 + Math.random() * 30000
        repeat: true
        running: root.running
        onTriggered: {
            interval = 20000 + Math.random() * 30000;
            streak.startX = root.area.x + Math.random() * root.area.width;
            streak.startY = root.area.y + Math.random() * root.area.height;
            falling.restart();
        }
    }
}
```
