## `config/quickshell/penumbra/MixerPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Services.Pipewire

// Sound: pick the output and input device, and set each app's own volume.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    property bool active: false
    readonly property var audioNodes: Pipewire.nodes.values.filter(n => n.audio)
    // A laptop's HDMI and DisplayPort outputs exist even with nothing plugged in; list them only
    // while an external screen is connected, or while one is in use.
    readonly property bool externalScreen: Quickshell.screens.some(s => !/^(eDP|LVDS|DSI)/.test(s.name))
    readonly property var outputs: audioNodes.filter(n => n.isSink && !n.isStream
        && (externalScreen || !isDisplayOutput(n) || n === Pipewire.defaultAudioSink))
    readonly property var inputs: audioNodes.filter(n => !n.isSink && !n.isStream)
    // Apps playing sound. Quickshell flags playback streams as sinks (AudioOutStream =
    // Audio | Sink | Stream); recording streams are sources and are left out.
    readonly property var streams: audioNodes.filter(n => n.isStream && n.isSink)

    spacing: 12

    // Volume, mute and properties are only live on tracked nodes.
    PwObjectTracker {
        objects: root.active ? [...root.outputs, ...root.inputs, ...root.streams] : []
    }

    function isDisplayOutput(node) {
        return /hdmi|displayport/i.test(node.name + " " + node.description);
    }
    // The port ("Speaker") tells a card's devices apart, a display output goes by its short name
    // ("HDMI 1"), and Bluetooth devices by their own name.
    function deviceName(node) {
        if (isDisplayOutput(node) && node.nickname)
            return node.nickname;
        const port = node.name.startsWith("bluez") ? "" : node.properties["device.profile.description"];
        return port || node.description || node.nickname || node.name;
    }
    function deviceGlyph(node, input) {
        const name = (node.name + " " + node.description).toLowerCase();
        if (name.includes("bluez") || name.includes("headset") || name.includes("headphone"))
            return input ? "󰋎" : "󰋋";
        if (name.includes("hdmi") || name.includes("displayport"))
            return "󰡁";
        return input ? "󰍬" : "󰓃";
    }
    function appName(node) {
        const p = node.properties;
        return p["application.name"] || node.description || node.name;
    }
    function appIcon(node) {
        const p = node.properties;
        const entry = DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(p["application.process.binary"] ?? p["application.name"] ?? "");
        return Quickshell.iconPath(p["application.icon-name"] || entry?.icon || p["application.process.binary"] || "", "audio-volume-high");
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Sound"
        status: Pipewire.defaultAudioSink ? root.deviceName(Pipewire.defaultAudioSink) : "No output"
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
    }

    Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
        text: "Output"
    }
    Repeater {
        model: root.outputs
        delegate: ListRow {
            required property var modelData
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            glyph: root.deviceGlyph(modelData, false)
            title: root.deviceName(modelData)
            highlighted: Pipewire.defaultAudioSink === modelData
            subtitle: highlighted ? "In use" : ""
            onClicked: Pipewire.preferredDefaultAudioSink = modelData
        }
    }

    Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
        visible: root.inputs.length > 0
        text: "Input"
    }
    Repeater {
        model: root.inputs
        delegate: ListRow {
            required property var modelData
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            glyph: root.deviceGlyph(modelData, true)
            title: root.deviceName(modelData)
            highlighted: Pipewire.defaultAudioSource === modelData
            subtitle: highlighted ? "In use" : ""
            onClicked: Pipewire.preferredDefaultAudioSource = modelData
        }
    }

    Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
        text: "Applications"
    }
    Repeater {
        model: root.streams
        delegate: ColumnLayout {
            id: stream
            required property var modelData
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 0
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 46
                text: root.appName(stream.modelData) + (stream.modelData.properties["media.name"] ? " · " + stream.modelData.properties["media.name"] : "")
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.textSoft
            }
            SliderRow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                icon: root.appIcon(stream.modelData)
                value: Math.round((stream.modelData.audio?.volume ?? 0) * 100)
                muted: stream.modelData.audio?.muted ?? false
                onMoved: v => { stream.modelData.audio.muted = false; stream.modelData.audio.volume = v / 100; }
                onGlyphClicked: stream.modelData.audio.muted = !stream.modelData.audio.muted
            }
        }
    }
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.bottomMargin: 4
        visible: root.streams.length === 0
        spacing: 4
        Glyph { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "󰝚"; size: 26; color: Theme.dim }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: "No app is playing sound"
            color: Theme.muted
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
        text: "Advanced sound settings"
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: advancedArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.muted
        MouseArea {
            id: advancedArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            anchors.margins: -4
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: { Ui.close(); Ui.run("pavucontrol"); }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/MonitorPanel.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Effects
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Widgets
import "processes.js" as Processes

// The system monitor, under the system capsule: live graphs of the processor, memory,
// graphics, disks and network with storage, or the busiest apps.
Panel {
    id: root
    originKey: "monitor"
    anchors { top: true; right: true }
    margins.right: edgeMargin - shadowRoom
    preferredSheetWidth: 440
    open: Ui.monitorOpen
    onDismissed: Ui.dismiss()

    readonly property var pages: [
        { page: "overview", label: "Overview", glyph: "󰕮" },
        { page: "processes", label: "Processes", glyph: "󰉹" }
    ]
    property string page: "overview"
    readonly property bool listing: open && page === "processes"

    readonly property int shown: 10
    property string sortBy: "cpu" // cpu or memory
    property string expanded: ""
    property var groups: []

    // The graphics card shows the GPU picked by clicking it, or else the discrete GPU while it
    // is awake and the integrated one otherwise.
    property int gpuChoice: -1
    readonly property int gpuDefault: Math.max(0, Usage.gpus.findIndex(g => !g.integrated && !g.asleep), Usage.gpus.findIndex(g => g.integrated))
    readonly property var gpu: Usage.gpus[gpuChoice >= 0 ? gpuChoice : gpuDefault] ?? null

    onOpenChanged: if (!open) expanded = ""
    onPageChanged: pageIn.restart()
    onSortByChanged: refreshList()

    // Two batch iterations: the second measures CPU over the one-second delay. Then each
    // process's cgroup, which tells apps apart (processes.js). The C locale keeps decimal points
    // out of the user's locale.
    Process {
        id: top
        command: ["bash", "-c", "LC_ALL=C top -b -n 2 -d 1 -w 512 -c -e k; echo '## cgroups'; grep -sH '' /proc/[0-9]*/cgroup"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const at = text.indexOf("\n## cgroups\n");
                root.groups = Processes.group(at < 0 ? text : text.slice(0, at), at < 0 ? "" : text.slice(at));
                root.refreshList();
            }
        }
    }
    Timer {
        interval: 2000
        running: root.listing
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: if (!top.running) top.running = true
    }

    // Apps whose desktop file is named after something else (com.anthropic.Claude runs
    // claude-desktop) are found by the program they launch; wrappers say nothing about the app.
    readonly property var launchers: {
        const wrappers = ["env", "flatpak", "sh", "bash", "python", "python3", "java", "sudo", "pkexec"];
        const map = {};
        for (const e of DesktopEntries.applications.values) {
            const exe = (e.command[0] ?? "").split("/").pop();
            if (exe && !wrappers.includes(exe) && (!map[exe] || map[exe].noDisplay))
                map[exe] = e;
        }
        return map;
    }
    // Updated in place, so rows keep their state between samples.
    function refreshList() {
        const byCpu = (a, b) => (b.cpu - a.cpu) || (b.mem - a.mem);
        const byMem = (a, b) => b.mem - a.mem;
        const top = groups.slice().sort(sortBy === "cpu" ? byCpu : byMem).slice(0, shown);
        top.forEach((g, i) => {
            // By the unit's desktop file ID, else by its program.
            const entry = g.key === "kernel" ? null
                : (g.appId ? DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(g.appId) : null) ?? DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(g.exe) ?? launchers[g.exe];
            const row = {
                key: g.key,
                name: g.key === "kernel" ? "Kernel" : entry?.name || g.name,
                icon: entry?.icon ? Quickshell.iconPath(entry.icon, true) : "",
                cpu: g.cpu / Usage.cores,
                mem: g.mem,
                pids: g.pids.join(" "),
                count: g.pids.length,
                user: g.user,
                units: g.units.join(" "),
                guarded: g.guarded
            };
            if (i < rows.count)
                rows.set(i, row);
            else
                rows.append(row);
        });
        while (rows.count > top.length)
            rows.remove(rows.count - 1);
    }
    function percent(value) {
        return value < 0.05 ? "0%" : value < 10 ? value.toFixed(1) + "%" : Math.round(value) + "%";
    }
    function size(kib) {
        return kib < 512 ? "—" : kib >= 1048576 ? (kib / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " GiB" : Math.round(kib / 1024) + " MiB";
    }
    function gib(kib) {
        return (kib / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " GiB";
    }
    // Decimal units, as drives and connections are sold.
    function bytes(n) {
        const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
        let i = 0;
        for (; n >= 1000 && i < units.length - 1; i++)
            n /= 1000;
        return `${i === 0 || n >= 10 ? Math.round(n) : n.toFixed(1)} ${units[i]}`;
    }
    function rate(n) {
        return bytes(n) + "/s";
    }
    // Calm, then amber, then rose as something fills up.
    function level(value, calm) {
        return value >= 90 ? Theme.rose : value >= 75 ? Theme.amber : calm;
    }
    // An app in its own unit is ended through systemd, which also reaches processes started
    // since the last sample; anything else by its PIDs.
    function end(row, force) {
        if (row.units)
            Quickshell.execDetached(["systemctl", "--user", "kill", "--signal=" + (force ? "KILL" : "TERM"), "--"].concat(row.units.split(" ")));
        else
            Quickshell.execDetached(["kill", force ? "-KILL" : "-TERM", "--"].concat(row.pids.split(" ")));
        expanded = "";
        refreshSoon.restart();
    }
    Timer {
        id: refreshSoon
        interval: 400
        onTriggered: if (!top.running) top.running = true
    }

    ListModel { id: rows }

    // A figure over its history graph, which fills the card's lower part edge to edge.
    component Meter: Rectangle {
        id: meter
        property string glyph
        property string title
        property color accent: Theme.accent
        property bool interactive: false
        // The graphs; the header's right side; the figures under the title.
        default property alias graphs: graphArea.data
        property alias corner: cornerSlot.data
        property alias figures: figureSlot.data
        signal clicked()

        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.preferredWidth: 1
        implicitHeight: 132
        radius: Theme.radius
        color: interactive && meterArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
        border.color: Theme.line
        Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

        CardLight { parent: meter; radius: meter.radius }
        MouseArea {
            id: meterArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            enabled: meter.interactive
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: meter.clicked()
        }

        Item {
            id: graphArea
            anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom; margins: 1 }
            height: 54
            layer.enabled: true
            layer.effect: MultiEffect {
                maskEnabled: true
                maskSource: graphMask
                maskThresholdMin: 0.25
                maskSpreadAtMin: 0.25
            }
        }
        // The card's lower corners, for the graphs.
        Rectangle {
            id: graphMask
            anchors.fill: graphArea
            visible: false
            layer.enabled: true
            bottomLeftRadius: Math.max(0, meter.radius - 1)
            bottomRightRadius: Math.max(0, meter.radius - 1)
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 12; leftMargin: 14; rightMargin: 14 }
            spacing: 4
            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: 16
                spacing: 7
                Glyph { text: meter.glyph; size: 13; color: meter.accent }
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: meter.title; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.muted }
                RowLayout { id: cornerSlot; spacing: 6 }
            }
            ColumnLayout {
                id: figureSlot
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 0
            }
        }
    }

    // A big figure and a line of detail under it.
    component Figure: ColumnLayout {
        id: figure
        property string value
        property string detail
        property color color: Theme.text
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 0
        Label {
            text: figure.value
            font.family: Theme.display
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textHeading
            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
            color: figure.color
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            visible: text !== ""
            text: figure.detail
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.subtle
        }
    }

    // A column title that sorts the list.
    component SortHeader: Overline {
        id: header
        property string mode
        readonly property bool current: root.sortBy === mode
        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
        font.weight: current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Medium
        color: current ? Theme.accentBright : headerArea.containsMouse ? Theme.textSoft : Theme.muted
        MouseArea {
            id: headerArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            anchors.margins: -6
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: root.sortBy = header.mode
        }
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        x: 18
        y: 18
        width: root.sheetWidth - 36
        spacing: 12

        // Header: the machine, and the two pages. Only the current page shows its name.
        RowLayout {
            StaggerReveal { shown: root.open; order: 0 }
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.bottomMargin: 2
            spacing: 6
            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 1
                Label { text: "System"; font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge; font.weight: Font.DemiBold }
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: Usage.cpuModel || `${Usage.cores} threads`
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                    color: Theme.muted
                }
            }
            Repeater {
                model: root.pages
                delegate: Rectangle {
                    required property var modelData
                    readonly property bool current: root.page === modelData.page
                    implicitWidth: current ? pageRow.implicitWidth + 24 : 32
                    implicitHeight: 32
                    radius: Theme.corner(16)
                    color: current ? Theme.accent : pageArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
                    border.color: current ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.line
                    Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                    Behavior on implicitWidth { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                    RowLayout {
                        id: pageRow
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        spacing: 6
                        Glyph { text: modelData.glyph; size: 13; color: current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft }
                        Label { visible: current; text: modelData.label; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; font.weight: Font.DemiBold; color: Theme.accentInk }
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: pageArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: root.page = modelData.page
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            id: pageContent
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 12

            ParallelAnimation {
                id: pageIn
                NumberAnimation { target: pageContent; property: "opacity"; from: 0; to: 1; duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
                NumberAnimation { target: pageContent; property: "Layout.topMargin"; from: 8; to: 0; duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo }
            }

            // Overview
            GridLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: root.page === "overview"
                columns: 2
                rowSpacing: 8
                columnSpacing: 8

                Meter {
                    id: meter1
                    StaggerReveal { target: meter1; shown: root.open && root.page === "overview"; order: 1 }
                    glyph: "󰻠"
                    title: "Processor"
                    accent: Theme.accent
                    // One bar per thread.
                    corner: Row {
                        readonly property int count: Usage.coreLoads.length
                        readonly property real bar: Math.max(1, (84 - (count - 1)) / count)
                        spacing: 1
                        Repeater {
                            model: parent.count
                            delegate: Rectangle {
                                required property int index
                                width: parent.bar
                                height: 14
                                radius: Theme.corner(1)
                                color: Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.16)
                                Rectangle {
                                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                    width: parent.width
                                    height: Math.max(1, parent.height * (Usage.coreLoads[index] ?? 0) / 100)
                                    radius: parent.radius
                                    color: root.level(Usage.coreLoads[index] ?? 0, Theme.accent)
                                    Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    figures: Figure {
                        value: Usage.cpu + "%"
                        detail: [Usage.cpuTemp >= 0 ? Usage.cpuTemp + " °C" : "", Usage.cpuGhz ? Usage.cpuGhz.toFixed(1) + " GHz" : "", Usage.loadAverage ? "load " + Usage.loadAverage : ""].filter(s => s).join(" · ")
                    }
                    Graph {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        values: Usage.cpuHistory
                        color: Theme.accent
                        live: root.open
                    }
                }

                Meter {
                    id: meter2
                    StaggerReveal { target: meter2; shown: root.open && root.page === "overview"; order: 2 }
                    glyph: "󰍛"
                    title: "Memory"
                    accent: Theme.pink
                    corner: Label {
                        visible: Usage.swapUsed >= 1024
                        text: "Swap " + root.gib(Usage.swapUsed)
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                        color: Theme.dim
                    }
                    figures: Figure {
                        value: Usage.memory + "%"
                        detail: `${root.gib(Usage.memoryUsed)} of ${root.gib(Usage.memoryTotal)}`
                    }
                    Graph {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        values: Usage.memoryHistory
                        color: Theme.pink
                        live: root.open
                    }
                }

                Meter {
                    id: meter3
                    StaggerReveal { target: meter3; shown: root.open && root.page === "overview"; order: 3 }
                    glyph: "󰢮"
                    title: root.gpu?.name ?? "Graphics"
                    accent: Theme.blue
                    interactive: Usage.gpus.length > 1
                    onClicked: root.gpuChoice = (Usage.gpus.indexOf(root.gpu) + 1) % Usage.gpus.length
                    // Which GPU of several this is.
                    corner: Row {
                        visible: Usage.gpus.length > 1
                        spacing: 4
                        Repeater {
                            model: Usage.gpus.length
                            delegate: Rectangle {
                                required property int index
                                readonly property bool current: Usage.gpus[index] === root.gpu
                                width: current ? 12 : 5
                                height: 5
                                radius: Theme.corner(2.5)
                                color: current ? Theme.blue : Theme.alpha(Theme.blue, 0.3)
                                Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    figures: Figure {
                        readonly property var g: root.gpu
                        value: !g ? "—" : g.asleep ? "Asleep" : g.busy >= 0 ? Math.round(g.busy) + "%" : "…"
                        color: g?.asleep ? Theme.textSoft : Theme.text
                        detail: {
                            if (!g)
                                return "No GPU found";
                            if (g.asleep)
                                return "Wakes when an app needs it";
                            return [g.temp >= 0 ? g.temp + " °C" : "",
                                    g.memTotal > 0 ? `${(g.memUsed / 1024).toFixed(1)} of ${(g.memTotal / 1024).toFixed(1)} GiB` : "",
                                    g.power >= 0 ? g.power + " W" : "",
                                    g.freq >= 0 ? `${g.freq} MHz` : ""].filter(s => s).join(" · ");
                        }
                    }
                    Graph {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        values: root.gpu?.history ?? []
                        color: Theme.blue
                        live: root.open
                    }
                }

                Meter {
                    id: meter4
                    StaggerReveal { target: meter4; shown: root.open && root.page === "overview"; order: 4 }
                    glyph: "󰋊"
                    title: "Disks"
                    accent: Theme.green
                    figures: Figure {
                        value: root.rate(Usage.diskRead + Usage.diskWrite)
                        detail: `Read ${root.rate(Usage.diskRead)} · Write ${root.rate(Usage.diskWrite)}`
                    }
                    Graph {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        values: Usage.diskHistory
                        maximum: 0
                        floor: 1e6
                        color: Theme.green
                        live: root.open
                    }
                }

                Meter {
                    id: meter5
                    StaggerReveal { target: meter5; shown: root.open && root.page === "overview"; order: 5 }
                    Layout.columnSpan: 2
                    glyph: Devices.networkGlyph
                    title: Devices.networkName
                    accent: Theme.cyan
                    corner: Label {
                        text: Usage.netInterface
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                        color: Theme.dim
                    }
                    figures: RowLayout {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 22
                        Repeater {
                            model: [
                                { glyph: "󰇚", value: Usage.netDown, total: Usage.netReceived, what: "received", color: Theme.cyan },
                                { glyph: "󰕒", value: Usage.netUp, total: Usage.netSent, what: "sent", color: Theme.accentBright }
                            ]
                            delegate: RowLayout {
                                required property var modelData
                                spacing: 8
                                Glyph { text: modelData.glyph; size: 16; color: modelData.color }
                                Figure {
                                    value: root.rate(modelData.value)
                                    detail: `${root.bytes(modelData.total)} ${modelData.what}`
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Item { Layout.fillWidth: true }
                    }
                    // Both directions on one scale.
                    Graph {
                        id: download
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        values: Usage.downHistory
                        maximum: Math.max(1e5, 1.15 * Math.max(0, ...Usage.downHistory, ...Usage.upHistory))
                        color: Theme.cyan
                        live: root.open
                    }
                    Graph {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        values: Usage.upHistory
                        maximum: download.maximum
                        color: Theme.accentBright
                        fillOpacity: 0.16
                        live: root.open
                    }
                }

                // Storage, one row per filesystem.
                Rectangle {
                    Layout.columnSpan: 2
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: Usage.filesystems.length > 0
                    implicitHeight: storage.implicitHeight + 24
                    radius: Theme.radius
                    color: Theme.raised
                    border.color: Theme.line
                    ColumnLayout {
                        id: storage
                        anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 12; leftMargin: 14; rightMargin: 14 }
                        spacing: 10
                        Repeater {
                            model: Usage.filesystems
                            delegate: ColumnLayout {
                                id: fs
                                required property var modelData
                                readonly property real used: 100 * modelData.used / modelData.size
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                spacing: 6
                                RowLayout {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    spacing: 7
                                    Glyph { text: "󰋊"; size: 13; color: Theme.green }
                                    Label { text: fs.modelData.name; font.weight: Font.Medium }
                                    Label {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        text: fs.modelData.mount
                                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                        color: Theme.dim
                                    }
                                    Label {
                                        text: `${root.bytes(fs.modelData.size - fs.modelData.used)} free of ${root.bytes(fs.modelData.size)}`
                                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                        color: Theme.subtle
                                    }
                                }
                                Rectangle {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    implicitHeight: 6
                                    radius: Theme.corner(3)
                                    color: Theme.hover
                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: Math.max(height, parent.width * Math.min(fs.used, 100) / 100)
                                        height: parent.height
                                        radius: parent.radius
                                        color: root.level(fs.used, Theme.green)
                                        Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Processes
            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: root.page === "processes"
                spacing: 8

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.leftMargin: 10
                    Layout.rightMargin: 10
                    spacing: 0
                    Overline {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: "Apps & processes"
                    }
                    SortHeader { Layout.preferredWidth: 56; text: "CPU"; mode: "cpu" }
                    SortHeader { Layout.preferredWidth: 76; text: "Memory"; mode: "memory" }
                }

                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: 2

                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.preferredHeight: 40
                        visible: rows.count === 0
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        text: "Measuring…"
                        color: Theme.muted
                    }

                    Repeater {
                        model: rows
                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            id: row
                            required property string key
                            required property string name
                            required property string icon
                            required property real cpu
                            required property real mem
                            required property string pids
                            required property int count
                            required property string user
                            required property string units
                            required property bool guarded
                            readonly property bool expanded: root.expanded === key
                            readonly property bool mine: user === Quickshell.env("USER")

                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            implicitHeight: column.implicitHeight + 14
                            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                            color: area.containsMouse || expanded ? Theme.raised : "transparent"
                            border.color: expanded ? Theme.line : "transparent"
                            clip: true
                            Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                            Behavior on implicitHeight { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }

                            MouseArea {
                                id: area
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                hoverEnabled: true
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: root.expanded = row.expanded ? "" : row.key
                            }

                            ColumnLayout {
                                id: column
                                anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 7; leftMargin: 10; rightMargin: 10 }
                                spacing: 8

                                RowLayout {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    spacing: 11
                                    Item {
                                        implicitWidth: 22
                                        implicitHeight: 22
                                        IconImage {
                                            anchors.fill: parent
                                            visible: row.icon !== ""
                                            source: row.icon
                                            asynchronous: true
                                        }
                                        Glyph {
                                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                                            visible: row.icon === ""
                                            text: row.key === "kernel" ? "󰻠" : "󰣆"
                                            size: 17
                                            color: Theme.textSoft
                                        }
                                    }
                                    ColumnLayout {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        spacing: 0
                                        Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: row.name }
                                        Label {
                                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                                            text: (row.count > 1 ? `${row.count} processes` : `PID ${row.pids}`) + (row.user && !row.mine ? ` · ${row.user}` : "")
                                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                            color: Theme.muted
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Label {
                                        Layout.preferredWidth: 56
                                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                                        text: root.percent(row.cpu)
                                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                                        color: root.sortBy === "cpu" ? Theme.text : Theme.muted
                                    }
                                    Label {
                                        Layout.preferredWidth: 76
                                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                                        text: root.size(row.mem)
                                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                                        color: root.sortBy === "memory" ? Theme.text : Theme.muted
                                    }
                                }

                                RowLayout {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    Layout.leftMargin: 33
                                    visible: row.expanded
                                    spacing: 8
                                    Label {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        text: row.key === "kernel" ? "Kernel threads" : !row.mine ? "Owned by another user"
                                            : row.guarded ? "Part of the desktop" : `Running as ${row.user}`
                                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                        color: Theme.dim
                                    }
                                    PillButton {
                                        visible: row.mine && !row.guarded
                                        text: "End"
                                        onClicked: root.end(row, false)
                                    }
                                    PillButton {
                                        visible: row.mine && !row.guarded
                                        text: "Force quit"
                                        danger: true
                                        onClicked: root.end(row, true)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        RowLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.topMargin: 2
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: "Updates every 2 s"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.dim
            }
            PillButton {
                text: "Advanced view"
                primary: true
                onClicked: {
                    Ui.close();
                    Ui.spawn(Ui.terminal(["btop"], ["--class", "penumbra-monitor"]));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/MoonPhase.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick

// Local phase illustration, with the same palette in every mode. No emoji font dependency.
Canvas {
    id: root
    property real phase: 0
    property color lit: Theme.accentBright
    property color shade: Theme.control
    property color rim: Theme.lineStrong
    implicitWidth: 38
    implicitHeight: 38
    onPhaseChanged: requestPaint()
    onLitChanged: requestPaint()
    onShadeChanged: requestPaint()
    onRimChanged: requestPaint()
    onPaint: {
        const ctx = getContext("2d");
        ctx.reset();
        ctx.scale(width / 128, height / 128);
        const c = 64, r = 53, k = 0.55228475;
        const p = ((phase % 1) + 1) % 1;
        const waxing = p <= 0.5;
        const tx = Math.cos(p * 2 * Math.PI) * r * (waxing ? 1 : -1);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c, c, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = shade;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = rim;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(c, c - r);
        ctx.arc(c, c, r, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, !waxing);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c + k * tx, c + r, c + tx, c + k * r, c + tx, c);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(c + tx, c - k * r, c + k * tx, c - r, c, c - r);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = lit;
        ctx.fill();
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/NightLight.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import "sun.js" as Sun

// Night light: hyprsunset warms the screen. It is turned on by hand, or by a schedule (fixed
// times, or sunset to sunrise where you are), and fades between warm and neutral rather than
// jumping. The choices are in Settings (shell.json); a toggle by hand lasts until the schedule
// next turns it on or off, and in manual mode it is saved so it survives a shell restart.
Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property bool available: Ui.hasNightLight
    property bool on: false
    readonly property int temperature: Settings.nightTemperature
    readonly property int neutral: 6500
    readonly property string schedule: Settings.nightSchedule // manual, times or sun

    function toggle() {
        on = !on;
        if (schedule === "manual")
            Settings.nightOn = on;
        fade(0);
    }

    // ── Where you are, for sunset and sunrise ───────────────────────
    // zone1970.tab lists a city with coordinates for every time zone, so a typed city is found
    // without a network lookup; with nothing typed, this computer's time zone stands in.
    // The list is read only for a sun schedule, or once the night light page asks for it.
    property var cities: [] // [{ name: "New York", zone: "America/New_York", latitude, longitude }]
    property bool citiesWanted: false
    property string timeZone: ""
    FileView {
        path: root.citiesWanted || root.schedule === "sun" ? "/usr/share/zoneinfo/zone1970.tab" : ""
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: {
            const found = [];
            for (const line of text().split("\n")) {
                const fields = line.split("\t");
                if (line.startsWith("#") || fields.length < 3)
                    continue;
                const at = Sun.coordinates(fields[1]);
                if (at)
                    found.push(Object.assign({ name: fields[2].replace(/^.*\//, "").replace(/_/g, " "), zone: fields[2] }, at));
            }
            root.cities = found;
        }
    }
    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["readlink", "/etc/localtime"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.timeZone = text.trim().replace(/^.*zoneinfo\//, "")
        }
    }
    // A typed place → { name, latitude, longitude }, or null when it means nothing.
    function locate(text) {
        const typed = text.trim();
        if (typed === "")
            return cities.find(c => c.zone === timeZone) ?? null;
        const m = /^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[, ]\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/.exec(typed);
        if (m) {
            const latitude = Number(m[1]), longitude = Number(m[2]);
            return Math.abs(latitude) <= 90 && Math.abs(longitude) <= 180 ? { name: `${latitude}, ${longitude}`, latitude, longitude } : null;
        }
        const name = typed.toLowerCase();
        return cities.find(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === name) ?? cities.find(c => c.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(name)) ?? null;
    }
    readonly property var place: locate(Settings.nightPlace)

    // ── The schedule ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Today's on and off times in minutes after midnight, or null (manual, or no sunset today).
    readonly property var window: {
        if (schedule === "times") {
            const from = Sun.minutes(Settings.nightFrom), to = Sun.minutes(Settings.nightTo);
            return from >= 0 && to >= 0 && from !== to ? { from, to } : null;
        }
        if (schedule === "sun" && place) {
            const t = Sun.times(Clock.date, place.latitude, place.longitude);
            if (t.polar)
                return { polar: t.polar };
            return { from: t.set, to: t.rise };
        }
        return null;
    }
    readonly property bool scheduledOn: {
        if (!window)
            return false;
        if (window.polar)
            return window.polar === "night";
        return Sun.between(Clock.date.getHours() * 60 + Clock.date.getMinutes(), window.from, window.to);
    }
    // The next change the schedule makes, for the status line: "On until 07:12".
    readonly property string status: {
        if (!available)
            return "Needs hyprsunset";
        const state = on ? `On · ${temperature} K` : "Off";
        if (!window || window.polar)
            return state;
        return `${on ? "On" : "Off"} until ${Sun.clock(on ? window.to : window.from)}`;
    }
    // The schedule turning on or off (each minute is checked), or a change to its settings, wins
    // over a toggle by hand.
    property bool lastScheduled: false
    function followSchedule(slowly, changed) {
        if (schedule === "manual")
            return;
        const wanted = scheduledOn;
        if (!changed && wanted === lastScheduled)
            return;
        lastScheduled = wanted;
        if (on !== wanted) {
            on = wanted;
            fade(slowly ? 5 * 60 * 1000 : 0);
        }
    }
    Connections {
        target: Clock
        function onDateChanged() { root.followSchedule(true, false); }
    }
    Connections {
        target: Settings
        function onNightScheduleChanged() { root.followSchedule(false, true); }
        function onNightFromChanged() { root.followSchedule(false, true); }
        function onNightToChanged() { root.followSchedule(false, true); }
    }
    // A typed place, or the list of cities once it has loaded.
    onPlaceChanged: if (schedule === "sun") followSchedule(false, true)
    // Settings load just after the shell starts; manual mode comes back as it was left.
    Timer {
        interval: 1500
        running: true
        onTriggered: {
            if (root.schedule === "manual" && Settings.nightOn && !root.on) {
                root.on = true;
                root.fade(0);
            }
            root.followSchedule(false, true);
        }
    }
    // The slider moves in many small steps; send hyprsunset only where it stops.
    onTemperatureChanged: if (on) settle.restart()
    Timer {
        id: settle
        interval: 300
        onTriggered: if (root.on) root.fade(0)
    }

    // ── Applying it ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // hyprsunset runs while the screen is warm or fading, and takes each step over its IPC
    // (`hyprctl hyprsunset temperature N`); it leaves the colours alone when it stops.
    property int applied: neutral
    property int fadeFrom: neutral
    property int fadeTo: neutral
    property real fadeStart: 0
    property int fadeLength: 0
    readonly property bool fading: fader.running
    function fade(ms) {
        fadeFrom = applied;
        fadeTo = on ? temperature : neutral;
        fadeStart = Date.now();
        fadeLength = ms;
        // A change by hand is one step (Hyprland eases colour changes itself); a scheduled fade is
        // steps of 100 K at least ten seconds apart, since every step is a new colour transform
        // for the whole screen.
        fader.interval = ms > 0 ? Math.max(10000, ms / Math.max(1, Math.abs(fadeTo - fadeFrom) / 100)) : 100;
        fader.restart();
    }
    Timer {
        id: fader
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: {
            if (!root.available) {
                stop();
                return;
            }
            if (step.running)
                return;
            const t = root.fadeLength > 0 ? Math.min(1, (Date.now() - root.fadeStart) / root.fadeLength) : 1;
            const eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
            const value = Math.round((root.fadeFrom + (root.fadeTo - root.fadeFrom) * eased) / 10) * 10;
            if (value !== root.applied && value < root.neutral && sunset.running) {
                step.value = value;
                step.command = ["hyprctl", "hyprsunset", "temperature", String(value)];
                step.running = true;
            } else if (value >= root.neutral) {
                root.applied = root.neutral;
            }
            if (t >= 1 && root.applied === root.fadeTo)
                stop();
        }
    }
    Process {
        id: sunset
        running: root.available && (root.on || root.applied < root.neutral || root.fading)
        command: ["hyprsunset", "--identity"]
    }
    Process {
        id: step
        property int value
        // hyprsunset takes a moment to listen after starting; a failed step is tried again.
        onExited: code => { if (code === 0) root.applied = value; }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/NightLightPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import "sun.js" as Sun

// Night light: how warm, and when it comes on by itself.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12
    // Cities are only read for the place field and sunset schedules.
    Component.onCompleted: NightLight.citiesWanted = true

    // Steps a "HH:MM" setting by a quarter of an hour.
    function shifted(text, quarters) {
        const m = Math.max(0, Sun.minutes(text));
        return Sun.clock(Math.round(m / 15) * 15 + 15 * quarters);
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Night light"
        status: NightLight.status
        checked: NightLight.on
        showSwitch: NightLight.available
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
        onToggled: NightLight.toggle()
    }

    Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Warmth" }
    SliderRow {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        glyph: "󱩌"
        // Warmer to the right.
        from: 6000
        to: 2500
        stepSize: 100
        value: Settings.nightTemperature
        label: Settings.nightTemperature + " K"
        labelWidth: 48
        muted: !NightLight.on
        onMoved: v => Settings.nightTemperature = Math.round(v / 100) * 100
        onGlyphClicked: NightLight.toggle()
    }

    Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Schedule" }
    Segmented {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        current: Settings.nightSchedule
        options: [
            { value: "manual", title: "By hand" },
            { value: "times", title: "Set times" },
            { value: "sun", title: "Sunset to sunrise" }
        ]
        onChosen: value => Settings.nightSchedule = value
    }

    // Fixed times, a quarter of an hour at a time.
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Settings.nightSchedule === "times"
        spacing: 2
        Repeater {
            model: [
                { title: "Turns on", glyph: "󰖔", key: "nightFrom" },
                { title: "Turns off", glyph: "󰖙", key: "nightTo" }
            ]
            delegate: RowLayout {
                required property var modelData
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                spacing: 11
                Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: modelData.glyph; size: 17 }
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: modelData.title }
                Stepper {
                    text: Settings[modelData.key]
                    lessGlyph: "󰍴"
                    moreGlyph: "󰐕"
                    onDecreased: Settings[modelData.key] = root.shifted(Settings[modelData.key], -1)
                    onIncreased: Settings[modelData.key] = root.shifted(Settings[modelData.key], 1)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Sunset and sunrise where you are: a city or coordinates, worked out on this computer.
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Settings.nightSchedule === "sun"
        spacing: 6
        Field {
            id: place
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: Settings.nightPlace
            placeholderText: NightLight.locate("")?.name ? `${NightLight.locate("").name} (your time zone) · or a city, or latitude, longitude` : "A city, or latitude, longitude"
            invalid: text.trim() !== "" && !NightLight.locate(text)
            onTextEdited: if (!invalid) Settings.nightPlace = text.trim()
            onEditingFinished: if (!invalid) Settings.nightPlace = text.trim()
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 4
            readonly property var where: NightLight.place
            readonly property var sun: where ? Sun.times(Clock.date, where.latitude, where.longitude) : null
            text: place.invalid ? "No time zone city by that name; try a nearby large city, or latitude, longitude"
                : !where ? "Type a city, or latitude, longitude"
                : sun.polar === "day" ? `${where.name} · the sun doesn't set today`
                : sun.polar === "night" ? `${where.name} · the sun doesn't rise today`
                : `${where.name} · sunset ${Sun.clock(sun.set)}, sunrise ${Sun.clock(sun.rise)}`
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: place.invalid ? Theme.rose : Theme.muted
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.leftMargin: 4
        visible: Settings.nightSchedule !== "manual"
        text: "It fades in and out over five minutes. Turning it on or off by hand lasts until the next change."
        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.dim
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Notes.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Keep the draft and pending save alive when the sidebar page closes.
Singleton {
    id: root
    property string draft: ""
    property bool ready: false
    property bool dirty: false
    property string error: ""
    property string writing: ""
    function edit(text) {
        draft = text;
        dirty = true;
        settle.restart();
    }
    function save() {
        if (!ready || !dirty) return;
        error = "";
        writing = draft;
        file.setText(writing);
    }
    Timer { id: settle; interval: 400; onTriggered: root.save() }
    FileView {
        id: file
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/notes.txt"
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: { root.draft = text(); root.ready = true; }
        onLoadFailed: code => {
            root.ready = code === FileViewError.FileNotFound;
            if (!root.ready) root.error = "Couldn't read notes";
        }
        onSaved: {
            root.dirty = root.draft !== root.writing;
            if (root.dirty) settle.restart();
        }
        onSaveFailed: root.error = "Couldn't save notes. Your draft is still here; retry when storage is available."
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/NotificationCard.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Services.Notifications
import Quickshell.Widgets

// One notification: icon, app, summary, body and actions. Click runs the default action.
Rectangle {
    id: root

    required property var notification
    property bool compact: false
    readonly property bool critical: notification?.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Critical
    readonly property var actions: (notification?.actions ?? []).filter(a => a.identifier !== "default")
    // Big images (screenshots, photos) show under the text; small ones (avatars) are the icon.
    readonly property bool largeImage: probe.status === Image.Ready && probe.implicitWidth >= 240
    readonly property string appIconSource: {
        const icon = notification?.appIcon ?? "";
        if (!icon)
            return "";
        return icon.startsWith("/") || icon.includes("://") ? icon : Quickshell.iconPath(icon, true);
    }
    readonly property string iconSource: notification?.image && !largeImage ? notification.image : appIconSource
    // Decoded no wider than 240: an image only ever shrinks to fit, so it still tells which are
    // that wide, and their shape, without holding a whole screenshot.
    Image {
        id: probe
        visible: false
        source: root.notification?.image ?? ""
        sourceSize.width: 240
        asynchronous: true
    }

    implicitHeight: layout.implicitHeight + 28
    radius: Theme.radius
    color: compact ? (area.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised) : Theme.panel
    border.color: critical ? Theme.rose : compact ? Theme.line : Theme.lineStrong
    Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

    CardLight { radius: root.radius }
    Shadow {
        z: -1
        target: root
        visible: !root.compact
        // A child already takes the card's fade and scale.
        opacity: 1
        scale: 1
    }
    GlassEdge {
        visible: !root.compact
        radius: root.radius
    }

    MouseArea {
        id: area
        anchors.fill: parent
        hoverEnabled: true
        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
        onClicked: {
            const n = root.notification;
            const action = n.actions.find(a => a.identifier === "default");
            if (action)
                action.invoke();
            n.dismiss();
        }
    }

    RowLayout {
        id: layout
        anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 14 }
        spacing: 12

        Item {
            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
            implicitWidth: 36
            implicitHeight: 36
            ClippingRectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: Theme.corner(10)
                color: Theme.raised
                visible: root.iconSource !== ""
                IconImage {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    source: root.iconSource
                }
            }
            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: Theme.corner(10)
                color: Theme.raised
                visible: root.iconSource === ""
                Glyph {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    text: root.critical ? "󰀦" : "󰂚"
                    size: 17
                    color: root.critical ? Theme.rose : Theme.accentBright
                }
            }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 3

            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.notification?.appName || "Notification"
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                    font.letterSpacing: 1.2
                    font.capitalization: Font.AllUppercase
                    color: root.critical ? Theme.rose : Theme.accent
                }
                Label {
                    text: Notifs.age(root.notification, Clock.date.getTime())
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                    color: Theme.dim
                }
                Glyph {
                    text: "󰅖"
                    size: 13
                    color: close.containsMouse ? Theme.text : Theme.dim
                    MouseArea {
                        id: close
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: -6
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: root.notification.dismiss()
                    }
                }
            }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: root.notification?.summary ?? ""
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
            }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: text !== ""
                text: root.notification?.body ?? ""
                textFormat: Text.StyledText
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                maximumLineCount: root.compact ? 2 : 4
                color: Theme.textSoft
                linkColor: Theme.accentBright
                onLinkActivated: link => Qt.openUrlExternally(link)
            }
            ClippingRectangle {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.topMargin: 6
                Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(root.compact ? 120 : 180, width * probe.implicitHeight / Math.max(1, probe.implicitWidth))
                visible: root.largeImage
                radius: Theme.corner(10)
                color: Theme.raised
                Image {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    source: root.largeImage ? root.notification.image : ""
                    // Twice the card's width, at most 360.
                    sourceSize.width: 720
                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                    asynchronous: true
                }
            }

            // Inline reply, for chat apps that offer it.
            Rectangle {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.topMargin: 6
                visible: root.notification?.hasInlineReply ?? false
                implicitHeight: 34
                radius: Theme.corner(17)
                color: Theme.raised
                border.color: reply.activeFocus ? Theme.accent : Theme.line
                TextInput {
                    id: reply
                    anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 14; rightMargin: 40 }
                    verticalAlignment: TextInput.AlignVCenter
                    color: Theme.text
                    font.family: Theme.sans
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                    selectionColor: Theme.accentDeep
                    clip: true
                    function send() {
                        if (!text.trim())
                            return;
                        root.notification.sendInlineReply(text);
                        root.notification.dismiss();
                    }
                    Keys.onReturnPressed: send()
                    Keys.onEnterPressed: send()
                    Label {
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        visible: !reply.text
                        text: root.notification?.inlineReplyPlaceholder || "Reply…"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                        color: Theme.dim
                    }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 3; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                    width: 28
                    height: 28
                    radius: Theme.corner(14)
                    color: reply.text ? Theme.accent : "transparent"
                    Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰒊"; size: 13; color: reply.text ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.dim }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: reply.send()
                    }
                }
            }

            Flow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.topMargin: 6
                visible: root.actions.length > 0
                spacing: 6
                Repeater {
                    model: root.actions
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var modelData
                        implicitWidth: actionLabel.implicitWidth + 24
                        implicitHeight: 28
                        radius: Theme.corner(14)
                        color: actionArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accent : Theme.raised
                        border.color: Theme.line
                        Label {
                            id: actionLabel
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: modelData.text
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                            color: actionArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: actionArea
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: {
                                modelData.invoke();
                                root.notification.dismiss();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/NotificationPopups.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland

// New notifications slide in at the top right, then retire to the control center.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    screen: Ui.screen
    anchors { top: true; right: true }
    // Room around the cards for their shadows.
    readonly property int shadowRoom: Theme.edge
    margins { top: Theme.barHeight + 10 + Theme.gap - shadowRoom; right: Theme.edge - shadowRoom }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    implicitWidth: 360 + 2 * shadowRoom
    implicitHeight: Math.max(1, column.height + 2 * shadowRoom)
    visible: Notifs.popups.length > 0 && !Ui.controlOpen
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-popups"
    // A click gives the popup the keyboard, for inline replies.
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: WlrKeyboardFocus.OnDemand
    // Only the cards take input; the rest of the column passes clicks through.
    mask: Region { item: column }

    Column {
        id: column
        x: root.shadowRoom
        y: root.shadowRoom
        width: parent.width - 2 * root.shadowRoom
        spacing: 8
        move: Transition { NumberAnimation { property: "y"; duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }

        // ScriptModel keeps existing cards when the array is replaced, so their
        // timers, hover state and reply text survive a new notification.
        Repeater {
            model: ScriptModel { values: Notifs.popups }
            delegate: NotificationCard {
                id: card
                required property var modelData
                width: column.width
                notification: modelData
                opacity: 0
                x: 40
                Component.onCompleted: { opacity = 1; x = 0; }
                Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal } }
                Behavior on x { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo } }

                Timer {
                    interval: Notifs.timeout(card.modelData)
                    running: interval > 0 && !card.hoveredCard
                    onTriggered: Notifs.retire(card.modelData)
                }
                readonly property bool hoveredCard: hover.hovered
                HoverHandler { id: hover }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import "sun.js" as Sun

// Notifications: when Do not disturb comes on by itself, sounds, the lock screen, and each app's rule.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12

    // Steps a "HH:MM" setting by a quarter of an hour.
    function shifted(text, quarters) {
        const m = Math.max(0, Sun.minutes(text));
        return Sun.clock(Math.round(m / 15) * 15 + 15 * quarters);
    }
    readonly property var ruleNames: ({ "silent": "No popups", "mute": "Muted", "keep": "Always kept" })
    readonly property var ruleApps: Object.keys(Settings.notificationRules).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Notifications"
        status: Notifs.dnd ? "Do not disturb · " + Notifs.dndStatus.toLowerCase() : "Do not disturb is off"
        checked: Notifs.dnd
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
        onToggled: Notifs.toggleDnd()
    }

    Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Do not disturb by itself" }
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 2
        SwitchRow {
            glyph: "󰑊"
            title: "While sharing the screen"
            subtitle: "Recording or casting, so nothing private shows"
            checked: Settings.dndWhileSharing
            onToggled: Settings.dndWhileSharing = !Settings.dndWhileSharing
        }
        SwitchRow {
            glyph: "󰊓"
            title: "While a window is fullscreen"
            subtitle: "Videos, games and presentations"
            checked: Settings.dndFullscreen
            onToggled: Settings.dndFullscreen = !Settings.dndFullscreen
        }
        SwitchRow {
            glyph: "󰔛"
            title: "On a schedule"
            subtitle: Settings.dndSchedule ? `${Settings.dndFrom} to ${Settings.dndTo}` : "Every day at set times"
            checked: Settings.dndSchedule
            onToggled: Settings.dndSchedule = !Settings.dndSchedule
        }
        // Fixed times, a quarter of an hour at a time.
        Repeater {
            model: Settings.dndSchedule ? [
                { title: "From", glyph: "󰖔", key: "dndFrom" },
                { title: "Until", glyph: "󰖙", key: "dndTo" }
            ] : []
            delegate: RowLayout {
                required property var modelData
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                spacing: 11
                Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: modelData.glyph; size: 17 }
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: modelData.title }
                Stepper {
                    text: Settings[modelData.key]
                    lessGlyph: "󰍴"
                    moreGlyph: "󰐕"
                    onDecreased: Settings[modelData.key] = root.shifted(Settings[modelData.key], -1)
                    onIncreased: Settings[modelData.key] = root.shifted(Settings[modelData.key], 1)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Alerts" }
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 2
        SwitchRow {
            glyph: "󰂞"
            title: "Sounds"
            subtitle: "For new notifications; critical ones sound different"
            checked: Settings.notificationSounds
            onToggled: Settings.notificationSounds = !Settings.notificationSounds
        }
        SwitchRow {
            glyph: "󰌾"
            title: "Count on the lock screen"
            subtitle: "How many came in while locked, never what they say"
            checked: Settings.lockNotificationCount
            onToggled: Settings.lockNotificationCount = !Settings.lockNotificationCount
        }
    }

    Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.topMargin: 2; text: "Apps" }
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 2
        Repeater {
            model: root.ruleApps
            delegate: RowLayout {
                id: app
                required property string modelData
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                spacing: 11
                Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: "󰂚"; size: 17 }
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: app.modelData; elide: Text.ElideRight }
                Segmented {
                    Layout.preferredWidth: 220
                    current: Settings.notificationRules[app.modelData] ?? ""
                    options: [
                        { value: "", title: "Normal" },
                        { value: "silent", title: "Quiet" },
                        { value: "mute", title: "Mute" },
                        { value: "keep", title: "Keep" }
                    ]
                    onChosen: value => Settings.setRule(app.modelData, value)
                }
            }
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 4
            text: (root.ruleApps.length ? "" : "No app has a rule yet. ")
                + "The bell next to an app in the notification history sets one: Quiet keeps its notifications out of the popups, Mute drops them, Keep holds them past the history's limit of " + Notifs.limit + "."
            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.dim
        }
    }
}
```
