## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Notifs.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Services.Notifications
import "sun.js" as Sun

// Notification daemon: popups for new notifications, history for the control center. Do not
// disturb comes on by hand, on a schedule, or by itself while you share the screen (recording,
// casting) or a window is fullscreen; per-app rules (Settings → Notifications) can keep an app's
// notifications out of the popups, drop them, or keep them past the history limit.
Singleton {
    id: root

    // By hand or by the schedule: the schedule sets it when its window starts and ends, so a
    // toggle by hand lasts until the next change, as with night light.
    property bool dndOn: false
    readonly property bool scheduled: Settings.dndSchedule
        && Sun.between(Clock.date.getHours() * 60 + Clock.date.getMinutes(), Sun.minutes(Settings.dndFrom), Sun.minutes(Settings.dndTo))
    onScheduledChanged: dndOn = scheduled
    Component.onCompleted: if (scheduled) dndOn = true
    // Recording, casting or a fullscreen window turn it on until they end; turning it off by
    // hand meanwhile holds until they do.
    readonly property bool sharing: Recorder.recording || Cast.casting || Cast.connecting
    readonly property bool fullscreen: Hyprland.focusedMonitor?.activeWorkspace?.hasFullscreen ?? false
    readonly property bool autoQuiet: !!(Settings.dndWhileSharing && sharing || Settings.dndFullscreen && fullscreen)
    property bool autoDismissed: false
    onAutoQuietChanged: if (!autoQuiet) autoDismissed = false
    readonly property bool dnd: dndOn || autoQuiet && !autoDismissed
    readonly property string dndStatus: !dnd ? "Off"
        : dndOn && scheduled ? `Until ${Settings.dndTo} · only critical alerts`
        : dndOn ? "Only critical alerts"
        : sharing && Settings.dndWhileSharing ? "While you share the screen"
        : "While a window is fullscreen"
    function toggleDnd() {
        if (dnd) {
            dndOn = false;
            if (autoQuiet)
                autoDismissed = true;
        } else {
            dndOn = true;
        }
    }

    // The rule for an app: "" (normal), "silent", "mute" or "keep".
    function rule(app) {
        return Settings.notificationRules[app || "Notification"] ?? "";
    }
    property var popups: []
    // The history keeps this many notifications; older ones expire.
    readonly property int limit: 50
    // When each notification arrived (Date.now()), by id.
    property var received: ({})
    // Newest first.
    readonly property var history: server.trackedNotifications.values.slice().reverse()
    readonly property int count: history.length
    // History by app, newest first: [{ app, items }].
    readonly property var groups: {
        const groups = [];
        for (const n of history) {
            const app = n.appName || "Notification";
            let group = groups.find(g => g.app === app);
            if (!group)
                groups.push(group = { app, items: [] });
            group.items.push(n);
        }
        return groups;
    }

    function clear() {
        for (const n of server.trackedNotifications.values.slice())
            n.dismiss();
        popups = [];
    }
    function clearApp(app) {
        for (const n of history.filter(n => (n.appName || "Notification") === app))
            n.dismiss();
    }
    function hidePopup(n) {
        popups = popups.filter(p => p !== n);
    }
    // A popup timed out: transient notifications go away instead of into the history.
    function retire(n) {
        hidePopup(n);
        if (n.transient && rule(n.appName) !== "keep")
            n.expire();
    }

    // A sound for a new popup (Settings → Notifications): the sound the app asks for, or the
    // sound theme's; never for low urgency or when the app asks for silence.
    function chime(n) {
        const hints = n.hints ?? {};
        if (!Settings.notificationSounds || n.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Low || hints["suppress-sound"])
            return;
        const asked = String(hints["sound-file"] ?? "");
        const sound = asked.startsWith("/") ? asked
            : "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/" + (n.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Critical ? "dialog-warning.oga" : "message-new-instant.oga");
        Quickshell.execDetached(["pw-play", sound]);
    }
    // "now", "5 min", "2 h", "yesterday" or the date; `now` is passed in so callers update with the clock.
    function age(n, now) {
        const at = received[n.id];
        if (!at)
            return "";
        const minutes = Math.floor((now - at) / 60000);
        if (minutes < 1)
            return "now";
        if (minutes < 60)
            return `${minutes} min`;
        if (minutes < 24 * 60)
            return `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} h`;
        return minutes < 48 * 60 ? "yesterday" : Qt.formatDate(new Date(at), "d MMM");
    }
    // Milliseconds a popup stays up (expireTimeout is already in ms); critical ones wait for the user.
    function timeout(n) {
        if (n.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Critical)
            return 0;
        return n.expireTimeout > 0 ? Math.min(n.expireTimeout, 20000) : 6000;
    }

    NotificationServer {
        id: server
        keepOnReload: true
        actionsSupported: true
        bodyMarkupSupported: true
        bodyHyperlinksSupported: true
        imageSupported: true
        inlineReplySupported: true
        persistenceSupported: true

        onNotification: n => {
            const rule = root.rule(n.appName);
            // Muted: never tracked, so it is dropped at once.
            if (rule === "mute")
                return;
            n.tracked = true;
            root.received = Object.assign({}, root.received, { [n.id]: Date.now() });
            n.closed.connect(() => {
                root.hidePopup(n);
                const received = Object.assign({}, root.received);
                delete received[n.id];
                root.received = received;
            });
            const shown = rule !== "silent" && (!root.dnd || n.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Critical);
            if (shown)
                root.chime(n);
            if (shown) {
                const stack = [n, ...root.popups];
                root.popups = stack.slice(0, 4);
                // Pushed out of the stack counts as timed out, so transient ones still expire.
                for (const dropped of stack.slice(4))
                    root.retire(dropped);
            } else if (n.transient)
                Qt.callLater(() => n.expire());
            // Oldest first; keep the newest `limit`, apart from apps whose rule is to keep them.
            const all = server.trackedNotifications.values.filter(o => root.rule(o.appName) !== "keep");
            for (const old of all.slice(0, Math.max(0, all.length - root.limit)))
                old.expire();
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Osd.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland

// Volume / microphone / brightness feedback, floating above the bottom edge; Caps Lock and the
// keyboard layout show as text in the same pill.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    screen: Ui.screen
    readonly property bool atTop: Settings.osdPosition === "top"
    anchors.bottom: !atTop
    anchors.top: atTop
    // Room around the pill for its shadow.
    readonly property int shadowRoom: 16
    margins.bottom: atTop ? 0 : 80 - shadowRoom
    margins.top: 0
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    implicitWidth: 300 + 2 * shadowRoom
    implicitHeight: 58 + 2 * shadowRoom
    IslandSurface {
        x: root.shadowRoom; y: 0
        width: parent.width - 2 * root.shadowRoom; height: parent.height - root.shadowRoom
        visible: root.atTop
        opacity: pill.opacity
    }
    visible: Ui.osdVisible || pill.opacity > 0
    color: "transparent"
    mask: Region {}
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-osd"

    readonly property bool textOnly: Ui.osdKind === "capslock" || Ui.osdKind === "layout"
    readonly property string glyph: {
        if (Ui.osdKind === "capslock")
            return Ui.osdMuted ? "󰘲" : "󰪛";
        if (Ui.osdKind === "layout")
            return "󰌌";
        if (Ui.osdKind === "brightness")
            return Ui.osdValue > 66 ? "󰃠" : Ui.osdValue > 33 ? "󰃟" : "󰃞";
        if (Ui.osdKind === "microphone")
            return Ui.osdMuted ? "󰍭" : "󰍬";
        return Ui.osdMuted ? "󰝟" : Ui.osdValue > 60 ? "󰕾" : Ui.osdValue > 25 ? "󰖀" : "󰕿";
    }

    Shadow { target: pill }
    Rectangle {
        id: pill
        anchors { fill: parent; margins: root.shadowRoom }
        radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
        color: root.atTop ? "transparent" : Theme.glassStrong
        border.color: Theme.line
        opacity: Ui.osdVisible ? 1 : 0
        scale: Ui.osdVisible ? 1 : 0.92
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal } }
        Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutBack } }

        GlassEdge { radius: pill.radius }

        RowLayout {
            anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 20; rightMargin: 20 }
            spacing: 14
            Glyph {
                text: root.glyph
                size: 19
                color: Ui.osdMuted ? Theme.dim : Theme.accentBright
                Layout.preferredWidth: 22
            }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: root.textOnly
                text: Ui.osdText
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                color: Ui.osdMuted ? Theme.textSoft : Theme.text
            }
            Rectangle {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: !root.textOnly
                implicitHeight: 8
                radius: Theme.corner(4)
                color: Theme.raised
                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width * (Ui.osdMuted ? 0 : Ui.osdValue / 100)
                    height: parent.height
                    radius: Theme.corner(4)
                    gradient: Gradient {
                        orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
                        GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accentDeep }
                        GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.accent }
                    }
                    Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                }
            }
            Label {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 38
                visible: !root.textOnly
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                text: Ui.osdMuted ? "Muted" : Ui.osdValue + "%"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.textSoft
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Every workspace at a glance, with live previews of its windows. Click a workspace to go there or
// a window to focus it, drag a window onto another workspace to move it, type to find a window by
// its title or app (Tab steps through the matches, Enter goes to one). Super and the key left of 1,
// or four fingers up on a touchpad, opens it.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    screen: Ui.screen
    anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    visible: Ui.overviewOpen || backdrop.opacity > 0
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-overview"
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: Ui.overviewOpen ? WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive : WlrKeyboardFocus.None

    Connections {
        target: Ui
        function onOverviewOpenChanged() {
            if (!Ui.overviewOpen)
                return;
            search.text = "";
            search.forceActiveFocus();
            root.picking = false;
            // Window positions come from Hyprland's last report; ask for a fresh one.
            Hyprland.refreshMonitors();
            Hyprland.refreshWorkspaces();
            Hyprland.refreshToplevels();
            root.selected = Math.max(0, root.matches.findIndex(t => t.activated));
        }
    }

    // Workspaces with windows or on screen, then the first free number, to drop a window into.
    readonly property var workspaces: {
        const list = Hyprland.workspaces.values.filter(w => w.id > 0 && (w.toplevels.values.length > 0 || w.active))
            .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id).map(w => ({ id: w.id, workspace: w }));
        let free = 1;
        while (list.some(w => w.id === free))
            free++;
        return list.concat([{ id: free, workspace: null }]);
    }
    function entry(toplevel) {
        return DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(toplevel.lastIpcObject?.class ?? "");
    }
    readonly property string query: search.text.trim().toLowerCase()
    function found(toplevel) {
        if (query === "")
            return true;
        const o = toplevel.lastIpcObject ?? {};
        return [toplevel.title, o.class, entry(toplevel)?.name].some(t => (t ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(query));
    }
    // The windows that match, in workspace order: Tab and Enter move through these.
    readonly property var matches: workspaces.filter(w => w.workspace)
        .reduce((all, w) => all.concat(w.workspace.toplevels.values.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.lastIpcObject?.at?.[0] ?? 0) - (b.lastIpcObject?.at?.[0] ?? 0))), [])
        .filter(t => found(t))
    property int selected: 0
    // Whether Tab or the arrows have been used: only then, or while searching, is the pick outlined.
    property bool picking: false
    readonly property var chosen: matches[Math.min(selected, matches.length - 1)] ?? null
    onQueryChanged: selected = 0
    function step(by) {
        picking = true;
        selected = (selected + by + matches.length) % Math.max(1, matches.length);
    }

    function address(toplevel) {
        return toplevel.lastIpcObject?.address ?? "0x" + toplevel.address;
    }
    function focusWindow(toplevel) {
        Ui.overviewOpen = false;
        Hyprland.dispatch(`hl.dsp.focus({window = "address:${address(toplevel)}"})`);
    }
    function goTo(id) {
        Ui.overviewOpen = false;
        Hyprland.dispatch(`hl.dsp.focus({workspace = ${id}})`);
    }
    function moveWindow(toplevel, id) {
        Hyprland.dispatch(`hl.dsp.window.move({workspace = ${id}, follow = false, window = "address:${address(toplevel)}"})`);
        refresh.restart();
    }
    Timer {
        id: refresh
        interval: 150
        onTriggered: { Hyprland.refreshWorkspaces(); Hyprland.refreshToplevels(); }
    }

    // A tile is this wide; its height follows its screen's shape.
    readonly property int columns: Math.max(1, Math.min(workspaces.length, width > 2400 ? 5 : 4))
    readonly property real tileWidth: Math.min(380, (width - 160 - (columns - 1) * 22) / columns)

    Rectangle {
        id: backdrop
        anchors.fill: parent
        color: Theme.alpha(Theme.scrim, 0.62)
        opacity: Ui.overviewOpen ? 1 : 0
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal } }

        MouseArea {
            anchors.fill: parent
            onClicked: Ui.overviewOpen = false
        }

        // Typing goes here; the field itself shows only once something is typed.
        TextInput {
            id: search
            width: 0
            height: 0
            opacity: 0
            function pick() {
                if (root.chosen && (root.picking || root.query !== ""))
                    root.focusWindow(root.chosen);
                else
                    Ui.overviewOpen = false;
            }
            Keys.onEscapePressed: {
                if (text !== "")
                    text = "";
                else
                    Ui.overviewOpen = false;
            }
            Keys.onReturnPressed: pick()
            Keys.onEnterPressed: pick()
            Keys.onTabPressed: root.step(1)
            Keys.onBacktabPressed: root.step(-1)
            Keys.onRightPressed: root.step(1)
            Keys.onLeftPressed: root.step(-1)
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            spacing: 28
            scale: Ui.overviewOpen ? 1 : 0.94
            Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo } }

            // The search, or the hint.
            Rectangle {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                implicitWidth: Math.max(260, searchRow.implicitWidth + 36)
                implicitHeight: 40
                radius: Theme.corner(20)
                color: Theme.glassStrong
                border.color: root.query !== "" ? Theme.accent : Theme.line
                RowLayout {
                    id: searchRow
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    spacing: 10
                    Glyph { text: "󰍉"; size: 15; color: root.query !== "" ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.dim }
                    Label {
                        text: search.text !== "" ? search.text : "Type to find a window"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                        color: search.text !== "" ? Theme.text : Theme.dim
                    }
                    Label {
                        visible: root.query !== ""
                        text: root.matches.length === 1 ? "1 window" : `${root.matches.length} windows`
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                        color: root.matches.length ? Theme.muted : Theme.rose
                    }
                }
            }

            GridLayout {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                columns: root.columns
                rowSpacing: 22
                columnSpacing: 22

                Repeater {
                    model: root.workspaces
                    delegate: ColumnLayout {
                        id: tile
                        required property int index
                        StaggerReveal { shown: Ui.overviewOpen; order: tile.index }
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property var workspace: modelData.workspace
                        readonly property var monitor: workspace?.monitor ?? Hyprland.focusedMonitor
                        readonly property bool turned: (monitor?.lastIpcObject?.transform ?? 0) % 2 === 1
                        // The screen's size in layout pixels, which window positions use too.
                        readonly property real screenWidth: (turned ? monitor?.height : monitor?.width) / (monitor?.scale || 1) || 1920
                        readonly property real screenHeight: (turned ? monitor?.width : monitor?.height) / (monitor?.scale || 1) || 1080
                        readonly property real fit: root.tileWidth / screenWidth
                        readonly property bool current: !!workspace && workspace.active && workspace.monitor?.name === root.screen?.name
                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
                        spacing: 8

                        Rectangle {
                            id: frame
                            Layout.preferredWidth: root.tileWidth
                            Layout.preferredHeight: tile.screenHeight * tile.fit
                            radius: Theme.radius
                            clip: true
                            color: drop.containsDrag ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.2) : Theme.alpha(Theme.base, 0.55)
                            border.width: tile.current || drop.containsDrag ? 2 : 1
                            border.color: tile.current || drop.containsDrag ? Theme.accent : Theme.line
                            Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

                            // The wallpaper behind the windows.
                            Image {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                source: Ui.fileUrl(Ui.wallpaperStill)
                                sourceSize.width: root.tileWidth * 2
                                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                asynchronous: true
                                opacity: 0.55
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: root.goTo(tile.modelData.id)
                            }
                            DropArea {
                                id: drop
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onDropped: drag => {
                                    if (drag.source?.toplevel && drag.source.toplevel.workspace?.id !== tile.modelData.id)
                                        root.moveWindow(drag.source.toplevel, tile.modelData.id);
                                }
                            }
                            Glyph {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                visible: !tile.workspace
                                text: "󰐕"
                                size: 26
                                color: drop.containsDrag ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.dim
                            }

                            Repeater {
                                model: tile.workspace?.toplevels.values ?? []
                                delegate: Item {
                                    id: win
                                    required property var modelData
                                    readonly property var info: modelData.lastIpcObject ?? {}
                                    readonly property bool hit: root.found(modelData)
                                    readonly property bool isChosen: root.chosen === modelData && (root.query !== "" || root.picking)
                                    x: ((info.at?.[0] ?? 0) - (tile.monitor?.x ?? 0)) * tile.fit
                                    y: ((info.at?.[1] ?? 0) - (tile.monitor?.y ?? 0)) * tile.fit
                                    width: Math.max(12, (info.size?.[0] ?? 0) * tile.fit)
                                    height: Math.max(12, (info.size?.[1] ?? 0) * tile.fit)
                                    // Floating windows over tiled ones, the most recently used on top.
                                    z: (info.floating ? 100 : 0) + 50 - (info.focusHistoryID ?? 0)
                                    opacity: hit ? (pressArea.dragging ? 0.35 : 1) : 0.22
                                    visible: !info.hidden
                                    Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

                                    ClippingRectangle {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        radius: Theme.corner(6)
                                        color: Theme.raised
                                        border.width: win.isChosen || pressArea.containsMouse ? 2 : 0
                                        border.color: Theme.accentBright
                                        ScreencopyView {
                                            anchors.fill: parent
                                            captureSource: root.visible ? win.modelData.wayland : null
                                            live: Ui.overviewOpen
                                            constraintSize: Qt.size(width, height)
                                        }
                                    }
                                    AppIcon {
                                        anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: Math.min(10, parent.height / 6) }
                                        implicitSize: Math.max(14, Math.min(32, Math.min(parent.width, parent.height) / 3))
                                        icon: root.entry(win.modelData)?.icon ?? ""
                                        asynchronous: true
                                    }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        id: pressArea
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        hoverEnabled: true
                                        cursorShape: dragging ? Qt.ClosedHandCursor : Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                        property point start
                                        property bool dragging: false
                                        onPressed: m => start = Qt.point(m.x, m.y)
                                        onPositionChanged: m => {
                                            if (!pressed)
                                                return;
                                            const p = mapToItem(backdrop, m.x, m.y);
                                            if (!dragging && Math.hypot(m.x - start.x, m.y - start.y) > 6) {
                                                dragging = true;
                                                ghost.toplevel = win.modelData;
                                                ghost.width = win.width;
                                                ghost.height = win.height;
                                                ghost.grab = start;
                                            }
                                            if (dragging) {
                                                ghost.x = p.x - ghost.grab.x;
                                                ghost.y = p.y - ghost.grab.y;
                                            }
                                        }
                                        onReleased: {
                                            if (dragging) {
                                                ghost.Drag.drop();
                                                ghost.toplevel = null;
                                                dragging = false;
                                            } else {
                                                root.focusWindow(win.modelData);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        onCanceled: { ghost.toplevel = null; dragging = false; }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        RowLayout {
                            Layout.preferredWidth: root.tileWidth
                            spacing: 8
                            Label {
                                text: tile.workspace ? tile.workspace.name : "New workspace"
                                font.weight: tile.current ? Font.Bold : Font.DemiBold
                                color: tile.current ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.textSoft
                            }
                            Label {
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                visible: !!tile.workspace
                                text: {
                                    const n = tile.workspace?.toplevels.values.length ?? 0;
                                    return n === 0 ? "Empty" : n === 1 ? "1 window" : `${n} windows`;
                                }
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                color: Theme.muted
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: "Click to go there · drag a window to move it · Tab and Enter pick a match · Esc to close"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.muted
            }
        }

        // The window being dragged, following the pointer over the tiles.
        Item {
            id: ghost
            property var toplevel: null
            property point grab
            visible: !!toplevel
            z: 10
            Drag.active: !!toplevel
            Drag.hotSpot.x: grab.x
            Drag.hotSpot.y: grab.y
            Drag.source: ghost
            ClippingRectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: Theme.corner(6)
                color: Theme.raised
                border.width: 2
                border.color: Theme.accent
                ScreencopyView {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    captureSource: ghost.toplevel?.wayland ?? null
                    live: true
                    constraintSize: Qt.size(width, height)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// Back arrow, title, optional status text and an on/off switch.
RowLayout {
    id: root

    property string title
    property string status
    property bool checked: false
    property bool showSwitch: true
    signal back()
    signal toggled()

    spacing: 10

    Rectangle {
        implicitWidth: 34
        implicitHeight: 34
        radius: Theme.corner(17)
        color: backArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
        border.color: Theme.line
        Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰁍"; size: 15; color: Theme.textSoft }
        MouseArea {
            id: backArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: root.back()
        }
    }
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: 0
        // fillWidth on the labels lets the column (and so the row) stretch to the switch.
        Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: root.title; font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge; font.weight: Font.DemiBold }
        Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; visible: text !== ""; text: root.status; font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall; color: Theme.muted }
    }
    Switch {
        visible: root.showSwitch
        checked: root.checked
        onToggled: root.toggled()
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Panel.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Wayland

// A glass sheet that grows from its bar capsule and closes on Escape or a click outside.
PanelWindow {
    id: panel

    property bool open: false
    property string originKey: ""
    // Screen-local bar coordinates also work for keyboard/IPC opens. Clamp to the sheet when
    // a capsule lies outside it; without a bar (startup), grow from its nearest upper corner.
    readonly property real originX: Math.max(0, Math.min(sheetWidth,
        (Ui.panelOrigins[screen?.name]?.[originKey] ?? (anchors.right ? screen?.width ?? sheetWidth : 0))
        - (anchors.right ? (screen?.width ?? implicitWidth) - margins.right - implicitWidth : margins.left)
        - shadowRoom))
    readonly property real attachedLeft: Math.max(Theme.edge, Math.min((screen?.width ?? 1920) - sheetWidth - Theme.edge,
        (Ui.panelOrigins[screen?.name]?.[originKey] ?? (screen?.width ?? 1920) / 2) - sheetWidth / 2))
    readonly property real edgeMargin: Settings.barStyle === "island"
        ? (anchors.right ? (screen?.width ?? 1920) - attachedLeft - sheetWidth : attachedLeft) : Theme.edge
    property real expansion: open ? 1 : 0
    Behavior on expansion {
        enabled: !Theme.reducedMotion
        SpringAnimation { spring: 4.5; damping: 0.82; epsilon: 0.001 }
    }
    property int preferredSheetWidth: 400
    readonly property int sheetWidth: Math.max(1, Math.min(preferredSheetWidth, (screen?.width ?? 1920) - 2 * Theme.edge))
    default property alias content: sheet.data
    property alias sheet: sheet
    // Items that see key presses before the sheet does (which closes on Escape).
    property list<Item> keyTargets
    signal dismissed()

    // Room around the sheet for its shadow; panels anchor with Theme.edge - shadowRoom, so the
    // sheet itself still sits Theme.edge from the screen's edge.
    readonly property int shadowRoom: Theme.edge

    screen: Ui.screen
    visible: open || sheet.opacity > 0
    color: "transparent"
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    implicitWidth: sheetWidth + 2 * shadowRoom
    // A fixed-height surface; only the sheet takes input, so it can grow and shrink smoothly.
    implicitHeight: (screen?.height ?? 1080) - margins.top - Theme.edge
    mask: Region { item: sheet }
    margins.top: Theme.barHeight + 10 + (Settings.barStyle === "floating" ? Theme.gap : 0) - shadowRoom
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Top
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-panel"
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: open ? WlrKeyboardFocus.OnDemand : WlrKeyboardFocus.None

    HyprlandFocusGrab {
        windows: [panel]
        active: panel.open
        onCleared: panel.dismissed()
    }

    // The material, rim and shadow share one transform, so their edges never separate.
    Item {
        id: surface
        x: panel.shadowRoom
        y: panel.shadowRoom
        width: panel.sheetWidth
        height: sheet.height
        transform: Scale {
            origin.x: panel.originX
            origin.y: -Theme.gap - Theme.barHeight / 2
            xScale: 0.86 + 0.14 * panel.expansion
            yScale: xScale
        }

        Rectangle {
            visible: Settings.barStyle !== "floating"
            x: Math.max(0, Math.min(parent.width - width, panel.originX - width / 2))
            y: -12
            width: Math.min(parent.width, 100)
            height: 24
            color: Theme.panel
            opacity: sheet.opacity
        }
        Shadow { target: sheet }
        Rectangle {
            id: sheet
            width: panel.sheetWidth
            // Content sits at x/y = 18; keep the same padding below it.
            implicitHeight: childrenRect.y + childrenRect.height + Theme.padding
            height: implicitHeight
            clip: true
            radius: Theme.corner(Theme.barHeight / 2 + (22 - Theme.barHeight / 2) * panel.expansion)
            color: Theme.panel
            border.color: Theme.line
            opacity: panel.open ? 1 : 0
            focus: panel.open
            Keys.forwardTo: panel.keyTargets
            Keys.onEscapePressed: panel.dismissed()
            Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
            Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
        }
        // Outside the sheet so it doesn't count toward the content height.
        GlassEdge {
            anchors.fill: sheet
            radius: sheet.radius
            opacity: sheet.opacity
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
        hoverEnabled: true
        enabled: root.available
        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/PolkitDialog.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Services.Polkit
import Quickshell.Wayland

// The polkit agent: when an app asks for administrator rights, a password card over the dimmed screen.
// When the system's polkit stack asks for a finger first (install.sh adds pam_fprintd to it once
// fprintd is installed), a fingerprint glyph pulses; a password typed meanwhile goes in as soon as
// the stack asks for it.
Scope {
    id: root

    readonly property var flow: agent.flow
    property bool shown: false
    property string error: ""
    // The fingerprint reader is waiting: pam_fprintd said so and nothing is asked for yet.
    readonly property bool fingerWaiting: !!flow && !flow.isResponseRequired && !flow.isCompleted
        && /finger|swipe/i.test(flow.supplementaryMessage ?? "") && !flow.supplementaryIsError
    // A password typed while the reader waited.
    property string queued: ""

    PolkitAgent {
        id: agent
        onAuthenticationRequestStarted: {
            root.error = "";
            root.shown = true;
        }
    }
    Connections {
        target: root.flow
        ignoreUnknownSignals: true
        function onAuthenticationFailed() {
            root.error = "Wrong password";
            shake.restart();
        }
        function onIsCompletedChanged() {
            if (root.flow?.isCompleted)
                root.shown = false;
        }
    }
    onFlowChanged: {
        input.text = "";
        queued = "";
        if (!flow)
            shown = false;
    }
    Connections {
        target: root.flow
        ignoreUnknownSignals: true
        function onIsResponseRequiredChanged() {
            if (root.flow?.isResponseRequired && root.queued !== "") {
                root.flow.submit(root.queued);
                root.queued = "";
            }
        }
    }

    function submit() {
        if (flow && flow.isResponseRequired) {
            error = "";
            flow.submit(input.text);
            input.text = "";
        } else if (fingerWaiting && input.text !== "") {
            queued = input.text;
            input.text = "";
        }
    }
    function cancel() {
        flow?.cancelAuthenticationRequest();
        shown = false;
    }

    PanelWindow {
        screen: Ui.screen
        anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
        exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
        visible: root.shown || card.opacity > 0
        color: "transparent"
        WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
        WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-polkit"
        WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: root.shown ? WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive : WlrKeyboardFocus.None

        Rectangle {
            anchors.fill: parent
            color: Theme.alpha(Theme.scrim, 0.62)
            opacity: card.opacity
        }

        Shadow { target: card }
        Rectangle {
            id: card
            width: 420
            height: column.implicitHeight + 48
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            radius: Theme.radiusLarge
            color: Theme.glassStrong
            border.color: Theme.lineStrong
            opacity: root.shown ? 1 : 0
            scale: root.shown ? 1 : 0.94
            Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal } }
            Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo } }

            GlassEdge { radius: card.radius }

            SequentialAnimation {
                id: shake
                NumberAnimation { target: card; property: "anchors.horizontalCenterOffset"; to: 14; duration: 50 * Theme.motion }
                NumberAnimation { target: card; property: "anchors.horizontalCenterOffset"; to: -12; duration: 70 * Theme.motion }
                NumberAnimation { target: card; property: "anchors.horizontalCenterOffset"; to: 8; duration: 60 * Theme.motion }
                NumberAnimation { target: card; property: "anchors.horizontalCenterOffset"; to: 0; duration: 60 * Theme.motion }
            }

            ColumnLayout {
                id: column
                x: 24
                y: 24
                width: parent.width - 48
                spacing: 14

                RowLayout {
                    spacing: 14
                    Rectangle {
                        implicitWidth: 48
                        implicitHeight: 48
                        radius: Theme.corner(24)
                        gradient: Gradient {
                            GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accent }
                            GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.accentDeep }
                        }
                        Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰒃"; size: 22; color: Theme.accentInk }
                    }
                    ColumnLayout {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 2
                        Label {
                            text: "A U T H E N T I C A T E"
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                            color: Theme.accent
                        }
                        Label {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            text: "Administrator rights needed"
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        }
                    }
                }

                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.flow?.message ?? ""
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    color: Theme.textSoft
                }
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: text !== ""
                    text: root.flow?.actionId ?? ""
                    font.family: Theme.mono
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                    color: Theme.dim
                }

                Rectangle {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.topMargin: 4
                    implicitHeight: 48
                    radius: Theme.corner(24)
                    color: Theme.raised
                    border.width: input.activeFocus ? 2 : 1
                    border.color: root.error ? Theme.rose : input.activeFocus ? Theme.accent : Theme.lineStrong
                    Behavior on border.color { ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

                    TextInput {
                        id: input
                        anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 20; rightMargin: 44 }
                        verticalAlignment: TextInput.AlignVCenter
                        echoMode: root.flow?.responseVisible ? TextInput.Normal : TextInput.Password
                        passwordCharacter: "•"
                        color: Theme.text
                        font.family: Theme.sans
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                        font.letterSpacing: echoMode === TextInput.Password ? 2 : 0
                        selectionColor: Theme.accentDeep
                        enabled: !!root.flow?.isResponseRequired || root.fingerWaiting
                        focus: root.shown
                        onVisibleChanged: if (visible) forceActiveFocus()
                        Keys.onReturnPressed: root.submit()
                        Keys.onEnterPressed: root.submit()
                        Keys.onEscapePressed: root.cancel()
                        Label {
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            visible: !input.text
                            text: (root.flow?.inputPrompt ?? "").replace(/:\s*$/, "") || "Password"
                            color: Theme.dim
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                        }
                    }
                    Glyph {
                        property real pulse: 1
                        anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 18; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                        text: root.fingerWaiting ? "󰈷" : root.flow?.isResponseRequired === false ? "󰔟" : "󰌆"
                        size: root.fingerWaiting ? 18 : 15
                        color: root.fingerWaiting ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.dim
                        opacity: root.fingerWaiting ? pulse : 1
                        SequentialAnimation on pulse {
                            running: root.fingerWaiting && !Theme.reducedMotion
                            loops: Animation.Infinite
                            NumberAnimation { to: 0.35; duration: 900; easing.type: Easing.InOutSine }
                            NumberAnimation { to: 1; duration: 900; easing.type: Easing.InOutSine }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: text !== ""
                    text: root.error || (root.queued !== "" ? "Your password goes in once the reader gives up" : root.fingerWaiting ? "Touch the fingerprint reader, or type your password" : root.flow?.supplementaryMessage ?? "")
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                    color: root.error || root.flow?.supplementaryIsError ? Theme.rose : Theme.muted
                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.topMargin: 4
                    spacing: 8
                    Item { Layout.fillWidth: true }
                    PillButton {
                        text: "Cancel"
                        implicitHeight: 36
                        implicitWidth: 96
                        onClicked: root.cancel()
                    }
                    PillButton {
                        text: "Authenticate"
                        primary: true
                        implicitHeight: 36
                        implicitWidth: 124
                        available: !!root.flow?.isResponseRequired || root.fingerWaiting && input.text !== ""
                        onClicked: root.submit()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Recorder.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Screen recordings and capture countdowns. penumbra-record does the recording and keeps it in
// $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/penumbra/recording ("started-at\nfile\npaused"; the start moves on by the time
// spent paused), so a recording outlives the shell; the bar shows it from there. A capture with a
// timer counts down here first, shown in the bar too.
Singleton {
    id: root

    property bool recording: false
    property real startedAt: 0 // seconds since the epoch
    property string file: ""
    property bool paused: false
    property int elapsed: 0 // seconds
    readonly property string elapsedText: `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60)}:${String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`

    function refresh() {
        state.reload();
    }
    function stop() {
        Quickshell.execDetached([Ui.bin + "penumbra-record", "stop"]);
    }
    function togglePause() {
        Quickshell.execDetached([Ui.bin + "penumbra-record", paused ? "resume" : "pause"]);
    }

    FileView {
        id: state
        path: (Quickshell.env("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR") || "/tmp") + "/penumbra/recording"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onLoaded: {
            const [started, file, paused] = text().split("\n");
            root.startedAt = Number(started) || 0;
            root.file = file ?? "";
            root.paused = paused === "paused";
            root.recording = root.startedAt > 0;
        }
        onLoadFailed: { root.recording = false; root.paused = false; }
    }
    Timer {
        interval: 1000
        repeat: true
        running: root.recording && !root.paused
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: root.elapsed = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000 - root.startedAt))
    }

    // Run `command` after `delay` seconds of countdown. The countdown leaves the bar a moment before
    // the command runs, so a screenshot of the bar doesn't show it.
    property int countdown: 0
    property var pending: []
    function after(delay, command) {
        pending = command;
        countdown = delay;
        if (delay > 0)
            tick.restart();
        else
            go.restart();
    }
    function cancel() {
        tick.stop();
        countdown = 0;
        pending = [];
    }
    Timer {
        id: tick
        interval: 1000
        repeat: true
        onTriggered: {
            root.countdown -= 1;
            if (root.countdown <= 0) {
                tick.stop();
                go.restart();
            }
        }
    }
    // Also lets the compositor draw a frame without the overlay before the capture starts.
    Timer {
        id: go
        interval: 90
        onTriggered: {
            if (root.pending.length)
                Ui.spawn(root.pending);
            root.pending = [];
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/SceneLayer.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick

// One pre-rendered layer of a scene, placed where tools/build-wallpapers.py cropped it.
// `angle` turns it and `zoom` scales it around `pivot`, in scene coordinates.
Image {
    id: root
    required property WallpaperScene scene
    required property string name
    readonly property var info: scene.layers.find(layer => layer.name === name)
    property point pivot: Qt.point(info.x + info.width / 2, info.y + info.height / 2)
    property real angle: 0
    property real zoom: 1

    x: info.x
    y: info.y
    width: info.width
    height: info.height
    source: scene.folder + "/" + name + ".png"
    sourceSize: Qt.size(Math.ceil(info.width * scene.pixelScale), Math.ceil(info.height * scene.pixelScale))
    smooth: true
    transform: [
        Scale {
            origin.x: root.pivot.x - root.x
            origin.y: root.pivot.y - root.y
            xScale: root.zoom
            yScale: root.zoom
        },
        Rotation {
            origin.x: root.pivot.x - root.x
            origin.y: root.pivot.y - root.y
            angle: root.angle
        }
    ]
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick

import Quickshell.Wayland

// A click-through bezel on every output. The inner cutout forms concave joins below the bar;
// it hides for fullscreen windows. It reserves no space beyond the bar's existing exclusive zone.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    required property var modelData
    screen: modelData
    visible: (Settings.screenFrame || Settings.barStyle === "framed") && !(Hyprland.monitorFor(screen)?.activeWorkspace?.hasFullscreen ?? false)
    anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    color: "transparent"
    mask: Region {}
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Top
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "screen-frame"
    FrameSurface { anchors.fill: parent }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/ScreenshotOverlay.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Wayland

// Print: the screen freezes; drag a region, click a window or click for the whole screen, or (with
// several screens) take them all at once, or move the overlay to another screen with Tab.
// The overlay then steps aside (no closing animation) and penumbra-shot captures the area, or
// penumbra-record records it (Video); a timer counts down in the bar first.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    // The focused screen when it opens; Tab moves it to the next one.
    property var shotScreen: Ui.screen
    screen: shotScreen
    anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    visible: Ui.shotOpen
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-shot"
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: Ui.shotOpen ? WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive : WlrKeyboardFocus.None

    property string mode: "region" // region, window, screen, or all (every screen; not for video)
    property bool annotate: false
    property bool record: false
    property bool sound: false // kept between recordings
    readonly property bool several: Quickshell.screens.length > 1
    property int delay: 0 // seconds
    readonly property var delays: [0, 3, 5, 10]
    property rect selection: Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)
    property point origin
    property bool dragging: false
    property var hovered: null // window geometry under the pointer, in window mode

    readonly property var monitor: Hyprland.monitorFor(screen)
    // Windows on this screen's workspace in local coordinates, floating ones first (they're on top).
    readonly property var windows: (monitor?.activeWorkspace?.toplevels.values ?? [])
        .filter(t => t.lastIpcObject?.size)
        .sort((a, b) => (b.lastIpcObject.floating ?? false) - (a.lastIpcObject.floating ?? false))
        .map(t => ({
            title: t.title,
            rect: Qt.rect(t.lastIpcObject.at[0] - monitor.x, t.lastIpcObject.at[1] - monitor.y, t.lastIpcObject.size[0], t.lastIpcObject.size[1])
        }))
    // What gets captured if the user confirms now.
    readonly property rect target: mode === "screen" || mode === "all" ? Qt.rect(0, 0, width, height)
        : mode === "window" ? (hovered?.rect ?? Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)) : selection

    function open(withAnnotate, withRecord) {
        Ui.openShot();
        annotate = withAnnotate;
        record = withRecord;
    }
    function nextScreen() {
        const all = Quickshell.screens;
        shotScreen = all[(all.indexOf(shotScreen) + 1) % all.length];
        selection = Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
        hovered = null;
    }
    function nextDelay() {
        delay = delays[(delays.indexOf(delay) + 1) % delays.length];
    }
    // Start fresh however it opens (Print, or the control center's tile).
    Connections {
        target: Ui
        function onShotOpenChanged() {
            if (!Ui.shotOpen)
                return;
            Hyprland.refreshToplevels();
            root.shotScreen = Ui.screen;
            root.annotate = false;
            root.record = false;
            root.delay = 0;
            root.mode = "region";
            root.selection = Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
            root.hovered = null;
            root.dragging = false;
        }
    }
    function capture() {
        const r = target;
        if (r.width < 4 || r.height < 4)
            return;
        const geometry = `${Math.round(r.x + monitor.x)},${Math.round(r.y + monitor.y)} ${Math.round(r.width)}x${Math.round(r.height)}`;
        const area = mode === "all" && !record ? ["--all"] : ["--geometry", geometry];
        Ui.shotOpen = false;
        Recorder.after(delay, record
            ? [Ui.bin + "penumbra-record", "start", "--geometry", geometry, ...(sound ? ["--sound"] : []), ...(Settings.recordMicrophone ? ["--microphone"] : [])]
            : [Ui.bin + "penumbra-shot", ...(annotate ? ["annotate"] : []), ...area]);
    }
    function windowAt(x, y) {
        return windows.find(w => x >= w.rect.x && x < w.rect.x + w.rect.width && y >= w.rect.y && y < w.rect.y + w.rect.height) ?? null;
    }

    // The frozen frame, taken once as the overlay opens.
    ScreencopyView {
        id: frame
        anchors.fill: parent
        captureSource: Ui.shotOpen ? root.screen : null
        live: false
    }

    Item {
        id: content
        anchors.fill: parent
        visible: frame.hasContent
        focus: Ui.shotOpen
        Keys.onPressed: event => {
            if (event.key === Qt.Key_Escape)
                Ui.shotOpen = false;
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_R)
                root.mode = "region";
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_W)
                root.mode = "window";
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_S)
                root.mode = "screen";
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_D && root.several && !root.record)
                root.mode = "all";
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Tab && root.several)
                root.nextScreen();
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_M && root.record)
                Settings.recordMicrophone = !Settings.recordMicrophone;
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_E && !root.record)
                root.annotate = !root.annotate;
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_V) {
                root.record = !root.record;
                if (root.record && root.mode === "all")
                    root.mode = "screen";
            }
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_A && root.record)
                root.sound = !root.sound;
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_T)
                root.nextDelay();
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_Return || event.key === Qt.Key_Enter)
                root.capture();
            else
                return;
            event.accepted = true;
        }

        // Dim everything but the target: above, below, left and right of it.
        component Shade: Rectangle {
            color: Theme.alpha(Theme.scrim, 0.5)
        }
        Shade { width: root.width; height: Math.max(0, root.target.y) }
        Shade {
            y: root.target.y + root.target.height
            width: root.width
            height: Math.max(0, root.height - y)
        }
        Shade {
            y: root.target.y
            width: Math.max(0, root.target.x)
            height: root.target.height
        }
        Shade {
            x: root.target.x + root.target.width
            y: root.target.y
            width: Math.max(0, root.width - x)
            height: root.target.height
        }
        Rectangle {
            visible: root.target.width > 0 && root.target.height > 0 && root.mode !== "screen"
            x: root.target.x - 2
            y: root.target.y - 2
            width: root.target.width + 4
            height: root.target.height + 4
            color: "transparent"
            radius: Theme.corner(4)
            border.width: 2
            border.color: root.record ? Theme.rose : Theme.accent
            Rectangle {
                anchors { left: parent.left; top: parent.bottom; topMargin: 8 }
                visible: parent.width > 60
                implicitWidth: size.implicitWidth + 16
                implicitHeight: 22
                radius: Theme.corner(11)
                color: Theme.glassStrong
                Label {
                    id: size
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    text: `${Math.round(root.target.width)} × ${Math.round(root.target.height)}`
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                    color: Theme.textSoft
                }
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            anchors.fill: parent
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: root.mode === "region" ? Qt.CrossCursor : Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onPressed: m => {
                if (root.mode !== "region")
                    return;
                root.origin = Qt.point(m.x, m.y);
                root.selection = Qt.rect(m.x, m.y, 0, 0);
                root.dragging = true;
            }
            onPositionChanged: m => {
                if (root.mode === "window")
                    root.hovered = root.windowAt(m.x, m.y);
                else if (root.dragging)
                    root.selection = Qt.rect(Math.min(m.x, root.origin.x), Math.min(m.y, root.origin.y),
                        Math.abs(m.x - root.origin.x), Math.abs(m.y - root.origin.y));
            }
            onReleased: {
                const wasDragging = root.dragging;
                root.dragging = false;
                if (root.mode !== "region" || wasDragging)
                    root.capture();
            }
        }

        // A toggle on the toolbar, lit in `tint` while on.
        component Chip: Rectangle {
            id: chip
            property string glyph
            property string text
            property bool on: false
            property color tint: Theme.accent
            signal clicked()
            implicitWidth: chipRow.implicitWidth + 24
            implicitHeight: 38
            radius: Theme.corner(19)
            color: on ? Theme.alpha(tint, 0.2) : chipArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
            border.color: on ? tint : "transparent"
            Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
            RowLayout {
                id: chipRow
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                spacing: 7
                Glyph { text: chip.glyph; size: 15; color: chip.on ? chip.tint : Theme.textSoft }
                Label { text: chip.text; color: chip.on ? chip.tint : Theme.text }
            }
            MouseArea {
                id: chipArea
                anchors.fill: parent
                hoverEnabled: true
                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                onClicked: chip.clicked()
            }
        }

        // Mode and after-capture choices.
        Rectangle {
            id: toolbar
            anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 48 }
            visible: !root.dragging
            implicitWidth: tools.implicitWidth + 16
            implicitHeight: 52
            radius: Theme.corner(26)
            color: Theme.glassStrong
            border.color: Theme.lineStrong

            // Clicks between the buttons stay on the toolbar.
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

            RowLayout {
                id: tools
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                spacing: 6
                Repeater {
                    model: [
                        { mode: "region", glyph: "󰆞", label: "Region", key: "R" },
                        { mode: "window", glyph: "󰖯", label: "Window", key: "W" },
                        { mode: "screen", glyph: "󰍹", label: "Screen", key: "S" },
                        // wf-recorder records one screen, so video leaves this out.
                        ...(root.several && !root.record ? [{ mode: "all", glyph: "󰍺", label: "All screens", key: "D" }] : [])
                    ]
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        required property var modelData
                        readonly property bool current: root.mode === modelData.mode
                        implicitWidth: toolRow.implicitWidth + 24
                        implicitHeight: 38
                        radius: Theme.corner(19)
                        color: current ? Theme.accent : toolArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                        Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                        RowLayout {
                            id: toolRow
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            spacing: 7
                            Glyph { text: modelData.glyph; size: 15; color: current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft }
                            Label { text: modelData.label; font.weight: Font.DemiBold; color: current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text }
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: toolArea
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: { root.mode = modelData.mode; root.hovered = null; }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    Layout.leftMargin: 4
                    Layout.rightMargin: 4
                    implicitWidth: 1
                    implicitHeight: 24
                    color: Theme.line
                }
                Chip {
                    glyph: "󰕧"
                    text: "Video"
                    on: root.record
                    tint: Theme.rose
                    onClicked: {
                        root.record = !root.record;
                        if (root.record && root.mode === "all")
                            root.mode = "screen";
                    }
                }
                Chip {
                    visible: !root.record
                    glyph: "󰏫"
                    text: "Annotate"
                    on: root.annotate
                    onClicked: root.annotate = !root.annotate
                }
                Chip {
                    visible: root.record
                    glyph: root.sound ? "󰕾" : "󰖁"
                    text: "Sound"
                    on: root.sound
                    tint: Theme.rose
                    onClicked: root.sound = !root.sound
                }
                Chip {
                    visible: root.record
                    glyph: Settings.recordMicrophone ? "󰍬" : "󰍭"
                    text: "Microphone"
                    on: Settings.recordMicrophone
                    tint: Theme.rose
                    onClicked: Settings.recordMicrophone = !Settings.recordMicrophone
                }
                Chip {
                    visible: root.several
                    glyph: "󰍺"
                    text: root.screen?.name ?? "Screen"
                    onClicked: root.nextScreen()
                }
                Chip {
                    glyph: "󰔛"
                    text: root.delay ? `${root.delay} s` : "Timer"
                    on: root.delay > 0
                    onClicked: root.nextDelay()
                }
                Rectangle {
                    implicitWidth: 38
                    implicitHeight: 38
                    radius: Theme.corner(19)
                    color: closeArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                    Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰅖"; size: 15; color: Theme.textSoft }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: closeArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: Ui.shotOpen = false
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Label {
            anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: toolbar.top; bottomMargin: 12 }
            visible: !root.dragging
            text: (root.mode === "region" ? "Drag to select" : root.mode === "window" ? "Click a window"
                    : root.mode === "all" ? "Click or press Enter for every screen" : "Click or press Enter for the whole screen")
                + (root.several ? " · Tab for the next screen" : "")
                + (root.record ? " · records until you click the bar's red capsule or press Ctrl+Print"
                    : root.annotate ? " · opens in Satty" : " · saved and copied")
                + (root.delay ? ` · starts after ${root.delay} s` : "") + " · Esc to cancel"
            font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
            color: Theme.textSoft
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Segmented.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// A row of choices with the current one lit: power profiles, night light's schedule.
Rectangle {
    id: root

    // [{ value, title, glyph (optional), available (optional, default true) }]
    property var options: []
    property var current
    signal chosen(var value)

    implicitHeight: Math.max(44, Theme.textSmall + 28)
    radius: Theme.radius
    color: Theme.control
    border.color: Theme.line

    RowLayout {
        anchors { fill: parent; margins: 4 }
        spacing: 4
        Repeater {
            model: root.options
            delegate: Rectangle {
                id: segment
                required property var modelData
                readonly property bool current: root.current === modelData.value
                readonly property bool available: modelData.available ?? true
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.fillHeight: true
                Layout.preferredWidth: 1 // equal shares
                radius: Theme.corner(Theme.radius - 4)
                color: current ? Theme.accent : segmentArea.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                border.color: current ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accentBright, 0.55) : "transparent"
                opacity: available ? 1 : 0.45
                Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                RowLayout {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: Math.min(implicitWidth, parent.width - 8)
                    spacing: 6
                    Glyph {
                        visible: !!segment.modelData.glyph
                        text: segment.modelData.glyph ?? ""
                        size: 14
                        color: segment.current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft
                    }
                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: segment.modelData.title
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                        font.weight: segment.current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                        color: segment.current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft
                    }
                }
                MouseArea {
                    id: segmentArea
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    hoverEnabled: true
                    enabled: segment.available && !segment.current
                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                    onClicked: root.chosen(segment.modelData.value)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/SessionMenu.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland

// Full-screen session overlay. Destructive choices need a second press to confirm.
PanelWindow {
    id: root
    screen: Ui.screen
    anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    visible: Ui.sessionOpen || backdrop.opacity > 0
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "penumbra-session"
    WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: Ui.sessionOpen ? WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive : WlrKeyboardFocus.None

    readonly property var entries: [
        { glyph: "󰌾", label: "Lock", command: "loginctl lock-session" },
        { glyph: "󰤄", label: "Suspend", command: "systemctl suspend" },
        // Windows are asked to close first, so apps can save or ask about unsaved work (penumbra-exit).
        { glyph: "󰍃", label: "Log out", command: Ui.bin + "penumbra-exit logout", confirm: true },
        { glyph: "󰜉", label: "Restart", command: Ui.bin + "penumbra-exit reboot", confirm: true },
        { glyph: "󰐥", label: "Shut down", command: Ui.bin + "penumbra-exit poweroff", confirm: true }
    ]
    property int selected: 0
    property int armed: -1

    Connections {
        target: Ui
        function onSessionOpenChanged() {
            root.selected = 0;
            root.armed = -1;
        }
    }

    function choose(index) {
        const entry = entries[index];
        if (entry.confirm && armed !== index) {
            armed = index;
            selected = index;
            return;
        }
        Ui.sessionOpen = false;
        Ui.run(entry.command);
    }

    Rectangle {
        id: backdrop
        anchors.fill: parent
        color: Theme.alpha(Theme.scrim, 0.62)
        opacity: Ui.sessionOpen ? 1 : 0
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal } }

        focus: Ui.sessionOpen
        Keys.onEscapePressed: Ui.sessionOpen = false
        Keys.onLeftPressed: { root.selected = (root.selected + root.entries.length - 1) % root.entries.length; root.armed = -1; }
        Keys.onRightPressed: { root.selected = (root.selected + 1) % root.entries.length; root.armed = -1; }
        Keys.onTabPressed: { root.selected = (root.selected + 1) % root.entries.length; root.armed = -1; }
        Keys.onReturnPressed: root.choose(root.selected)
        Keys.onEnterPressed: root.choose(root.selected)
        Keys.onSpacePressed: root.choose(root.selected)

        MouseArea {
            anchors.fill: parent
            onClicked: Ui.sessionOpen = false
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            spacing: 26
            scale: Ui.sessionOpen ? 1 : 0.94
            Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.slow; easing.type: Easing.OutExpo } }

            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: "S E S S I O N"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                color: Theme.accent
            }

            RowLayout {
                spacing: 14
                Repeater {
                    model: root.entries
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        id: tile
                        required property var modelData
                        required property int index
                        readonly property bool current: root.selected === index
                        readonly property bool isArmed: root.armed === index
                        implicitWidth: 132
                        implicitHeight: 140
                        radius: Theme.radiusLarge
                        color: isArmed ? Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.22) : current ? Theme.raised : Theme.glassStrong
                        border.width: current ? 2 : 1
                        border.color: isArmed ? Theme.rose : current ? Theme.accent : Theme.line
                        scale: current ? 1.04 : 1
                        Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
                        Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

                        CardLight { radius: tile.radius; pointer: Qt.point(tileMouse.mouseX, tileMouse.mouseY); hovered: tileMouse.containsMouse }
                        ColumnLayout {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            spacing: 12
                            Glyph {
                                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                                text: tile.modelData.glyph
                                size: 34
                                color: tile.isArmed ? Theme.rose : tile.current ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.textSoft
                            }
                            Label {
                                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                                text: tile.isArmed ? "Confirm" : tile.modelData.label
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.textMedium
                                font.weight: tile.current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                                color: tile.isArmed ? Theme.rose : Theme.text
                            }
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            id: tileMouse
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            hoverEnabled: true
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onEntered: if (root.armed !== tile.index) { root.selected = tile.index; root.armed = -1; }
                            onClicked: root.choose(tile.index)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Label {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: root.armed >= 0 ? `Press again to ${root.entries[root.armed].label.toLowerCase()} · Esc to cancel` : "← → to choose · Enter to select · Esc to close"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: root.armed >= 0 ? Theme.rose : Theme.muted
            }
        }
    }
}
```
