## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Settings.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Shell preferences from the settings page, kept in ~/.config/penumbra/shell.json. The corner
// style is penumbra-corners' instead (see Theme), since Hyprland and other apps follow it too.
Singleton {
    property alias animatedWallpapers: adapter.animatedWallpapers
    // Animated wallpapers hold still while tiled windows hide them, and on battery or in power saver.
    property alias stillWhenCovered: adapter.stillWhenCovered
    property alias stillOnBattery: adapter.stillOnBattery
    // Optional desktop depth and a frame joined to the bar.
    property alias desktopClock: adapter.desktopClock
    property alias desktopAura: adapter.desktopAura
    property alias barStyle: adapter.barStyle
    property alias workspaceStyle: adapter.workspaceStyle
    property alias osdPosition: adapter.osdPosition
    property alias glassFrost: adapter.glassFrost
    property alias weatherInBar: adapter.weatherInBar
    property alias screenFrame: adapter.screenFrame
    property alias weatherEnabled: adapter.weatherEnabled
    property alias weatherPlace: adapter.weatherPlace
    property alias dockMode: adapter.dockMode
    property alias dockPins: adapter.dockPins
    property alias hotCorner: adapter.hotCorner
    // Night light: its warmth in kelvin, and when it comes on (see NightLight).
    property alias nightTemperature: adapter.nightTemperature
    property alias nightSchedule: adapter.nightSchedule // manual, times or sun
    property alias nightFrom: adapter.nightFrom
    property alias nightTo: adapter.nightTo
    property alias nightPlace: adapter.nightPlace // a city or "latitude, longitude"; empty: the time zone's
    property alias nightOn: adapter.nightOn // the last toggle by hand, restored on start in manual mode
    // Casting: whether the TV also plays what the computer plays, and a fixed port for the stream
    // (0: any free one), so a firewall rule can let the TV in.
    property alias castSound: adapter.castSound
    property alias castPort: adapter.castPort
    // Accessibility: no animations anywhere (shell, wallpapers, Hyprland), and larger text.
    property alias reducedMotion: adapter.reducedMotion
    property alias textScale: adapter.textScale
    // Do not disturb: on a schedule, while recording or casting, while a window is fullscreen.
    property alias dndSchedule: adapter.dndSchedule
    property alias dndFrom: adapter.dndFrom
    property alias dndTo: adapter.dndTo
    property alias dndWhileSharing: adapter.dndWhileSharing
    property alias dndFullscreen: adapter.dndFullscreen
    // A sound for new notifications (not for low urgency).
    property alias notificationSounds: adapter.notificationSounds
    // Per app: { "App name": "silent" (history only) | "mute" (dropped) | "keep" (never expires) }.
    property alias notificationRules: adapter.notificationRules
    // Clipboard: pinned texts, which "Clear history" keeps, and days the history keeps (0: always).
    property alias clipboardPins: adapter.clipboardPins
    property alias clipboardDays: adapter.clipboardDays
    // Recording: the microphone along with (or instead of) what the computer plays.
    property alias recordMicrophone: adapter.recordMicrophone
    // The lock screen shows how many notifications came in, never what they say.
    property alias lockNotificationCount: adapter.lockNotificationCount
    // Window classes (or app ids) that keep the screen awake while open, like a video call.
    property alias idleInhibitApps: adapter.idleInhibitApps
    property alias calendarWeekNumbers: adapter.calendarWeekNumbers
    // Stop charging at this percentage where the battery supports it (100: off).
    property alias batteryLimit: adapter.batteryLimit

    // hyprland.lua reads it at start; a change applies to the running Hyprland at once.
    onReducedMotionChanged: Quickshell.execDetached(["hyprctl", "eval", `hl.config({animations = {enabled = ${!reducedMotion}}})`])

    function signatureComposition() {
        barStyle = "floating";
        workspaceStyle = "pills";
        osdPosition = "bottom";
        screenFrame = false;
        desktopClock = false;
        desktopAura = false;
        weatherInBar = false;
        dockMode = "off";
        glassFrost = 0;
    }

    function setRule(app, rule) {
        const rules = Object.assign({}, notificationRules);
        if (rule === "" || rule === "normal")
            delete rules[app];
        else
            rules[app] = rule;
        notificationRules = rules;
    }

    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.config/penumbra/shell.json"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onAdapterUpdated: writeAdapter()
        // The first run has no file yet: write the defaults.
        onLoadFailed: error => {
            if (error === FileViewError.FileNotFound)
                writeAdapter();
        }

        JsonAdapter {
            id: adapter
            property bool animatedWallpapers: true
            property bool stillWhenCovered: true
            property bool stillOnBattery: true
            property bool desktopClock: false
            property bool desktopAura: false
            property string barStyle: "floating"
            property string workspaceStyle: "pills"
            property string osdPosition: "bottom"
            property real glassFrost: 0
            property bool weatherInBar: false
            property bool screenFrame: false
            property bool weatherEnabled: false
            // null preserves the old shared location until a weather location is chosen;
            // an empty string explicitly uses the computer's time zone.
            property var weatherPlace: null
            property string dockMode: "off" // off, auto, empty
            property var dockPins: ["firefox", "kitty", "org.kde.dolphin"]
            property bool hotCorner: true
            property int nightTemperature: 4500
            property string nightSchedule: "manual"
            property string nightFrom: "21:00"
            property string nightTo: "07:00"
            property string nightPlace: ""
            property bool nightOn: false
            property bool castSound: true
            property int castPort: 0
            property bool reducedMotion: false
            property real textScale: 1
            property bool dndSchedule: false
            property string dndFrom: "22:00"
            property string dndTo: "07:00"
            property bool dndWhileSharing: true
            property bool dndFullscreen: false
            property bool notificationSounds: false
            property var notificationRules: ({})
            property var clipboardPins: []
            property int clipboardDays: 0
            property bool recordMicrophone: false
            property bool lockNotificationCount: true
            property var idleInhibitApps: []
            property bool calendarWeekNumbers: false
            property int batteryLimit: 100
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/SettingsPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Settings: the look, screens, keyboard, idle timings, default apps and notifications (each a page
// of its own), the wallpaper, accessibility, battery care, the clipboard and a few shell
// behaviours. Typing in the search field finds any of them, on this page or another.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    spacing: 12
    onVisibleChanged: if (visible) { Config.loadLayouts(); findExport.running = true; }
    Component.onCompleted: { Config.loadLayouts(); findExport.running = true; }

    component Section: Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
    }

    // What search finds: a page to open (page), or a row of this page (page: "settings").
    readonly property var index: [
        { page: "notes", glyph: "󰎞", title: "Quick notes", words: "notes draft text writing local sidebar" },
        { page: "look", glyph: "󰏘", title: "Look", words: "theme dark light auto colours colors accent hue vividness corners rounded sharp harmonize depth clock audio aura screen frame bezel" },
        { page: "displays", glyph: "󰍹", title: "Displays", words: "monitors screens resolution refresh rate scale rotation arrangement" },
        { page: "keyboard", glyph: "󰌌", title: "Keyboard", words: "layout variant options num lock xkb" },
        { page: "idle", glyph: "󰒲", title: "Idle and sleep", words: "dim lock screens off suspend timeout stay awake apps inhibit video calls" },
        { page: "apps", glyph: "󰀻", title: "Default apps", words: "browser file manager terminal" },
        { page: "notifications", glyph: "󰂚", title: "Notifications", words: "do not disturb dnd schedule fullscreen sharing sounds lock screen count mute quiet keep rules" },
        { page: "night", glyph: "󰖔", title: "Night light", words: "warmth temperature kelvin sunset sunrise schedule hyprsunset" },
        { page: "weather", glyph: "󰖐", title: "Weather", words: "location city coordinates forecast temperature calendar clock bar" },
        { page: "wifi", glyph: "󰤨", title: "Wi-Fi", words: "wireless network internet" },
        { page: "bluetooth", glyph: "󰂯", title: "Bluetooth", words: "devices headphones mouse pair battery" },
        { page: "mixer", glyph: "󰕾", title: "Sound", words: "audio volume output input microphone speakers apps" },
        { page: "cast", glyph: "󰄘", title: "Cast screen", words: "tv chromecast dlna firewall port" },
        { page: "wallpapers", glyph: "󰸉", title: "Wallpaper", words: "background picture image video gif" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰐊", title: "Animated wallpapers", words: "motion still battery power covered windows" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰆾", title: "Hot corner", words: "corner control center" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰘾", title: "Reduced motion", words: "animations accessibility" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰛖", title: "Text size", words: "font larger bigger accessibility zoom" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰂄", title: "Battery care", words: "charge limit threshold power" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰅌", title: "Clipboard history", words: "copy paste keep days expire pins" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰈝", title: "Export settings", words: "backup move another computer save file" },
        { page: "settings", glyph: "󰈞", title: "Import settings", words: "restore another computer load file" }
    ]
    readonly property string query: search.text.trim().toLowerCase()
    readonly property var matches: query === "" ? [] : index.filter(e => query.split(/\s+/).every(q => (e.title + " " + e.words).toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    function open(entry) {
        search.text = "";
        if (entry.page === "wallpapers")
            Ui.toggle("wallpapers");
        else if (entry.page !== "settings")
            Ui.controlPage = entry.page;
    }

    // The newest export in the home folder, offered for import.
    property string exportFile: ""
    Process {
        id: findExport
        command: ["bash", "-c", "ls -t \"$HOME\"/penumbra-settings-*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1"]
        stdout: StdioCollector { onStreamFinished: root.exportFile = text.trim() }
    }
    property string transferMessage: ""
    Process {
        id: transfer
        stdout: StdioCollector { id: transferOut }
        stderr: StdioCollector { id: transferErr }
        onExited: code => {
            root.transferMessage = code === 0 ? transferOut.text.trim().replace(Quickshell.env("HOME"), "~") : transferErr.text.trim();
            findExport.running = true;
        }
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Settings"
        status: "Super+, opens this page"
        showSwitch: false
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
    }

    Field {
        id: search
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        placeholderText: "Search settings"
        Keys.onReturnPressed: if (root.matches.length) root.open(root.matches[0])
        Keys.onEscapePressed: event => {
            if (text) {
                text = "";
                event.accepted = true;
            } else {
                event.accepted = false;
            }
        }
    }

    // Search results.
    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: root.query !== ""
        spacing: 2
        Repeater {
            model: root.matches
            delegate: ListRow {
                required property var modelData
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                glyph: modelData.glyph
                title: modelData.title
                subtitle: modelData.page === "settings" ? "On this page" : ""
                trailing: "󰅂"
                onClicked: root.open(modelData)
            }
        }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.leftMargin: 4
            visible: root.matches.length === 0
            text: "No setting matches"
            color: Theme.muted
        }
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: root.query === ""
        spacing: 12

        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 2
            Repeater {
                model: [
                    { page: "notes", glyph: "󰎞", title: "Quick notes", subtitle: "A local draft, saved as you type" },
                    { page: "look", glyph: "󰏘", title: "Look", subtitle: Look.summary },
                    { page: "displays", glyph: "󰍹", title: "Displays", subtitle: Quickshell.screens.length > 1 ? `${Quickshell.screens.length} screens · arrangement, resolution, scale` : "Resolution, refresh rate, scale" },
                    { page: "keyboard", glyph: "󰌌", title: "Keyboard", subtitle: (Config.values.kb_layout ?? "").split(",").map(l => Config.layoutName(l)).join(", ") },
                    { page: "idle", glyph: "󰒲", title: "Idle and sleep", subtitle: `Lock after ${Config.duration(Config.values.idle_lock).toLowerCase()}` },
                    { page: "notifications", glyph: "󰂚", title: "Notifications", subtitle: "Do not disturb, sounds, app rules" },
                    { page: "apps", glyph: "󰀻", title: "Default apps", subtitle: "Browser, file manager, terminal" }
                ]
                delegate: ListRow {
                    required property var modelData
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    glyph: modelData.glyph
                    title: modelData.title
                    subtitle: modelData.subtitle
                    trailing: "󰅂"
                    onClicked: Ui.controlPage = modelData.page
                }
            }
        }

        Section { text: "Desktop" }

        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 2
            ListRow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                glyph: "󰸉"
                title: "Wallpaper"
                subtitle: Ui.wallpaperTitle(Ui.wallpaper)
                trailing: "󰅂"
                onClicked: Ui.toggle("wallpapers")
            }
            SwitchRow {
                glyph: "󰐊"
                title: "Animated wallpapers"
                subtitle: Settings.reducedMotion ? "Still while Reduced motion is on" : Settings.animatedWallpapers ? "Dawn, eclipse, GIFs and videos move" : "Still images"
                checked: Settings.animatedWallpapers
                onToggled: Settings.animatedWallpapers = !Settings.animatedWallpapers
            }
            SwitchRow {
                visible: Settings.animatedWallpapers
                glyph: "󰖯"
                title: "Hold still behind windows"
                subtitle: "While tiled windows hide the wallpaper"
                checked: Settings.stillWhenCovered
                onToggled: Settings.stillWhenCovered = !Settings.stillWhenCovered
            }
            SwitchRow {
                visible: Settings.animatedWallpapers
                glyph: "󰌪"
                title: "Hold still to save power"
                subtitle: "On battery or in power saver"
                checked: Settings.stillOnBattery
                onToggled: Settings.stillOnBattery = !Settings.stillOnBattery
            }
            SwitchRow {
                glyph: "󰆾"
                title: "Hot corner"
                subtitle: "Top-right corner opens the control center"
                checked: Settings.hotCorner
                onToggled: Settings.hotCorner = !Settings.hotCorner
            }
        }

        Section { text: "Accessibility" }

        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 2
            SwitchRow {
                glyph: "󰘾"
                title: "Reduced motion"
                subtitle: "No animations in the shell, wallpapers or windows"
                checked: Settings.reducedMotion
                onToggled: Settings.reducedMotion = !Settings.reducedMotion
            }
            RowLayout {
                id: textSize
                readonly property var sizes: [1, 1.1, 1.25, 1.4]
                readonly property int current: Math.max(0, sizes.indexOf(Settings.textScale))
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                Layout.rightMargin: 4
                spacing: 11
                Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: "󰛖"; size: 17 }
                Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "Text size" }
                Stepper {
                    text: ["Default", "Large", "Larger", "Largest"][textSize.current]
                    textWidth: 92
                    canDecrease: textSize.current > 0
                    canIncrease: textSize.current < textSize.sizes.length - 1
                    onDecreased: Settings.textScale = textSize.sizes[textSize.current - 1]
                    onIncreased: Settings.textScale = textSize.sizes[textSize.current + 1]
                }
            }
        }

        Section { text: "Battery and clipboard" }

        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 2
            // Only where the battery's firmware can stop charging early.
            RowLayout {
                id: battery
                readonly property var limits: [100, 90, 80, 60]
                readonly property int current: Math.max(0, limits.indexOf(Settings.batteryLimit))
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                Layout.rightMargin: 4
                visible: Sys.chargeLimitFile !== ""
                spacing: 11
                Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: "󰂄"; size: 17 }
                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: 0
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "Battery care" }
                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: !Sys.chargeLimitWritable ? "Run ./install.sh again to allow it" : Settings.batteryLimit < 100 ? "Stops charging early; the battery lasts more years" : "Charges to full"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                        color: Sys.chargeLimitWritable ? Theme.muted : Theme.amber
                        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    }
                }
                Stepper {
                    text: Settings.batteryLimit < 100 ? `Up to ${Settings.batteryLimit}%` : "Full"
                    textWidth: 92
                    canDecrease: Sys.chargeLimitWritable && battery.current < battery.limits.length - 1
                    canIncrease: Sys.chargeLimitWritable && battery.current > 0
                    onDecreased: Settings.batteryLimit = battery.limits[battery.current + 1]
                    onIncreased: Settings.batteryLimit = battery.limits[battery.current - 1]
                }
            }
            RowLayout {
                id: clipboard
                readonly property var days: [0, 1, 7, 30]
                readonly property int current: Math.max(0, days.indexOf(Settings.clipboardDays))
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 10
                Layout.rightMargin: 4
                spacing: 11
                Glyph { Layout.preferredWidth: 22; text: "󰅌"; size: 17 }
                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: 0
                    Label { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "Clipboard history" }
                    Label {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: "Pinned entries always stay"
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                        color: Theme.muted
                    }
                }
                Stepper {
                    text: ["Kept", "1 day", "7 days", "30 days"][clipboard.current]
                    textWidth: 92
                    canDecrease: clipboard.current > 0
                    canIncrease: clipboard.current < clipboard.days.length - 1
                    onDecreased: Settings.clipboardDays = clipboard.days[clipboard.current - 1]
                    onIncreased: Settings.clipboardDays = clipboard.days[clipboard.current + 1]
                }
            }
        }

        Section { text: "Moving to another computer" }

        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 2
            ListRow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                glyph: "󰈝"
                title: "Export settings"
                subtitle: "Settings, look and screens, to one file in your home folder"
                busy: transfer.running
                onClicked: if (!transfer.running) {
                    transfer.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-settings", "export"];
                    transfer.running = true;
                }
            }
            ListRow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: root.exportFile !== ""
                glyph: "󰈞"
                title: "Import settings"
                subtitle: "From " + root.exportFile.replace(/^.*\//, "~/")
                busy: transfer.running
                onClicked: if (!transfer.running) {
                    transfer.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-settings", "import", root.exportFile];
                    transfer.running = true;
                }
            }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 4
                visible: text !== ""
                text: root.transferMessage
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.muted
            }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.leftMargin: 4
                visible: root.exportFile === "" && root.transferMessage === ""
                text: "To import, put a penumbra-settings-….json file from another computer in your home folder."
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.dim
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Shadow.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Effects

// The soft shadow under a floating surface. Hyprland only shadows windows, so shell surfaces
// draw their own. Declare it just before the surface it lies under.
RectangularShadow {
    required property Item target

    anchors.fill: target
    radius: target.radius
    offset.y: 6
    blur: 26
    spread: -4
    color: Theme.shadow
    opacity: target.opacity
    scale: target.scale
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/SliderRow.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Glyph (or app icon) button for mute, plus a soft violet slider, 0–100 unless `from` and `to` say
// otherwise.
RowLayout {
    id: root

    property string glyph
    property string icon: ""
    property real value: 0
    property real from: 0
    property real to: 100
    property real stepSize: 0
    property string label: Math.round(value) + "%"
    property int labelWidth: 34
    property bool muted: false
    signal moved(real value)
    signal glyphClicked()

    spacing: 10

    Rectangle {
        implicitWidth: 36
        implicitHeight: 36
        radius: Theme.corner(18)
        color: button.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.raised
        Glyph {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            visible: root.icon === ""
            text: root.glyph
            size: 16
            color: root.muted ? Theme.dim : Theme.accentBright
        }
        IconImage {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            visible: root.icon !== ""
            implicitSize: 20
            source: root.icon
            opacity: root.muted ? 0.4 : 1
        }
        MouseArea {
            id: button
            anchors.fill: parent
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: root.glyphClicked()
        }
    }

    Slider {
        id: slider
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        // The custom background and handle give no implicit height, which would leave a 0 px hit area.
        implicitHeight: 36
        hoverEnabled: true
        from: root.from
        to: root.to
        stepSize: root.stepSize
        value: root.value
        onMoved: root.moved(value)
        background: Rectangle {
            x: slider.leftPadding
            y: slider.topPadding + slider.availableHeight / 2 - height / 2
            width: slider.availableWidth
            height: slider.hovered || slider.pressed ? 12 : 6
            radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
            Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
            color: Theme.raised
            Rectangle {
                width: slider.visualPosition * parent.width
                height: parent.height
                radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
                gradient: Gradient {
                    orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
                    GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accentDeep }
                    GradientStop { position: 1; color: root.muted ? Theme.dim : Theme.accent }
                }
            }
        }
        handle: Rectangle {
            x: slider.leftPadding + slider.visualPosition * (slider.availableWidth - width)
            y: slider.topPadding + slider.availableHeight / 2 - height / 2
            width: slider.pressed ? 18 : 16
            height: width
            radius: Theme.corner(width / 2)
            color: Theme.white
            border.color: Theme.accent
            border.width: 2
            Rectangle {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                y: -height - 8
                width: bubble.implicitWidth + 16
                height: 26
                radius: Theme.corner(13)
                visible: slider.pressed
                color: Theme.surface
                border.color: Theme.accent
                Label { id: bubble; anchors.centerIn: parent; text: root.label; color: Theme.text }
            }
            Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.preferredWidth: root.labelWidth
        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
        text: root.label
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: Theme.muted
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/StaggerReveal.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick

// Attach to a layout section or delegate. Transforming avoids moving the layout's geometry.
// Closing resets immediately; reopening during a reveal cancels its old delay and starts fresh.
Item {
    id: root
    property Item target: parent
    required property bool shown
    property int order: 0
    property real progress: 0
    visible: false

    function reset() {
        entrance.stop();
        if (!shown) {
            progress = 0;
        } else if (Theme.reducedMotion) {
            progress = 1;
        } else {
            progress = 0;
            entrance.start();
        }
    }
    onShownChanged: reset()
    Connections {
        target: Theme
        function onReducedMotionChanged() { root.reset(); }
    }
    Component.onCompleted: {
        target.transform = [...target.transform, offset];
        reset();
    }
    Binding { target: root.target; property: "opacity"; value: root.progress }
    Translate { id: offset; y: 10 * (1 - root.progress) }
    SequentialAnimation {
        id: entrance
        PauseAnimation { duration: Math.min(12, Math.max(0, root.order)) * 18 * Theme.motion }
        NumberAnimation {
            target: root
            property: "progress"
            to: 1
            duration: Theme.normal
            easing.type: Easing.OutQuint
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick

// A scene's stars, each twinkling on its own rhythm; glint stars flash a four-point sparkle at their brightest.
Item {
    id: root
    required property WallpaperScene scene
    required property var stars
    property color color: scene.sceneTint

    Repeater {
        model: root.stars

        delegate: Item {
            id: star
            required property var modelData
            required property int index
            readonly property real twinkle: 0.8 + 0.45 * root.scene.wave(3.5 + index * 0.73 % 4, index * 2.4)
            readonly property real flash: Math.max(0, twinkle - 0.85) / 0.4
            x: modelData.x
            y: modelData.y

            Rectangle {
                x: -width / 2
                y: -height / 2
                width: star.modelData.r * 2
                height: width
                radius: width / 2
                color: root.color
                opacity: star.modelData.opacity * star.twinkle
            }

            Item {
                visible: star.modelData.glint && star.flash > 0
                opacity: star.flash
                scale: 0.6 + 0.6 * star.flash
                Rectangle {
                    x: -width / 2
                    y: -height / 2
                    width: 56
                    height: 1.2
                    gradient: Gradient {
                        orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
                        GradientStop { position: 0; color: "transparent" }
                        GradientStop { position: 0.5; color: root.color }
                        GradientStop { position: 1; color: "transparent" }
                    }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    x: -width / 2
                    y: -height / 2
                    width: 1.2
                    height: 40
                    gradient: Gradient {
                        GradientStop { position: 0; color: "transparent" }
                        GradientStop { position: 0.5; color: root.color }
                        GradientStop { position: 1; color: "transparent" }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick.Layouts

// A value between two arrows that step it, repeating while held: night light's times, idle
// timings, screen modes.
RowLayout {
    id: root

    property string text
    property string lessGlyph: "󰅁"
    property string moreGlyph: "󰅂"
    property bool canDecrease: true
    property bool canIncrease: true
    property int textWidth: 72
    signal decreased()
    signal increased()

    spacing: 2

    component Arrow: Rectangle {
        id: arrow
        property string glyph
        property bool available: true
        signal step()
        implicitWidth: 28
        implicitHeight: 28
        radius: Theme.corner(14)
        color: area.containsMouse && available ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
        opacity: available ? 1 : 0.35
        Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: arrow.glyph; size: 13; color: Theme.textSoft }
        MouseArea {
            id: area
            anchors.fill: parent
            hoverEnabled: true
            enabled: arrow.available
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onPressed: { arrow.step(); held.interval = 420; held.start(); }
            onReleased: held.stop()
            onCanceled: held.stop()
        }
        Timer {
            id: held
            repeat: true
            onTriggered: {
                interval = 70;
                if (arrow.available)
                    arrow.step();
            }
        }
    }

    Arrow { glyph: root.lessGlyph; available: root.canDecrease; onStep: root.decreased() }
    Label {
        Layout.preferredWidth: root.textWidth
        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
        text: root.text
        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
    }
    Arrow { glyph: root.moreGlyph; available: root.canIncrease; onStep: root.increased() }
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Sys.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Polled system state: backlight, pending updates and the battery's charge limit. Resource usage
// is in Usage.
Singleton {
    id: root

    // Battery care: laptops whose firmware supports it stop charging at Settings.batteryLimit.
    // The file is root's; Penumbra's udev rule (90-penumbra-battery.rules) lets the session write
    // it. Firmware may forget it at power-off, so the shell sets it again at each start.
    property string chargeLimitFile: "" // empty: not supported
    property bool chargeLimitWritable: false
    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["bash", "-c", "for f in /sys/class/power_supply/BAT*/charge_control_end_threshold; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; [[ -w $f ]] && echo \"w $f\" || echo \"r $f\"; break; done"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const m = /^([rw]) (.+)$/.exec(text.trim());
                root.chargeLimitFile = m ? m[2] : "";
                root.chargeLimitWritable = !!m && m[1] === "w";
                // At start only a limit you set, so one set by other tools (TLP) stays alone.
                if (Settings.batteryLimit < 100)
                    root.applyChargeLimit();
            }
        }
    }
    function applyChargeLimit() {
        if (chargeLimitFile && chargeLimitWritable)
            Quickshell.execDetached(["bash", "-c", 'echo "$1" > "$2"', "bash", String(Settings.batteryLimit), chargeLimitFile]);
    }
    Connections {
        target: Settings
        function onBatteryLimitChanged() { root.applyChargeLimit(); }
    }

    property int brightness: -1 // -1 when the machine has no backlight
    property int updates: 0
    property string updatesDetail: ""
    property var updateSources: [] // [{ name, packages: ["name old -> new" or a Flatpak ref] }]
    property var updateNews: [] // the distribution's latest news: [{ title, link, date, new }]
    property var restartReasons: [] // why a restart is due ("The kernel was updated")
    readonly property bool unreadNews: updateNews.some(n => n.new)
    property bool checkingUpdates: updateCheck.running

    // brightnessctl -m prints: device,class,current,percent%,max
    Process {
        id: backlight
        command: ["brightnessctl", "-m", "--class=backlight", "info"]
        running: true
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const parts = text.trim().split(",");
                root.brightness = parts.length >= 4 ? parseInt(parts[3]) : -1;
            }
        }
    }
    function refreshBrightness() {
        backlight.running = true;
    }
    // Brightness keys: 5% steps, never down to black; the popup shows the result.
    Process {
        id: brightnessStep
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const parts = text.trim().split(",");
                if (parts.length < 4)
                    return;
                root.brightness = parseInt(parts[3]);
                Ui.showOsd("brightness", root.brightness, false);
            }
        }
    }
    function stepBrightness(action) {
        if (root.brightness < 0)
            return false;
        if (action === "current") {
            Ui.showOsd("brightness", root.brightness, false);
            return true;
        }
        if (action !== "up" && action !== "down")
            return false;
        brightnessStep.command = ["brightnessctl", "-m", "--class=backlight", "--min-value=1", "set", action === "up" ? "5%+" : "5%-"];
        brightnessStep.running = true;
        return true;
    }
    function setBrightness(percent) {
        root.brightness = Math.max(1, Math.round(percent));
        brightnessDebounce.restart();
    }
    Timer {
        id: brightnessDebounce
        interval: 60
        onTriggered: Quickshell.execDetached(["brightnessctl", "--class=backlight", "--min-value=1", "set", root.brightness + "%"])
    }

    Process {
        id: updateCheck
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-updates", "status"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                try {
                    const status = JSON.parse(text);
                    root.updates = status.count ?? 0;
                    root.updatesDetail = (status.details ?? []).join("\n");
                    root.updateSources = status.sources ?? [];
                    root.updateNews = status.news ?? [];
                    root.restartReasons = status.restart ?? [];
                } catch (e) {
                    root.updates = 0;
                    root.updateSources = [];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    function refreshUpdates() {
        updateCheck.running = true;
    }
    Timer {
        interval: 15 * 60 * 1000
        running: true
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: root.refreshUpdates()
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Theme.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import "palette.js" as P

// PENUMBRA palette, type and geometry, shared by every shell surface.
Singleton {
    id: root

    // Colours start from palette.js, which tools/build-palette.py writes from palette/palette.toml.
    // penumbra-theme writes the chosen palette to palette.json; a new one fades in over `to`, so every
    // colour below, and every binding on them, crossfades instead of snapping.
    readonly property color base: mix("base")
    readonly property color surface: mix("surface")
    readonly property color glass: alpha(surface, Math.min(1, Math.max(0.4, level("glass") + Settings.glassFrost)))
    readonly property color glassStrong: alpha(surface, Math.min(1, Math.max(0.55, level("glassStrong") + Settings.glassFrost)))
    readonly property color raised: alpha(mix("glassRaised"), level("raised"))
    readonly property color hover: mix("hover")
    // Background = base; panels prioritize legibility; controls have their own solid fill.
    readonly property color panel: alpha(surface, Math.min(1, Math.max(0.92, level("glassStrong") + Settings.glassFrost)))
    readonly property color control: mix("button")
    readonly property color line: alpha(text, light ? 0.12 : 0.10)
    readonly property color lineStrong: alpha(accent, level("lineStrong"))
    // Behind full-screen overlays (launcher, session menu, polkit, screenshots).
    readonly property color scrim: mix("shade")
    readonly property color accent: mix("accent")
    readonly property color accentBright: mix("accentBright")
    readonly property color accentDeep: mix("accentDeep")
    // Text and glyphs on an accent fill.
    readonly property color accentInk: mix("onAccent")
    readonly property color white: mix("white")
    readonly property color text: mix("text")
    readonly property color textSoft: mix("textSoft")
    readonly property color subtle: mix("subtle")
    readonly property color muted: mix("muted")
    readonly property color dim: mix("dim")
    readonly property color rose: mix("rose")
    readonly property color green: mix("green")
    readonly property color amber: mix("amber")
    // The system monitor's series.
    readonly property color blue: mix("blue")
    readonly property color pink: mix("pink")
    readonly property color cyan: mix("cyan")

    // Overlays that are white or black on dark glass and the other way round on light glass.
    // The lit top edge of glass (GlassEdge scales its strength by highlightGain).
    readonly property color highlight: mix("highlight")
    readonly property real highlightGain: level("highlightGain")
    // The soft shadow under floating surfaces.
    readonly property color shadow: alpha(mix("shadow"), level("shadowAlpha"))
    // Hover and track overlays that work on any fill.
    readonly property color overlay: alpha(mix("overlay"), level("overlayAlpha"))
    readonly property color overlayStrong: alpha(mix("overlay"), level("overlayStrongAlpha"))

    // "dark" or "light", as the palette on screen (or fading in) has it.
    readonly property string mode: to.mode
    readonly property bool light: mode === "light"
    // True while a new palette fades in; components with their own colour Behavior may skip it.
    readonly property bool fading: fade.running

    // A palette colour made translucent.
    function alpha(c, a) {
        const q = Qt.lighter(c, 1);
        return Qt.rgba(q.r, q.g, q.b, a);
    }

    // The levels the derived colours are made with, per mode: dark glass wants faint lines and white
    // light, light glass denser fills and dark overlays.
    readonly property var levels: ({
        dark: { glass: 0.58, glassStrong: 0.72, raised: 0.55, line: 0.16, lineStrong: 0.34,
                highlightGain: 1, shadowAlpha: 0.55, overlayAlpha: 0.08, overlayStrongAlpha: 0.12 },
        light: { glass: 0.78, glassStrong: 0.9, raised: 0.7, line: 0.22, lineStrong: 0.42,
                 highlightGain: 2.7, shadowAlpha: 0.18, overlayAlpha: 0.06, overlayStrongAlpha: 0.1 }
    })

    // A full palette: the given colours over the compiled-in ones, plus the mode's levels and overlays.
    function makePalette(mode, colors) {
        const m = mode === "light" ? "light" : "dark";
        const p = Object.assign({}, P.colors, colors ?? {}, levels[m]);
        p.mode = m;
        p.highlight = "#ffffff";
        p.shadow = m === "light" ? p.shade : "#000000";
        p.overlay = m === "light" ? "#000000" : "#ffffff";
        return p;
    }

    // The palette fading out, the one fading in, and how far along it is.
    property var from: makePalette("dark")
    property var to: from
    property real t: 1
    function mix(key) { return root.t >= 1 ? root.to[key] : Qt.tint(root.from[key], alpha(root.to[key], root.t)); }
    function level(key) { return root.from[key] + (root.to[key] - root.from[key]) * root.t; }

    NumberAnimation {
        id: fade
        target: root
        property: "t"
        from: 0
        to: 1
        easing.type: Easing.InOutQuad
    }

    // Fades to a palette over `duration` ms, starting from whatever is on screen now (even mid-fade).
    function show(next, duration) {
        if (duration > 0) {
            const now = {};
            for (const key in next)
                now[key] = typeof next[key] === "number" ? level(key) : key === "mode" ? root.to.mode : mix(key);
            fade.stop();
            root.from = now;
            root.to = next;
            root.t = 0;
            fade.duration = duration;
            fade.start();
        } else {
            fade.stop();
            root.from = next;
            root.to = next;
            root.t = 1;
        }
    }

    // palette.json: {"mode": "dark"|"light", "duration": ms, "colors": {name: "#rrggbb", …}}.
    // No file (or an unreadable one) means the default palette. Loading blocks and the first load
    // doesn't fade, so the very first frame already has the chosen colours.
    property string paletteSource: ""
    property bool started: false
    function load(text) {
        if (text === paletteSource)
            return;
        paletteSource = text;
        let p = null;
        try {
            p = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("Theme: ignoring unreadable palette.json:", e);
        }
        show(makePalette(p?.mode, p?.colors), started && !reducedMotion ? p?.duration ?? slow : 0);
    }
    FileView {
        id: paletteFile
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/palette.json"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        blockLoading: true
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onLoaded: root.load(text())
        onLoadFailed: root.load("")
    }
    Component.onCompleted: {
        load(paletteFile.text());
        started = true;
    }

    readonly property string sans: "Inter"
    // Inter's optical size for large text: tighter spacing and finer detail from about 20 px up.
    readonly property string display: "Inter Display"
    readonly property string mono: "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"
    // The distribution's logo on the bar's launcher button, set by install.sh from distro/NAME/distro.sh.
    readonly property string distroGlyph: "@@DISTRO_GLYPH@@"

    // The type scale. Every text size in the shell is one of these, scaled by Settings → Text size.
    readonly property real textScale: Settings.textScale > 0 ? Settings.textScale : 1
    readonly property int textTiny: Math.round(11 * textScale)     // badges, timestamps
    readonly property int textSmall: Math.round(12 * textScale)    // subtitles, section labels
    readonly property int textBody: Math.round(14 * textScale)     // the default
    readonly property int textMedium: Math.round(15 * textScale)   // notification titles, emphasized rows
    readonly property int textLarge: Math.round(17 * textScale)    // page titles, the bar clock
    readonly property int textTitle: Math.round(20 * textScale)    // the launcher's search, big figures
    readonly property int textHeading: Math.round(24 * textScale)  // panel headlines, in the display face
    readonly property int textDisplay: 124 // the lock screen clock

    // Rounded or sharp corners, as penumbra-corners records them. Every radius goes through
    // corner(), so the whole shell follows the choice at once.
    property string corners: "rounded"
    readonly property bool sharp: corners === "sharp"
    function corner(px) { return sharp ? 0 : px; }
    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/corners"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onLoaded: root.corners = text().trim() || "rounded"
    }

    readonly property int radiusLarge: corner(22)
    readonly property int radius: corner(16)
    readonly property int radiusSmall: corner(12)
    readonly property int barHeight: 40
    readonly property int padding: 18
    readonly property int controlPadding: 12
    readonly property int gap: 8
    readonly property int edge: 14

    // Animation timings; all of them are 0 with Settings → Reduced motion. `motion` is for
    // durations written out where they are used (multiply them by it).
    readonly property bool reducedMotion: Settings.reducedMotion
    onReducedMotionChanged: if (reducedMotion && fade.running) show(to, 0)
    readonly property real motion: reducedMotion ? 0 : 1
    readonly property int fast: 160 * motion
    readonly property int normal: 260 * motion
    readonly property int slow: 420 * motion
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Tile.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// Quick-settings toggle: click the body to toggle, the chevron for more.
Rectangle {
    id: root
    scale: Theme.reducedMotion ? 1 : (available ? (body.pressed ? 0.96 : body.containsMouse ? 1.02 : 1) : 1)
    Behavior on scale { enabled: !Theme.reducedMotion; SpringAnimation { spring: 5; damping: 0.7 } }

    property string glyph
    property string title
    property string subtitle
    property bool on: false
    property bool available: true
    property bool hasMore: false
    signal toggled()
    signal more()

    implicitHeight: Math.max(68, labels.implicitHeight + 24)
    radius: Theme.radius
    // Selected controls carry the accent; the surrounding panel stays quiet.
    color: on ? (body.containsMouse ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.accent) : body.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : Theme.control
    border.color: "transparent"
    opacity: available ? 1 : 0.45
    Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }

    CardLight { radius: root.radius; pointer: Qt.point(body.mouseX, body.mouseY); hovered: body.containsMouse }
    MouseArea {
        id: body
        anchors.fill: parent
        hoverEnabled: true
        enabled: root.available
        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
        onClicked: root.toggled()
    }

    RowLayout {
        anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: Theme.controlPadding; rightMargin: root.hasMore ? 6 : 14 }
        spacing: 11
        Rectangle {
            implicitWidth: 36
            implicitHeight: 36
            radius: Theme.corner(18)
            color: root.on ? Theme.alpha(Theme.accentInk, 0.10) : Theme.alpha(Theme.accent, 0.10)
            Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
            Glyph {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                text: root.glyph
                size: 17
                color: root.on ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.accentBright
            }
        }
        ColumnLayout {
            id: labels
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 1
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: root.title
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                maximumLineCount: 2
                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                color: root.on ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.text
            }
            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: root.subtitle
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: root.on ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft
            }
        }
        Rectangle {
            visible: root.hasMore
            implicitWidth: 30
            implicitHeight: 44
            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
            color: more.containsMouse ? Theme.overlay : "transparent"
            Glyph {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                text: "󰅂"
                color: root.on ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.textSoft
            }
            MouseArea {
                id: more
                anchors.fill: parent
                hoverEnabled: true
                enabled: root.available
                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                onClicked: root.more()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Ui.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import "wallpapers.js" as Wallpapers
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland

// Which surfaces are open, and the screen they open on.
Singleton {
    id: root

    // At most one panel is open: control, calendar, monitor, updates, wallpapers, or "".
    property string openPanel: ""
    readonly property bool controlOpen: openPanel === "control"
    readonly property bool calendarOpen: openPanel === "calendar"
    readonly property bool monitorOpen: openPanel === "monitor"
    readonly property bool updatesOpen: openPanel === "updates"
    readonly property bool wallpapersOpen: openPanel === "wallpapers"
    property string controlPage: "main" // main, wifi, bluetooth, mixer, night, cast, notifications, settings or a settings page
    property bool sessionOpen: false
    property bool launcherOpen: false
    property string launcherMode: "apps" // apps, windows, clipboard, emoji or symbols
    property bool shotOpen: false
    property bool overviewOpen: false
    property bool caffeine: false
    // Open apps from Settings → Idle and sleep that keep the screen awake (by app id).
    readonly property var awakeApps: ToplevelManager.toplevels.values.map(t => t.appId).filter(a => Settings.idleInhibitApps.includes(a))
    readonly property bool stayAwake: caffeine || awakeApps.length > 0

    property string osdKind: "volume" // volume, microphone, brightness, or capslock and layout (text only)
    property int osdValue: 0
    property bool osdMuted: false
    property string osdText: ""
    property bool osdVisible: false

    // Panels follow the monitor that has focus.
    readonly property var screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === Hyprland.focusedMonitor?.name) ?? Quickshell.screens[0]

    // Capsule centers in screen-local coordinates, published by each monitor's bar.
    property var panelOrigins: ({})
    function setPanelOrigins(name, origins) {
        panelOrigins = Object.assign({}, panelOrigins, { [name]: origins });
    }

    function close() {
        openPanel = "";
    }
    // Full-screen overlays replace each other and any open panel.
    function closeOverlays() {
        close();
        sessionOpen = false;
        launcherOpen = false;
        shotOpen = false;
        overviewOpen = false;
    }
    // A click outside a panel closes it; ignore that same click reopening it from the bar.
    property double closedAt: 0
    function dismiss() {
        closedAt = Date.now();
        close();
    }
    // Open panel `name`, or close it if it is open. The control center always opens on its main page.
    function toggle(name) {
        const reopen = openPanel !== name && Date.now() - closedAt > 250;
        if (reopen && name === "control")
            controlPage = "main";
        openPanel = reopen ? name : "";
    }
    function openControl(page) {
        controlPage = page;
        openPanel = "control";
    }
    function openSession() {
        closeOverlays();
        sessionOpen = true;
    }
    function toggleLauncher(mode) {
        const reopen = !(launcherOpen && launcherMode === mode);
        closeOverlays();
        launcherMode = mode;
        launcherOpen = reopen;
    }
    function toggleOverview() {
        const reopen = !overviewOpen;
        closeOverlays();
        overviewOpen = reopen;
    }
    function openShot() {
        closeOverlays();
        shotOpen = true;
    }

    function showOsd(kind, value, muted, text) {
        osdKind = kind;
        osdValue = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value));
        osdMuted = muted;
        osdText = text ?? "";
        osdVisible = true;
        osdTimer.restart();
    }
    Timer {
        id: osdTimer
        interval: 1500
        onTriggered: root.osdVisible = false
    }

    // The chosen wallpaper, as penumbra-wallpaper records it: one of Penumbra's (wallpaper,
    // wallpaper-dawn…), or the path of your own image, GIF or video.
    property string wallpaper: "wallpaper"
    readonly property string wallpapers: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/share/penumbra/"
    readonly property string wallpaperFolder: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/Pictures/Wallpapers"
    readonly property var wallpaperScenes: Wallpapers.scenes
    function wallpaperTitle(name) {
        return wallpaperScenes[name]?.title ?? name.replace(/^.*\//, "").replace(/\.[^.]*$/, "");
    }
    // scene (dawn, eclipse), still (night or an image), gif or video.
    function wallpaperKind(name) {
        if (wallpaperScenes[name]?.scene)
            return "scene";
        const ext = name.startsWith("/") ? name.replace(/^.*\./, "").toLowerCase() : "";
        if (ext === "gif")
            return "gif";
        return ["mp4", "webm", "mkv", "mov", "m4v"].includes(ext) ? "video" : "still";
    }
    // The first frame penumbra-wallpaper saves of a GIF, video or non-PNG image.
    function wallpaperPoster(path) {
        return Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.cache/penumbra/wallpapers/" + Qt.md5(path) + ".png";
    }
    // The still the lock screen shows: the wordmark-free scene, or your image or its first frame.
    readonly property string wallpaperStill: !wallpaper.startsWith("/") ? wallpapers + wallpaper + "-clean.png"
        : wallpaperKind(wallpaper) === "still" && wallpaper.toLowerCase().endsWith(".png") ? wallpaper : wallpaperPoster(wallpaper)
    // A file:// URL for a path that may hold spaces, # or ?.
    function fileUrl(path) {
        return "file://" + path.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");
    }
    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/state/penumbra/wallpaper"
        watchChanges: true
        printErrors: false
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onLoaded: root.wallpaper = text().trim() || "wallpaper"
    }

    // Optional tools, found once at startup.
    property bool hasNightLight: false
    property bool hasVisualizer: false
    property bool hasTyping: false // wtype types emoji and symbols into the focused window
    property bool hasPowerProfiles: false // power-profiles-daemon (or another daemon with its D-Bus API)
    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["bash", "-c", "command -v hyprsunset; command -v cava; command -v wtype; busctl --system list --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -qE \"^(org.freedesktop.UPower.PowerProfiles|net.hadess.PowerProfiles) \" && echo /power-profiles"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                root.hasNightLight = text.includes("/hyprsunset");
                root.hasVisualizer = text.includes("/cava");
                root.hasTyping = text.includes("/wtype");
                root.hasPowerProfiles = text.includes("/power-profiles");
            }
        }
    }

    // Start a program in its own systemd scope (under app.slice), so it outlives the shell: the
    // shell runs as penumbra-shell.service, and restarting it must not take the apps along.
    // `command` is an argument list, or { command, workingDirectory }.
    function spawn(command) {
        // Without the shell's allocator tuning (penumbra-shell.service).
        const scope = ["systemd-run", "--user", "--scope", "--slice=app.slice", "--collect", "--quiet", "--", "env", "-u", "MALLOC_CONF"];
        if (Array.isArray(command))
            Quickshell.execDetached(scope.concat(command));
        else
            Quickshell.execDetached({ command: scope.concat(command.command), workingDirectory: command.workingDirectory });
    }
    function run(command) {
        spawn(["bash", "-c", command]);
    }
    // The argument list for running `command` (a list) in the terminal from Settings → Default
    // apps; `options` are penumbra-terminal's, such as ["--class", "penumbra-monitor", "--hold"].
    function terminal(command, options) {
        return [bin + "penumbra-terminal", ...(options ?? []), "--", ...command];
    }
    readonly property string bin: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.local/bin/"
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts

// Pending updates by source, under the updates capsule; "Update now" opens the update session in a
// terminal. Above them, a restart that is due and the distribution's news since the last upgrade
// (Arch's sometimes ask for a step by hand), each opening in the browser.
Panel {
    id: root
    originKey: "updates"
    anchors { top: true; right: true }
    margins.right: edgeMargin - shadowRoom
    preferredSheetWidth: 400
    open: Ui.updatesOpen
    onDismissed: Ui.dismiss()

    ColumnLayout {
        x: 18
        y: 18
        width: root.sheetWidth - 36
        spacing: 12

        RowLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            spacing: 12
            Rectangle {
                implicitWidth: 42
                implicitHeight: 42
                radius: Theme.corner(21)
                gradient: Gradient {
                    GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accent }
                    GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.accentDeep }
                }
                Glyph { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "󰚰"; size: 19; color: Theme.accentInk }
            }
            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 1
                Label {
                    text: Sys.updates === 1 ? "1 update" : `${Sys.updates} updates`
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                }
                Label {
                    text: Sys.checkingUpdates ? "Checking…" : Sys.updates === 0 && Sys.restartReasons.length ? "Restart to finish the last upgrade" : "Checked every 15 minutes"
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                    color: Theme.muted
                }
            }
        }

        // A restart that is due.
        Rectangle {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            visible: Sys.restartReasons.length > 0
            implicitHeight: restartRow.implicitHeight + 20
            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
            color: Theme.alpha(Theme.amber, 0.12)
            border.color: Theme.alpha(Theme.amber, 0.4)
            RowLayout {
                id: restartRow
                anchors { fill: parent; margins: 10 }
                spacing: 10
                Glyph { text: "󰜉"; size: 17; color: Theme.amber }
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: Sys.restartReasons.join(" · ") + ". Restart when convenient to use the new versions."
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                }
                PillButton {
                    text: "Restart"
                    onClicked: { Ui.close(); Ui.openSession(); }
                }
            }
        }

        // The latest news; new since the last upgrade ones are lit.
        ColumnLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            visible: Sys.updateNews.length > 0
            spacing: 2
            Overline { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: Sys.unreadNews ? "News · read before updating" : "News" }
            Repeater {
                model: Sys.updateNews
                delegate: ListRow {
                    required property var modelData
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    glyph: modelData.new ? "󰎕" : "󰈙"
                    highlighted: modelData.new
                    title: modelData.title
                    subtitle: Qt.formatDate(new Date(modelData.date), "d MMMM yyyy") + (modelData.new ? " · since your last upgrade" : "")
                    trailing: "󰏌"
                    onClicked: {
                        Ui.close();
                        Ui.spawn(["xdg-open", modelData.link]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Flickable {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(contentHeight, 380)
            contentHeight: list.implicitHeight
            clip: true
            boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

            ColumnLayout {
                id: list
                width: parent.width
                spacing: 6

                Repeater {
                    model: Sys.updateSources
                    delegate: ColumnLayout {
                        id: source
                        required property var modelData
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 2

                        Overline {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            Layout.topMargin: 4
                            Layout.bottomMargin: 2
                            text: `${source.modelData.name} · ${source.modelData.packages.length}`
                        }
                        Repeater {
                            model: source.modelData.packages
                            // "name old -> new", or just a Flatpak ref.
                            delegate: RowLayout {
                                required property string modelData
                                readonly property var parts: modelData.match(/^(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+->\s+(\S+)$/)
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                Layout.leftMargin: 4
                                spacing: 8
                                Label {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    text: parent.parts ? parent.parts[1] : parent.modelData
                                    font.family: Theme.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                                }
                                Label {
                                    visible: !!parent.parts
                                    text: parent.parts ? `${parent.parts[2]} → ${parent.parts[3]}` : ""
                                    Layout.maximumWidth: 190
                                    font.family: Theme.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                                    color: Theme.accent
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        RowLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.topMargin: 4
            spacing: 8
            Item { Layout.fillWidth: true }
            PillButton {
                text: "Check again"
                implicitHeight: 34
                available: !Sys.checkingUpdates
                onClicked: Sys.refreshUpdates()
            }
            PillButton {
                text: "Update now"
                primary: true
                implicitHeight: 34
                onClicked: {
                    Ui.close();
                    Ui.run(Ui.bin + "penumbra-updates open");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Usage.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

// Resource usage: CPU, memory, GPUs, disks and network, with two minutes of history for the
// monitor's graphs. The /proc counters are cheap and always read, so the graphs already have a
// past when the monitor opens; temperatures, clocks, GPUs and filesystems are only read while
// it is open.
Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property int interval: 2000
    readonly property int historyLength: 60
    readonly property bool watching: Ui.monitorOpen

    property int cpu: 0
    property int cores: 1
    property var coreLoads: [] // percent, one per thread
    property string cpuModel: ""
    property real cpuGhz: 0
    property int cpuTemp: -1
    property string loadAverage: ""
    property var cpuHistory: []

    // KiB, as /proc/meminfo counts.
    property int memory: 0
    property real memoryUsed: 0
    property real memoryCache: 0 // page cache the kernel gives back when asked
    property real memoryTotal: 0
    property real swapUsed: 0
    property real swapTotal: 0
    property string memoryDetail: ""
    property var memoryHistory: []

    // Bytes per second across the physical disks, and bytes for filesystems.
    property real diskRead: 0
    property real diskWrite: 0
    property var diskHistory: []
    property var filesystems: [] // [{ name, mount, used, size }]

    // The interface with the default route; bytes per second, and bytes since it came up.
    property string netInterface: ""
    property real netDown: 0
    property real netUp: 0
    property real netReceived: 0
    property real netSent: 0
    property var downHistory: []
    property var upHistory: []

    // [{ card, driver, name, integrated, asleep, busy, memUsed, memTotal, temp, power, freq, maxFreq, history }]
    // Memory in MiB, temperature in °C, power in W, clocks in MHz; -1 where the driver says nothing.
    property var gpus: []

    // Previous counters, for rates.
    property var lastCpu: null
    property var lastCores: []
    property var lastDisk: null
    property var lastNet: null
    property var lastGpu: ({})
    property string cpuTempPath: ""

    function push(list, value) {
        return list.concat([value]).slice(-historyLength);
    }

    Timer {
        interval: root.interval
        running: true
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: {
            stat.reload();
            meminfo.reload();
            route.reload();
            netdev.reload();
            diskstats.reload();
            if (root.watching)
                root.readDetails();
        }
    }
    function readDetails() {
        cpuinfo.reload();
        loadavg.reload();
        if (cpuTempPath)
            cpuTemp.reload();
        if (gpus.length && !gpuSample.running)
            gpuSample.running = true;
    }
    // Filesystems change rarely; ask on opening, then every half minute. Intel's GPU busy time
    // is a difference between samples, so a stale sample from the last opening is dropped.
    onWatchingChanged: {
        lastGpu = {};
        if (watching) {
            readDetails();
            df.running = true;
        }
    }
    Timer {
        interval: 30000
        running: root.watching
        repeat: true
        onTriggered: df.running = true
    }

    FileView {
        id: stat
        path: "/proc/stat"
        onLoaded: {
            const lines = text().split("\n").filter(l => l.startsWith("cpu"));
            const times = lines.map(l => {
                const f = l.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(1).map(Number);
                return { idle: f[3] + f[4], total: f.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) };
            });
            const busy = (now, before) => {
                const dt = now.total - before.total;
                return dt > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 * (1 - (now.idle - before.idle) / dt))) : 0;
            };
            root.cores = times.length - 1 || 1;
            if (root.lastCpu) {
                root.cpu = Math.round(busy(times[0], root.lastCpu));
                root.cpuHistory = root.push(root.cpuHistory, root.cpu);
            }
            if (root.lastCores.length === times.length - 1)
                root.coreLoads = times.slice(1).map((t, i) => busy(t, root.lastCores[i]));
            root.lastCpu = times[0];
            root.lastCores = times.slice(1);
        }
    }

    FileView {
        id: cpuinfo
        path: "/proc/cpuinfo"
        onLoaded: {
            const mhz = (text().match(/^cpu MHz\s*:\s*([\d.]+)/gm) ?? []).map(l => Number(l.split(":")[1]));
            root.cpuGhz = mhz.length ? mhz.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / mhz.length / 1000 : 0;
            if (!root.cpuModel) {
                const model = text().match(/^model name\s*:\s*(.+)$/m)?.[1] ?? "";
                root.cpuModel = model.replace(/\((R|TM)\)/g, "").replace(/ CPU @.*$| \d+-Core Processor$/, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
            }
        }
    }

    FileView {
        id: loadavg
        path: "/proc/loadavg"
        onLoaded: root.loadAverage = text().split(" ")[0]
    }

    // The package sensor: coretemp on Intel, k10temp or zenpower on AMD.
    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do case $(cat $h/name) in coretemp|k10temp|zenpower|cpu_thermal) echo $h/temp1_input; exit;; esac; done"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.cpuTempPath = text.trim()
        }
    }
    FileView {
        id: cpuTemp
        path: root.cpuTempPath
        printErrors: false
        onLoaded: root.cpuTemp = Math.round(Number(text()) / 1000)
    }

    FileView {
        id: meminfo
        path: "/proc/meminfo"
        onLoaded: {
            const kb = key => Number(text().match(new RegExp("^" + key + ":\\s+(\\d+)", "m"))?.[1] ?? 0);
            const total = kb("MemTotal"), available = kb("MemAvailable"), used = total - available;
            root.memoryTotal = total;
            root.memoryUsed = used;
            root.memoryCache = Math.max(0, available - kb("MemFree"));
            root.swapTotal = kb("SwapTotal");
            root.swapUsed = root.swapTotal - kb("SwapFree");
            root.memory = Math.round(100 * used / total);
            root.memoryDetail = `${(used / 1048576).toFixed(1)} / ${(total / 1048576).toFixed(1)} GiB`;
            root.memoryHistory = root.push(root.memoryHistory, 100 * used / total);
        }
    }

    // Whole disks only: partitions would count the same bytes twice, and zram is memory.
    FileView {
        id: diskstats
        path: "/proc/diskstats"
        onLoaded: {
            let read = 0, written = 0;
            for (const line of text().split("\n")) {
                const f = line.trim().split(/\s+/);
                if (/^(nvme\d+n\d+|sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|xvd[a-z]+|hd[a-z]+|mmcblk\d+)$/.test(f[2] ?? "")) {
                    read += Number(f[5]) * 512;
                    written += Number(f[9]) * 512;
                }
            }
            const now = Date.now(), last = root.lastDisk;
            if (last) {
                const dt = (now - last.time) / 1000;
                root.diskRead = Math.max(0, (read - last.read) / dt);
                root.diskWrite = Math.max(0, (written - last.written) / dt);
                root.diskHistory = root.push(root.diskHistory, root.diskRead + root.diskWrite);
            }
            root.lastDisk = { read, written, time: now };
        }
    }

    Process {
        id: df
        command: ["env", "LC_ALL=C", "df", "--local", "-B1", "--output=source,size,used,target"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                // Btrfs subvolumes and bind mounts list one device several times; keep its
                // shortest mount point. Boot partitions are not worth a row.
                const found = {};
                for (const line of text.trim().split("\n").slice(1)) {
                    const m = line.match(/^(\/dev\/\S+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(.+)$/);
                    if (!m || /^\/(boot|efi)(\/|$)/.test(m[4]))
                        continue;
                    if (!found[m[1]] || m[4].length < found[m[1]].mount.length)
                        found[m[1]] = { mount: m[4], size: Number(m[2]), used: Number(m[3]) };
                }
                root.filesystems = Object.values(found).sort((a, b) => a.mount.length - b.mount.length).map(f => Object.assign(f, {
                    name: f.mount === "/" ? "System" : f.mount === "/home" ? "Home" : f.mount.split("/").pop()
                }));
            }
        }
    }

    // The default route's interface: Destination 00000000, lowest metric.
    FileView {
        id: route
        path: "/proc/net/route"
        onLoaded: {
            const routes = text().trim().split("\n").slice(1).map(l => l.trim().split(/\s+/)).filter(f => f[1] === "00000000");
            routes.sort((a, b) => Number(a[6]) - Number(b[6]));
            root.netInterface = routes[0]?.[0] ?? "";
        }
    }
    FileView {
        id: netdev
        path: "/proc/net/dev"
        onLoaded: {
            let rx = 0, tx = 0;
            for (const line of text().split("\n").slice(2)) {
                const [name, rest] = line.split(":");
                const iface = name?.trim(), f = rest?.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
                if (!f || iface === "lo" || (root.netInterface && iface !== root.netInterface))
                    continue;
                rx += f[0];
                tx += f[8];
            }
            const now = Date.now(), last = root.lastNet;
            root.netReceived = rx;
            root.netSent = tx;
            // A new interface starts from its own counters; skip the jump between them.
            if (last && last.iface === root.netInterface) {
                const dt = (now - last.time) / 1000;
                root.netDown = Math.max(0, (rx - last.rx) / dt);
                root.netUp = Math.max(0, (tx - last.tx) / dt);
            } else {
                root.netDown = root.netUp = 0;
            }
            if (last) {
                root.downHistory = root.push(root.downHistory, root.netDown);
                root.upHistory = root.push(root.upHistory, root.netUp);
            }
            root.lastNet = { rx, tx, time: now, iface: root.netInterface };
        }
    }

    // GPUs come from bin/penumbra-gpus, which never wakes a sleeping one.
    Process {
        running: true
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-gpus", "list"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                root.gpus = text.trim().split("\n").filter(l => l).map(line => {
                    const [card, driver, model] = line.split("\t");
                    // "AD107M [GeForce RTX 4060 Max-Q / Mobile]" → "GeForce RTX 4060 Max-Q"
                    const name = (model?.match(/\[(.+)\]/)?.[1] ?? model ?? "").split(" / ")[0].trim();
                    return {
                        card, driver,
                        name: name || "Graphics",
                        integrated: driver === "i915" || driver === "xe",
                        asleep: false, busy: -1, memUsed: -1, memTotal: -1, temp: -1, power: -1, freq: -1, maxFreq: -1,
                        history: []
                    };
                });
            }
        }
    }
    Process {
        id: gpuSample
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-gpus", "sample"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const lines = text.trim().split("\n");
                const now = Number(lines[0]?.split(" ")[1]) * 1000;
                const readings = {};
                for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
                    const [card, ...pairs] = line.split("\t");
                    readings[card] = {};
                    for (const pair of pairs) {
                        const at = pair.indexOf("=");
                        readings[card][pair.slice(0, at)] = pair.slice(at + 1);
                    }
                }
                const seen = {};
                root.gpus = root.gpus.map(gpu => {
                    const r = readings[gpu.card];
                    if (!r)
                        return gpu;
                    const num = key => r[key] === undefined || r[key] === "" || isNaN(Number(r[key])) ? -1 : Number(r[key]);
                    let busy = num("busy");
                    // Intel counts the time spent idle (RC6); busy is the rest.
                    if (num("idle_ms") >= 0) {
                        const before = root.lastGpu[gpu.card];
                        busy = before && now > before.now ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 * (1 - (num("idle_ms") - before.idle) / (now - before.now)))) : -1;
                        seen[gpu.card] = { idle: num("idle_ms"), now };
                    }
                    const asleep = r.state === "asleep";
                    return Object.assign({}, gpu, {
                        asleep,
                        busy: asleep ? -1 : busy,
                        memUsed: num("mem_used"), memTotal: num("mem_total"),
                        temp: num("temp"), power: num("power"),
                        freq: num("freq"), maxFreq: num("max_freq"),
                        history: busy >= 0 || asleep ? root.push(gpu.history, Math.max(0, busy)) : gpu.history
                    });
                });
                root.lastGpu = seen;
            }
        }
    }
}
```
