## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Wallpaper.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtMultimedia
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Services.UPower
import Quickshell.Wayland

// Animated wallpapers: the dawn and eclipse scenes, and your GIFs and videos. Each sits on the
// bottom layer over awww's still copy of the same image (a GIF's or video's first frame), so
// fading it in or out changes nothing at rest; night and plain images have nothing to animate.
// Ui and penumbra-wallpaper say when the wallpaper changes; the settings page can keep them still, and
// they stop while tiled windows hide them and, if chosen, on battery or in power saver.
Scope {
    id: root

    // The chosen wallpaper; the animated one that should be up, and the one loaded now (they
    // differ while one fades out).
    property string chosen: ""
    // Depth widgets still need the layered scene when wallpaper motion is disabled.
    readonly property bool depthScene: Ui.wallpaperKind(chosen) === "scene"
        && (Settings.desktopClock || Settings.desktopAura)
    readonly property bool customDepth: chosen.startsWith("/") && Ui.wallpaperKind(chosen) === "still" && Settings.desktopClock
    property string depthMask: ""
    property string sceneMask: ""
    onSceneChanged: sceneMask = depthMask
    onChosenChanged: maskCheck.restart()
    onCustomDepthChanged: maskCheck.restart()
    Timer {
        id: maskCheck
        interval: 100
        onTriggered: {
            root.depthMask = "";
            if (!root.customDepth || maskProbe.running) return;
            maskProbe.wallpaper = root.chosen;
            maskProbe.candidate = root.chosen.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, "-fg.png");
            maskProbe.command = ["test", "-f", maskProbe.candidate];
            maskProbe.running = true;
        }
    }
    Process {
        id: maskProbe
        property string wallpaper
        property string candidate
        onExited: (exitCode, exitStatus) => {
            if (wallpaper !== root.chosen) maskCheck.restart();
            else if (root.customDepth && exitCode === 0) root.depthMask = candidate;
        }
    }
    readonly property string target: depthMask !== "" || depthScene || (Settings.animatedWallpapers && !Settings.reducedMotion
        && Ui.wallpaperKind(chosen) !== "still") ? chosen : ""
    property string scene: ""
    // awww's transition is still running.
    property bool waiting: false
    readonly property bool shown: target !== "" && scene === target && !waiting
    // Nothing to see behind the lock screen; stop drawing.
    property bool paused: false
    // Saving power: on battery, or in the power saver profile.
    readonly property bool saving: Settings.stillOnBattery
        && (UPower.onBattery || (Ui.hasPowerProfiles && PowerProfiles.profile === PowerProfile.PowerSaver))

    property real fade: shown ? 1 : 0
    Behavior on fade { NumberAnimation { duration: (root.shown ? 900 : 350) * Theme.motion; easing.type: Easing.InOutQuad } }
    onFadeChanged: if (fade === 0) scene = target
    onTargetChanged: if (fade === 0) scene = target

    // Wait out awww's transition before covering it.
    function show(name, delay) {
        chosen = name;
        waiting = delay > 0;
        if (waiting) {
            reveal.interval = delay;
            reveal.restart();
        }
    }
    Timer {
        id: reveal
        onTriggered: root.waiting = false
    }

    // Whether a window floats is only in Hyprland's IPC objects, which have to be asked for again
    // when windows open, close, move or float, and when workspaces change.
    readonly property bool watchCovers: Settings.stillWhenCovered && target !== ""
    onWatchCoversChanged: if (watchCovers) clients.restart()
    Connections {
        target: Hyprland
        enabled: root.watchCovers
        function onRawEvent(event) {
            if (["openwindow", "closewindow", "movewindow", "changefloatingmode", "workspace", "focusedmon", "moveworkspace"]
                    .includes(event.name.replace(/v2$/, "")))
                clients.restart();
        }
    }
    Timer {
        id: clients
        interval: 200
        onTriggered: Hyprland.refreshToplevels()
    }
    // A tiled window fills the workspace, gaps aside: the wallpaper is hidden.
    function covered(workspace) {
        return watchCovers && (workspace?.toplevels.values.some(t => t.lastIpcObject?.floating === false && !t.lastIpcObject.hidden) ?? false);
    }

    // Ui watches the state file. penumbra-wallpaper writes it, then calls show() with the delay;
    // if that call is missed, the file still has the last word, only without the wait.
    Connections {
        target: Ui
        function onWallpaperChanged() { follow.restart(); }
    }
    Timer {
        id: follow
        interval: 500
        onTriggered: if (root.chosen !== Ui.wallpaper) root.show(Ui.wallpaper, 0)
    }
    Component.onCompleted: follow.restart()

    Variants {
        model: Quickshell.screens

        delegate: Scope {
            id: output
            required property var modelData

            LazyLoader {
                active: root.fade > 0

                PanelWindow {
                    id: window
                    screen: output.modelData
                    anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
                    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
                    color: "transparent"
                    mask: Region {}
                    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Bottom
                    // Not penumbra-*: the glass layer rule would blur it.
                    WlrLayershell.namespace: "animated-wallpaper"

                    // Nothing to see under a fullscreen or tiled window; stop drawing.
                    readonly property var workspace: Hyprland.monitorFor(screen)?.activeWorkspace ?? null
                    readonly property bool running: Settings.animatedWallpapers && !Settings.reducedMotion && !root.paused && !root.saving
                        && !(workspace?.hasFullscreen ?? false) && !root.covered(workspace)

                    // Cover the screen like `awww img --resize crop`.
                    Loader {
                        id: scene
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        scale: item && item.width > 0 && item.height > 0 ? Math.max(window.width / item.width, window.height / item.height) : 1
                        opacity: root.fade
                        // Nothing for a still or no scene: a video player with no video would
                        // still load FFmpeg and wake the GPUs' video decoders.
                        sourceComponent: ({ "dawn": dawn, "eclipse": eclipse })[Ui.wallpaperScenes[root.scene]?.scene]
                            ?? ({ "gif": gif, "video": video })[Ui.wallpaperKind(root.scene)] ?? (root.customDepth ? depth : null)

                        Component {
                            id: depth
                            Item {
                                width: window.width; height: window.height
                                DesktopDepth {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    active: foreground.status === Image.Ready
                                    running: window.running
                                    center: Qt.point(parent.width / 2, parent.height / 2)
                                    orbitRadius: parent.height * 0.22
                                    clockY: parent.height * 0.15
                                    scale: Math.min(1, parent.width / 1100)
                                    transformOrigin: Item.Top
                                }
                                Image {
                                    id: foreground
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    source: Ui.fileUrl(root.sceneMask)
                                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                    asynchronous: true
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        Component {
                            id: dawn
                            DawnScene {
                                folder: Ui.wallpaperScenes[root.scene]?.folder ?? "dawn"
                                sceneTint: Ui.wallpaperScenes[root.scene]?.tint ?? "#c4a6ff"
                                desktop: true
                                running: window.running
                                pixelScale: Math.max(window.width / width, window.height / height) * window.devicePixelRatio
                            }
                        }
                        Component {
                            id: eclipse
                            EclipseScene {
                                folder: Ui.wallpaperScenes[root.scene]?.folder ?? "eclipse"
                                sceneTint: Ui.wallpaperScenes[root.scene]?.tint ?? "#c4a6ff"
                                desktop: true
                                running: window.running
                                pixelScale: Math.max(window.width / width, window.height / height) * window.devicePixelRatio
                            }
                        }
                        Component {
                            id: gif
                            AnimatedImage {
                                width: window.width
                                height: window.height
                                source: Ui.fileUrl(root.scene)
                                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                cache: false
                                playing: window.running
                            }
                        }
                        // Silent, looping, and with no audio output, so it never shows in the mixer.
                        Component {
                            id: video
                            VideoOutput {
                                id: clip
                                width: window.width
                                height: window.height
                                fillMode: VideoOutput.PreserveAspectCrop
                                readonly property bool running: window.running
                                onRunningChanged: running ? player.play() : player.pause()
                                MediaPlayer {
                                    id: player
                                    source: Ui.fileUrl(root.scene)
                                    videoOutput: clip
                                    loops: MediaPlayer.Infinite
                                    Component.onCompleted: if (clip.running) play()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/WallpaperPicker.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Qt.labs.folderlistmodel
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Widgets

// Penumbra's coordinated wallpapers, then the images, GIFs and videos in ~/Pictures/Wallpapers; click
// one, or pick it with the arrow keys and Enter, to switch with penumbra-wallpaper's transition.
Panel {
    id: root
    originKey: "wallpapers"
    anchors { top: true; right: true }
    margins.right: edgeMargin - shadowRoom
    preferredSheetWidth: 620
    open: Ui.wallpapersOpen
    onDismissed: Ui.dismiss()

    readonly property int cell: (sheetWidth - 36 - 20) / 3
    readonly property var scenes: Object.keys(Ui.wallpaperScenes).map(name => ({
        name: name, badge: Ui.wallpaperScenes[name].scene ? "Animated" : ""
    }))

    // Look again each time it opens: the folder may have been created or filled since, and new
    // videos need their first frame for a thumbnail.
    onOpenChanged: {
        if (!open)
            return;
        yours.folder = "";
        yours.folder = Ui.fileUrl(Ui.wallpaperFolder);
        posters.running = true;
        selectCurrent();
    }

    // The highlighted choice: Penumbra's three, then yours, read as one three-column grid.
    property int selected: 0
    property var customFiles: []
    function refreshFiles() {
        const files = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < yours.count; i++) {
            const path = yours.get(i, "filePath");
            if (path && !path.toLowerCase().endsWith("-fg.png")) files.push(path);
        }
        customFiles = files;
        if (open) selectCurrent();
    }
    readonly property int total: scenes.length + customFiles.length
    function selectCurrent() {
        const scene = scenes.findIndex(s => s.name === Ui.wallpaper);
        let mine = customFiles.length - 1;
        while (mine >= 0 && customFiles[mine] !== Ui.wallpaper)
            mine--;
        select(scene >= 0 ? scene : mine >= 0 ? scenes.length + mine : 0);
    }
    // The folder lists its files after the panel opens; find the current one among them.
    Connections {
        target: yours
        function onStatusChanged() {
            if (yours.status === FolderListModel.Ready && root.open)
                root.refreshFiles();
        }
        function onCountChanged() { root.refreshFiles(); }
    }
    function select(index) {
        selected = Math.max(0, Math.min(total - 1, index));
        const item = selected >= scenes.length ? mine.itemAt(selected - scenes.length) : builtins.itemAt(selected);
        if (!item) return;
        const y = item.mapToItem(content, 0, 0).y;
        if (y < scroller.contentY) scroller.contentY = y;
        else if (y + item.height > scroller.contentY + scroller.height)
            scroller.contentY = y + item.height - scroller.height;
    }
    function choose(index) {
        const name = index < scenes.length ? scenes[index].name : customFiles[index - scenes.length];
        if (name && name !== Ui.wallpaper)
            Ui.spawn([Ui.bin + "penumbra-wallpaper", name]);
    }
    keyTargets: [keys]
    Item {
        id: keys
        Keys.onLeftPressed: root.select(root.selected - 1)
        Keys.onRightPressed: root.select(root.selected + 1)
        Keys.onUpPressed: root.select(root.selected - 3)
        // From the last full row, down still reaches the shorter one below.
        Keys.onDownPressed: root.select(root.selected + 3 < root.total ? root.selected + 3 : Math.floor(root.selected / 3) < Math.floor((root.total - 1) / 3) ? root.total - 1 : root.selected)
        Keys.onTabPressed: root.select((root.selected + 1) % root.total)
        Keys.onBacktabPressed: root.select((root.selected + root.total - 1) % root.total)
        Keys.onPressed: event => {
            if (event.key === Qt.Key_Home)
                root.select(0);
            else if (event.key === Qt.Key_End)
                root.select(root.total - 1);
            else if ([Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter, Qt.Key_Space].includes(event.key))
                root.choose(root.selected);
            else
                return;
            event.accepted = true;
        }
    }
    FolderListModel {
        id: yours
        showDirs: false
        caseSensitive: false
        nameFilters: ["*.png", "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.webp", "*.bmp", "*.gif", "*.mp4", "*.webm", "*.mkv", "*.mov", "*.m4v"]
    }
    Process {
        id: posters
        command: [Ui.bin + "penumbra-wallpaper", "posters"]
        onExited: root.postersMade()
    }
    signal postersMade()

    component Choice: Column {
        id: choice
        required property string name
        property string badge: ""
        property url thumbnail
        // Its place among all the choices.
        required property int position
        readonly property bool current: Ui.wallpaper === name
        readonly property bool highlighted: root.selected === position
        width: root.cell
        spacing: 6

        ClippingRectangle {
            width: parent.width
            height: width * 9 / 16
            radius: Theme.radiusSmall
            color: Theme.raised
            border.width: choice.current ? 2 : 1
            border.color: choice.current ? Theme.accent : choice.highlighted ? Theme.lineStrong : Theme.line
            contentUnderBorder: true
            Image {
                id: thumb
                anchors.fill: parent
                source: choice.thumbnail
                sourceSize.width: 360
                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                asynchronous: true
                cache: false
                scale: choice.highlighted ? 1.04 : 1
                Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: Theme.normal; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
            }
            // A video's first frame may only just have been made.
            Connections {
                target: root
                function onPostersMade() {
                    if (thumb.status !== Image.Error)
                        return;
                    thumb.source = "";
                    thumb.source = choice.thumbnail;
                }
            }
            Glyph {
                visible: thumb.status !== Image.Ready
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                text: "󰸉"
                size: 22
                color: Theme.dim
            }
            Rectangle {
                visible: choice.badge !== ""
                anchors { left: parent.left; top: parent.top; margins: 8 }
                implicitWidth: badge.implicitWidth + 14
                implicitHeight: 20
                radius: Theme.corner(10)
                color: Theme.glassStrong
                Label {
                    id: badge
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    text: choice.badge
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                    color: Theme.accentBright
                }
            }
            MouseArea {
                id: area
                anchors.fill: parent
                hoverEnabled: true
                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                // The mouse and the arrow keys move the same highlight.
                onEntered: root.selected = choice.position
                onClicked: root.choose(choice.position)
            }
        }
        Row {
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            spacing: 6
            Rectangle {
                visible: choice.current
                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                width: 6
                height: 6
                radius: Theme.corner(3)
                color: Theme.accent
            }
            Label {
                width: Math.min(implicitWidth, root.cell - 12)
                text: Ui.wallpaperTitle(choice.name)
                font.weight: choice.current ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                color: choice.current || choice.highlighted ? Theme.text : Theme.muted
            }
        }
    }

    Flickable {
        id: scroller
        x: Theme.padding; y: Theme.padding
        width: root.sheetWidth - 2 * Theme.padding
        height: Math.min(content.implicitHeight, root.height - 2 * root.shadowRoom - 2 * Theme.padding)
        contentWidth: width
        contentHeight: content.implicitHeight
        clip: true
        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
        ColumnLayout {
            id: content
            width: scroller.width
            spacing: 12

            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Label {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: "Wallpaper"
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textLarge
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                }
                PillButton {
                    text: "Open folder"
                    onClicked: {
                        Ui.spawn(["bash", "-c", 'mkdir -p "$1" && exec xdg-open "$1"', "_", Ui.wallpaperFolder]);
                        Ui.dismiss();
                    }
                }
            }

            Overline { text: "Penumbra" }
            Grid {
                columns: 3
                spacing: 10
                Repeater {
                    id: builtins
                    model: root.scenes
                    delegate: Choice {
                        required property var modelData
                        required property int index
                        position: index
                        name: modelData.name
                        badge: modelData.badge
                        thumbnail: Ui.fileUrl(Ui.wallpapers + modelData.name + ".png")
                    }
                }
            }

            Overline { text: "Yours" }
            Label {
                visible: root.customFiles.length === 0
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                text: "Put images, GIFs and videos in ~/Pictures/Wallpapers, or right-click one in Lia Files or Dolphin and choose Set as Wallpaper."
                color: Theme.muted
            }
            Grid {
                id: grid
                visible: root.customFiles.length > 0
                columns: 3
                spacing: 10
                Repeater {
                    id: mine
                    model: root.customFiles
                    delegate: Choice {
                        required property string modelData
                        readonly property string filePath: modelData
                        required property int index
                        position: root.scenes.length + index
                        readonly property string kind: Ui.wallpaperKind(filePath)
                        name: filePath
                        badge: kind === "gif" ? "GIF" : kind === "video" ? "Video" : ""
                        thumbnail: Ui.fileUrl(kind === "video" ? Ui.wallpaperPoster(filePath) : filePath)
                    }
                }
            }

            Label {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: "Arrow keys and Enter pick one · Super+W cycles through them · the lock screen follows"
                font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
                color: Theme.dim
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/WallpaperScene.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick

// Base for an animated wallpaper scene, laid out in the SVG's own coordinates. Its layers are
// PNGs and a layers.js written by tools/build-wallpapers.py into `folder`, next to this file.
Item {
    id: root
    required property string folder
    required property var layers
    property bool running: true
    property color sceneTint: "#c4a6ff"
    // The lock screen leaves out the wordmark.
    property bool clean: false
    // Only the desktop opts in; lock-screen scenes never contain desktop widgets.
    property bool desktop: false
    // Device pixels per scene unit, so layers decode no larger than they are shown.
    property real pixelScale: 1

    // Seconds of animation; ticking at 30 Hz keeps the redraws cheap.
    property real t: 0
    Timer {
        interval: 33
        repeat: true
        running: root.running
        onTriggered: root.t += interval / 1000
    }
    function wave(period, phase = 0) {
        return Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * root.t / period + phase);
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/Weather.qml`

```qml
pragma Singleton
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

Singleton {
    id: root
    readonly property var place: Settings.weatherPlace == null ? NightLight.place : NightLight.locate(Settings.weatherPlace)
    readonly property string locationKey: place ? `${place.latitude},${place.longitude}` : ""
    property var result: ({})
    property string loaded: ""
    property double lastAttempt: 0
    readonly property var current: result.current ?? null
    readonly property bool stale: result.stale === true || (!!result.at && Clock.date.getTime() / 1000 - result.at > 3600)
    readonly property string description: {
        const code = current?.weather_code;
        if (code === 0) return "Clear sky";
        if (code <= 3) return "Cloudy";
        if (code === 45 || code === 48) return "Fog";
        if (code >= 51 && code <= 57) return "Drizzle";
        if (code >= 61 && code <= 67) return "Rain";
        if ((code >= 71 && code <= 77) || code === 85 || code === 86) return "Snow";
        if (code >= 80 && code <= 82) return "Showers";
        if (code >= 95) return "Thunderstorms";
        return "Weather";
    }
    function refresh() {
        if (!Settings.weatherEnabled || !place || request.running) return;
        if (loaded === locationKey && Date.now() - lastAttempt < 1800000) return;
        request.locationKey = locationKey;
        request.command = [Ui.bin + "penumbra-online", "weather", String(place.latitude), String(place.longitude)];
        loaded = locationKey;
        lastAttempt = Date.now();
        request.running = true;
    }
    onLocationKeyChanged: { result = {}; loaded = ""; settle.restart(); }
    Component.onCompleted: if (Settings.weatherEnabled) { NightLight.citiesWanted = true; settle.restart(); }
    Connections {
        target: Settings
        function onWeatherEnabledChanged() {
            root.result = {}; root.loaded = "";
            if (Settings.weatherEnabled) { NightLight.citiesWanted = true; settle.restart(); }
        }
    }
    Connections { target: Ui; function onCalendarOpenChanged() { if (Ui.calendarOpen) root.refresh(); } }
    Timer { id: settle; interval: 500; onTriggered: root.refresh() }
    Timer { interval: 1800000; repeat: true; running: Settings.weatherEnabled; onTriggered: root.refresh() }
    Process {
        id: request
        property string locationKey
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                if (!Settings.weatherEnabled || request.locationKey !== root.locationKey) return;
                try { root.result = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { root.result = { status: "offline" }; }
            }
        }
        onExited: {
            if (request.locationKey !== root.locationKey) settle.restart();
            else if (!root.result.status) root.result = { status: "offline" };
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/WifiPage.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell.Networking

// Wi-Fi networks: scan, connect (with a password when needed), disconnect and forget.
ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    property bool active: false
    readonly property var device: Devices.wifiDevice
    readonly property var networks: (device?.networks.values ?? [])
        .filter(n => n.name)
        .sort((a, b) => (b.connected - a.connected) || (b.known - a.known) || (Devices.strength(b) - Devices.strength(a)))
    property string expanded: ""
    property var failures: ({}) // network name → message

    spacing: 12

    // Scan only while the page is on screen.
    function updateScanner() {
        if (device)
            device.scannerEnabled = active && Networking.wifiEnabled;
    }
    onActiveChanged: { updateScanner(); if (!active) expanded = ""; }
    onDeviceChanged: updateScanner()
    // The control center builds the page when it is shown and drops it when it is left.
    Component.onCompleted: updateScanner()
    Component.onDestruction: if (device) device.scannerEnabled = false
    Connections {
        target: Networking
        function onWifiEnabledChanged() { root.updateScanner(); }
    }

    function fail(name, message) {
        failures = Object.assign({}, failures, { [name]: message });
    }
    function clearFailure(name) {
        const next = Object.assign({}, failures);
        delete next[name];
        failures = next;
    }

    PageHeader {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        title: "Wi-Fi"
        status: !root.device ? "No Wi-Fi adapter" : !Networking.wifiEnabled ? "Off" : Devices.wifiNetwork ? `Connected to ${Devices.wifiNetwork.name}` : "Not connected"
        showSwitch: !!root.device
        checked: Networking.wifiEnabled
        onBack: Ui.controlPage = "main"
        onToggled: Networking.wifiEnabled = !Networking.wifiEnabled
    }

    // Wired connection, while a cable is plugged in.
    ListRow {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        visible: Devices.wired
        glyph: "󰈀"
        title: "Ethernet"
        subtitle: "Connected"
        highlighted: true
    }

    Overline {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 2
        visible: !!root.device && Networking.wifiEnabled
        text: root.networks.length ? "Networks" : "Searching for networks…"
    }

    ListView {
        id: list
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.preferredHeight: Math.min(contentHeight, 380)
        visible: !!root.device && Networking.wifiEnabled
        clip: true
        spacing: 4
        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
        model: root.networks
        ScrollBar.vertical: ScrollBar { policy: list.contentHeight > list.height ? ScrollBar.AsNeeded : ScrollBar.AlwaysOff }

        delegate: ListRow {
            id: row
            required property var modelData
            readonly property var net: modelData
            readonly property bool secured: net.security !== WifiSecurityType.Open
            readonly property bool connecting: net.stateChanging || net.state === ConnectionState.Connecting
            readonly property string failure: root.failures[net.name] ?? ""

            width: ListView.view.width
            glyph: Devices.signalGlyph(net)
            title: net.name
            subtitle: failure !== "" ? failure : net.connected ? "Connected" : connecting ? "Connecting…" : net.known ? "Saved" : secured ? "Secured" : "Open"
            danger: failure !== ""
            trailing: secured ? "󰌾" : ""
            highlighted: net.connected
            busy: connecting
            expanded: root.expanded === net.name

            function connect() {
                root.clearFailure(net.name);
                if (net.known || !secured)
                    net.connect();
                else if (password.text !== "")
                    net.connectWithPsk(password.text);
            }

            onClicked: {
                const open = root.expanded === net.name;
                root.expanded = open ? "" : net.name;
                // Saved and open networks connect straight away; the row stays open for Forget.
                if (!open && !net.connected && (net.known || !secured))
                    connect();
                if (!open && !net.known && secured)
                    password.forceActiveFocus();
            }

            Connections {
                target: row.net
                function onConnectionFailed(reason) {
                    const wrongKey = reason === ConnectionFailReason.NoSecrets || reason === ConnectionFailReason.WifiAuthTimeout || reason === ConnectionFailReason.WifiClientFailed;
                    root.fail(row.net.name, wrongKey ? "Wrong password, or the network refused the connection" : "Couldn't connect");
                    root.expanded = row.net.name;
                }
                function onConnectedChanged() {
                    if (row.net.connected) {
                        root.clearFailure(row.net.name);
                        password.text = "";
                    }
                }
            }

            // Password entry for new secured networks.
            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: !row.net.known && row.secured
                spacing: 8
                TextField {
                    id: password
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    placeholderText: "Password"
                    echoMode: reveal.checked ? TextInput.Normal : TextInput.Password
                    color: Theme.text
                    placeholderTextColor: Theme.dim
                    selectionColor: Theme.accent
                    selectedTextColor: Theme.accentInk
                    font.family: Theme.sans
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.textBody
                    leftPadding: 12
                    rightPadding: 34
                    background: Rectangle {
                        implicitHeight: 32
                        radius: Theme.corner(10)
                        color: Theme.glassStrong
                        border.color: password.activeFocus ? Theme.accent : Theme.lineStrong
                    }
                    onAccepted: row.connect()
                    Glyph {
                        id: reveal
                        property bool checked: false
                        anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 10; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                        text: checked ? "󰈈" : "󰈉"
                        size: 14
                        color: Theme.muted
                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: -4
                            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                            onClicked: reveal.checked = !reveal.checked
                        }
                    }
                }
                PillButton {
                    text: "Connect"
                    primary: true
                    available: password.text !== "" && !row.connecting
                    onClicked: row.connect()
                }
            }

            Flow {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: row.net.known || row.net.connected || !row.secured
                spacing: 6
                PillButton {
                    visible: !row.net.connected
                    text: row.connecting ? "Connecting…" : "Connect"
                    primary: true
                    available: !row.connecting
                    onClicked: row.connect()
                }
                PillButton {
                    visible: row.net.connected
                    text: "Disconnect"
                    onClicked: row.net.disconnect()
                }
                PillButton {
                    visible: row.net.known
                    text: "Forget"
                    danger: true
                    onClicked: { row.net.forget(); root.expanded = ""; }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    ColumnLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.topMargin: 6
        Layout.bottomMargin: 6
        visible: !root.device || !Networking.wifiEnabled
        spacing: 4
        Glyph { Layout.fillWidth: true; text: "󰤭"; size: 28; color: Theme.dim }
        Label {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: !root.device ? "This computer has no Wi-Fi adapter" : "Wi-Fi is off"
            color: Theme.muted
        }
    }

    Label {
        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
        text: "Advanced network settings"
        font.pixelSize: Theme.textSmall
        color: advancedArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accentBright : Theme.muted
        MouseArea {
            id: advancedArea
            anchors.fill: parent
            anchors.margins: -4
            hoverEnabled: true
            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
            onClicked: { Ui.close(); Ui.run("nm-connection-editor"); }
        }
    }
}
```

```qml
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets

// One shared glass surface; the two edges of its active pill travel at different speeds.
Rectangle {
    id: root
    required property var workspaces
    // Compact to numbers when the rest of the bar needs the space.
    property string style: Settings.workspaceStyle
    property bool showIcons: style === "icons"
    readonly property int activeIndex: workspaces.findIndex(w => w.active)
    readonly property Item activeItem: spaces.count > activeIndex && activeIndex >= 0 ? spaces.itemAt(activeIndex) : null
    readonly property real targetLeft: activeItem ? activeItem.x + row.x : 4
    readonly property real targetRight: activeItem ? targetLeft + activeItem.width : 4
    property real previousLeft: 4
    property bool movingRight: true
    property bool ready: false
    onTargetLeftChanged: {
        movingRight = targetLeft >= previousLeft;
        previousLeft = targetLeft;
    }
    Component.onCompleted: Qt.callLater(() => root.ready = true)

    implicitWidth: row.implicitWidth + 8
    implicitHeight: Theme.barHeight
    radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
    color: Theme.glass
    border.color: Theme.line
    clip: true

    Rectangle {
        id: indicator
        property real leftEdge: root.targetLeft
        property real rightEdge: root.targetRight
        x: Math.min(leftEdge, rightEdge)
        y: 4
        width: Math.max(0, Math.abs(rightEdge - leftEdge))
        height: parent.height - 8
        radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
        visible: !!root.activeItem
        gradient: Gradient {
            orientation: Gradient.Horizontal
            GradientStop { position: 0; color: Theme.accentBright }
            GradientStop { position: 1; color: Theme.accent }
        }
        Behavior on leftEdge {
            enabled: root.ready
            NumberAnimation { duration: (root.movingRight ? 340 : 220) * Theme.motion; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
        }
        Behavior on rightEdge {
            enabled: root.ready
            NumberAnimation { duration: (root.movingRight ? 220 : 340) * Theme.motion; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
        }
        GlassEdge { radius: indicator.radius; strength: 0.55 }
    }

    GlassEdge { radius: root.radius; strength: 0.2 }
    Row {
        id: row
        x: 4
        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
        spacing: 2
        Repeater {
            id: spaces
            model: ScriptModel { values: root.workspaces }
            delegate: Rectangle {
                id: workspace
                required property var modelData
                readonly property bool current: modelData.active
                readonly property var windows: modelData.toplevels.values
                readonly property string tip: "Workspace " + modelData.name + (windows.length ? " · " + windows.length + " windows" : "")
                width: root.style === "dots" ? 28 : Math.max(36, contents.implicitWidth + 20)
                height: root.height - 8
                radius: Theme.corner(height / 2)
                color: current ? "transparent" : modelData.urgent ? Theme.alpha(Theme.rose, 0.3) : mouse.containsMouse ? Theme.hover : "transparent"
                Behavior on color { enabled: !Theme.fading; ColorAnimation { duration: Theme.fast } }
                RowLayout {
                    id: contents
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    spacing: 5
                    Rectangle {
                        visible: root.style === "dots"
                        implicitWidth: 7; implicitHeight: 7
                        radius: Theme.corner(3.5)
                        color: workspace.current ? Theme.accentInk : workspace.modelData.urgent ? Theme.rose : Theme.muted
                    }
                    Label {
                        visible: root.style !== "dots"
                        text: workspace.modelData.name
                        color: workspace.current ? Theme.accentInk : workspace.modelData.urgent ? Theme.rose : Theme.textSoft
                        font.weight: workspace.current ? Font.Bold : Font.DemiBold
                    }
                    Repeater {
                        model: root.showIcons ? workspace.windows.slice(0, 2) : []
                        delegate: Item {
                            id: app
                            required property var modelData
                            readonly property string appId: modelData.wayland?.appId || modelData.lastIpcObject?.class || ""
                            readonly property var entry: appId ? DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(appId) : null
                            implicitWidth: 15
                            implicitHeight: 15
                            IconImage {
                                id: icon
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                source: app.entry?.icon ? Quickshell.iconPath(app.entry.icon, true) : ""
                                asynchronous: true
                            }
                            Glyph {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                visible: icon.status !== Image.Ready
                                text: "󰣆"
                                size: 13
                                color: workspace.current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.subtle
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Label {
                        visible: root.showIcons && workspace.windows.length > 2
                        text: "+" + (workspace.windows.length - 2)
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.textTiny
                        color: workspace.current ? Theme.accentInk : Theme.subtle
                    }
                }
                MouseArea {
                    id: mouse
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    hoverEnabled: true
                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                    onClicked: workspace.modelData.activate()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/eclipse/aurora.frag`

```glsl
#version 440
// Aurora over the near world's horizon: curtains that fold and drift along the arc, fine rays,
// violet at the base turning rose higher up, and a faint glow on the night side below.
// Compiled to aurora.frag.qsb by tools/build-shaders.py or tools/build-wallpapers.py.
layout(location = 0) in vec2 qt_TexCoord0;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragColor;
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform buf {
    mat4 qt_Matrix;
    float qt_Opacity;
    float time;
    vec2 size;      // item size, scene units
    vec2 center;    // world center, relative to the item
    float radius;   // world radius
    float arcFrom;  // where the aurora starts and ends, radians from the top of the world
    float arcTo;
    float bass;
    float mids;
    float treble;
    float audioActive;
    vec4 sceneTint;
};

void main() {
    vec2 p = qt_TexCoord0 * size;
    vec2 d = p - center;
    float h = length(d) - radius;
    float a = atan(d.x, -d.y);
    float u = (a - arcFrom) / (arcTo - arcFrom);
    float s = a * radius;

    float envelope = smoothstep(0.0, 0.22, u) * smoothstep(1.0, 0.7, u);
    float fold = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 0.011 - time * 0.45 + 1.8 * sin(s * 0.0037 + time * 0.12));
    float ripple = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 0.029 + time * 0.9 + 2.0 * sin(s * 0.006 - time * 0.3));
    float rays = 0.74 + 0.16 * sin(s * 0.21 + 4.0 * sin(s * 0.012 - time * 0.55)) + 0.1 * sin(s * 0.083 - time * 0.3);

    // Low to high frequencies spread along the horizon, blended into continuous curtains.
    float energy = mix(bass, mids, smoothstep(0.0, 0.5, u));
    energy = mix(energy, treble, smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, u));
    float top = 150.0 + 130.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 0.005 + time * 0.2));
    float strength = 1.0;
    if (audioActive > 0.5) {
        // Replace the timed drift with spectrum-driven folds, rays and height. Silence
        // settles to a low, faint rim; bass beats lift the whole horizon, while mids and
        // treble shape their own sections. No motion here is driven by elapsed time.
        fold = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 0.011 - bass * 2.5 + 1.8 * sin(s * 0.0037 + mids * 2.0));
        ripple = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 0.029 + mids * 3.0 + 2.0 * sin(s * 0.006 - treble * 2.0));
        rays = 0.74 + 0.16 * sin(s * 0.21 + 4.0 * sin(s * 0.012 - treble * 2.5))
            + 0.1 * sin(s * 0.083 - mids * 2.0);
        top = 45.0 + 320.0 * energy + 100.0 * bass;
        strength = 0.12 + 2.6 * energy + 0.5 * bass;
    }
    float light = fold * (0.35 + 0.65 * ripple);
    // Curtains thin out well before the top of the item, so its edge never shows.
    float curtain = smoothstep(0.0, 22.0, h) * exp(-max(h, 0.0) / top) * (1.0 - smoothstep(top, top * 2.0, h)) * rays;
    float below = exp(min(h, 0.0) / 40.0) * (1.0 - step(0.0, h)) * 0.35;

    float alpha = 0.55 * envelope * light * (curtain + below) * smoothstep(0.0, 160.0, p.y);
    alpha = min(0.9, alpha * strength);
    vec3 color = mix(sceneTint.rgb, mix(sceneTint.rgb, vec3(1.0), 0.22), smoothstep(30.0, 260.0, h));
    fragColor = vec4(color * alpha, alpha) * qt_Opacity;
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/lyrics.js`

```javascript
.pragma library

// Multiple timestamps per line, fractional seconds and global LRC offsets are common.
function parse(text) {
    const offset = Number(/\[offset:\s*([+-]?\d+)\]/i.exec(text)?.[1] ?? 0) / 1000;
    const lines = [];
    for (const row of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const stamps = [], pattern = /\[(\d+):([0-5]\d)(?:\.(\d{1,3}))?\]/g;
        let match;
        while ((match = pattern.exec(row)) !== null) stamps.push(match);
        const words = row.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, "").trim();
        for (const stamp of stamps)
            lines.push({ time: Math.max(0, Number(stamp[1]) * 60 + Number(stamp[2]) + Number("0." + (stamp[3] || "0")) + offset), text: words });
    }
    return lines.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
}

// A binary search also handles seeking backwards and tracks with long introductions.
function current(lines, seconds) {
    let low = 0, high = lines.length;
    while (low < high) {
        const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
        if (lines[mid].time <= seconds) low = mid + 1;
        else high = mid;
    }
    return low - 1;
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/oklch.js`

```javascript
.pragma library
// OKLCH (lightness 0–1, chroma, hue in degrees) to #rrggbb and back, as share/penumbra/palette.py
// does it: for swatches of accents the shell isn't showing yet, and for colours typed in.

function linear(L, C, H) {
    const a = C * Math.cos(H * Math.PI / 180), b = C * Math.sin(H * Math.PI / 180);
    const l = Math.pow(L + 0.3963377774 * a + 0.2158037573 * b, 3);
    const m = Math.pow(L - 0.1055613458 * a - 0.0638541728 * b, 3);
    const s = Math.pow(L - 0.0894841775 * a - 1.2914855480 * b, 3);
    return [4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s,
            -1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s,
            -0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.7076147010 * s];
}

function gamma(c) {
    c = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, c));
    return c <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * c : 1.055 * Math.pow(c, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055;
}

// Out of the sRGB gamut, chroma is lowered until it fits; L and H stay.
function color(L, C, H) {
    const fits = c => linear(L, c, H).every(x => x >= -1e-4 && x <= 1 + 1e-4);
    if (!fits(C)) {
        let low = 0, high = C;
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            const middle = (low + high) / 2;
            if (fits(middle))
                low = middle;
            else
                high = middle;
        }
        C = low;
    }
    return "#" + linear(L, C, H).map(x => Math.round(gamma(x) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function toLinear(c) {
    return c <= 0.04045 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
}

// #rrggbb (or #rgb, the # optional) to [L, C, H], or null when it isn't one.
function fromHex(text) {
    let hex = String(text).trim().replace(/^#/, "");
    if (/^[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(hex))
        hex = hex.split("").map(x => x + x).join("");
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(hex))
        return null;
    const [r, g, b] = [0, 2, 4].map(i => toLinear(parseInt(hex.substr(i, 2), 16) / 255));
    const l = Math.cbrt(0.4122214708 * r + 0.5363325363 * g + 0.0514459929 * b);
    const m = Math.cbrt(0.2119034982 * r + 0.6806995451 * g + 0.1073969566 * b);
    const s = Math.cbrt(0.0883024619 * r + 0.2817188376 * g + 0.6299787005 * b);
    const L = 0.2104542553 * l + 0.7936177850 * m - 0.0040720468 * s;
    const a = 1.9779984951 * l - 2.4285922050 * m + 0.4505937099 * s;
    const bb = 0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.8086757660 * s;
    return [L, Math.hypot(a, bb), (Math.atan2(bb, a) * 180 / Math.PI + 360) % 360];
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/processes.js`

```javascript
.pragma library

// The system monitor's process list: top's last sample, grouped into apps by systemd unit.
// Apps started by the shell, a launcher or an autostart file each run in their own scope or
// service under app.slice, so a unit is one app, all of its processes and nothing else. Processes
// in a unit shared by unrelated programs (the compositor's, a login session's) are grouped by
// executable within it, and interpreters and shells there one process at a time: ending "python3"
// must not end every Python script.

// Units that hold whatever was started from them rather than one app.
function shared(unit) {
    return /^(session-.*\.scope|init\.scope|user@\d+\.service|wayland-wm@.*\.service|.*\.slice)$/.test(unit);
}

// Programs that run something else, so their name says nothing about the app.
var interpreters = ["sh", "bash", "dash", "zsh", "fish", "python", "python3", "perl", "ruby", "node", "lua", "env"];
function interpreter(exe) {
    return interpreters.includes(exe) || /^python3\.\d+$/.test(exe);
}

// The desktop's own pieces: ending one would end the session, its lock screen or this list.
function guarded(unit, exe) {
    return unit.startsWith("penumbra-") || ["Hyprland", "quickshell", "systemd", "hypridle"].includes(exe);
}

// cgroups(text) → { pid: path } from `grep -H '' /proc/[0-9]*/cgroup`, which prints
// "/proc/PID/cgroup:0::/user.slice/…/app-firefox@1.scope" (cgroup v2's line is the "0::" one).
function cgroups(text) {
    const paths = {};
    for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
        const m = line.match(/^\/proc\/(\d+)\/cgroup:0::(.*)$/);
        if (m)
            paths[m[1]] = m[2];
    }
    return paths;
}

// The unit at the end of a cgroup path, and whether it is one of the user's own (so
// `systemctl --user` can signal it).
function unitOf(path) {
    const parts = (path ?? "").split("/").filter(p => p);
    const unit = parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "";
    return { unit: /\.(scope|service)$/.test(unit) ? unit : "", user: /\/user@\d+\.service\//.test(path ?? "") };
}

// The PID a scope was made by, when its name says so: systemd-run's run-pPID-iN.scope, or
// kitty-PID-N.scope (a terminal's tabs); 0 otherwise. Apps' own scopes (app-…) stand alone.
function parent(unit) {
    const m = unit.match(/^(?:run-p(\d+)-i\d+|(?!app-)[a-z][\w.]*-(\d+)-\d+)\.scope$/);
    return m ? Number(m[1] ?? m[2]) : 0;
}

// The desktop file ID in a unit named the XDG way, app-[LAUNCHER-]ID-RANDOM.scope or
// app-[LAUNCHER-]ID@RANDOM.service, with systemd's \x escapes undone; "" otherwise.
function appId(unit) {
    const m = unit.match(/^app-(.+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]+\.scope|@[^@]*\.service|\.service|\.scope)$/);
    return m ? m[1].replace(/\\x([0-9a-f]{2})/gi, (_, hex) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(hex, 16))) : "";
}

// The program a command line runs; for an interpreter, its script ("python3 /x/penumbra-cast …"
// is penumbra-cast).
function program(command) {
    const words = command.split(" ").filter(w => w);
    const exe = (words[0] ?? "").split("/").pop().replace(/^-/, "").replace(/:$/, "");
    if (!interpreter(exe))
        return { exe, name: exe };
    const script = words.slice(1).find(w => !w.startsWith("-") && !w.includes("="));
    return { exe, name: script && exe !== "env" ? script.split("/").pop() : exe };
}

// RES is in KiB, but top shortens values too wide for the column (e.g. 10.2g).
function kib(value) {
    const scale = { m: 1024, g: 1048576, t: 1073741824 }[value.slice(-1)];
    return scale ? parseFloat(value) * scale : Number(value);
}

// group(top, cgroupText) → [{ key, units, exe, name, appId, cpu, mem, pids, user, guarded }]:
// one per app. `top` is `top -b -n 2 -c` output (only the last sample counts), the sampling itself
// left out. `units` lists the user units to signal when every process came from one, else is empty
// and the PIDs are signalled.
function group(top, cgroupText) {
    const lines = top.split("\n");
    let start = lines.length;
    for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (/^\s*PID\s+USER/.test(lines[i])) {
            start = i + 1;
            break;
        }
    }
    const paths = cgroups(cgroupText);
    const found = {};
    const keyOf = {}; // pid → key
    const made = {}; // key → the PID that made its scope
    for (const line of lines.slice(start)) {
        // PID USER PR NI VIRT RES SHR S %CPU %MEM TIME+ COMMAND
        const m = line.match(/^\s*(\d+)\s+(\S+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+(\S+)\s+\S+\s+\S\s+([\d.]+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+(.+)$/);
        if (!m || m[5].includes("top -b -n 2"))
            continue;
        const pid = m[1], command = m[5];
        let key, unit = "", userUnit = false, exe, name;
        if (command.startsWith("[")) {
            key = "kernel";
            exe = name = "kernel";
        } else {
            ({ exe, name } = program(command));
            if (!exe)
                continue;
            const u = unitOf(paths[pid]);
            if (u.unit && !shared(u.unit)) {
                key = u.unit;
                unit = u.unit;
                userUnit = u.user;
                if (parent(unit))
                    made[key] = parent(unit);
            } else {
                // Shared or unknown: by program within the unit, interpreters one by one.
                key = (interpreter(exe) ? `${name}#${pid}` : exe) + "@" + (u.unit || "?");
            }
        }
        if (!found[key])
            found[key] = { key, units: [], loose: false, exe: "", name: "", appId: appId(unit), cpu: 0, mem: 0, pids: [], user: m[2], guarded: false, lowest: Infinity };
        const g = found[key];
        keyOf[pid] = key;
        g.cpu += Number(m[4]);
        g.mem += kib(m[3]);
        g.pids.push(pid);
        if (g.user !== m[2])
            g.user = "";
        if (userUnit && !g.units.includes(unit))
            g.units.push(unit);
        else if (!userUnit)
            g.loose = true;
        g.guarded = g.guarded || guarded(unit, exe);
        // An app's name is its first program that is not a wrapper, else its first.
        const rank = Number(pid) + (interpreter(exe) ? 1e9 : 0);
        if (rank < g.lowest) {
            g.lowest = rank;
            g.exe = exe;
            g.name = name;
        }
    }
    // A scope an app made for its helpers is part of that app, unless the app is the desktop's
    // (the shell starts every app in a scope of its own: those stay apart).
    for (const key in made) {
        const into = found[keyOf[made[key]]];
        const from = found[key];
        if (!into || into === from || into.guarded || into.key === "kernel")
            continue;
        into.cpu += from.cpu;
        into.mem += from.mem;
        into.pids = into.pids.concat(from.pids);
        into.units = into.units.concat(from.units.filter(u => !into.units.includes(u)));
        into.loose = into.loose || from.loose;
        if (into.user !== from.user)
            into.user = "";
        into.guarded = into.guarded || from.guarded;
        delete found[key];
    }
    return Object.values(found).map(g => {
        if (g.loose)
            g.units = [];
        delete g.loose;
        delete g.lowest;
        return g;
    });
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/search.js`

```javascript
.pragma library

// The launcher's matching, kept apart from Launcher.qml so it can be tested (tests/shell).

// Every term in the name or group; names that start with the first term come first, and
// often-picked characters rise (`picks`: how often this one was picked). Everything matches no
// terms, most picked first.
function charScore(c, terms, picks) {
    const boost = Math.min(40, picks ?? 0);
    if (!terms.length)
        return 1 + boost;
    const name = c.name.toLowerCase(), all = name + " " + c.group.toLowerCase();
    if (!terms.every(t => all.includes(t)))
        return 0;
    const first = terms[0];
    const s = name === terms.join(" ") ? 100 : name.startsWith(first) ? 60 : name.split(/[\s:\-]+/).some(w => w.startsWith(first)) ? 40 : 10;
    return s + boost;
}

// Frecency: each launch adds 1 to an app's score, and the score halves every `halfLife` days, so
// apps used often *lately* rise and old habits fade. A record is { score, at } (at: ms since the
// epoch); a bare number is a launch count from before, taken as that many recent launches.
var halfLife = 14;
function frecency(record, now) {
    if (typeof record === "number")
        return Math.min(record, 15);
    if (!record || !(record.score > 0))
        return 0;
    return record.score * Math.pow(0.5, Math.max(0, now - record.at) / (halfLife * 86400000));
}
function launched(record, now) {
    return { score: frecency(record, now) + 1, at: now };
}
// The boost frecency gives a match: up to 15, rising quickly then slowly, so apps never tie at a cap.
function boost(uses) {
    return 15 * (1 - Math.exp(-(uses ?? 0) / 5));
}

// Name matches first, then initials and scattered letters, then descriptions; often-launched
// apps rise a little (`uses`: the app's frecency). Everything matches an empty query.
function score(entry, q, uses) {
    const lift = boost(uses);
    if (!q)
        return 1 + lift;
    const name = entry.name.toLowerCase();
    let s = 0;
    if (name === q)
        s = 120;
    else if (name.startsWith(q))
        s = 100;
    else if (name.split(/[\s\-_.]+/).some(w => w.startsWith(q)))
        s = 85;
    else if (name.includes(q))
        s = 70;
    else if (fuzzy(name, q))
        s = 30 + fuzzy(name, q);
    else if ([entry.genericName, entry.keywords.join(" "), entry.comment, entry.id].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q))
        s = 25;
    return s ? s + lift : 0;
}

// A desktop action ("New Private Window" of Firefox) for a query of three letters or more: every
// word in the app's name and the action's together; the action's own name matching scores more.
function actionScore(appName, actionName, q) {
    if (q.length < 3)
        return 0;
    const action = actionName.toLowerCase(), all = appName.toLowerCase() + " " + action;
    if (!q.split(/\s+/).every(t => all.includes(t)))
        return 0;
    return action.includes(q) ? 60 : 45;
}

// Letters of q in order inside name; fewer gaps score higher (1–30), no match is 0.
function fuzzy(name, q) {
    let at = -1, gaps = 0;
    for (const c of q) {
        const next = name.indexOf(c, at + 1);
        if (next < 0)
            return 0;
        gaps += next - at - 1;
        at = next;
    }
    return Math.max(1, 30 - gaps);
}

// Arithmetic and Math functions only; anything else is not a sum.
var mathNames = {
    pi: "Math.PI", e: "Math.E", sqrt: "Math.sqrt", cbrt: "Math.cbrt", abs: "Math.abs", round: "Math.round",
    floor: "Math.floor", ceil: "Math.ceil", sin: "Math.sin", cos: "Math.cos", tan: "Math.tan",
    asin: "Math.asin", acos: "Math.acos", atan: "Math.atan", ln: "Math.log", log: "Math.log10",
    exp: "Math.exp", min: "Math.min", max: "Math.max", pow: "Math.pow"
};
// The value of a sum ("2+2", "=12", "sqrt(2)", "3,5*2"), or null when the text is not one.
function calculate(text) {
    const forced = text.startsWith("=");
    let expr = text.replace(/^=/, "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!expr || !/^[\d\s+\-*/%^().,a-z]+$/.test(expr) || !/\d|pi/.test(expr))
        return null;
    // A sum needs an operator or a function; a bare number is a search.
    if (!forced && !/[+\-*/%^]|[a-z]+\s*\(/.test(expr.replace(/^-/, "")))
        return null;
    // A comma is a decimal point (3,5), unless it separates a function's arguments.
    if (!/[a-z]\s*\(/.test(expr))
        expr = expr.replace(/(\d),(\d)/g, "$1.$2");
    let unknown = false;
    expr = expr.replace(/\^/g, "**")
        .replace(/[a-z]+/g, word => mathNames[word] ?? (unknown = true, word));
    if (unknown)
        return null;
    try {
        const value = Function(`"use strict"; return (${expr});`)();
        return typeof value === "number" && isFinite(value) ? Number(value.toPrecision(12)) : null;
    } catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
}

// Unit conversion: "10 km in mi", "5kg to lb", "70 f in c", "2 GiB in MB". Each unit is a factor to
// its kind's base unit (temperatures convert through kelvin). Returns { value, unit } or null.
var units = {
    length: { mm: 0.001, cm: 0.01, m: 1, km: 1000, in: 0.0254, inch: 0.0254, inches: 0.0254, ft: 0.3048, feet: 0.3048, foot: 0.3048, yd: 0.9144, mi: 1609.344, mile: 1609.344, miles: 1609.344, nmi: 1852 },
    mass: { mg: 1e-6, g: 0.001, kg: 1, t: 1000, oz: 0.028349523125, lb: 0.45359237, lbs: 0.45359237, st: 6.35029318 },
    volume: { ml: 0.001, cl: 0.01, dl: 0.1, l: 1, tsp: 0.00492892159375, tbsp: 0.01478676478125, floz: 0.0295735295625, cup: 0.2365882365, pt: 0.473176473, qt: 0.946352946, gal: 3.785411784 },
    data: { b: 1, kb: 1e3, mb: 1e6, gb: 1e9, tb: 1e12, kib: 1024, mib: 1048576, gib: 1073741824, tib: 1099511627776 },
    time: { ms: 0.001, s: 1, sec: 1, min: 60, h: 3600, hr: 3600, hours: 3600, d: 86400, days: 86400, wk: 604800, week: 604800, weeks: 604800, yr: 31557600, year: 31557600, years: 31557600 },
    speed: { "m/s": 1, "km/h": 1 / 3.6, kmh: 1 / 3.6, kph: 1 / 3.6, mph: 0.44704, kn: 0.514444, knots: 0.514444 },
    area: { m2: 1, km2: 1e6, ha: 1e4, acre: 4046.8564224, acres: 4046.8564224, ft2: 0.09290304, sqft: 0.09290304 }
};
var temperatures = { c: "c", "°c": "c", celsius: "c", f: "f", "°f": "f", fahrenheit: "f", k: "k", kelvin: "k" };
function convert(text) {
    const m = /^\s*(-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*([a-z°/0-9]+)\s+(?:in|to|as|->)\s+([a-z°/0-9]+)\s*$/i.exec(text);
    if (!m)
        return null;
    const amount = Number(m[1].replace(",", ".")), from = m[2].toLowerCase(), to = m[3].toLowerCase();
    if (temperatures[from] && temperatures[to]) {
        const toK = { c: v => v + 273.15, f: v => (v - 32) * 5 / 9 + 273.15, k: v => v }[temperatures[from]];
        const fromK = { c: v => v - 273.15, f: v => (v - 273.15) * 9 / 5 + 32, k: v => v }[temperatures[to]];
        return { value: Number(fromK(toK(amount)).toPrecision(6)), unit: { c: "°C", f: "°F", k: "K" }[temperatures[to]] };
    }
    for (const kind in units) {
        const table = units[kind];
        // Data units are case-sensitive in spirit (b is a byte here), but people type them any way.
        if (from in table && to in table)
            return { value: Number((amount * table[from] / table[to]).toPrecision(6)), unit: m[3] };
    }
    return null;
}
// A currency conversion, "100 usd in eur" or "20€ to $": { amount, from, to } in ISO codes, or null.
var currencySigns = { "$": "USD", "€": "EUR", "£": "GBP", "¥": "JPY", "₹": "INR", "₩": "KRW", "₽": "RUB", "₺": "TRY", "₿": "" };
function currency(text) {
    const m = /^\s*([$€£¥₹₩₺])?\s*(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*([a-z]{3}|[$€£¥₹₩₺])?\s+(?:in|to)\s+([a-z]{3}|[$€£¥₹₩₺])\s*$/i.exec(text);
    if (!m || (!m[1] && !m[3]) || (m[1] && m[3]))
        return null;
    const code = t => currencySigns[t] ?? t.toUpperCase();
    const from = code(m[1] || m[3]), to = code(m[4]);
    if (!from || !to || from === to)
        return null;
    return { amount: Number(m[2].replace(",", ".")), from, to };
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/shaders/card-light.frag`

```glsl
#version 440
layout(location = 0) in vec2 qt_TexCoord0;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragColor;
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform buf {
    mat4 qt_Matrix;
    float qt_Opacity;
    float radius;
    vec2 pointer;
    float glow;
    vec2 size;
    vec4 tint;
    vec4 light;
};
void main() {
    vec2 p = qt_TexCoord0 * size;
    float r = min(radius, min(size.x, size.y) * .5);
    vec2 q = abs(p - .5 * size) - .5 * size + r;
    float d = min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.) + length(max(q, 0.)) - r;
    float mask = clamp(.5 - d, 0., 1.);
    float wash = .035 * (1. - qt_TexCoord0.y);
    float spot = .12 * glow * exp(-dot(p - pointer, p - pointer) / 7000.);
    fragColor = vec4(light.rgb * wash + tint.rgb * spot, wash + spot) * mask * qt_Opacity;
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/shaders/glass-edge.frag`

```glsl
#version 440
// GlassEdge: a 1 px ring with top-left light and a faint bottom-right accent reflection.
// Drawn in one pass, with no offscreen layer or mask.
// Compiled to glass-edge.frag.qsb by tools/build-shaders.py.
layout(location = 0) in vec2 qt_TexCoord0;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragColor;
layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform buf {
    mat4 qt_Matrix;
    float qt_Opacity;
    vec2 size;      // item size, pixels
    float radius;   // corner radius, pixels
    float edge;     // peak alpha
    vec4 tint;      // the light's colour, opaque
    vec4 reflection; // the accent reflection, opaque
};

// Signed distance to a rounded rectangle of half size b centred on the origin.
float box(vec2 p, vec2 b, float r) {
    vec2 q = abs(p) - b + r;
    return min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0) + length(max(q, 0.0)) - r;
}

void main() {
    vec2 p = qt_TexCoord0 * size;
    float r = min(radius, 0.5 * min(size.x, size.y));
    float d = box(p - 0.5 * size, 0.5 * size, r);
    // Coverage of the band between the outer edge and 1 px inside it, antialiased.
    float ring = clamp(0.5 - d, 0.0, 1.0) - clamp(-0.5 - d, 0.0, 1.0);
    // Normalise in surface coordinates so even a very wide capsule catches light along its top.
    vec2 direction = qt_TexCoord0 - 0.5;
    direction /= max(length(direction), 0.0001);
    float light = dot(direction, vec2(-0.6, -0.8));
    float specular = pow(max(light, 0.0), 1.5);
    float bounce = 0.18 * pow(max(-light, 0.0), 1.5);
    float coverage = ring * edge * qt_Opacity;
    fragColor = vec4((tint.rgb * specular + reflection.rgb * bounce) * coverage,
                     (specular + bounce) * coverage);
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/shell.qml`

```qml
//@ pragma UseQApplication
//@ pragma IconTheme Penumbra
// PENUMBRA shell: animated wallpapers, bar, control center, notifications, OSD, calendar, session
// overlay, launcher, workspace overview, lock screen, polkit agent and screenshot/recording overlay.
// Run with `quickshell -c penumbra`; scripts talk to it with `quickshell -c penumbra ipc call …`.
import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io

ShellRoot {
    Wallpaper {
        id: wallpaper
        paused: lockScreen.locked
    }

    Variants {
        model: Quickshell.screens
        delegate: Scope {
            id: output
            required property var modelData
            ScreenFrame { modelData: output.modelData }
            Bar { modelData: output.modelData }
            Dock { modelData: output.modelData; locked: lockScreen.locked }
        }
    }

    ControlCenter {}
    CalendarPanel {}
    MonitorPanel {}
    UpdatesPanel {}
    WallpaperPicker {}
    NotificationPopups {}
    Osd {}
    SessionMenu {}
    Launcher {}
    HotCorners {}
    PolkitDialog {}
    ScreenshotOverlay {
        id: shot
    }
    Overview {}
    LockScreen {
        id: lockScreen
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "osd"
        function flash(kind: string, value: int, muted: bool): void {
            Ui.showOsd(kind, value, muted);
        }
        // What the volume, microphone and brightness keys do: penumbra-osd calls this first.
        // `action` is up, down, mute or current (just show the popup).
        function adjust(control: string, action: string): bool {
            return control === "brightness" ? Sys.stepBrightness(action) : Devices.adjust(control, action);
        }
        // Hyprland calls this when Caps Lock is released; the popup says whether it is on.
        function capsLock(): void {
            Devices.showCapsLock();
        }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "panel"
        function control(): void { Ui.toggle("control"); }
        function wifi(): void { Ui.openControl("wifi"); }
        function bluetooth(): void { Ui.openControl("bluetooth"); }
        function mixer(): void { Ui.openControl("mixer"); }
        function cast(): void { Ui.openControl("cast"); }
        function settings(): void { Ui.openControl("settings"); }
        // A page of Settings: look, displays, keyboard, idle or apps; or night (night light).
        function page(name: string): void { Ui.openControl(name); }
        function overview(): void { Ui.toggleOverview(); }
        function calendar(): void { Ui.toggle("calendar"); }
        function monitor(): void { Ui.toggle("monitor"); }
        function session(): void { Ui.openSession(); }
        function updates(): void { Ui.toggle("updates"); }
        function wallpapers(): void { Ui.toggle("wallpapers"); }
        function close(): void { Ui.closeOverlays(); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "launcher"
        function apps(): void { Ui.toggleLauncher("apps"); }
        function clipboard(): void { Ui.toggleLauncher("clipboard"); }
        function emoji(): void { Ui.toggleLauncher("emoji"); }
        function symbols(): void { Ui.toggleLauncher("symbols"); }
        function windows(): void { Ui.toggleLauncher("windows"); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "shot"
        function open(annotate: bool): void { shot.open(annotate, false); }
        // The same overlay, set to record a video.
        function record(): void { shot.open(false, true); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "recorder"
        // penumbra-record calls this when a recording starts or ends.
        function refresh(): void { Recorder.refresh(); }
        function stop(): void { Recorder.stop(); }
        function pause(): void { Recorder.togglePause(); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "cast"
        // penumbra-cast calls this when a cast starts, connects or ends.
        function refresh(): void { Cast.refresh(); }
        function stop(): void { Cast.stop(); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "lock"
        // False if the compositor refused; hypridle then falls back to hyprlock.
        function lock(): bool { return lockScreen.lock(); }
        function isLocked(): bool { return lockScreen.locked; }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "nightlight"
        function toggle(): void { NightLight.toggle(); }
        function isOn(): bool { return NightLight.on; }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "notifications"
        function clear(): void { Notifs.clear(); }
        function dnd(): void { Notifs.toggleDnd(); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "wallpaper"
        // `delay` is how long awww's transition takes, in milliseconds.
        function set(name: string, delay: int): void { wallpaper.show(name, delay); }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "updates"
        function refresh(): void { Sys.refreshUpdates(); }
    }
}
```

## `config/quickshell/penumbra/sun.js`

```javascript
.pragma library

// Sunrise and sunset for night light's schedule, worked out here rather than looked up: NOAA's
// approximation, within a minute or two away from the poles.

// times(date, latitude, longitude) → { rise, set } in minutes after the local midnight of `date`
// (this computer's time zone), or { polar: "day" } / { polar: "night" } when the sun doesn't set
// or rise that day. Latitude and longitude are in degrees, north and east positive.
function times(date, latitude, longitude) {
    const rad = Math.PI / 180;
    const day = Math.round((new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()) - new Date(date.getFullYear(), 0, 1)) / 86400000);
    const year = 2 * Math.PI / 365 * (day + 0.5); // the fractional year, at noon
    const equation = 229.18 * (0.000075 + 0.001868 * Math.cos(year) - 0.032077 * Math.sin(year)
        - 0.014615 * Math.cos(2 * year) - 0.040849 * Math.sin(2 * year));
    const declination = 0.006918 - 0.399912 * Math.cos(year) + 0.070257 * Math.sin(year)
        - 0.006758 * Math.cos(2 * year) + 0.000907 * Math.sin(2 * year)
        - 0.002697 * Math.cos(3 * year) + 0.00148 * Math.sin(3 * year);
    // The sun's centre 0.833° below the horizon: refraction and its radius.
    const cosHour = Math.cos(90.833 * rad) / (Math.cos(latitude * rad) * Math.cos(declination))
        - Math.tan(latitude * rad) * Math.tan(declination);
    if (cosHour > 1)
        return { polar: "night" };
    if (cosHour < -1)
        return { polar: "day" };
    const hour = Math.acos(cosHour) / rad;
    // Solar noon in UTC minutes, then in local time.
    const noon = 720 - 4 * longitude - equation - new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate(), 12).getTimezoneOffset();
    const wrap = m => (Math.round(m) % 1440 + 1440) % 1440;
    return { rise: wrap(noon - 4 * hour), set: wrap(noon + 4 * hour) };
}

// "21:30" → 1290, or -1 when it isn't a time.
function minutes(text) {
    const m = /^([01]?\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$/.exec(text.trim());
    return m ? Number(m[1]) * 60 + Number(m[2]) : -1;
}

// 1290 → "21:30".
function clock(minutes) {
    const m = (Math.round(minutes) % 1440 + 1440) % 1440;
    return String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0");
}

// Whether `now` (minutes) falls between `from` and `to`, across midnight when `to` comes first.
function between(now, from, to) {
    return from <= to ? now >= from && now < to : now >= from || now < to;
}

// zone1970.tab's coordinates, "+4852+00220" or "+404251-0740023" → { latitude, longitude }.
function coordinates(text) {
    const m = /^([+-]\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})?([+-]\d{3})(\d{2})(\d{2})?$/.exec(text);
    if (!m)
        return null;
    const part = (d, mm, ss) => (d.startsWith("-") ? -1 : 1) * (Math.abs(Number(d)) + Number(mm) / 60 + Number(ss ?? 0) / 3600);
    return { latitude: part(m[1], m[2], m[3]), longitude: part(m[4], m[5], m[6]) };
}

// Low-order lunar/solar longitude model (degrees), including the Moon's principal
// perturbations. An approximate geocentric phase, not a rise/set or eclipse ephemeris.
function moon(date) {
    const d = (date.getTime() - Date.UTC(2000, 0, 1, 12)) / 86400000;
    const rad = Math.PI / 180;
    const sin = a => Math.sin(a * rad);
    const wrap = a => (a % 360 + 360) % 360;
    const solarMean = wrap(357.529 + 0.98560028 * d);
    const solar = wrap(280.459 + 0.98564736 * d + 1.915 * sin(solarMean) + 0.020 * sin(2 * solarMean));
    const anomaly = wrap(134.963 + 13.064993 * d);
    const elongation = wrap(297.850 + 12.190749 * d);
    const latitude = wrap(93.272 + 13.229350 * d);
    const lunar = 218.316 + 13.176396 * d + 6.289 * sin(anomaly)
        + 1.274 * sin(2 * elongation - anomaly) + 0.658 * sin(2 * elongation)
        + 0.214 * sin(2 * anomaly) - 0.186 * sin(solarMean) - 0.114 * sin(2 * latitude);
    const phase = wrap(lunar - solar) / 360;
    const names = ["New moon", "Waxing crescent", "First quarter", "Waxing gibbous", "Full moon", "Waning gibbous", "Last quarter", "Waning crescent"];
    const glyphs = ["🌑", "🌒", "🌓", "🌔", "🌕", "🌖", "🌗", "🌘"];
    const index = Math.round(phase * 8) % 8;
    return { phase, illumination: (1 - Math.cos(phase * 2 * Math.PI)) / 2, name: names[index], glyph: glyphs[index] };
}
```

## `config/rofi/penumbra.rasi`

```css
/* Colours come from colors.rasi, generated from palette/palette.toml. */
@import "colors"
* { background-color: transparent; text-color: @fg; border-color: @line; }
window { width: 640px; padding: 26px; border: 1px; border-radius: 22px; background-color: @bg; }
mainbox { spacing: 22px; children: [ inputbar, listview, mode-switcher ]; }
inputbar { padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background-color: @field; spacing: 14px; children: [ prompt, entry ]; }
prompt { text-color: @accent; font: "Inter Bold 11"; vertical-align: 0.5; }
entry { placeholder: "Search your applications…"; placeholder-color: @muted; }
listview { lines: 6; columns: 1; spacing: 5px; fixed-height: true; }
element { padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; spacing: 14px; }
element selected.normal { background-color: @selection; text-color: @accent; }
element-icon { size: 28px; }
element-text { vertical-align: 0.5; text-color: inherit; }
mode-switcher { spacing: 10px; }
button { padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; text-color: @muted; font: "Inter 10"; }
button selected { text-color: @accent; background-color: @field; }
message { padding: 10px; }
/* Corner style: penumbra-corners rewrites this to square everything off. */
@import "corners"
```
