```toml
format = "[](#1c1528)[$symbol$branch]($style)[](#1c1528) "
[git_status]
style = "#e5c89a"
[cmd_duration]
min_time = 2000
format = "[ · $duration ](#8f809f)"
[time]
disabled = false
time_format = "%H:%M"
format = "[󰥔 $time](#71637f)"
```

## `config/systemd/user/penumbra-awww.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Penumbra wallpaper daemon (awww)
PartOf=graphical-session.target
After=graphical-session.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecCondition=/bin/sh -c 'test -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/awww-daemon
# A new daemon starts blank: show the wallpaper again.
ExecStartPost=-/bin/sh -c 'exec "$HOME/.local/bin/penumbra-wallpaper" restore'
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
```

## `config/systemd/user/penumbra-cliphist@.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Penumbra clipboard history (%i)
PartOf=graphical-session.target
After=graphical-session.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecCondition=/bin/sh -c 'test -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"'
# penumbra-session starts one for text and one for images. Copies a password manager marks as
# sensitive (x-kde-passwordManagerHint) reach cliphist with CLIPBOARD_STATE=sensitive, and it
# skips them (wl-clipboard 2.2 and cliphist 0.5 or newer).
ExecStart=/usr/bin/wl-paste --type %i --watch cliphist store
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
```

## `config/systemd/user/penumbra-hypridle.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Penumbra idle: dim, lock, screens off and suspend (hypridle)
PartOf=graphical-session.target
After=graphical-session.target penumbra-shell.service
# Without it the screen no longer locks when idle or before sleep, so it keeps coming back.
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=10

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecCondition=/bin/sh -c 'test -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/hypridle
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
```

## `config/systemd/user/penumbra-lock-fallback.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Penumbra lock fallback: hyprlock when the shell can no longer come back while locked
# penumbra-shell.service starts this through OnFailure= once systemd gives up restarting it.

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# Only when the session was locked (the shell keeps that outside itself), and while the
# compositor is up.
ExecCondition=/bin/sh -c 'test -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" && grep -qx locked "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/penumbra-locked"'
# hyprlock takes over the session lock the dead shell left (allow_session_lock_restore). Once
# unlocked there the session is unlocked, so the marker goes and the next shell does not lock again.
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'pidof hyprlock >/dev/null || hyprlock; rm -f "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/penumbra-locked"'
```

## `config/systemd/user/penumbra-shell.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=Penumbra shell: bar, notifications, launcher, lock screen and polkit agent
PartOf=graphical-session.target
After=graphical-session.target
# A shell that keeps crashing stops being restarted.
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5
# Once systemd gives up, a session that was locked stays locked under hyprlock.
OnFailure=penumbra-lock-fallback.service

[Service]
Type=exec
# Only while the compositor is up: after logging out its socket is gone, and the unit is skipped
# rather than restarted in a loop.
ExecCondition=/bin/sh -c 'test -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"'
# Video wallpapers decode through VA-API before CUDA: Qt otherwise opens a CUDA context on a
# hybrid laptop's NVIDIA card, which costs ~50 MB and keeps that card awake.
Environment=QT_FFMPEG_DECODING_HW_DEVICE_TYPES=vaapi,cuda
Environment=QT_FFMPEG_ENCODING_HW_DEVICE_TYPES=vaapi,cuda
# Quickshell allocates with jemalloc, which by default keeps an arena per thread per core and
# holds on to what they free: one arena, purged after a second, about halves the shell's memory.
# Ui.spawn keeps this from the apps it starts.
Environment=MALLOC_CONF=narenas:1,background_thread:true,dirty_decay_ms:1000,muzzy_decay_ms:0
ExecStart=/usr/bin/quickshell -c penumbra
# If the shell dies (even while the screen is locked) it comes back, and locks again if it was.
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
# Apps started from the shell run in their own scopes (Ui.spawn), so they survive a restart.
```

## `config/xdg-desktop-portal/portals.conf`

```ini
[preferred]
default=hyprland;gtk
# Open, Select Folder and Save dialogs are Lia Files' when its native build is installed; the
# portal skips a backend that isn't installed, so gtk until then.
org.freedesktop.impl.portal.FileChooser=lia;gtk
# Sandboxed apps keep their passwords in gnome-keyring.
org.freedesktop.impl.portal.Secret=gnome-keyring
```

```css
        --newtab-text-secondary-color: #c8bbde !important;
        --newtab-background-color-secondary: #1c1528 !important;
        --newtab-primary-action-background: #b69af7 !important;
        --newtab-element-hover-color: #38264f !important;
    }
    body {
        background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 15%, rgba(109,40,217, 0.24), transparent 65%), #0d0a12 !important;
        color: #e9e1f5 !important;
    }
    .search-wrapper .search-handoff-button, .search-wrapper input {
        border-radius: 28px !important;
        background-color: rgba(28,21,40, 0.85) !important;
        border: 1px solid #33263f !important;
        color: #e9e1f5 !important;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) !important;
    }
    .search-wrapper .search-handoff-button:focus-within {
        outline: 2px solid #b69af7 !important;
    }
    .top-site-outer .tile {
        border-radius: 18px !important;
        background: linear-gradient(rgba(28,21,40, 0.8), rgba(16,13,24, 0.65)) !important;
        border: 1px solid #33263f !important;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) !important;
    }
    .top-site-outer:hover { background-color: #38264f !important; border-radius: 18px !important; }
    .top-site-outer .title { color: #c8bbde !important; }
}
```

```css
/* PENUMBRA colours for Firefox's toolbars, tabs and menus. Generated by tools/build-palette.py
   from palette/palette.toml; do not edit. ./install.sh imports it from each profile's

    --toolbar-field-color: #e9e1f5 !important;

    --toolbar-field-focus-background-color: #1c1528 !important;
    --toolbar-field-focus-color: #faf5ff !important;
    --toolbar-field-focus-border-color: #b69af7 !important;
    --toolbarbutton-hover-background: #1c1528 !important;
    --toolbarbutton-active-background: #38264f !important;
    --toolbarbutton-icon-fill-attention: #b69af7 !important;
    --tab-selected-bgcolor: #0d0a12 !important;
    --tab-selected-textcolor: #faf5ff !important;
    --tab-hover-background-color: #1c1528 !important;
    --tab-loading-fill: #b69af7 !important;
    --tab-attention-icon-color: #b69af7 !important;
    --lwt-tab-line-color: #b69af7 !important;
    --chrome-content-separator-color: #33263f !important;
    --focus-outline-color: #b69af7 !important;
    --arrowpanel-background: #16111f !important;
    --arrowpanel-color: #e9e1f5 !important;
    --arrowpanel-border-color: #33263f !important;
    --panel-separator-color: #33263f !important;
    --button-hover-bgcolor: #38264f !important;
    --urlbarView-highlight-background: #38264f !important;
    --urlbarView-highlight-color: #faf5ff !important;
    --urlbarView-separator-color: #33263f !important;
    --sidebar-background-color: #100d18 !important;
    --sidebar-text-color: #c8bbde !important;
    --sidebar-border-color: #33263f !important;
    --newtab-background-color: #0d0a12 !important;
    --color-accent-primary: #b69af7 !important;
    --color-accent-primary-hover: #c4a5ff !important;
    --color-accent-primary-active: #916dcf !important;
    --button-text-color-primary: #100b1b !important;
    /* Current Firefox token names; keep the older names above for earlier releases. */
    --toolbox-background-color: #100d18 !important;
    --toolbox-background-color-inactive: #100d18 !important;
    --toolbox-text-color: #c8bbde !important;
    --toolbox-text-color-inactive: #8f809f !important;
    --toolbar-background-color: #0d0a12 !important;
    --toolbar-text-color: #e9e1f5 !important;
    --toolbar-field-text-color: #e9e1f5 !important;
    --toolbar-field-text-color-focus: #faf5ff !important;
    --toolbar-field-background-color-focus: #1c1528 !important;
    --toolbar-field-border-color-focus: #b69af7 !important;
    --tab-background-color-selected: #0d0a12 !important;
    --tab-background-color-hover: #1c1528 !important;
    --tab-text-color: #c8bbde !important;
    --tab-text-color-selected: #faf5ff !important;
    --tab-text-color-hover: #faf5ff !important;
}
::selection {
    background-color: #563b7e !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* Floating tabs preserve Firefox's pinned-tab and vertical-tab sizing. */
.tab-background {
    border-radius: 10px !important;
    margin: 4px 2px !important;
    border: 1px solid transparent !important;
    transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease !important;
}
.tab-background[selected] {
    background: linear-gradient(#1c1528, #0d0a12) !important;
    border-color: #33263f !important;
    border-top-color: #6d28d9 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) !important;
}
#urlbar-background, #searchbar {
    border-radius: 14px !important;
    transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease !important;
}
#urlbar[focused] > #urlbar-background {
    border-color: #b69af7 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(182,154,247, 0.18), 0 5px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) !important;
}
.urlbar-input-container { padding-inline: 8px !important; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .tab-background, #urlbar-background, #searchbar { transition: none !important; }
}
```

```css
  --popover-bg-color: #16111f;
  --popover-fg-color: #e9e1f5;
  --thumbnail-bg-color: #1c1528;
  --thumbnail-fg-color: #e9e1f5;
  --error-bg-color: #ef8fa4;
  --error-fg-color: #100b1b;
  --success-bg-color: #a5ccb3;
  --success-fg-color: #0d0a12;
  --warning-bg-color: #e5c89a;
  --warning-fg-color: #0d0a12;
  --shade-color: alpha(#07070b, 0.36);
  --scrollbar-outline-color: #33263f;
  --borders: #33263f;
  --lia-hover-bg: alpha(#38264f, 0.65);
  --lia-fast: 160ms;
  --lia-normal: 260ms;
  --lia-slow: 420ms;
  --lia-window-opacity: 0.85;
  --lia-view-opacity: 0.98;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root { --lia-window-opacity: 0.88; }
}

/* gtk.css is a user stylesheet too: these surface rules must override its
   opaque window/headerbar rules at the same priority. */
window.lia-window {
  background-color: alpha(var(--window-bg-color), var(--lia-window-opacity));
  color: var(--window-fg-color);
}
window.lia-window headerbar,
window.lia-window toolbarview > top-bar,
window.lia-window toolbarview > bottom-bar,
window.lia-window overlay-split-view > sidebar,
window.lia-window lia-sidebar {
  background: none;
}
window.lia-window headerbar { color: var(--headerbar-fg-color); }
```

## `apps/vesktop/config/vesktop/themes/penumbra.theme.css`

```css
/**
 * @name Penumbra
 * @author Penumbra
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description The Penumbra desktop's colours: near-black, violet and soft pastels. Generated by
 * tools/build-palette.py from palette/palette.toml; do not edit.
 */

/* Discord's dark themes, before and after its 2025 visual refresh. */
.theme-dark, .theme-darker, .theme-midnight, .visual-refresh.theme-dark, .visual-refresh .theme-dark {
    --background-primary: rgba(13,10,18, 0.78);
    --background-secondary: rgba(16,13,24, 0.72);
    --background-secondary-alt: rgba(22,17,31, 0.76);
    --background-tertiary: rgba(16,13,24, 0.72);

    --modal-footer-background: #16111f;
    --input-background: #1c1528;
    --scrollbar-thin-thumb: #59446a;
    --scrollbar-auto-thumb: #59446a;
    --scrollbar-auto-track: #100d18;

    --background-base-lowest: transparent;
    --bg-overlay-chat: rgba(13,10,18, 0.75);
    --background-base-lower: rgba(13,10,18, 0.78);
    --background-base-low: rgba(16,13,24, 0.72);
    --background-surface-high: #16111f;
    --background-surface-higher: #1c1528;
    --background-surface-highest: #1f182b;
    --chat-background-default: rgba(13,10,18, 0.75);
    --panel-bg: rgba(16,13,24, 0.72);
    --border-subtle: #33263f;
    --border-normal: #33263f;
    --border-strong: #42344f;

    --text-normal: #e9e1f5;
    --text-default: #e9e1f5;

    --text-muted: #8f809f;

    --text-warning: #e5c89a;
    --text-danger: #ef8fa4;
    --text-brand: #b69af7;
    --header-primary: #faf5ff;
    --header-secondary: #c8bbde;
    --channels-default: #8f809f;

    --interactive-normal: #c8bbde;

    --interactive-muted: #71637f;
    --icon-default: #c8bbde;
    --icon-muted: #8f809f;

    --brand-experiment: #b69af7;
    --brand-500: #b69af7;
    --brand-560: #916dcf;
    --brand-600: #7655ae;
    --control-brand-foreground: #b69af7;
    --control-brand-foreground-new: #b69af7;
    --mention-background: #38264f;
    --mention-foreground: #c4a5ff;
    --info-positive-foreground: #a5ccb3;
    --info-warning-foreground: #e5c89a;
    --info-danger-foreground: #ef8fa4;
    --status-positive: #a5ccb3;
    --status-warning: #e5c89a;
    --status-danger: #ef8fa4;
}

/* Remove the full-window underpaint so the translucent surfaces reach the compositor.
   install.sh enables Vencord's transparent window option; restart Vesktop after installing. */
html, body, #app-mount,
#app-mount > [class^="app_"], #app-mount [class^="bg_"] {
    background: transparent !important;
}

::selection {
    background: #563b7e;
    color: #ffffff;
}
```

```
# Penumbra: let the desktop session set the battery's charge limit (Settings → Battery care in the
# shell). Only on laptops whose firmware offers charge_control_end_threshold.
SUBSYSTEM=="power_supply", ATTR{type}=="Battery", TEST=="charge_control_end_threshold", RUN+="/bin/chmod 0666 /sys%p/charge_control_end_threshold"
```

## `system/usr/share/sddm/themes/penumbra/Main.qml`

```qml
import QtQuick 2.15
import QtQuick.Controls 2.15
import QtQuick.Layouts 1.15
import "palette.js" as P

// The sign-in screen. It is laid out like the shell's lock screen (the clock high in the centre,
// you and the password field below), so signing in and unlocking look like one place.
Rectangle {
 id: root
 width: 1280; height: 800; color: P.shade
 // Every size is designed for a 1280×800 screen and grows with larger ones.
 readonly property real u: Math.max(1, Math.min(width / 1280, height / 800))
 property date now: new Date()
 property bool busy: false
 property string error: ""
 function login() { if (!busy && username.text.length) { busy = true; error = ""; sddm.login(username.text, password.text, session.currentIndex); } }
 // #rrggbb with an alpha, as #aarrggbb.
 function alpha(color, a) { return "#" + ("0" + Math.round(a * 255).toString(16)).slice(-2) + color.slice(1); }

 Image { anchors.fill: parent; source: "wallpaper.png"; fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop }
 // Darker toward the bottom, where the password field sits, as on the lock screen.
 Rectangle {
  anchors.fill: parent
  gradient: Gradient {
   GradientStop { position: 0; color: root.alpha(P.base, 0.25) }
   GradientStop { position: 0.55; color: root.alpha(P.base, 0.35) }
   GradientStop { position: 1; color: root.alpha(P.base, 0.78) }
  }
 }
 Timer { interval: 1000; repeat: true; running: true; onTriggered: root.now = new Date() }

 Item {
  id: content
  anchors.fill: parent
  opacity: 0
  Component.onCompleted: entrance.start()
  NumberAnimation { id: entrance; target: content; property: "opacity"; from: 0; to: 1; duration: 840; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }

  // ── Clock ──
  ColumnLayout {
   anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
   y: Math.round(parent.height * 0.2)
   spacing: 0
   Text {
    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
    text: Qt.formatTime(root.now, "HH:mm")
    color: P.text; font.family: "Inter Display"; font.weight: Font.Light; font.pixelSize: 112 * root.u; font.letterSpacing: -1
    font.features: { "tnum": 1 }
   }
   Text {
    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
    text: Qt.formatDate(root.now, "dddd d MMMM")
    color: P.accent; font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 14 * root.u; font.letterSpacing: 3 * root.u; font.capitalization: Font.AllUppercase
   }
  }

  // ── You and your password ──
  ColumnLayout {
   anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
   y: Math.round(parent.height * 0.56)
   spacing: 14 * root.u

   // The initial of whoever signs in, on the violet disc the lock screen shows.
   Rectangle {
    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
    width: 76 * root.u; height: width; radius: width / 2
    border.width: 2; border.color: P.accent
    gradient: Gradient { GradientStop { position: 0; color: P.accent } GradientStop { position: 1; color: P.accentDeep } }
    Text {
     anchors.centerIn: parent
     text: username.text.charAt(0).toUpperCase()
     color: P.onAccent; font.family: "Inter Display"; font.bold: true; font.pixelSize: 30 * root.u
    }
   }
   TextField {
    id: username
    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
    implicitWidth: 240 * root.u; implicitHeight: 34 * root.u
    text: userModel.lastUser; placeholderText: "Username"; horizontalAlignment: TextInput.AlignHCenter
    color: P.text; placeholderTextColor: P.muted; font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 15 * root.u; font.weight: Font.DemiBold
    background: Rectangle {
     radius: height / 2
     color: username.activeFocus || username.hovered ? root.alpha(P.surface, 0.7) : "transparent"
     border.color: username.activeFocus ? P.accent : "transparent"
    }
    onAccepted: password.forceActiveFocus()
   }
   TextField {
    id: password
    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
    Layout.topMargin: 4 * root.u
    implicitWidth: 320 * root.u; implicitHeight: 52 * root.u
    placeholderText: "Password"; echoMode: TextInput.Password; passwordCharacter: "●"; horizontalAlignment: TextInput.AlignHCenter
    color: P.text; placeholderTextColor: P.muted; font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 15 * root.u
    leftPadding: rightPadding
    rightPadding: (layoutButton.visible ? layoutButton.width + 10 * root.u : 0) + 54 * root.u
    enabled: !root.busy
    background: Rectangle {
     radius: height / 2
     color: root.alpha(P.surface, 0.88)
     border.width: password.activeFocus ? 2 : 1
     border.color: root.error !== "" ? P.rose : password.activeFocus ? P.accent : root.alpha(P.accent, 0.34)
    }
    onAccepted: root.login()
    // With several keyboard layouts, the one the password is typed in; click to switch.
    Rectangle {
     id: layoutButton
     visible: keyboard.layouts.length > 1
     anchors.right: submit.left; anchors.rightMargin: 8 * root.u; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
     width: layoutText.implicitWidth + 16 * root.u; height: 26 * root.u; radius: height / 2
     color: layoutArea.containsMouse ? P.hover : "transparent"; border.color: P.border
     Text {
      id: layoutText; anchors.centerIn: parent
      text: (keyboard.layouts[keyboard.currentLayout] ? keyboard.layouts[keyboard.currentLayout].shortName : "").toUpperCase()
      color: P.textSoft; font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 11 * root.u; font.bold: true
     }
     MouseArea {
      id: layoutArea; anchors.fill: parent; hoverEnabled: true; cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
      onClicked: { keyboard.currentLayout = (keyboard.currentLayout + 1) % keyboard.layouts.length; password.forceActiveFocus(); }
     }
    }
    // Sign in.
    Rectangle {
     id: submit
     anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.rightMargin: 6 * root.u; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
     width: 40 * root.u; height: width; radius: width / 2
     color: submitArea.containsMouse ? P.accentBright : P.accent
     opacity: root.busy ? 0.5 : 1
     Behavior on color { ColorAnimation { duration: 160 } }
     Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "→"; color: P.onAccent; font.family: "Inter"; font.bold: true; font.pixelSize: 18 * root.u }
     MouseArea { id: submitArea; anchors.fill: parent; hoverEnabled: true; cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor; onClicked: root.login() }
    }
   }
   // Signing in, a sign-in error, else a Caps Lock warning.
   Text {
    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
    Layout.minimumHeight: 16 * root.u
    text: root.busy ? "Signing in…" : root.error !== "" ? root.error : keyboard.capsLock ? "Caps Lock is on" : ""
    color: root.busy ? P.textSoft : root.error !== "" ? P.rose : P.amber
    font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 12 * root.u
   }
  }

  // ── Footer: the wordmark, the session, and power ──
  Text {
   anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom; anchors.margins: 32 * root.u
   text: "PENUMBRA"
   color: root.alpha(P.accent, 0.8); font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 11 * root.u; font.weight: Font.DemiBold; font.letterSpacing: 5 * root.u
  }
  RowLayout {
   anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom; anchors.margins: 24 * root.u
   spacing: 6 * root.u
   ComboBox {
    id: session; implicitHeight: 34 * root.u; implicitWidth: 220 * root.u
    model: sessionModel; textRole: "name"; currentIndex: sessionModel.lastIndex
    palette.button: P.raised; palette.buttonText: P.textSoft; palette.text: P.text; palette.base: P.raised; palette.highlight: P.selection; palette.highlightedText: P.selectionText; palette.window: P.surfaceAlt
    font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 12 * root.u
    background: Rectangle { color: session.hovered ? root.alpha(P.hover, 0.8) : root.alpha(P.surface, 0.6); radius: height / 2; border.color: root.alpha(P.accent, 0.16) }
   }
   Repeater {
    model: [
     { label: "Suspend", show: sddm.canSuspend, run: function() { sddm.suspend() } },
     { label: "Restart", show: true, run: function() { powerDialog.action = "restart"; powerDialog.open() } },
     { label: "Shut down", show: true, run: function() { powerDialog.action = "shutdown"; powerDialog.open() } }
    ]
    delegate: Rectangle {
     visible: modelData.show
     implicitWidth: powerText.implicitWidth + 28 * root.u; implicitHeight: 34 * root.u; radius: height / 2
     color: powerArea.containsMouse ? root.alpha(P.hover, 0.8) : "transparent"
     Text { id: powerText; anchors.centerIn: parent; text: modelData.label; color: powerArea.containsMouse ? P.text : P.muted; font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 12 * root.u }
     MouseArea { id: powerArea; anchors.fill: parent; hoverEnabled: true; cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor; onClicked: modelData.run() }
    }
   }
  }
 }

 MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; z: -1; onClicked: password.forceActiveFocus() }

 Dialog {
  id: powerDialog; property string action: ""; anchors.centerIn: parent; title: action === "restart" ? "Restart computer?" : "Shut down computer?"; modal: true
  standardButtons: Dialog.Ok | Dialog.Cancel; font.family: "Inter"; font.pixelSize: 13 * root.u
  palette.window: P.surfaceAlt; palette.windowText: P.text; palette.button: P.hover; palette.buttonText: P.accent
  onAccepted: { if (action === "restart") sddm.reboot(); else sddm.powerOff(); }
 }
 Connections {
  target: sddm
  function onLoginFailed() { root.busy = false; password.text = ""; root.error = "Sign-in failed. Please try again."; password.forceActiveFocus(); }
  function onLoginSucceeded() { root.error = ""; }
 }
 Component.onCompleted: { if (username.text.length) password.forceActiveFocus(); else username.forceActiveFocus(); }
}
```

```text
# Penumbra — original orbital artwork, using GRUB's bundled Unicode font.
desktop-image: "background.png"

title-text: ""

    color = "#b69af7"
}

    color = "#b69af7"
    font = "Unifont Regular 16"
}
```
